TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Not at all the circumstances under which I had hoped to visit Ishgard for the first time, but so be it.
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_TATARU_000_011: They say the winds can be rather fierce on the Steps of Faith. Be sure to wrap up before we go!
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_HAURCHEFANT_000_020: I must go on ahead and speak with the count. Fear not, however, for everything has been arranged.
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_HAURCHEFANT_000_021: The sentries at the Gates of Judgement have been informed of our decision. You need but state your names, and they will allow you to pass.
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_HAURCHEFANT_000_022: My manservant shall be waiting for you at the city gates, ready to escort you to our manor, where we shall meet again. Until then!
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_TEMPLEKNIGHT01580_0: Wards of House Fortemps? Ah, yes... You may pass.
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_ALPHINAUD_000_031: From afar, the spires did not seem so tall...
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_TATARU_000_032: Gods... I feel like a child in a giant's castle!
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_BUTLER01580_000_040: Greetings,  . On behalf of House Fortemps, I bid you welcome to Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_BUTLER01580_000_041: My lord humbly requests your presence at his residence in the Pillars.
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_BUTLER01580_000_042: If you all would come with me...
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_ALPHINAUD_000_043: To look upon the splendor of these heights, one would little suspect the ruin wrought by the wyverns below...
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_TATARU_000_044: Is it just me, or is the air up here different? You can almost smell the wealth and power! Gods, it's making me feel faint...
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_HOUSEFORTEMPSGUARD0: Greetings, , and welcome to Fortemps Manor.
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_HAURCHEFANT_000_050: The Warrior of Light and  brave companions, walking the streets of Ishgard at last! What a glorious sight!
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_HAURCHEFANT_000_051: I cannot tell you how long I have waited for this day. Allow me to present to you my family home: Fortemps Manor!
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_HAURCHEFANT_000_052: I should like nothing more than to show you around, but everyone is gathered to receive you.
TEXT_HEAVNA101_01580_HAURCHEFANT_000_053: Come, my friends! Introductions must be made!
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Though our friends in House Fortemps have been generous enough to extend us their protection, we must take care not to impose too much on their hospitality.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_011: It is only proper that we learn about our new home, so that we might become more self-sufficient.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_TATARU_000_012: It'll take a while to learn the lay of the land, but learn it we must. Then there's the markets and taverns─we'll need to know where to shop and where to hear small talk.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_013: 'Twould seem a tour of the city is indeed in order.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_014: I thank you for your counsel, my lord. My companions and I shall of course do as you suggest.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_EDMONT_000_015: Very good. Then my manservant shall accompany you. He will be able to answer any questions you might have.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_EDMONT_000_016: Ah, but I grow forgetful in my dotage─there is something I must give you ere we part.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_EDMONT_000_017: Their documentation is in order, I trust?
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_EDMONT_000_019: Those documents identify you as wards of House Fortemps.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_EDMONT_000_020: Given that our borders have remained closed for decades, many of my countrymen are unaccustomed to treating with foreigners.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_EDMONT_000_021: Should anyone happen to question your presence here, it may prove necessary to remind them that you remain under the protection of House Fortemps. But let us hope it shall not come to that.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Rest assured that we shall do our utmost to avoid any situation which might compel us to invoke your name.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_TATARU_000_025: So this is what the inside of the manor of a High House looks like! To think that Lord Haurchefant was raised here...
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_EDMONT_000_026: As I said before, my home is your home. After all you have done on our behalf, it is the least I can offer.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_EMMANELLAIN_000_027: They'll be whispering about you soon, if they aren't already. “The mysterious guests of House Fortemps,” or some such.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ARTOIREL_000_028: Greetings, Scion, and welcome. We are honored by your presence.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_029: I confess, it had long been a dream of mine to visit Ishgard. To my childish self, her towers, bridges, and cobbled streets seemed akin to something from a faerie tale─and I have never quite outgrown the fantasy.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_TATARU_100_029: I'm glad I have a map!
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_030: As this is your first time in our fair city, pray permit me to show you to the Hoplon, from whence we may gaze upon the splendor of the Holy Vault. Though all other sights pale in comparison, 'tis only meet that you see it first.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_031: I shall then show you around the Jeweled Crozier, where you may purchase all manner of goods and services, before descending to Foundation's aetheryte plaza. If there are no questions...
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_032: The Holy Vault, where Archbishop Thordan VII rules from on high...
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_TATARU_000_033: They're awfully fond of statues, aren't they? Hey, what if I took up sculpting? I bet you could make a fortune in a place like this! And we need every gil we can get!
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_040: The Hoplon, so named for the bronze greatshield borne by our nation's patron deity, is the largest plaza in Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_041: The magnificent cathedral to the north is, of course, the Holy Vault.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_042: The Vault is both Ishgard's seat of government and the residence of the archbishop of the Ishgardian Orthodox Church.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Begging your pardon... The statues to the south─are they perchance Thordan's famed “knights twelve”?
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_044: Very good, Master Alphinaud. They are the fathers of Ishgard─the brave knights who joined with King Thordan I to put down Nidhogg and found this great nation.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_045: Ours is a city rich in history and tradition, and there is much you can learn by exploring the Pillars─time permitting, of course.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_046: Now then, if you would follow me to the Jeweled Crozier, I shall introduce you to Mistress Elaisse, our master of the markets.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_047: Not a single scorched stone in sight... To watch these merchants going about their business, one would think the dragons had never attacked.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_TATARU_000_048: If you want to buy something, let me do the talking. I could haggle for Ul'dah!
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_049: I present to you Mistress Elaisse. Mayhap you would like to say a few words?
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ELAISSE_000_050: Well you're clearly not locals or traveling peddlers, which makes you all...?
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ELAISSE_000_051: Ahhh, wards of House Fortemps! How very interesting.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Count Edmont has granted us leave to remain in Ishgard for as long as we wish─which may be some time.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Accordingly, we will have need of sundry goods, hence our desire to make your acquaintance. That is, of course, assuming you are content to accept the custom of foreigners. Should you be uncomfortable─
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ELAISSE_000_054: Young sir, we do not discriminate in matters of money. If you have coin to spend, who are we to refuse it?
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ELAISSE_000_055: Weapons, armor, accoutrements, medicine, materials─whatever your desire, it can be found in the Crozier. Our merchants will be more than happy to accommodate you, as you shall soon see.
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_056: Our next destination is the aetheryte plaza in Foundation. If everyone is ready...
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_ALPHINAUD_000_057: Hm? Oh, I have already attuned myself to the aetheryte. I trust you have as well?
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_TATARU_000_058: Do you ever get a funny tingling feeling when you attune to an aetheryte, or is it just me? ...No? So, it is just me... Hmmm...
TEXT_HEAVNA102_01581_BUTLER01581_000_060: And here we have Foundation's aetheryte plaza. If you have yet to attune to the aetheryte, it would be wise to do so now.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Mayhap we should decide together. What else can be found nearby?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_BUTLER01582_000_002: The Skysteel Manufactory stands to the west. There our engineers conceive and manufacture weapons for use against the dragons. The Holy Stables, where chocobos are trained for war, also lie in that direction.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_BUTLER01582_000_003: To the north and east can be found the Congregation of Our Knights Most Heavenly, while to the south and east...well... 'Twould be best if you avoided that area.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_BUTLER01582_000_005: I...I fear our knights may not be able to ensure your safety in the lowest levels, Master Alphinaud...
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_THEPOOR01582_000_00: (-???-)Hold yer nose when ye pass the Brume, little lord! A delicate flower like you is like to wilt in our fumes!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_007: You misjudge me, sir, for I am no lord but a humble traveler.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_THEPOOR01582_000_00: Oh, come to see the sights, have ye? Take a turn down the Hoplon and gawp at the statues?
Bwahaha! Well, if ye've a mind to learn how the better half live, come and have a drink at the Forgotten Knight─if yer nursemaid'll let ye!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_BUTLER01582_000_010: My humblest apologies, Master Alphinaud. Pray pay that drunken lout no mind.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Oh, but I must. It would not do to refuse such a heartfelt invitation. Yes, I simply must see this Forgotten Knight for myself.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_012: I trust you see the wisdom in this, . There are few sources of information more abundant than a bustling local hostelry.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Not that I expect to hear any news of our missing comrades just yet. Nevertheless, who can say what we might learn of recent events?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_015: If you have attuned to the aetheryte then let us move on. I am eager to see more of the city.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_TATARU_000_016: You don't think it's anything serious, do you? The tingling, I mean. There couldn't be something wrong with my anima, could there...?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_017: Back so soon from your excursion? I confess, I thought you would want to see more of the city.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EMMANELLAIN_000_018: I suppose your presence here will serve to make us seem that much more mysterious by association. And few things are more attractive than an air of mystery...
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ARTOIREL_000_019: You are, of course, free to come and go as you please. Do let us know if you require anything.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_100_019: Mayhap one drink would be... No, no, I mustn't.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_TATARU_200_019: Hm. Hmmm... Yes, I've got a good feeling about this place.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_BUTLER01582_300_019: Once more, I must urge you to reconsider. There are several...gentlemen who appear less than pleased by our presence.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_GIBRILLONT_000_020: Must say, this is rather unusual. Not just one, but a whole party of fresh new faces in my tavern.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_021: We but recently arrived in Ishgard and are eager to acquaint ourselves with her more notable establishments, Master...?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_GIBRILLONT_000_022: Gibrillont─just Gibrillont'll do. And I'm flattered you think so highly of my establishment. Can't promise it'll live up to your expectations, but if it's decent food and drink you're after, you could do much worse.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Judging by the number of customers I see, I suspect your fare is rather more than decent. Speaking of your clientele...I could not help but note a difference between those who frequent the upper and lower floors...
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_GIBRILLONT_000_024: Spotted that, did you? Aye, up here you'll find peddlers, porters, off-duty knights, and so forth, dropping in on their way to or from somewhere else. Regulars maybe, but not locals.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_GIBRILLONT_000_025: Folks from the Brume, they tend to congregate downstairs, where we offer a menu more suited to their tastes. Cheaper meals, stronger spirits─all quality, mind, but not the sort of stuff I'd recommend to yourselves.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_026: You speak of the lowest levels, yes? Why do they call them the Brume, if I may ask?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_GIBRILLONT_000_027: 'Cause when the weather's foul and the brume rolls in thick, it's the poor sods living at the bottom who have to deal with it.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_GIBRILLONT_000_029: ...And it's not just the weather. When the wyverns broke through the wards and started tearing up the city, it was the Brume that got the worst of it, while the Pillars enjoyed the protection of the High Houses and the Temple Knights.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_GIBRILLONT_000_030: More'n a few people are still sore about that, mind, which is why, considering your present company, I'd recommend you keep your wits about you if you mean to go below─and something sharp in your boot, just to be sure.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_031: ...I shall take your words to heart, sir.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_BUTLER01582_000_032: Master Alphinaud, I think it would be best if we returned to Fortemps Manor.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_TATARU_000_033: You go on ahead without me. I'm staying for a drink or two!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_BUTLER01582_000_034: M-Miss Tataru...I am afraid that is out of the question! My lord the count would never forgive me if I abandoned one of his charges in such a place─least of all a maiden!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_035: What are you up to, Tataru?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_TATARU_000_036: Look around, Alphinaud─this tavern is full of people whose business regularly takes them beyond the Gates of Judgement.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_TATARU_000_037: With friends like that, I could practically live here and wait for the newest gossip to come to me.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_038: Indeed. But will you be safe here on your own?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_TATARU_000_039: Oh please─do you know how often I looked after the Waking Sands and the Rising Stones by myself? If I had a gil for every unwelcome caller I've driven away, I'd be rich beyond my wildest dreams! I'll be fiiine!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_GIBRILLONT_000_040: Not that I doubt the lady's knack for fending off unwanted advances, but I'll be damned if I'm going to let anyone lay an unwelcome hand on a patron in my establishment.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_041: That settles it, then. Tataru,  and I shall return to the manor for now. Contact me by linkpearl if you require assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_TATARU_000_043: Don't you worry, ─if there's any news of our friends, I'll find it!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ARTOIREL_000_044: How do you find our city? Beautiful, is it not?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EMMANELLAIN_000_045: Is that...? <sniff> <sniff> Aye, it is the smell of mead! Newly come and already sampling the delights of our taverns! Oh yes, I like you. I like you a lot.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_HONOROIT_000_046: Ah, pray do not concern yourself with me, .
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_050: Tell us, then, Master Alphinaud─does Ishgard meet with your expectations?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_051: That which I imagined pales in comparison to the reality. I felt the weight of a thousand years of history with every step I took...and when those steps took me past the scars left by the wyverns in Foundation, I understood how easily that history could end in tragedy.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_052: The attack was devastating─the casualties...unspeakable. The wyverns did not discriminate. Unarmed men and women...even children were given no quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_053: Ser Aymeric has ordered his knights to strengthen our defenses, and each house has been called upon to lend what support it can. There is much to be done, yet alas, able-bodied men and women are in short supply.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_054: Mayhap we could be of assistance, my lord? After all you have done for us, we would welcome any opportunity to repay your kindness.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_055: That is...a most generous offer, Master Alphinaud.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_056: You are guests in my home, to whom I have extended my hospitality without obligation, let, or lien. Nevertheless, Ishgard's need is great, and if you are willing to aid our cause, I cannot well refuse.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_057: Good. What would you ask of us?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_058: From what I have heard, you are an intelligent and persuasive young man. Such qualities may prove most useful to us in our efforts to secure provisions from foreign sources─identifying trustworthy suppliers, brokering contracts, and so on.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_059: As for you,  ... I could ask for no one better than a storied veteran such as yourself─a  with the capacity to act swiftly and decisively when needed─to aid Artoirel and Emmanellain in their duties.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ARTOIREL_000_061: I am more than capable of carrying out my duty by myself. I have no need of our honored guest's assistance!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EMMANELLAIN_000_062: Now, now, be reasonable, Brother. What manner of fool would say no when a famous hero offered to do his work?
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_063: Hold your tongues! By the Fury...the two of you will conduct yourselves with dignity befitting your station and show   the respect  deserves!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_064: and some half-dozen primals besides!  is not here to steal your glory or serve as your errand !
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_065: ...If you can pardon them their impropriety,  , I should be much obliged if you would lend my sons a helping hand.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EDMONT_000_066: My thanks. Fury willing, they may even learn something from you.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ARTOIREL_000_067: Forgive me,  . I was...unprepared for my father's decision.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_EMMANELLAIN_000_068: I look forward to working with you, ! It's going to be grand!
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_070: 'Twould seem we shall not want for employment over the coming days─though that was never in doubt.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Our host's initial reluctance to accept our offer of aid was solely for appearance's sake. In truth, he is glad of this opportunity to put us to work.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_072: By granting us patronage, House Fortemps has taken a tremendous risk. Until we demonstrate our worth to Ishgard at large, the count will face considerable opposition from his peers in matters great and small.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_073: And so he would have us publicly serve Ishgard─whilst simultaneously keeping his sons in check.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_074: 'Tis an arrangement we may benefit from in unexpected ways. My own duties may feasibly bring me into contact with people who know something of our missing comrades.
TEXT_HEAVNA103_01582_ALPHINAUD_000_075: And as you go about helping our two lords with their various responsibilities, you will inevitably make new acquaintances in Ishgard, mayhap even new allies. Yes...the more I think on it, the more confident I am that by furthering their goals, we shall further our own.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_000: Let us begin anew,  . I am Ser Artoirel de Fortemps, eldest son of Count Edmont de Fortemps.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_001: You will forgive me my outburst, I hope. I meant no disrespect. I merely consider myself equal to the duties entrusted to me...unlike some.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_002: ...Haurchefant has spoken of you often. If you are even half the  he claims, I shall be glad to have you at my side.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_003: To the matter at hand, then: we will be assisting my esteemed compatriots of houses Durendaire and Dzemael.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_004: You are aware of our friendly rivalry, I take it? Aye, well, suffice it to say, the prospect of assisting said houses does not fill me with joy.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_005: However, it is the will of the Holy See that we set aside our differences at this crucial juncture. But we shall speak more of that anon.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_006: First, we must needs secure transport to Falcon's Nest. Let us make for the chocobo stables in Foundation.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_STABLEHAND01583_000: Greetings,  . I've saddled a black chocobo for your journey to the western highlands, as per Lord Artoirel's instruction.

Will this be your first time riding a black chocobo, may I ask? If so, you're in for a treat. As I daresay you know, this particular breed can fly. Given the right conditions, they can carry you quite high, too─even over Snowcloak.

You needn't worry about directing the bird, of course. Like all porters, she's trained to carry you to your destination all by herself─so just relax and enjoy the view! Oh, but be sure not to relax your grip, will you? Two hands on the reins at all times, if you please.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_014: I've secured chocobo porters for the two of us. The chocobokeep has yours.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_020: The world looks quite different when viewed from the back of an airborne chocobo, does it not? I still find the experience strangely liberating...
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_021: To business. Ser Redwald is in charge here. He should be expecting us.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_REDWALD_000_030: It has been far, far too long, Lord Artoirel. And who might your companion be?
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_031: Pray forgive us our lateness, Ser Redwald. I present to you , ward of House Fortemps.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_REDWALD_000_032: Ahhh, yes, of course! Lord Drillemont spoke of you. I, Ser Redwald of House Durendaire, do bid you welcome to Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_033: We are both eager to contribute to the settlement's restoration. How may we be of service?
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_REDWALD_000_034: Before we speak of that─would I be correct in assuming that   is unfamiliar with our recent history? Then, with your permission, I shall recount the tale for  benefit.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_REDWALD_000_035: As you may know, Falcon's Nest was once a hamlet with a small garrison of knights and some few villagers. And then came the Calamity.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_REDWALD_000_036: When it became clear that the snow would not stop falling, we had no choice but to order a complete withdrawal. The settlement─and the entirety of the western highlands─were to be abandoned.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_037: ...Abandoned to the heretics. Lady Iceheart and her kind have walked these lands with impunity ever since.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_REDWALD_000_038: Aye, but no longer. The Holy See has commanded the reclamation of the western highlands and the expulsion of heretical elements.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_REDWALD_000_039: Falcon's Nest is key to accomplishing these objectives. But, as you can see, rebuilding the hamlet will be no small undertaking.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_REDWALD_000_040: Our craftsmen require support and protection. Any assistance you can offer will be greatly appreciated.
TEXT_HEAVNA104_01583_ARTOIREL_000_041: As promised, we of House Fortemps are at your disposal, Ser Redwald. You need but tell us where to begin.
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_REDWALD_000_000: Several craftsmen in service to House Dzemael are contributing to the restoration of Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_REDWALD_000_001: These men and women are quite skilled at building and repairing fortifications, but their progress has been hampered by a number of factors.
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_REDWALD_000_002: Rothe, their foreman, tells me he has need of a  with your talents. Would you be so kind as to seek him out?
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_ARTOIREL_000_003: Ser Redwald and I discussing how to deal with the heretics in this region. In the meantime, I ask that you see to other matters.
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_REDWALD_000_004: Have you spoken with Rothe yet? He was asking after an assistant not long ago.
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_ROTHE_000_010: Hm? Yes, I'm Rothe, and who might you be...?
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_ROTHE_000_011: Ah, the promised help! Glad to have you aboard!
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_ROTHE_000_012: I've the honor of overseein' this fine mess you see before you. Sent me over on one of them black birds, same as you, to build and mend and tell others how to build and mend. But Fury take me, this ice! It's bloody unnatural how fast it forms!
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_ROTHE_000_013: It's icicle sprites, I tell you. Mark my words, there're pockets of 'em here and there, just waitin' for me to turn my back so they can sneak out and do their dirty work! So I need you to search the hamlet and put an end to it. If you stand watch long enough, you're sure to find 'em.
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_ROTHE_000_020: I'm not mad, dammit! It's those bloody icicle sprites, gallivantin' around when no one's lookin'. Stand still long enough and you'll see!
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_ROTHE_000_030: Hah! Now there's a  what looks like  found  marks!
TEXT_HEAVNA105_01584_ROTHE_000_031: You're just the sort we need around here─the kind that'll hop to when  sees a task undone!
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_ROTHE_000_000: You're a dab hand at warcraft, I can tell. Not that I've any skill at arms to speak of, mind, but it doesn't take an expert to recognize expertise.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_ROTHE_000_001: Be a waste to keep you to myself when there're others out what need help same as me, so if you're keen to keep on doin' what you've done, I'd ask you to head north to the Pike─the bloody huge statue out in the wastes, if you've never been.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_ROTHE_000_002: Mason by the name of Thierremont is out there tendin' to the thing. Good man, Thierremont, but I reckon he's taken on too much work for one. Might be there's somethin' you can do for him.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_ROTHE_000_003: The Pike's due north of here. Just keep goin' and you'll see it in due time.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_010:
Hail to you, traveler! What brings you out this way?
...Hm? Foreman Rothe bid you assist me? Well, far be it from me to turn down a helping hand!
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_011: I've been tasked with the restoration of this sculpture. Five years of neglect have not been kind, to say the least.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_012: Fortunately, I've just the thing for it─rather, those deepeyes have it. If you could slay three and bring me their bristles, I would be in your debt.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_013: My work is far from finished, but if you could shear the bristles from three deepeyes for me, it would be a tremendous help.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_020: There you are. Have you the bristles?
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_021: Ahhh, feel how coarse that is? That's why they're perfect for scrubbing the soot from this statue.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_022: Beautiful, isn't it? The spitting image of Haldrath, first of the Azure Dragoons and one of Ishgard's founding fathers...
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_023: A symbol of everything the Dravanians despise, which is why they've taken to searing it with dragon fire every time they pass by.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_024: But no longer will we suffer this desecration of our nation's hero. Soon this statue will be as it once was─a proud, shining testament to the determination of Ishgard, and a message to the heretics that we have returned.
TEXT_HEAVNA106_01585_THIERREMONT_000_025: The work may be hard and the conditions harsh, but as a proud Ishgardian, I could ask for no greater honor.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_THIERREMONT_000_000: Are you for Falcon's Nest? If so, I've a favor to ask.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_THIERREMONT_000_001: There's this knight, Ser Ysaudore, stationed at the Anvil to the west of here. She's always treated me with kindness and respect─more than I deserve, to be honest...
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_THIERREMONT_000_002: Anyroad, while you were away, she came through on patrol, and I think she might have left a package behind.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_THIERREMONT_000_003: It's a bit of a detour, but would you mind returning it to her? My thanks to you, friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_THIERREMONT_000_004: You should be able to find Ser Ysaudore at the Anvil, to the west of here.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_THIERREMONT_000_005: It's not on the way to Falcon's Nest, I know, but, well...I'm fairly certain that belongs to her, and since I can't leave the Pike unattended...
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_YSAUDORE_000_010: What's that? A package? I haven't the foggiest what you're talking about.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_YSAUDORE_000_011: Confound it, that fool of a... <sigh> What a waste.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_YSAUDORE_000_012: It was a gift, adventurer. Thierremont labors day and night without regard for his own well-being. At the very least, he ought to try to eat better.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_YSAUDORE_000_013: ...Why not simply give it to him? By the Fury, have you no sense of decorum? A highborn knight cannot be seen favoring a lowborn mason in such a manner!
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_YSAUDORE_000_014: Nevertheless, I appreciate your concern, as well as your willingness to assist Thierremont.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_YSAUDORE_100_014: May your journey back to Falcon's Nest be safe and swift. Pray give my regards to Ser Redwald.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_YSAUDORE_000_015: Caught between a pike and anvil of my own─ Oh, you're still here! Ahem, er... Pray communicate my warmest regards to Ser Redwald...and nothing else.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_REDWALD_000_020: I must applaud your initiative,  . Rothe tells me you have been quite busy.
TEXT_HEAVNA107_01586_REDWALD_000_021: Alas, we have not the time to thank you properly. I have a task to which I would commit all able-bodied men and women─you and Lord Artoirel included.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_REDWALD_000_000: Calm as ever, even when you must surely sense the gravity of the situation. A veteran through and through, just as Lord Drillemont said. Good.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_REDWALD_000_001: We have lost contact with a reconnaissance party sent north to Riversmeet in search of the heretics' hideaway.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_REDWALD_000_002: Whether they were attacked or met with some other misfortune, we know not. But regardless of the cause, we must act quickly, for this is a harsh, unforgiving land which can claim─and has claimed─the lives of many men.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_REDWALD_000_003: To ensure we find our missing knights as quickly as possible, I have assigned each party a different area to search. You and Lord Artoirel will be working together. Seek him out when you are ready to depart, and good luck.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_REDWALD_000_004: Lord Artoirel has a map with the assigned areas. Bring our knights home,  .
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_010: It seems we have been assigned the area near Camp Riversmeet,  .
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_011: Lest you are unaware, the camp was one of many our knights were forced to abandon when we withdrew from the Coerthas western highlands─one of many sacrifices made in the wake of the Calamity.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_012: 'Twould not surprise me if our knights took shelter there. There is but one way to find out, though. Let us be off!
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_020: There, below us─Camp Riversmeet, or what remains of it.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_021: I see no way to descend the cliffs safely from here. Should we fall, the beasts below would make short work of us. Come─I know a path to the riverbed below, east of the Black Iron Bridge.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_030: If the reconnaissance party came this way, I see no sign of it.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_031: Still, it is possible that recent storms have obscured their trail, or that they took an alternate route to Camp Riversmeet. Until we investigate the camp itself, we cannot be certain. We must press on.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_032: Hmmm... The camp appears to be deserted, and yet I cannot shake the feeling that... Hm.  , pray search the camp while I stand watch. We dare not let the enemy take us unawares.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_040: Are you all right? I heard sounds of a struggle.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_KIGHT01583_000_041: Thank...thank the Fury... I thought no one would come...
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_042: Three heretics slain and one knight saved, just like that. You certainly live up to your reputation,  .
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_043: What happened here, ser? Is there no one else?
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_KIGHT01583_000_044: We were caught in a furious blizzard north of here, my lord. <cough> <wheeze> Naught but white all around...until we saw shapes moving towards us─running towards us, with naked steel in their hands.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_KIGHT01583_000_045: I cut down a few of the bastards who came close, but the others... There was shouting and screaming, but after a while I could only hear unfamiliar voices... I found my way to the camp, hoping to hide while the storm passed.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_045: But the heretics tracked you here.
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_KIGHT01583_000_046: Aye... <cough> <cough> ...My lord, the heretics' hideaway lies somewhere to the north. We must move quickly, before the snow buries all traces of their passing. For my brothers, we...we must... <cough> <wheeze>
TEXT_HEAVNA108_01587_ARTOIREL_000_047: Have faith, ser. Justice will be done. But first, we must see you to safety.
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_000: He has the right of it,  . Whatever remains of the heretics' trail will be gone with the next snowfall. But we cannot very well leave our friend here...
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_001: I will see him to Falcon's Nest and gather reinforcements. In the meantime, I would have you search the area to the north of the camp for signs of the attack. Should you pick up the heretics' trail, do not wait for me─follow it back to their lair forthwith, being sure to leave me some clear footprints.
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_002: ...I realize that this plan may place you in considerable danger, but I see no alternative.
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_003: Rest assured we will not be far behind. And ...thank you.
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_004: Do not concern yourself with our wounded man. When he has caught his breath, I shall see him safely back to Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_SYSTEM_000_010: The tracks continue to the north...
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_020: ! Praise Halone, you are alive! We came as swiftly as we could, but I see we are too late...
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_021: So they were lurking in the cellar of this farmhouse...
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_022: 'Tis a pity Lady Iceheart escaped, but we must not let that detract from your accomplishment! We have them on the run!
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_023: You have dealt our foes a telling blow this , my friend, and I shall see that your efforts are recognized.
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_ARTOIREL_000_030: Establishing an outpost in so remote a location could not have been easy. Tenacious devils.
TEXT_HEAVNA109_01588_KIGHTB01588_000_031: We are still searching the area, , but the only heretics we have found thus far are the ones you left behind.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_000: The knights have matters here well in hand. Let us return to Falcon's Nest and share our discoveries with Ser Redwald.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_001: Come! After tracking heretics across malms of ice and snow, I would say you are due a few hours' rest next to a warm fire.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_KIGHT01589_000_002: We'll take care of the rest, . If there are any heretics hiding hereabouts, we'll soon root them out.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_REDWALD_000_010: Lord Artoirel,  ! Full glad am I to see you both hale and healthy. What news?
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_REDWALD_000_011: ...You mean to say you hunted the heretics down on your own, and slew them before reinforcements could arrive? By the Fury!
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_012: I believe we have made great strides toward purging these lands of heretics─and I mean to say as much when I deliver my report to my father and the Holy See.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_REDWALD_000_013: As will I, Lord Artoirel. May it serve to remind our superiors what houses Durendaire and Fortemps could achieve through continued cooperation.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_014: Indeed. I trust you and your knights are content to handle the rest?
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_REDWALD_000_015: We most certainly are, my lord.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_REDWALD_000_016: During your short time with us, you and   have accomplished far more than I had thought possible. I cannot in good conscience impose upon you any longer. Pray return to Ishgard with my thanks.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_017: As you wish, Ser Redwald. We thank you for your hospitality.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_REDWALD_000_018: Mayhap your deeds here will serve to demonstrate the folly in continuing to exclude foreigners from our lands. With more hardworking men and women like you, Ishgard would be much the stronger.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_020: ...I would speak plain. From the first, I questioned your motives and your competence─unjustly, I now realize.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_021: Rumors have a way of growing more fantastic as they spread, and quite frankly, those surrounding you beggar belief. But Haurchefant swore that all the stories were true. He championed your cause and begged Father to grant you patronage...
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_022: And he duly listened, because for all his wisdom, he has never been able to say no to my dear half-brother─the legacy of my father's sole indiscretion.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_023: Mother hated him, of course. Even on her deathbed, she refused to acknowledge him. And...to be honest, she was not alone in her feelings.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_024:
But that is not the worst of it.
...At Camp Riversmeet, when we came upon the wounded knight, I knew immediately that one of us would have to pursue the heretics alone. An onerous task, fraught with danger...
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_025: And there you were─the savior of Eorzea and honored guest of House Fortemps. My new comrade-in-arms. Haurchefant's dear friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_026: I told myself it was to be a test, but part of me...part of me hoped that you would fail.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_027: Yet you accepted the task without a word of protest, nor any sign of fear. And you duly tracked the enemy down, faced him alone, and lived to tell the tale.
TEXT_HEAVNA110_01589_ARTOIREL_000_028: Plainly, Haurchefant had the right of it all along. That I doubted your strength bespeaks mine own weakness. But I will not doubt you again,  , on that you have my word.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_000: Shall we be off then, old ?
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_001: Ah, but where are my manners. Emmanellain de Fortemps, second son of Count Edmont de Fortemps─trueborn, that is.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_002: Yes, yes─I know what you're thinking, and you are absolutely right. What ill fortune to be born second in a society where the eldest inherits all.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_003: Oh, my brother would never cut me off, 'tis true, but who could be satisfied subsisting on a meager allowance, forever overshadowed by his sibling? Not I, old , not I!
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_004: Which is why I need your help to ensure that this business in the Sea of Clouds goes swimmingly, so that the tales of my great deeds can win me a place in the people's hearts─or better yet, raise me higher in their estimations than Artoirel! Ambitious, I grant you, but then I do have a legendary hero to do my bidding! Hah hah hah!
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_005: Oh, don't look at me that way! I jest, I jest! Anyway, we are to aid the good men and women of House Haillenarte. They have ever been steadfast friends to our house─though they've fallen on hard times since the Calamity, poor blighters.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_006: As for what precisely we will be doing, well... What fun would it be if I told you everything in advance?
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_007: Just come along with me to the airship landing. We'll need to take the airship to Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_008: Everything has been taken care of, old . Simply tell the attendant when you are ready to board, and away we'll go!
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_HONOROIT_000_008: Ah, my lord, there is still the matter of the bill...
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_HONOROIT_000_009: Ah,  ! Lord Emmanellain would like to speak with you...
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_WINDOW01590_000_010: Are you ready to depart, ? The airship bound for Camp Cloudtop will be leaving shortly.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_SCENE00007_EVENTARE: Board the airship to Camp Cloudtop?
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_020: Awfully cold up here... I mean, Coerthas may not be blessed with the warmest weather in the world, but compared to this, it seems positively balmy...
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_021: ...And, of course, our hero is wholly unperturbed. You don't have to maintain that strong, silent persona all of the time, you know.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_022: ...Never mind. We need to find Lady Laniaitte─she is in charge of the garrison here. Oh, and when we find her, just...just follow my lead, yes? Excellent!
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_HONOROIT_000_023: My lord, you mustn't wear your belt so loose, or you'll trip over your own sword!
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_LANIAITTE_000_030: ! Welcome! I am Ser Laniaitte de Haillenarte, commander of the forces stationed here at Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_LANIAITTE_000_031: Strange though it may sound, I have long dreamed of meeting you. I am in your debt, you see, and shall ever remain so. Were it not for you, my younger brother Francel would have been executed upon the word of a false inquisitor.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_LANIAITTE_000_032: Alas, a knight must go where duty demands, and thus have I been unable to seek you out. But by the grace of Halone, I have been granted an opportunity to thank my brother's savior in person, and to call upon  generous aid besides. Truly, I know not what I have done to deserve this double blessing!
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_033: Ahem! 'Tis a pleasure to see you again, my lady Laniaitte! You cut an elegant figure as always─a steel-clad rose, equally at home on a battlefield or in a ballroom.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_LANIAITTE_000_034: ...Lord Emmanellain, if it is not too much to ask, I should be grateful if you would allow me to finish speaking with  .
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_LANIAITTE_000_035: Camp Cloudtop was established to provide early warning of impending Dravanian incursions. The high elevation afforded by the floating isles makes it ideal for this purpose.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_LANIAITTE_000_036: Naturally, it also makes us a ready target for attack. We are not defenseless, however. The Protector, our largest and most advanced airship, is capable of downing all but the mightiest dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_LANIAITTE_000_037: Alas, as you may have noticed, it is currently undergoing repair. What is worse, our efforts have been hampered by an indigenous beast tribe known as the Vanu Vanu, with whom we have had several skirmishes already.
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_EMMANELLAIN_000_038: No beastman is a match for a man of Ishgard! Bring me a birdman and I'll show him a thing or two!
TEXT_HEAVNA111_01590_LANIAITTE_000_039: <sigh> I fear much and more may be asked of you in the days to come,  ...
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_LANIAITTE_000_000: While I understand Count Edmont's intentions, I would rather not waste valuable time ensuring that the young lord doesn't get trampled underfoot.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_LANIAITTE_000_001: True, it is entirely possible that he may learn something from this experience...but if left to his own devices, I think it far more likely that he will make a mess of things.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_LANIAITTE_000_002: Tell him...tell him that I would like him to keep watch for...Dravanian outflyers. Then, when you have a moment to speak with his manservant in private, make it clear that it is his responsibility to keep Emmanellain from shirking his duty.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_EMMANELLAIN_000_003: Ahhh, my lovely Lady Laniaitte! I shall win your heart yet!
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_HONOROIT_000_004: My lord, pray do not do anything rash...
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_EMMANELLAIN_000_010: Hm? A request from Laniaitte? Why didn't she think to ask me in person? Surely she must see me standing here but a few yalms away...
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_EMMANELLAIN_000_011: Oh, never mind. What is it?
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_A1_000_001: A mission of paramount importance: keep watch for Dravanian outflyers.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_A1_000_002: Roam about and keep an eye out for anything unusual.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_EMMANELLAIN_000_020: A m-mission!? Yes...yes, of course! That is why I am here. I shall do as my lady asks!
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_EMMANELLAIN_000_030: Oh, is that all? No “leading the van against a beast tribe stronghold” or some such? Well, it is a rather droll task, but who am I to deny her? I shall begin at once!
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_EMMANELLAIN_100_030: Well, that's rather childish of you.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_HONOROIT_000_031: I must say, is it me, or is the air here a bit...uhhh...
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_LANIAITTE_000_032: Remember to stress that this is a task vital to the continued survival of Camp Cloudtop─or something to that effect.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_HONOROIT_000_040: Ah,  . I do not believe I have properly introduced myself. My name is Honoroit, and I serve at the pleasure of Lord Emmanellain.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_HONOROIT_000_041: ...Lady Laniaitte would have me accompany Lord Emmanellain on his mission!?
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_HONOROIT_000_042: Ah, I understand completely. I will do my utmost to keep him out of harm's way.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_LANIAITTE_000_050: Were he of another house, mayhap I would not feel obligated to go to such lengths to preserve his safety and dignity...
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_LANIAITTE_000_051: In any case, I appreciate you speaking to him for me. It would seem he actually listens to you─at least, more so than others.
TEXT_HEAVNA112_01591_LANIAITTE_000_052: Or mayhap you are more skilled at this than most. Aye, I suspect you have had to humor your fair share of difficult men before.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_LANIAITTE_000_000: Now that Emmanellain is out of harm's way, we are free to discuss matters of actual import, such as our struggles with the Vanu Vanu.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_LANIAITTE_000_001: We first encountered the Vanu several years ago, when we had just begun to explore the Sea of Clouds. After an exchange of pleasantries and gifts, we received permission to construct a permanent lookout post.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_LANIAITTE_000_002: There was peace between our peoples for half a year, until suddenly, for reasons unknown, their attitudes towards us changed. They began to attack our foraging parties without provocation, forcing us to rely more heavily on supplies flown in from Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_LANIAITTE_000_003: ...But words are no substitute for firsthand experience. Go and see Ser Marielle─she could use your assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_LANIAITTE_000_004: Rather than listening to me go on and on, I think you would benefit from firsthand experience with the Vanu. Speak with Ser Marielle─she'll be expecting you.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_MARIELLE_000_010: , I presume? Lady Laniaitte told me you were coming.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_MARIELLE_000_011: I hear tell you've never faced a Vanu before? Well, spend enough time on patrol and you're sure to cross paths with them eventually.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_MARIELLE_000_012: These birdmen are native to the floating isles. I say “birdmen,” but they're not at all like the Ixal─unless that Ixal's mother was a gigas.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_MARIELLE_000_013: Here, let me mark several locations on your map. If you discover any Vanu in these areas, kill or drive them away.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_MARIELLE_000_014: For all I know, you may find nothing. If so, let us consider it an auspicious omen...
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_SYSTEM_000_020: You steel yourself for a mighty struggle, yet find no Vanu lying in wait.
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_MARIELLE_000_030: Finished with your patrol? Anything to report?
TEXT_HEAVNA113_01592_MARIELLE_000_031: Heh, maybe it was too much to hope for a day without a skirmish. At least I can take solace in the fact that Halone has blessed us with a mighty ally.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_MARIELLE_000_000: Excepting your recent clashes with the Vanu, it cannot have escaped your notice that things here are rather peaceful─to the detriment of our garrison's discipline.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_MARIELLE_000_001: Despite being built as an observation post, we have yet to record a single intrusion by the Horde. That is why, as far as everyone is concerned, Camp Cloudtop is a backwater of no significance.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_MARIELLE_000_002: And of course, the pride of our camp, the vaunted Protector, is in a perpetual state of needing repairs, so even were the Holy See to come under Dravanian attack, we would be unable to fly to their aid.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_MARIELLE_000_003: Simply put,  , this is where ambition comes to die. If you haven't aspirations for advancement, you'll be right at home.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_MARIELLE_000_004: However, I would like to think that enthusiasm can be just as contagious as apathy. If you'll indulge me, I would have you seek out the sentries and stoke their fighting spirit─psych them up, you might say.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_MARIELLE_000_005: Try to psych them up, as you might say. That should serve to liven their spirits.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_KIGHTA01593_000_010:
Wh-What!? What is it!? Is it the Horde!?
...By the Fury, what ever possessed you to do that?
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_KIGHTA01593_000_011: I'm awake, I'm awake, worry not. After the shock you just gave me, I doubt I'll sleep for a fortnight!
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_KIGHTA01593_000_012: Mmm... Is there anything fluffier than a cloud...?
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_KIGHTA01593_000_013: Mmm... If there is, I don't want to know about it...
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_KIGHTB01593_000_020: Ye gods, where did that come from?
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_KIGHTB01593_000_021: Fine, if you insist, I will make an effort to be more alert. But really, I fail to see the point! We're hundreds of malms away from the front lines─which is just the way I like it, thank you very much!
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_KIGHTB01593_000_022: You're looking rather grim. Why so serious? The Vanu are no real threat, and the Dravanians couldn't give a fig about us.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_KIGHTB01593_000_023: ...Aren't you an odd . Don't you have somewhere to be?
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_EMMANELLAIN_000_030: I-Is it an attack!? What should we do!? What should we do!?
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_EMMANELLAIN_000_031: ...You had me fooled there for a moment, old ! An amusing jest─albeit a tad cruel. Surely you must realize how unsuited I am to the monotony of mere sentry duty─yet still you tempt me with the promise of excitement!
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_EMMANELLAIN_000_032: No, this won't do. This won't do at all. Lady Laniaitte will give me a grand mission as befits my station!
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_EMMANELLAIN_000_033: <yawn> Hello there, old . Slain any Vanu champions yet? No? Oh, well, let me know when you have so I can make myself presentable for...for the... <snore>
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_EMMANELLAIN_000_034: Is this what you do for fun? Or is it some esoteric form of training? Well then, carry on, carry on.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_HONOROIT_000_035: As you wish, my lord. Should I spy an outflyer, I will alert you immediately...
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_MARIELLE_000_040: Many thanks,  . Already I can see a change in our sentries' behavior.
TEXT_HEAVNA114_01593_MARIELLE_000_041: Beg your pardon... Lord Emmanellain said what? Hah, well... I have no doubt that Lady Laniaitte will do her utmost to oblige him.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_MARIELLE_000_000: If Lord Emmanellain is going to demand a more dangerous duty, then I expect Lady Laniaitte will want you to accompany him.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_MARIELLE_000_001: Aye, you might as well speak with her sooner rather than later. There's no use avoiding the inevitable.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_MARIELLE_000_002: You ought to go and see if Lady Laniaitte needs you to keep an eye on Lord Emmanellain. I've nothing else for you at the moment, in any case.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_000_003: I'll have you know I trained with some of the finest instructors in Ishgard! You and me, we could march right into a Vanu stronghold and give them all what for!
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_HONOROIT_000_004: Oh dear, oh dear...and just when everything was going so well...
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_LANIAITTE_000_010: ! Lord Emmanellain has just informed me that “mere sentry duty” is beneath him. I understand we have you to thank for this epiphany?
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_LANIAITTE_000_011: Well, there's nothing for it but to give him something more demanding, then. Can I count on you to keep him safe?
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_LANIAITTE_000_012: Excellent. We are in constant need of fresh water in Camp Cloudtop, as there are no underground sources we can tap with wells. However, there is a unique variety of crystal we have recently discovered which may enable us to obtain water through other means.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_LANIAITTE_000_013: These spring crystals can be found in Voor Sian Siran, to the east of here. I would have you and Emmanellain bring one back to us.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_LANIAITTE_000_014: You may have to contend with the feral beasts which populate the lakes, not to mention Vanu scouts ranging from their nearby settlement. Of course, that all pales in comparison to keeping the young lord entertained, but you have doubtless grown accustomed to that by now. Good luck, and be safe.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_LANIAITTE_000_015: As before, I ask that you brief Emmanellain on his mission in my stead. I think he may find the task more palatable coming from you.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_000_020: Hm? Lady Laniaitte told you to tell me about my mission once again? If I didn't know any better, I'd swear she's avoiding me! Anyway, what is it?
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_A1_000_001: A vital mission, on the success of which the very survival of Camp Cloudtop rests: the procurement of potable water.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_A1_000_002: Go and fetch a spring crystal from the floating lakes to the east. With me.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_000_030: Finally! It's about time she entrusted me with a mission of real import. Right, then─let's go, let's go!
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_000_040: ...You're not making this sound terribly appealing. Still, I shall be glad to have you along. Come along, then!
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_100_040: Again with the silent treatment? Really now, that's just mean. That's mean!
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_000_050: So this is the Voor Sian Siran of legend. And nary a Vanu in sight. How disappointing. I could do with some sport.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_000_051: I know! Why don't you and I make it a competition? Whoever finds the superior specimen wins!
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_000_052: Honoroit shall judge our entries on size, purity, and, say, aesthetic sensibilities! Let us begin at once!
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_HONOROIT_000_053: I had heard the minstrels' tales of these lakes, but I never honestly believed that they were real!
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_SYSTEM_000_054: This water crystal does not appear to exhibit the properties described by Lady Laniaitte. Perhaps you should inspect another.
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_SYSTEM_000_055: This crystal appears to be secreting a steady stream of water. Perhaps it is the spring crystal Lady Laniaitte seeks...
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_EMMANELLAIN_000_056: Ah ah ah! This area is mine! You'll have to look elsewhere for your inferior specimen!
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_HONOROIT_100_056: I wish he would have at least stayed within sight...
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_HONOROIT_000_060: Ah,  . Have you brought your entry for the contest?
TEXT_HEAVNA115_01594_HONOROIT_000_061: My understanding of such things is...limited, but can this truly be used to draw moisture from air like water from a pump? Fascinating...
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_000_000: Lord Emmanellain has been gone for an awfully long time. Did you perchance see him while you were searching for your crystal? Even he must realize the dangers of wandering too far in such a place...
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_000_001: Mayhap I am worrying about nothing, but...I must ask that you assist me in looking for him,  . We shall find him more quickly if we split up. Pray search the southeastern area of Voor Sian Siran as swiftly as you are able and rendezvous with me in the north. Farewell, and good luck.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_SYSTEM_000_010: You survey the surrounding area for a time, but see no sign of Emmanellain.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_000_020: M- ! Lord Emmanellain...Lord Emmanellain has been taken by the Vanu!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_000_021: They had my lord surrounded─a whole gang of them! Please, you must come quickly!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_000_030: The Vanu must have taken him to that village, mayhap to present to their chieftain...
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_000_031: I-I will make haste to the Rosehouse and tell Lady Laniaitte what has happened.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_000_032: Yet... Yet by the time I return with aid, i-it may already be too late... Forgive me for asking,  , but should you spy an opportunity to sneak past the sentries and rescue Lord Emmanellain in my absence, I beg you to take it!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_000_033: I know he can be a trifle presumptuous...and insensitive...and, well...insufferable─but he doesn't deserve this!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_CID_000_040: The gods only know what might've happened had we not been around to save you... No need for thanks, though. It's not as if you haven't done the same for us on a few previous occasions. All right, more than a few.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_CID_000_041: 'Twas but blind chance that brought us together this time, in case you were wondering. The Holy See has petitioned the Ironworks for assistance with this creation of theirs, the Protector. Apparently, they just can't seem to get her flying.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_CID_000_042: Anyway, I came to Camp Cloudtop to cast an eye over the ship, only to learn that you had arrived some few days before with an Ishgardian lordling in tow.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_CID_000_043: "Small world!“ I thought─just as said lordling's manservant skittered into view, babbling about his master having been captured and you risking all to rescue him. And the rest, as they say, is history.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_CID_000_044: Right, well, I hate to cut short our reunion, but I am here on business after all, and the boys are already hard at work. Don't worry, old friend─we'll speak again soon, I promise.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_EMMANELLAIN_000_045: ...Frightened? Me!? For a fleeting moment at most! Hah hah...hah...
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HAURCHEFANT_000_046: We are all of us still alive, my friend! Let us take solace in that most simple of blessings.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONOROIT_100_047: Thank you,  , thank you! If you had not rushed to his aid, I dare not think what would have happened!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_QIB_TODO002: Protect Emmanellain and escape the Vanu stronghold!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_EMMANELLAIN_BATTLET: By the Fury, you're...you're not going to eat me, are you? That's not what you do to prisoners, is it!?
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HONU_BATTLETALK_000: Netherlings come to free prisoner! Spread word like thunder, and cast them into cloud sea!
Netherlings slink away like guileful gaelicats! Rally, warriors of Gundu! Let none escape!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_EMMANELLAIN_BATTLET: Haurchefant, is that you!? Thank heavens! Get us out of here!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HAURCHEFANT_BATTLET: Keep Emmanellain safe, ! We will hold them off!
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_EMMANELLAIN_BATTLET: Gods, is that my...? Oh... Ohhh...bugger.
TEXT_HEAVNA116_01595_HAURCHEFANT_BATTLET: If this is to be the end...
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_000: Very well, I admit it: it was an incredibly harrowing experience. I could very well have died, you know! Me! Dead!
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_001: On the other hand, by risking life and limb in the line of duty, I did succeed in uncovering the existence of a new primal. And that, old , is no small feat!
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_002: I have made an historic discovery─a fact even Lady Laniaitte will have no choice but to acknowledge! Yeeesss, I am rather looking forward to basking in the sunshine of her praise. Speaking of which─isn't it time we made our triumphant return?
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_003: How do I look? Dashing as always, with a suitable sprinkling of dirt and sweat? Excellent. Let us return to Lady Laniaitte at once!
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HAURCHEFANT_000_004: Even after everything he has been through, he manages to remain so...optimistic.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HONOROIT_000_005: Thank you,  , thank you! If you had not rushed to his aid, I dare not think what would have happened!
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_LANIAITTE_000_010: Praise Halone, I feared the worst! What happened out there?
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_LANIAITTE_000_012: Yet...now that I think on it, this Bismarck is reminiscent of the white whale of Vanu legend─a massive creature said to “swim” in the Sea of Clouds.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HAURCHEFANT_000_013: From what I have learned of comparable summonings, the presence of the Vanu's god would certainly explain the sudden change in their behavior toward the people of Camp Cloudtop.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HONOROIT_000_014: Ah, you mean to say that they have fallen under the primal's influence? I recall reading of such things in the documents provided by Master Alphinaud...
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_015: Aren't we forgetting something important, Lady Laniaitte? A little recognition for the hero of the hour? A few choice expressions of gratitude, respect, admiration, and so on...?
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_LANIAITTE_000_016: ...Why yes. You are right, of course.   deserves all that and more for having risked  life to rescue such an...esteemed personage.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HAURCHEFANT_000_017: Well, if there is naught else to discuss, I would depart for Ishgard forthwith. The Holy See and the Temple Knights must be informed of this new threat without delay.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_LANIAITTE_000_018:
But of course.
 , you have done more than enough here. Pray return to Ishgard with Lord Haurchefant and give my warmest regards to the count.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_019: So that's it, then? No more forays into enemy territory? Very well, I can see my services are no longer needed. Take care, Lady Laniaitte. May our next meeting take place under more...felicitous circumstances.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HAURCHEFANT_000_020: All's well that ends well, eh? To the airship landing, then! We can speak on the journey home.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_LANIAITTE_000_021: All things considered, Emmanellain came through relatively unscathed. More's the pity─he might have learned something otherwise.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HAURCHEFANT_000_030: I confess, I have always been rather fond of airship travel. The chill of the wind upon your face, the warmth of the blood pumping in your veins from the excitement...! I find the whole experience indescribably invigorating!
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HAURCHEFANT_000_031: Or mayhap it is simply the joy of having cheated death yet again!? Ha ha! In any event, I must make for the Congregation and inform Ser Aymeric of all that has occurred.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HAURCHEFANT_000_032: Emmanellain should have returned to the manor by now. Why not go and see if he has recovered from his ordeal?
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_040:
Oh, it's you, ...
<whimper> Gods, did he have to strike me so hard?
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_041: Father, he...he did not approve of how I handled matters in Camp Cloudtop─how I endangered the lives of others through my own...<sniff>...recklessness and incompetence.
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_EMMANELLAIN_000_042: It's not easy playing the hero, is it...
TEXT_HEAVNA117_01596_HONOROIT_000_043: (My lord the count was utterly beside himself,  . 'Tis a mercy you were not here to witness it.)
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWAR: Ah,  . My lord the count much desires to speak with you regarding your time with Lord Artoirel and Lord Emmanellain. If you would remain here for a moment...
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_EDMONT_000_010: Though you have won the hearts and minds of many of my countrymen, there are those who will never be swayed. Men who will dismiss your efforts and resent your successes, even as we celebrate them.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_EDMONT_000_011: 'Tis like that one such member of House Dzemael is manipulating Ser Grinnaux, for he is not a man to dabble in politics of his own volition. He may genuinely believe your friends to be guilty, though I am quite certain his masters know better.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_EDMONT_000_012: Yet the truth will avail us naught if we cannot prove their innocence.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_EDMONT_000_013: You would do well to speak with Ser Aymeric at the Congregation of Our Knights Most Heavenly. He will know more of these charges.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_014: ! I had but this moment resolved to go and fetch you! I presume you have heard what happened, then...
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_LUCIA_000_015: That they should regard the Scions with such suspicion even after you stood with us on the Steps of Faith... It is bad comedy.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_LUCIA_000_016: Yet unlike the grave injustice you suffered in Ul'dah, this wrong may swiftly be righted.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_EDMONT_000_017: I know as little as you do of the situation,  . Ser Aymeric, however, will surely know more.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWAR: Their status as wards of House Fortemps should afford them preferential treatment─for a time, at least...
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_AYMERIC_000_020: It has been too long, . Would that this visit came under happier circumstances. You are come to plead for Master Alphinaud and Mistress Tataru, I take it?
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_021: Word of their detainment reached us while I was delivering my report on the Vanu primal. Truly, I know not which is the more ludicrous─these charges or that flying feathered whale!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_AYMERIC_000_022: That Ser Grinnaux's accusations are baseless, I have no doubt. Refuting them will be difficult, however, as he is a knight of the Heavens' Ward.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_AYMERIC_000_023: I speak of the personal guard of the archbishop─the twelve finest knights in all of Ishgard, sworn to serve His Eminence alone. Suffice it to say, their testimony is unimpeachable, and I have not the authority to challenge their actions.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_024: After all the Scions have done─routing the heretics and defeating Shiva, helping us to defend the Steps of Faith and drive back the Dravanian Horde─after proving themselves true allies on countless occasions, is there naught we can do!?
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_AYMERIC_000_025:
I fear there is but one path left to us...
We must demand a trial by combat.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_027: In a trial by combat sanctioned by the inquisition, the victor's claim is judged true regardless of the petitioner's standing!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_AYMERIC_000_028: Under Ishgardian law, a trial by combat pits the accuser against the accused. In this instance, Master Alphinaud and Mistress Tataru would be expected to face Ser Grinnaux and a second of his choosing─another knight of the Heavens' Ward, most like.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_029: Two of them!? By the Fury, that can hardly be considered fair...
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_AYMERIC_000_030: Master Alphinaud's magical talents will not have gone unnoticed, meaning that he will have no choice but to participate. Mistress Tataru, on the other hand, is quite obviously bereft of martial skill, and should be afforded the right to name a champion to fight in her stead.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_AYMERIC_000_031: Lest you doubt, I am ready and willing to serve in this capacity, as I am sure is Lord Haurchefant...but all here present know that you are the most accomplished warrior among us, and mayhap in the realm at large...
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_032: Then it is settled! I will visit Master Alphinaud at once, and inform him of our intentions. ─meet me at the Tribunal when you have made ready. Until then, my friend!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_AYMERIC_000_033: The trial will be held at the Supreme Sacred Tribunal of Halonic Inquisitory Doctrine. I will be in attendance, as will many others with a vested interest in the outcome. Stint not in your preparations, my friend. The knights of the Heavens' Ward will provide a stern test for even one such as you.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_040: Listen carefully, . When the trial begins, the petitioner will be asked to restate his charges, and the accused invited to respond. Then, in accordance with the law, they will be asked to restate their request for a trial by combat.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_041: Once the high adjudicator acknowledges Mistress Tataru's right to name a champion, that is when you must make your entrance! Ohhh, I cannot wait to see the look on Ser Grinnaux's face when he sees his true opponent! 'Twill be priceless!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_042: More seriously...should you begin to lose heart, look to me in the stands, and I shall cheer so loud, you will wonder how you could ever have contrived to doubt yourself! Now, are you ready?
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_TRIALOFFICIANT01597: Alphinaud Leveilleur, Tataru Taru─you are hereby acquitted of all charges.
Blessed are we who receive of Her wisdom and see justice wrought by Her divine hand! Petitioners, accused─go forth in peace!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_ALPHINAUD_000_047: Delivered from an untimely demise yet again. My thanks...as always.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_050: By the Fury, what a splendid victory! To see how you strove in the face of adversity─two brave young souls bound together by the puissant bonds of camaraderie...! Why, it stirred me to the very depths of my soul!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_051: Having been treated to such a rousing spectacle, it seems only right that I present you with a humble token of mine admiration. Pray receive of me this chocobo whistle.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_052: With it, you may summon a black chocobo─fully trained and ready to fly!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_HAURCHEFANT_000_053: Magnificent, is she not? Strong yet sleek, elegant yet eager! What say you, ─will you take her for your steed?
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_GUARD01597_000_054: Lord Haurchefant! Chocobos are prohibited in the Supreme Sacred Tribunal of Halonic Inquisitory Doctrine! Your steed must remain outside!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_SYSTEM_000_055: You have obtained a black chocobo! When riding this mount, you will have the ability to fly, provided certain conditions have been met.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_SYSTEM_000_056: To fly in a given region, you must first find and attune to all the local aether currents.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_SYSTEM_101_056: In order to attune to some aether currents, you will need to complete certain quests. However, most can be discovered via exploration.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_SYSTEM_110_056: To aid you in this endeavor, you have also obtained an aether compass, which will provide you with both the bearing and the distance to the nearest aether current upon use. The aether compass can be found under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_SYSTEM_000_057: To review your progress, select Travel from the main menu, followed by Aether Currents.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: I shall do what I can to support you, ! Now, let us teach these noble sers the folly of bearing false witness!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_PAULECRAIN_BATTLETA: Well, well, who do we have here? This one is mine, Ser Grinnaux. Go and play with the boy.
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_GRINNAUX_BATTLETALK: Hmph. Bloody waste of... Come on, then! You wanted this, remember!?
I've had enough of your tricks!
TEXT_HEAVNA118_01597_PAULECRAIN_BATTLETA: Ha! A fine champion you are!
You have been indulged enough, heathen swine!
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: Black chocobos are all well and good, but the true reward for your efforts is the exoneration of your comrades.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_HAURCHEFANT_000_001: They shall be released upon the completion of certain minor formalities, which I mean to see to personally. In the meantime, pray return to Fortemps Manor. The count has done so already, and will doubtless be eager to discuss the day's events.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_HAURCHEFANT_000_002: Rest assured that Master Alphinaud and Mistress Tataru are no longer in danger. They will join you at the manor anon.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_ARTOIREL_000_003: I was not present at the trial, but my father told me of your performance. He said you were a wonder to behold!
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_EMMANELLAIN_000_004: Are you trying to become the talk of the city? Because if you are, you're doing an admirable job of it.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_HONOROIT_000_005: It brings me joy to see you in good health,  .
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_EDMONT_000_010: Halone smiles on us yet again,  , guiding you to victory and setting your comrades free.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_ARTOIREL_000_011: I confess, I did fear for your safety. Which is not to say I doubted your prowess, you understand... I merely knew the strength of your opponents. Ahem. You do have a habit of exceeding my expectations.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_EMMANELLAIN_000_012: Besting two of the Heavens' Ward while the city's elite looked on? By the Fury, anyone who hasn't been paying attention to you will surely do so from now on!
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWAR: We have just received a message from the Vault. His Eminence the archbishop requests the presence of  .
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_EDMONT_000_017: A personal summons is indeed a great honor, and given recent events, you would be wise not to delay...
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWAR: A priest will be waiting for you outside the Vault. Identify yourself to him and he will escort you inside.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_EDMONT_000_020: Do not worry about Master Alphinaud and Mistress Tataru. We will tend to them when they return from the Tribunal.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWAR: In case you have forgotten, the Vault lies at the opposite end of the Hoplon. Pray do not keep His Eminence waiting.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_PRIEST01598_000_030: We are honored to receive you,  . This way, please.
TEXT_HEAVNA119_01598_PRIEST01598_000_040: I nearly cried when you stepped forward at the Tribunal, ! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Though the situation calls for urgency, it would avail us little to charge headlong into Ul'dah without a plan. Before we can formulate a plan, however, we must first learn how things stand in the sultanate─which is why I propose that we visit Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Aye, you heard me right. While you were about your altruistic endeavors, I acted as an intermediary in trade negotiations between House Fortemps and a Lominsan consortium. During said negotiations, an opportunity to send word to the Admiral presented itself, and I duly seized it.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_002: I am happy to report that we yet have a stout ally in Limsa. The Admiral has pledged her full cooperation in any effort to rescue Raubahn.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Accordingly, I have agreed to meet with her, that we might discuss how best to proceed. Naturally, I told her to expect us both. Your presence never fails to embolden our allies, after all.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_004: When you arrive in Limsa Lominsa, make yourself known to Sergeant Zanthael at Bulwark Hall on the lower decks. He will admit you to the Bridge.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_TATARU_100_004: Gods, I hope we're not too late to save General Raubahn... I should have told you sooner─about the execution, I mean─but what with the trial and everything... <sigh>
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_006: Speak with Sergeant Zanthael when you are ready to meet the Admiral. He will admit us to the Bridge.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ZANTHAEL_000_010: The Admiral has been expecting you. Say the word and I will take you to her.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_MERLWYB_000_011: Raubahn's survival is vital to the Eorzean Alliance. We can ill afford to lose him.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_MERLWYB_000_012: But I cannot send troops into Ul'dah. 'Twould spell the end of the Alliance, and war, like as not. If there is to be a rescue, it falls to you and yours to attempt it.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_013: I would not have it any other way, Admiral.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_014: It was I who founded the Crystal Braves, and I who must take responsibility for their actions.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_MERLWYB_000_015: Spoken like a true leader, Master Alphinaud.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_MERLWYB_000_016: By way of a first step, you should seek out our Doman contact. You will find her among the frontier hands at Revenant's Toll, working in a kitchen.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_017: The Crystal Braves may no longer answer to me, but that does not absolve me of responsibility. As commander, I am accountable for all the wrongs they have committed─all the havoc they have wreaked.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_MERLWYB_000_018: Though it's useless to dwell on the past, I often wonder if I could have─and should have─done more for you and Raubahn that day.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_MERLWYB_101_018: Leaving the banquet was tantamount to leaving you and yours for dead. Should you think me craven, I wouldn't hold it against you.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_MERLWYB_101_019: But I will make it up to you, this I swear. Come what may, know that the Scions of the Seventh Dawn can count on our cooperation.
