TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: Would that we could join you in rescuing the Flame General, but the sultanate would not take kindly to a foreign power on their soil, allies or no.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_HIGIRI_000_020: ! I knew in my heart that you were safe, but to see you again in the flesh... Words cannot well express my relief.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_HIGIRI_000_021: Even as the victory feast was taking place, the Crystal Braves turned upon us and took the Rising Stones by force.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_HIGIRI_000_022: Amid the chaos, some few of my compatriots and I were able to slip away unnoticed. Since then, we have remained in Revenant's Toll, keeping watch over the mutineers while awaiting your return.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_HIGIRI_000_023: You have done well by us, and we Domans do not soon forget our debts. We swear to do all within our power to aid you.
TEXT_HEAVNA201_01599_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Could she be the Doman contact of whom the Admiral spoke?
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HIGIRI_000_000: Shortly before you arrived, I received word from Limsa Lominsa that you were searching for General Raubahn.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HIGIRI_000_001: As the Admiral will have informed you, he was recently moved from his cell in the Marasaja Pit.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HIGIRI_000_002: At the same juncture, Yuyuhase and the 3rd Unit were observed leaving the Rising Stones.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HIGIRI_000_003: This can be no simple coincidence. Their purpose, we believe, is to escort the Flame General to the scene of his execution.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HIGIRI_000_004: Suffice it to say, we have people shadowing the 3rd. If you would join the hunt, pray seek out Doware at Highbridge, where I too am bound.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HIGIRI_000_005: My comrades pursue the 3rd Unit Braves, even as we speak. If you would join the hunt, pray seek out Doware at Highbridge, where I too am bound.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_ALPHINAUD_000_006: Yet again, our Doman friends prove their worth... Lolorito was a fool to refuse them asylum.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_ALPHINAUD_000_007: Could she be the Doman contact of whom the Admiral spoke?
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_DOUWARE_000_010: I have been expecting you. Time is of the essence, so I shall be direct.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_DOUWARE_000_011: Yuyuhase and his men are bound for Halatali.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_DOUWARE_000_012: We believe that this is where they intend to carry out the execution.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_DOUWARE_000_013: Hozan is presently keeping watch over the entrance. Let us make haste and join him.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Yuyuhase... The mere mention of the name calls to mind the moment I felt the kiss of cold steel against my neck...
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HIGIRI_000_015: It has been a while since last I wore this garb. Since I came to Revenant's Toll, my days have been spent in kitchens. Fear not, however: though I have learned to wield a skillet, I have not forgotten the use of a dagger.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HOUZAN_000_020: You come at a good time, my friends. But moments ago, the traitor Ilberd arrived and entered Halatali.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_HOUZAN_000_021: From this, we may be certain that General Raubahn is being held within.
TEXT_HEAVNA202_01600_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Raubahn's ties to Halatali are well known. That Ilberd should choose this of all places to stage his execution is no coincidence. The fiend... Are there no depths to which he will not stoop?
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_HOUZAN_000_000: There is no time to lose─General Aldynn may be executed at any moment. You must enter Halatali and free him from his captors.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_HOUZAN_000_001: Please see to your preparations, and tell me when you are ready to proceed. One of our own will accompany you inside.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Raubahn's ties to Halatali are well known. That Ilberd should choose this of all places to stage his execution is no coincidence. The fiend... Are there no depths to which he will not stoop?
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUGIRI_000_003: He is bound by some manner of magitek device. Yet I dare not force it open─it may well be booby-trapped.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_000_004: I have heard of such devices. The Crystal Braves will possess the key. Let us split up and look for it.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUYUHASE_000_006: Pray do not take it personally, my friends. You are the victims of harsh economic conditions.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUYUHASE_000_007: Happily, you will not suffer for long. This poison will convey you swiftly unto the bosom of Thal, where I hope to join you, after the passing of many prosperous years.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_100_010: Slowly, General. You are yet weak from your ordeal.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUGIRI_100_011: Nevertheless, we must quit this place.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ILBERD_100_012: I should have known. What are clever contrivances to the Warrior of Light? ...Well done, hero.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ILBERD_100_014: You mean to struggle on, then? Very well. If you would stand in my way, I will cut you down like all the rest.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ILBERD_100_015: Come, Scions─let's get this over with.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUGIRI_000_010: The General is safe. What news without?
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_DOUWARE_000_011: My lady. The guards have been subdued, as per your command.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_DOUWARE_000_012: We have since kept watch over the entrance. There has been no further activity.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUGIRI_000_013: Then Ilberd and his minions have fled via some other egress. Scour the perimeter for signs of their passing.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_MESSENGER01601_000_: General Aldynn, I presume, and the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
Pray do not be alarmed. My mistress is a friend, and I come bearing a message of goodwill.
For your own safety, she bade me direct your steps to the Waking Sands. Know that Master Urianger awaits you there, along with others sympathetic to your cause.
This is no ruse, I assure you. General Aldynn─if you will come with me, I have prepared a carriage, that you may travel in comfort, safe from prying eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I have spoken with Urianger via linkpearl. He confirms the man's story.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Raubahn is in safe hands. Let us make our own way to Vesper Bay.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Raubahn is in safe hands. Let us make our own way to Vesper Bay.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_MESSENGER01601_000_: It is only prudent to be wary, but you may be assured that this is no ruse. Pray leave the care of General Aldynn to us, and make your way to the Waking Sands. Friends await you there.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUGIRI_000_024: Be at ease, my friend. I have an idea who this messenger's mistress might be...
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_000_030: I had not counted on Prioress Dewlala herself appearing. In my defense, my suspicions regarding the sultana proved more prescient.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Much remains to be done, but in rescuing Raubahn, we have taken a vital first step towards resolving matters in Ul'dah. We couldn't have done it without you, . Thank you.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_PAPASHAN_000_032: Thank you for rescuing General Raubahn. From the bottom of my heart. To behold him now, gaunt and unkempt... It pains me to think of all the hardship he has endured.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_PAPASHAN_000_033: I shall not forget what you have done for General Raubahn. You have saved more than just a man.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Not a soul from the Coliseum to be seen. This bodes ill.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: Take the lead, . I shall follow close upon you.
The General...but where are his captors? I mislike the look of this.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUYUHASE_BATTLETALK: Farewell, friends. Oh, and do try to relax. They tell me struggling only makes it worse.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: We cannot let them escape! , force the gate!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: The General fades... We must hurry!
Confound it! The mist stifles my healing!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: ...Beasts!? The mist must be drawing them!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_QIB_TODO003: Destroy the source of the mist!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: The mist remains... We must stop it at the source!
I shall tend to the General! Pray see to the mist and the key!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_QIB_TODO004: Defeat Crystal Braves and obtain the key.
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: That takes care of the mist!
Next, to find the key and free Raubahn!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_CRYSTALA_BATTLETALK: How did they survive the poison!?
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_CRYSTALB_BATTLETALK: Bah, looks like we'll just have to finish the job!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: The key! Take it to Raubahn!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_QIB_TODO005: Defeat Ilberd of the Dull Blade!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_ILBERD_BATTLETALK_0: The sultana's assassins are here! Crystal Braves, to arms!
TEXT_HEAVNA203_01601_LAURENTIUS_BATTLETA: I am no hero─never was, and never will be!
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Tataru? ...Yes, General Raubahn is now in safe hands.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_001: What? ...Another assault? Very well. We shall return at once. Pray notify the count of our coming.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_002: It would seem we face another crisis. The Dravanians are preparing to resume their siege of the Holy See.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_003: ...Though I am loath to abandon the sultana to her fate, we lack the necessary evidence to act upon Dewlala's claims.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_004: That being the case, I propose we leave Marshal Tarupin and the others to investigate, and return with all haste to Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_TATARU_000_010: Ah, there you are! Sorry for cutting your reunion with General Raubahn short.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_TATARU_000_011: I wouldn't have bothered you, but the city's awash with rumors of another Dravanian attack, and Lord Haurchefant was desperate to get hold of you. Speaking of whom, he and the others are waiting for you inside, so you'd better head in!
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_TATARU_000_012: We can talk later! Everyone's waiting for you inside!
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Let us hear what the count has to say.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_HAURCHEFANT_000_014: I believe Mistress Tataru wished a word with you. Pray do not take long, however, as we have much to discuss.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_EMMANELLAIN_000_017: There you are, old ! Tell me, do you want the good news first or the bad news? Actually, don't bother. There isn't any good news.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_PIPPIN_100_017: Pray do not tarry for my father's sake. I will see that he is well looked after. And should we uncover any information on Her Grace's whereabouts, I promise you will be the first to know.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_DEWLALA_100_018: I have taken charge of matters here. Consider yourself free to tend to other, more pressing tasks.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_HAURCHEFANT_000_020: My friend! I thank you for answering our call with such alacrity! As I am sure you are now aware, the Dravanians are once more gathering for war.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_EDMONT_000_021: , Master Leveilleur─I must apologize for this abrupt summons, but we thought it best to have Mistress Tataru contact you by the most direct means available.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ARTOIREL_000_022: When the Observatorium's bells toll, 'tis a warning that cannot be ignored. The Holy See has ordered that we make ready for battle.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_EMMANELLAIN_000_023: In case you haven't heard, a band of trappers returning from the west claim they saw a cloud of dragons big enough to dim the midday sky!
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_EDMONT_100_023: Nidhogg's minions gather once more for war...
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_EDMONT_000_024: But I would not have you take up arms in another of our conflicts. When first you came to Ishgard, I offered you my protection. If I cannot ensure your safety here, I cannot well accept your aid, much less ask for it.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_EDMONT_000_025: Scions of the Seventh Dawn, you are faced with a choice: to remain in a besieged Ishgard, or seek sanctuary elsewhere. I would not presume to influence your decision, but I must ask that you make it swiftly, lest our enemies force your hand.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_HAURCHEFANT_000_026: The coming of the Horde spells ruin for Ishgard...but her knights shall fight to the last to shield her citizens from harm!
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_EDMONT_000_027: I confess, I know not where else you might seek sanctuary, but few places are like to be more perilous than a city under siege.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ARTOIREL_000_028: The Observatorium bells have tolled. Either flee this place or make ready for war.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_EMMANELLAIN_000_029: How many dragons would it take to darken the midday sky, do you think? A thousand? More? Too many, at any rate...
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Though we flee to the ends of the world, 'twould seem that no place in this troubled age is free of strife. Once more the Horde descends upon Ishgard, and once more her weary defenders must take up spear and bow.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_032: The count would have us seek shelter from this storm, but I, for one, grow tired of running. If we are to shine the light of dawn, we must do so in the sight of our fellow man, not hunkered in a hole.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Then fight we shall! Let it never be said that we abandoned our allies in their hour of need!
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_ALPHINAUD_000_050: ...That is your answer? By the Twelve, how could you─ But, wait. Mayhap remaining in the city would not best serve our friends and allies. Mayhap there is another choice...
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_PAPASHAN_000_060: Thank you for rescuing General Raubahn. From the bottom of my heart. To behold him now, gaunt and unkempt... It pains me to think of all the hardship he has endured.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_PAPASHAN_000_061: From the bottom of my heart, thank you for rescuing General Raubahn.
TEXT_HEAVNA301_01602_TATARU_000_062: What will become of this place...and us?
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The choice we make this day may have grave implications for our order. It is only right that Tataru should have a say. Come, let us all meet outside and discuss the path that lies before us.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_HAURCHEFANT_000_001: The coming of the Horde spells ruin for Ishgard...but her knights shall fight to the last to shield her citizens from harm!
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_TATARU_000_005: What will become of this place...and us?
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_ALPHINAUD_000_010: We have chosen a difficult road─yet even should we succeed in winning Iceheart to our cause, our plans for parley will swiftly come to naught should the Holy See decide to strike first against the Horde.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_ALPHINAUD_000_012: We must petition the lord commander's aid ere we set forth. I only hope that Ser Aymeric will be willing to muzzle Ishgard's forces on the strength of our vague assurances.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Tataru─I would ask that you remain at Fortemps Manor and inform the count of our decision. Tell him that the Scions of the Seventh Dawn mean to do all in their power to ensure that Ishgard and her people survive.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_TATARU_000_015: Don't worry about the count─I'll tell him the Scions aren't going anywhere!
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_TEMPLEKIGHTGATE_000: You would speak with the lord commander? Pray make it quick.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_SCENE00020_EVENTARE: Proceed to the Seat of the Lord Commander?
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Having secured Ser Aymeric's support, we may proceed without fear of a preemptive Ishgardian attack─which is not to say we can afford to dither.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_ALPHINAUD_000_021: History tells us that the Dravanians will attack as soon as their Horde reaches a critical size. Before that happens, we must needs track down and win over the Lady Iceheart...and then locate and parley with Nidhogg.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_ALPHINAUD_000_022: In short, time is against us. If you are ready, Estinien, let us be about our task.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_ESTINIEN_000_031: I will say this for your plan: it has made keeping secrets from the Holy See seem almost entertaining.
TEXT_HEAVNA302_01603_TATARU_000_032: I told the count that the Scions are here to stay!
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_100_000: Before we set forth, we must needs inform Tataru of our plans.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ESTINIEN_100_001: Then I shall await you at Saint Reinette's Forum. Tell your friend we may be some time─the road you have chosen is neither short nor easy.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_100_002: Of that I need no reminding. Come, . Let us head back to Fortemps Manor.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ESTINIEN_300_003: I will say this for your plan: it has made keeping secrets from the Holy See seem almost entertaining.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_TATARU_400_004: I told the count that the Scions are here to stay!
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ESTINIEN_100_003: Have you spoken with your friend? ...Well, see that she is prepared for a long wait. She will burn many a candle at her window ere we set foot in Ishgard again.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_200_000: Our course is set, Tataru. It may be some time before  and I return to Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_TATARU_200_001: Well, just you be careful, all right? Oh, and don't worry about me─I'll be busy listening out for news of our lost friends!
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_200_002: If anyone can find them, it is you, Tataru. Farewell, for now...
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_TATARU_200_003: Oh! Oh! Before you go! You must put this on, Alphinaud! I made it specially!
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_200_004: No, no, I...I couldn't possibly... <sigh> Very well.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_300_004: By the Twelve... It fits perfectly. And the quality is...actually rather good.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_TATARU_200_005: I'm glad you like it! I've been practicing my needlework while I listen to rumors and the like. A good receptionist is always learning new skills!
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_200_006: My thanks, Tataru. Whatever else awaits me upon the road, I shall not fear the cold.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_TATARU_200_007: 'Twas the least I could do. Now, I must be getting back to the tavern, or I'll never catch up with all the gossip! Best of luck on your journey!
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_400_000: This new attire will serve me well in the bitter cold of Coerthas. I shall have to thank Tataru properly upon our return.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ESTINIEN_300_000: You have said your farewells, then?
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Aye, we are ready to depart. I suggest we begin our search for Lady Iceheart without delay.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ESTINIEN_300_001: Very well, but she will prove an elusive quarry. Where do you intend to start looking?
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_001: In the absence of any fresh intelligence on Ysayle's movements, I propose we pick up the trail where she was encountered last─the Coerthas western highlands.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Let us speak with...Ser Redwald, was it? As the commander of Falcon's Nest, it is like that he will know if any heretic activity has been reported in the area.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_REDWALD_000_010: Well, well!  ! What business brings you back to Falcon's Nest?
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_REDWALD_000_011: ...Judging by the company you keep, it can be no trifling matter. The Azure Dragoon I know, of course, but I do not believe I have met this young gentleman...?
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Alphinaud Leveilleur, at your service. And you are not mistaken as to the gravity of our mission, Ser Redwald. As I am sure you are aware, the Observatorium has warned that the Dravanians gather for another assault.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_013: We believe there may yet be a way to avert the coming conflict─but only if we can find the elusive Lady Iceheart. Thus have we come to Falcon's Nest in the hope of acquiring the latest intelligence on the heretics' movements.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_REDWALD_000_014: I see. Then you would be best served by speaking directly to my men. A patrol is due to return from its sweep of the surrounding lands at any moment.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_REDWALD_000_015: You may also wish to question the knights assigned to pick over the remains of the heretic refuge at Gorgagne Mills. 'Tis possible they have unearthed information that could be of use to you.   knows well the place I speak of, for it was  who first discovered it.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ESTINIEN_000_016: Let us divide our forces, then. I will stay and await the return of the patrol while the two of you visit this refuge. When I have completed my inquiries, I will join you there.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_017: A wise use of our time.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_018: Come, . I am eager to learn what Ser Redwald's men have found in the heretics' lair.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ESTINIEN_000_019: As agreed, I will stay and await the return of the patrol while the two of you visit the heretics' refuge. When I have completed my inquiries, I will join you there.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_400_002: Just a simple farmhouse... It makes one wonder what other innocent facades the heretics have chosen to hide behind.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_KIGHTLEADER01604_00: ! ...Our findings, you say? Well, there is something of a tale there...
No sooner had we chanced upon a promising-looking sheaf of letters than we were ambushed from the shadows by great white beasts.
'Twould seem the heretics foresaw our coming, and left behind their pets to discourage further investigation. Several of our number were badly wounded...
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_023: ...And you cannot carry out your duties until the creatures are slain. We have not the time to wait for reinforcements─let us deal with these “pets” ourselves, .
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Oh... Oh dear... Th-The creature took me by surprise... F-Forgive me... Until my hands stop shaking, I fear I shall prove more a hindrance than a h-help. Pray go on ahead, and when you are certain that the rest of these...things have been slain, notify the expedition leader that it is safe to return.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_KIGHTLEADER01604_00: We were ill prepared for what awaited us at the farmhouse... Forgive me, but until the creatures have been put down, we cannot safely continue our investigation.
The beasts are slain, then? My thanks,  ... We may return to our duty without fear of a mauling.
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ESTINIEN_000_031: My inquiries availed me naught. The patrol leader had little to say beyond which of his extremities the frost had bitten the hardest...
TEXT_HEAVNA303_01604_ALPHINAUD_100_032: I heard a frightful growling from below. You encountered more of the beasts, I take it?
TEXT_HEAVNA304_01605_KIGHTLEADER01605_00: You wish to track down Lady Iceheart, is this not so? The records we discovered ere those beasts mauled my comrades appeared to be some manner of correspondence.

We had not the luxury of perusing their contents more closely─intent as we were on surviving an onslaught of fang and claw─but I'd wager those epistles contain more than friendly salutations betwixt lonely heretics.
TEXT_HEAVNA304_01605_ESTINIEN_000_002: My interrogation of the patrol proved fruitless. Either we divine some clue from these letters, or we wander the snowfields and pray that the gods lead us right to Iceheart's door. 'Tis hardly a choice at all...
TEXT_HEAVNA304_01605_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Th-The thing took me by surprise... Until my hands stop shaking enough to weave spells, I fear I shall prove more a hindrance than a help.
TEXT_HEAVNA304_01605_ESTINIEN_000_004: My inquiries availed me naught. The patrol leader had little to report beyond which of his extremities had frozen the most completely...
TEXT_HEAVNA304_01605_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I have found some few of these letters. Let us gather a respectable stack, and see what secrets the expedition captain can wring from the collected correspondence.
TEXT_HEAVNA304_01605_KIGHTLEADER01605_00: Ah, the letters were in a neat pile just here...but 'twould seem the skirmish with the beasts has scattered them rather thoroughly.
TEXT_HEAVNA304_01605_ESTINIEN_000_012: Where are these damnable pages...? I'd rather battle two score aevis than continue this confounded search!
TEXT_HEAVNA304_01605_KIGHTLEADER01605_00: Have you recovered much of the heretics' correspondence?
Splendid. Added to the contributions from Master Leveilleur and Ser Estinien, we now have more than a dozen letters.
What have we here, then... Hmmm. Every one of these pages is a record of the dealings betwixt the Gorgagne Mills heretics and their fellows in the Akh Afah Amphitheatre.
There are requests for foodstuffs, clothing, and all manner of provisions. Iceheart's followers must yet inhabit the ruins we had thought abandoned...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The Akh Afah Amphitheatre... The very place where you witnessed the manifestation of the primal Shiva, was it not?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_001: If that is our destination, the journey will be long indeed. The amphitheatre lies on the other side of a treacherous tract of ice and snow that cannot swiftly be crossed.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Then we must place our faith in the Aethernet. As you may recall, our dear friend Moenbryda succeeded in recreating the Akh Afah beacon after it had been destroyed by Lady Iceheart. At the time, it was assumed that the resultant aetheryte would only be temporarily viable, but given that the heretics of Gorgagne Mills seem to have been in regular contact with their brethren at the amphitheatre, I'll wager it still functions. I suggest we make for the aetheryte within Snowcloak without delay.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Correct me if I am wrong, Estinien, but in the course of mapping the Snowcloak tunnel system, a passage was discovered leading out into the western highlands, was it not? Might it be possible for us to reach the aetheryte from this side of the wall?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_004: It should. House Durendaire posted soldiers at the western highlands entrance after the tunnels were cleared, but they will not deny us entry.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_KIGHTLEADER01605_00: There are requests for foodstuffs, clothing, and all manner of provisions. Iceheart's followers must yet inhabit the ruins we had thought abandoned...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_006: “Akh Afah” is taken from the dragons' tongue─it means, roughly, “Eternal Circle.” 'Tis little wonder the heretics thought to return to the place.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_KIGHTLEADER01605_00: Do you mean to follow the heretics' trail, then? I will see that Ser Redwald is informed.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Do you recall the first time you ventured into these tunnels in search of Lady Iceheart? It seems an age ago, does it not...? Back then, I still believed myself the commander of the Crystal Braves...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_009: What ails our young lord? The moment we arrived at the wall, his face took on an ashen pallor. Does he fear facing the heretics within their own lair?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_TRISTECHAMBEL_000_0: Ah, the guests of House Fortemps...accompanied by the Azure Dragoon, no less!
I cannot imagine what brought you out this far, but you are welcome to enter the tunnels if that is your will.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Assuming the Akh Afah beacon still functions─and we must pray to the Twelve it does─we shall arrive at our destination in mere moments.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Though I do not expect to be greeted by the primal Shiva, we should nevertheless be prepared for a frosty reception. ...The heretics are not like to rejoice at the appearance of uninvited guests─particularly ones with our history.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ADELPHEL_100_013: We have begun surveying the Warrens from the western entrance, but progress is slow. 'Twould seem not all the rats have left the nest...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_014: An impressive structure. I wonder how many ages it has endured...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_015: Mayhap you should ask its occupants. They seem a friendly bunch.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_HERETIC01606_000_01: Dogs of Ishgard! Is it not enough that you banish our beloved saint? Will you not be satisfied until the ice is slick with the last drops of our blood!?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Stay your weapons! We come under the flag of parley! We wish only to speak with your mistress, that we might broker a peace!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_HERETIC01606_000_01: Do you think us fools, boy!? It will take more than honeyed words to earn our trust. You walk with the dragonslayer, and we know all too well what he is capable of!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_HERETIC01606_000_02: Come, brothers! May dragon wings bear us to victory!
<gasp> Th-They fight like demons... 'Tis death to remain!
Fall back, brothers! Retreat to the Cinders!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_024: I see no sign of Lady Iceheart. Would that we could have questioned one of them...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_025: What would you ask that we do not already know? They make for the Cinders, and so must we. Even should an ambush await us, 'tis certain there will be more heretics to question.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_026: “The Cinders,” you say? I confess, the name is unknown to me. Mayhap you would be so good as to enlighten us, Estinien?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_027: ...I suspect it is the heretics' way of referring to the Dreaming Dragon─an island of sorts found in the midst of the frozen lake of Ashpool.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_028: Some five hundred years past, 'tis told that the Azure Dragoon of the age fought a dragon of titanic proportions. After a savage struggle, the mighty creature was weakened unto the point of death, and forced into a magicked slumber by an entire chapter of the Holy See's sorcerers.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_029: Ere long, a rain of ash and cinders did begin to fall upon the sleeping serpent's motionless form, covering the creature at length in a shroud of grey. ...Of course, a thick layer of ice has since formed on top of it, but you may be sure I speak true.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_030: A fascinating tale. We should make haste to this ashen isle.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Only in a land where war has raged for a thousand years could enough ash fall to bury a dragon the size of an island...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_040: The Dreaming Dragon lies far to the west. Before we approach the frozen beast, however, there is another place I would visit first.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_041: I am told the Convictors have set up camp in Twinpools. Their leader, Jantellot, may have information of use to us.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_042: Ah, but mayhap you are not familiar with that name, either... The Convictors are dragonslayers─after a fashion─but I am willing to wager that they encounter their fair share of heretics. If we are indeed walking into a trap, I would learn all there is to know of our foe.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_000_043: A sound suggestion. Let us speak with these Convictors, then, and temper our haste with a measure of caution.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ADELPHEL_100_044: My thanks for ridding the tunnels of their rat infestation. With any luck, I shall finally be able to carry out my work uninterrupted.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_TRISTECHAMBEL_100_0: What...? You've driven off the heretics? That should certainly ease the minds of our surveyors!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_JANTELLOT_000_050: Well, well. What do we have here? Hoping to join the esteemed ranks of the Convictors, are we?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_JANTELLOT_100_050: The hard-eyed  looks promising, but you have a frail look about you, boy... I give you three days ere the wilds claim your corpse.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ESTINIEN_000_052: Be not so quick to judge. I have seen this “frail” youth fell heretics with a flick of his wrist.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_JANTELLOT_000_053: And who are you to question my─ By the Fury!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_JANTELLOT_100_053: That armor... That lance! The Azure Dragoon himself graces our camp!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_JANTELLOT_000_054: Pray forgive my disrespect, ser. I am Jantellot─leader of the Convictors and fellow slayer of dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_JANTELLOT_000_055: ...May I ask what winds─fair or foul─carry you into our humble camp?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_JANTELLOT_000_056: Ah. Lady Iceheart, is it? Aye, I know her by reputation─but I'm afraid I've seen naught of her or her people.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_JANTELLOT_000_057: That said, my own men can be...ahem...somewhat lax when it comes to making reports. You may wish to question them yourselves.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ALPHINAUD_100_058: , Estinien─let us make our way through the camp, and see what information there is to be had.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_LANCER01607_000_060: Ah, 'tis colder than Lady Iceheart's frost-rimed...uh, soul! Greetings, ! A fine day, is it not?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_ARCHER01607_000_061: Be still! How am I supposed to watch for the distant flicker of dragon wings when my ears are ringing with your incessant chatter!?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_HERETIC_BATTLET: You will not defile this sacred place a second time!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_ALPHINAUD_BATTL: N-No! Wait! We did not come here to fight!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_ESTINIEN_BATTLE: Waste no more words on them. They are deaf to reason.
By the Fury... They partake of the blood of dragons!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_ALPHINAUD_BATTL: Seven hells... Can dragon blood truly bring about such a transformation?
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_HERETIC_BOSS_BA: You should not have come here, Ishgardians...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_ESTINIEN_BATTLE: At last, a foe I might sink my lance into.
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_HERETIC_BOSS_BA: You are fortunate indeed. Behold the true power of our faith!
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_ALPHINAUD_BATTL: No... Our journey has scarce begun...
TEXT_HEAVNA305_01606_QIB_ESTINIEN_BATTLE: I cannot fall to this rabble...
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Surely one of these people will have encountered heretics while out hunting. Pray speak with as many as you can, .
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_JANTELLOT_000_001: I've not seen Lady Iceheart myself, but we Convictors range far and wide in search of our prey. Mayhap one of my fellow dragonslayers has a helpful tale to tell.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ALPHINAUD_000_002: While this is, I confess, a somewhat tedious business, one of these people may have valuable knowledge that will save us days of searching.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ESTINIEN_000_003: ...I may have erred in seeking the wisdom of these whelps.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_LANCER01607_000_003: Ah, 'tis colder than Lady Iceheart's frost-rimed...uh, soul! Greetings, ! A fine day, is it not?
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ARCHER01607_000_004: Be still! How am I supposed to watch for the distant flicker of dragon wings when my ears are ringing with your incessant chatter!?
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_LANCER01607_000_010: Nay, I know of no heretics. Do you honestly expect me to keep track of every Raitmeaux, Vairemont, and Bertennant that wanders in and out of camp?
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_LANCER01607_000_011: Nay, I know of no heretics. Do you honestly expect me to keep track of every Raitmeaux, Vairemont, and Bertennant that wanders in and out of camp?
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ARCHER01607_000_020: Hm? Are there any heretics in the area? I have not the faintest idea. Why, a heretic could pass under my very nose and I should be none the wiser.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ARCHER01607_000_021: I hunt dragons, my dear ! The big ones! Forever do I scan the skies for signs of my prey─I care not for the miserable creatures that scurry upon the ground!
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ARCHER01607_000_022: Hm? Are there any heretics in the area? I have not the faintest idea. Why, a heretic could pass under my very nose and I should be none the wiser.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ARCHER01607_000_023: I hunt dragons, my dear ! The big ones! Forever do I scan the skies for signs of my prey─I care not for the miserable creatures that scurry upon the ground!
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_LUCIAE_000_030: Looking for heretics, you say? Hmph. Why don't you go and bother Pierriquet or someone?
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_LUCIAE_000_031: I've enough trouble keeping these preening fops fed and clothed as it is. 'Tis no business of mine what folk do with themselves out there in the wilds.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_LUCIAE_000_032: Looking for heretics, you say? Hmph. Why don't you go and bother Pierriquet or someone?
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_PIERRIQUET_000_040: Summat I can help you with, ?
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_PIERRIQUET_000_041: Heretics, is it? Well, I've never seen one meself...but that ain't to say I haven't heard a thing or two.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ALPHINAUD_000_042: We would be grateful for any information you can share with us. The gods know we've gleaned precious little from talking to the rest of these...people.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_PIERRIQUET_000_043: If it please milord, I'm Pierriquet─a soldier by trade, though not much of one, if I'm honest. It weren't for the love of stabbing folk that I took up the spear, see.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_PIERRIQUET_000_044: No, it was by order of Ser Jantellot's father. Still, as long as they keep paying me wages, I ain't fussy as to what they have me do.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_PIERRIQUET_000_045: Not everyone's as patient as me, though. Plenty of lowborn lads who get pressed into service start grumbling before they've seen their second battle.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_PIERRIQUET_000_046: And once they've got to thinking how unfair it all is, it don't take much for the heretics to turn their heads. From what I hear, the simple promise of freedom tends to do it.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ALPHINAUD_000_047: That may explain how Lady Iceheart was able to expand her following so swiftly.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_PIERRIQUET_000_048: Sad to say, some mates of mine gobbled down the heretics' tripe and asked for seconds─told me they were off to the western highlands to light a signal fire. That's how you let the heretics know you're serious about joining their ranks, apparently. Send up some purple smoke, and the bastards come to you.
TEXT_HEAVNA306_01607_ESTINIEN_000_049: ...Is that so? Why then...I am minded to start a fire.
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_ESTINIEN_000_000: If we are to lure our foes to our position, then we must find a means of producing a signal of purple hue.
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_ESTINIEN_000_001: ...As it so happens, I once heard the tale of a trapper who dropped the hide of a wooly yak onto his campfire. Aside from the terrible stench, the story also described in detail how the smoke from the smothered flames was tinged a deep violet.
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_ESTINIEN_000_002: You are a monster hunter of some note, are you not, ? It should prove a trifling task for you to procure a number of hides. We may need to burn more than one ere the heretics notice our beacon.
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_ESTINIEN_000_003: Master Alphinaud. You and I shall gather wood for the fire. Aye, it will take the both of us to find enough dry fuel in this frozen wasteland. Let us meet again at the Dreaming Dragon with the fruits of our labor.
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_ALPHINAUD_000_004: I am not familiar with the building of signal fires, but how difficult could it possibly be...?
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_LANCER01607_000_005: Right. Time for my patrol... I'll leave once my  meal has had a chance to settle.
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_ARCHER01607_000_006: I have spied not a scale nor a talon all day. Mayhaps the view would be better from Ashpool...
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_ESTINIEN_000_010: 'Twould seem that collecting firewood is a new experience for Master Alphinaud. His must have been a privileged upbringing... Ahem. Have you the hides we need?
TEXT_HEAVNA307_01608_ALPHINAUD_000_011: I left Ishgard on a mission of noble purpose, and now here I am scrabbling for sticks in the snow. How can my hands be at once so numb yet so sore...?
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_000:
You are , yes? Pray address me as “Ysayle” if you wish.
...'Tis passing strange, is it not, that fate should bring us together thus. Never did I think to walk alongside the Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_001: ...But history is full of such unexpected alliances. Shall we make our way into Dravania, then?
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_002: The chill of the western highlands is unrelenting, and I would sooner be under the sheltering canopy of the Chocobo Forest.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ALPHINAUD_000_003: We journey to the homeland of dragons, . The scholar within me burns to see the sights I have but read about...as does the child within me, I confess.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ESTINIEN_000_004: Be on your guard, Warrior of Light. With the mistress of the heretics as our guide, we may yet find that we are being led to our graves.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_010: We now stand on the threshold of Dravania. The path to Sohm Al will take us far to the west, beyond the embrace of the forest's branches.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_011: It will be a long and demanding journey. Might I suggest that we take our rest at the village up ahead, and see that we are properly provisioned?
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ALPHINAUD_000_012: There is a village here? But I thought these lands the sole domain of dragonkind. Why would anyone choose to live in so perilous a place?
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_013: The wild chocobos. Tailfeather was built by hunters who make their living capturing and selling the beasts. Their leader, Marcechamp, is an acquaintance of mine.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_014: Being a gregarious sort, he will no doubt welcome our arrival. And he will also possess more recent knowledge of the road we seek to travel. I trust there are no objections?
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ESTINIEN_000_015: Only to this ceaseless chatter. If we are to meet this acquaintance of yours, let us do it before Ishgard burns.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ALPHINAUD_000_016: This forest was mentioned in the pages of the New Eorzean Geographic. As I recall, the author advised travelers to give the local chocobos a wide berth. According to her, they can be remarkably aggressive...
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ESTINIEN_000_017: Do you sense them, ? A gathering of dragons, to the west...
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_MARCECHAMP_000_020: Well, tan my hide an' call me leatherface, we have visitors!
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_MARCECHAMP_100_020: Oho, an' if it ain't the lovely Ysayle! It's been too long, girl!
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_021: That it has, Marcechamp. That it has.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ICEHEART_000_022: My companions and I are on a pilgrimage to Sohm Al. Might we stay in Tailfeather awhile, and prepare for the next leg of our journey?
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_MARCECHAMP_000_023: Of course, of course, stay as long as you like! In fact, I wouldn't suggest leavin' the forest at all. The dragons've been absolutely bleedin' murderous of late.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Forgive me, sir, but I am not sure I understand. Do the dragons not bother you here in the forest?
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_MARCECHAMP_000_025: Bother us? Did Ysayle not explain things to you, boy?
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_MARCECHAMP_000_026: You've seen them towerin' caelumtrees all about, haven't you? If you were flyin' above the canopy, you'd barely be able to see the ground.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_MARCECHAMP_000_027: An' as you'd expect, the local wildlife's canny enough to stay hidden beneath the leaves─which is why the dragons do their huntin' elsewhere, an' we can do ours in peace.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_ALPHINAUD_000_028: ...I see. Thank you for the explanation.
TEXT_HEAVNA308_01609_MARCECHAMP_000_029: You're welcome. Now, I know it won't stop Ysayle here, but dragons ain't the only things you'll need to keep an eye out for. Especially if you're set on headin' west...
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_MARCECHAMP_000_000: I daresay you're wonderin' what could possibly be worse than dragons, eh? Well, I'll tell you: the bloody Gnath. They're what you might get if you crossed an antling with a megalocrab an' taught the thing how to walk on two legs.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_MARCECHAMP_000_001: They never used to stray far from their hives out of fear of the dragons, but they've gotten a lot more aggressive of late, sendin' out war parties for malms in all directions.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_MARCECHAMP_000_002: They've even taken to harassin' the Dravanians in their own lairs, if you can believe it.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_MARCECHAMP_000_003: An' when they venture into the forest─which is more an' more, by the way─they certainly ain't afraid to come after my lot. I can only imagine how much worse it'd be closer to the Gnath's home territory...
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_MARCECHAMP_000_004: Now listen here, : if you're set on headin' west, you'd best keep your ears peeled for the angry clicks of Gnath mandibles, or you'll find yourself staring into a set.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I have read widely of the world and its wonders, yet after taking but a few steps into the unknown, I am reminded how much I have still to discover.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ESTINIEN_000_006: These hunters scrabble in the shadow of dragons for naught but the love of coin. Greed inspires courage and madness in equal measure, it seems.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_007: I am glad to see Marcechamp is doing well.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_010: 'Twould seem that much has changed in Dravania. The Gnath were not wont to cause such strife when I lived here.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_012: Aye, 'twas in the time following the Calamity. My family was dead, my home was gone, and I had fled from the bitter cold into these lands. I knew not the paths of the forest then, and wandered out from under the protection of its boughs.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_013: That was when I chanced upon Hraesvelgr. He had descended from his mountain lair to hunt for food.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_014: My exhausted mind could not contend with the sight of the majestic wyrm─nor the vision of the past his presence visited upon me. Thankfully, Marcechamp found my unconscious form at the edge of the trees, and nursed me back to health. And in Tailfeather I remained for some time.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ALPHINAUD_000_015: ...Hence your familiarity with the locals. But I interrupted you─you were saying these Gnath were once a peaceful people?
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_016: “Peaceful” would not be the most fitting description. They are a fiercely territorial tribe, and any who intrude upon their domain are attacked without hesitation or quarter.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_017: Outside the borders of their homeland, however, they were rarely hostile. Indeed, we were even able to trade with them on occasion.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ESTINIEN_000_018: They have changed, then. What of it? We have not the time to creep through the underbrush on some roundabout route. I say we make straight for Sohm Al and crush any unruly insect we meet underfoot.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_019: A more direct path, then. Very well. Let us first follow the trail west out of the forest, and make for the statue of the Stained One.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_020: From there, we should have a fair view of the road that leads to Sohm Al. Shall we...?
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Should we chance to meet Marcechamp again, remind me to thank him. Had he not warned us to expect the Gnath, I doubt I would be standing here.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ALPHINAUD_000_031: ...Amid ruins that I would tentatively describe as Ishgardian...? The style, if not quite identical, betrays a definite resemblance...
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_032: You have a scholar's eye, Master Alphinaud. This structure is, in fact, over a thousand years old. It is a remnant of the age when our ancestors and dragonkind lived together in peace.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ESTINIEN_000_033: Hmph. You claim this as evidence of our harmonious past? I was taught that these buildings were constructed by heretics, in honor of your Dravanian masters. This rubble inspires no such awe in me...
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_034: Stubborn fool. How desperately you cling to the false teachings of your beloved Holy See!
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Enough! Both of you! You threaten the success of our mission with this incessant squabbling!
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_Q1_000_002: Set aside your differences for now.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_Q1_000_003: The truth of the past will be revealed.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Quite! Lest you forget, our goal is to prevent a war which will claim the lives of Dravanians and Ishgardians alike. If we are to accomplish this, you must learn to tolerate each other's presence.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ALPHINAUD_100_036: ...Gods above, even  has lost patience with you. We have a common goal, lest you forget: to prevent a war which will claim countless lives on both sides. If we are to accomplish this, you must learn to tolerate each other's presence.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ALPHINAUD_000_037: Trust in 's gift─in time, the secrets of history will be brought to light. Let that be enough, Estinien.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ESTINIEN_000_038: You would have me keep my counsel until 's visions confirm the truth? Very well. But bait me not.
TEXT_HEAVNA309_01610_ICEHEART_000_039: Our meeting with Hraesvelgr will likely provide the catalyst 's gift requires─as it did mine. Let us press on.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_000: Spy you the three great towers to the west? Ishgardians know them as Anyx Trine. The place serves as a roost for Hraesvelgr's lesser kindred.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_001: If we are to reach the peak of Sohm Al, then we must first beseech these dragons to open the way. But do not be disheartened─the one who leads them is a friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_002: Of rather more concern is the disposition of the Gnath. Let us survey the approach to the towers, and see if the path is clear.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Dragons in the sky, and Gnath upon the ground... One must needs sprout eyes in the back of one's head to survive this land!
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ESTINIEN_000_015: These antmen are bold to bring their war to the dragons' doorstep. Mayhap we should invite them to man the walls of Ishgard...
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_010: 'Tis as I feared: the road ahead is teeming with Gnath soldiers.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Marcechamp did not exaggerate, then. These beastmen have grown brazen indeed if they would threaten the dragons so openly. Do they intend to assault the lair itself...?
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_012: I pray they do not... Mighty though my Dravanian friends are, they are yet vulnerable to the Gnath's muskets.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_013: There is no route save the one before us. Should the beastmen offer battle, we have no choice but to accept.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ALPHINAUD_000_016: The Gnath are fast becoming a nuisance. They seem to plague our every step.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ESTINIEN_000_017: Hmph. 'Twould seem the enemy of mine enemy is also mine enemy.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_020: I take no pleasure in killing the Gnath. 'Twas to avoid bloodshed that I agreed to join you on this journey.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_021:
...Well, it cannot be helped.
We may proceed into the courtyard together─but leave the task of hailing its occupants to me.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_100_021: And keep your lance on your back, dragoon.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ESTINIEN_000_022: On my word to the Warrior of Light, I shall start no fight...only finish it.
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ICEHEART_000_023: You truly are beyond salvation. Come, then...
TEXT_HEAVNA310_01611_ALPHINAUD_000_030: The scale of this structure is nothing short of astounding... But that is only to be expected, I suppose, given the size of its occupants.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ICEHEART_000_000: So, the Gnath have summoned their god... And thus is the mystery of their newfound belligerence laid to rest.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ESTINIEN_000_001: Are you not glad, Lady Iceheart? I thought you would applaud them for summoning a primal to further their own ends. After all...you did.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ICEHEART_000_002: I did not reach out to Saint Shiva to further mine own ends! I desired her strength only to forge anew the peace between man and dragon! But what a fool I am to speak of peace to you─a bloodthirsty savage who murders without thought or compunction!
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Enough! Enough, I say! If the Gnath have truly brought forth their deity from the aether, we must face it together or watch our hopes fall apart! All now rests upon this primal's defeat.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_000_004: ...But ere we think of confronting it, we must first study its origins. What is the nature of this god? What manner of faith sustains its existence?
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ICEHEART_000_005: ...My apologies. You are right, of course. Let us return to Tailfeather and consult with Marcechamp─he knows more of the Gnath and their culture than most.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_000_009: Once more a primal rears its head, and once more the task of slaying it falls to you.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_101_009: Would that I, too, possessed the Echo...
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ESTINIEN_100_009: By the Fury... Must we now defeat a primal, that we might treat with a wyrm? I do begin to see how you gained your reputation for surmounting the insurmountable...
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_MARCECHAMP_000_010:
Oho! Back already, are we?
...Hm? Ah, met the Gnath, did you? And what is it you'd like to─
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_MARCECHAMP_000_011: Summoned a primal, you say!? Seven hells... Well, I don't know bugger all about Gnath religion, if I'm honest. Beyond their tradin' habits, there never seemed much point in askin'.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_MARCECHAMP_000_012: But it shouldn't be that hard to find out. From time to time, we barter with a small hive to the north and west of here─outcasts from the main tribe, from what I understand. I reckon they'd be willin' to tell you a bit about 'emselves...if you give 'em the right incentives.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_000_013: That sounds promising. And what exactly would a Gnath consider to be “the right incentives”?
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_MARCECHAMP_000_014: Oh, nothin' your average hunter couldn't scrounge up in a day or two. But seein' as you're in a hurry, you might want to divide the chores amongst yourselves. You'll want a good-sized jar of landtrap nectar, a basket of caelumtree fruit, and─always a Gnath favorite─a generous portion of young nanka flesh.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ESTINIEN_000_015: I shall gather the fruit─leaping to the lower branches of these forest giants should present little challenge to me.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ICEHEART_000_016: Then I shall collect the nectar...with Master Alphinaud's arcane assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_MARCECHAMP_000_016: An' that leaves you to bring home the meat. You'll need to carve it from the smaller nankas that live in the rivers─three big hunks should be enough, I reckon.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_MARCECHAMP_000_017: Once you've got everythin' together, you'll need to set it down at what we call the “tradin' post.” Here─I'll mark the spot on your map for you.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_100_017: You have been most kind, Master Marcechamp.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_100_018: Well, then! Let us attend to our respective tasks, and reconvene at the trading post. I need hardly add that the last one there is a rotten nanka egg!
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_MARCECHAMP_000_018: You're in charge of gatherin' the nanka flesh, right? You'll find the beasts down by the riverbanks─just be sure to avoid the bigger ones carryin' the unhatched spawn on their backs.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_MARCECHAMP_000_019: I reckon three good hunks ought to do it. Soon as you've got 'em, head over to the tradin' post I marked on your map, an' add 'em to your mates' offerin's. Simple.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I was able to gather a goodly amount of nectar from the landtraps─though I would not have known how to harvest it without Ysayle's help. Do you have the nanka meat?
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Splendid. I shall put this with Estinien's fruit and assemble a suitably generous-looking hamper for the Gnath.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ICEHEART_000_022: Master Alphinaud possesses a rare talent for the arcane arts. Should he continue to apply himself to their study, he will become a formidable mage in time.
TEXT_HEAVNA311_01612_ESTINIEN_000_023: When I set out to master the dragoon's jump, 'twas not to strike fear into the hearts of high-hanging fruit.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Well, everything appears to be in order. Assuming no one has any objections to my choice of presentation, I shall place our offerings at the trading post as instructed. Were I of the Gnath, I think I would be suitably impressed.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ALPHINAUD_100_001: Well? How long must we wait? Should we have sounded a signal or some such?
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ESTINIEN_200_001: Calm yourself, Master Alphinaud. Our offering has not gone unnoticed.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_IDATEN_000_002: <click> <click> Long has it been since hunters last came to trade, bearing gifts that filled the air with such delightful scents.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_IDATEN_000_004: What delectable foods you have brought for us. Our meager existence is much enriched by your bounty.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_IDATEN_000_005: <click> <click> Come, hunters. Come to our hive if you would trade. Cramped and stifling our homes are, but the rancid incense keeps the dragons at bay.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_IDATEN_000_007: But better to live in stench than be cracked and crunched by dragon jaws, yes? Come, come, it is not far.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Can those truly be Gnath? Were it not for their appearance, I would think them wholly unrelated to the savage creatures that attacked us on the road.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ICEHEART_000_009: These Gnath seem harmless enough. Almost jovial, even. I would prefer, however, that we conclude our business with them as soon as possible.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ESTINIEN_000_010: ...Strangely friendly, are they not? Or mayhap just strange.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ESTINIEN_000_011: When I set out to master the dragoon's jump, 'twas not to strike fear into the hearts of high-hanging fruit.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ICEHEART_000_012: Master Alphinaud possesses a rare talent for the arcane arts. Should he continue to apply himself to their study, he will become a formidable mage in time.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_IDATEN_000_020: <click> <click> Your presence has been announced to the storyteller. You must speak to our chosen leader in words, for we are Vath. We are the Nonmind.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_IDATEN_000_021: <click> <click> The storyteller awaits you. If you wish to trade, then it is to him that you must speak.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_030: <click> <click> Welcome to our hive, hunters. You have brought delicacies much sought after by our people, and we are much pleased. What would you have in return?
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Honored elder─pray allow me to begin by thanking you for welcoming us into your home, and for accepting our humble offerings. My companions and I are come in search of knowledge─specifically, knowledge of your people's god.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_032: Knowledge alone? What strange hunters you are! But if it is words you desire, then words you shall have! We are the Vath─the Nonmind─and to speak is our fate!
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_033: You will hear the tale of the Gnath's god─of the god the Onemind summoned into our midst.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ICEHEART_000_034: The “Onemind”...these are the Gnath who reside in the main colony?
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_035: Yes, they are one. Connected. But let us begin the story at its beginning...
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_036: Some moons ago, a single dragon flew in from the east, bleeding and weak. It fell from the sky and into the hive, where it was swarmed by my brethren. And with spear, and spell, and musket, the dragon was slain.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_ESTINIEN_000_037: 'Twas likely one that had fled battle with my kinsmen. I should commend you for finishing the job.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_038: Dragons are fierce and terrible adversaries. The Onemind would always cower when their winged shadows passed over the ground. But no longer─they had learned that a battle-weary Dravanian was easy prey.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_039: Thus did the Overmind decide to heed the words of the black-robed men. The Onemind would call forth our god, and unleash His blades upon the dragons...
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_040: Dravanian lands would become Gnath lands, and ever larger would grow our domain.
TEXT_HEAVNA312_01613_STORYTELLER_000_041: But our god ever hungers. The price He demands in crystals far exceeds the rewards for this war. We of the Vath despise and revile His insatiable existence!
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ICEHEART_000_000: I call upon the power of a primal for the greater good...conscious all the while that I do so at grave cost to the land. I reason that it is a necessary evil, and willingly shoulder the burden of my sin.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ICEHEART_000_001: In suggesting that such crimes can be justified, you may argue that I presume too much─but you must surely see that I am aware of the magnitude of my transgressions. Not so the Gnath. They summon their deity for no greater purpose than to expand their dominion.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_002: To a Scion of the Seventh Dawn─one sworn to eliminate the primal threat─the distinction you draw seems questionable at best. But the fact remains that my own grandfather risked unleashing the power of the Twelve in an attempt to prevent the Calamity. Thus, while I may not condone your actions, I at least understand them.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Not so the Gnath, as you so rightly put it. If they truly seek naught but territorial gain, I can only conclude that they are ignorant of the ruinous consequences of their god's insatiable appetite. The longer this primal is suffered to exist, the greater the suffering it will cause. It must be destroyed.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ESTINIEN_000_004: How lightly you propose the destruction of this god, Master Alphinaud─a being of whom we know naught. Has it occurred to you that you may be sending the Warrior of Light to  death?
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_005: No, I─ <sigh> ...You have the right of it, Estinien. 'Twould seem it is I who am guilty of presuming too much.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_A1_000_001: I do not fear my duty.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ICEHEART_000_006: Wait.  need not face this foe alone. Like , I am blessed with the Echo's protection, and may do battle without fear of primal influence. Let me bear this burden.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ESTINIEN_000_007: Ha! Do you truly imagine yourself a second Warrior of Light? Remind me: how many primals have you faced, my lady? Not that it matters─we know not where this god resides, or how to challenge it. Unless you mean to pray until it appears?
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Hm. Estinien makes a valid point. Let us speak with the Vath, and learn how best to secure an audience with their deity. In this, at least, I may be of assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ESTINIEN_101_007: The young lord certainly appears eager to prove his worth...
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_009: The beast tribes have ever summoned their gods out of necessity. That the Gnath should do so out of mere covetousness sets a worrying precedent...
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ESTINIEN_100_009: Even a wounded dragon is a dangerous opponent─these antmen did well to overpower one.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_STORYTELLER_000_010: <click> <click> You wish to meet our god? Offer yourself as a sacrifice, and you will soon be brought before Him. We would mourn the loss of such generous hunters, however...
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_STORYTELLER_000_011: <click> <click> You wish to meet our god? Offer yourself as a sacrifice, and you will soon be brought before Him. We would mourn the loss of such generous hunters, however...
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_CIBLEROIT_000_020: We are Vath. We are the Nonmind. We do not hear the Onemind's thoughts. We cannot predict their will.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_CIBLEROIT_000_021: We are Vath. We are the Nonmind. We do not hear the Onemind's thoughts; we cannot predict their will.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_IDATEN_000_030: <click> <click> Put this idea from your minds, generous hunters. If you meet with our god, then He will have your souls. Surely you are not so generous as that?
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_IDATEN_000_031: <click> <click> Put this thought from your minds, generous hunters. If you meet with our god, then He will have your souls. Surely you are not so generous as that?
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_040: There must be some way of infiltrating the main colony...
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ICEHEART_000_041: The Vath greet mine every question with cryptic utterances. I fear I am no closer to understanding the tenets of their faith...
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ESTINIEN_000_042: By the Fury... I would swear these beastmen know less about their god than I do.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_050: You are generous hunters, yes? Many gifts you have brought, but not enough for all Vath to enjoy. Maybe you could bring us just one more?
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_051: We are very fond of nanka flesh. Yes, the meat of a young nanka would make a fine repast.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_052: Nanka flesh loosens the mandibles, and makes it easier to talk. Just a bite or two would do...
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_053: The Vath tell me that their tribe is not accustomed to giving each individual a name. It seems they only grasped the concept after they began trading with the hunters.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ESTINIEN_000_054: And what has that to do with their primal or their faith, Master Alphinaud? Let us glean the information we require, and be done with this place...
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ICEHEART_000_055: For once, I am in agreement with the dragoon. Speaking with these beastmen is an exercise in frustration.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_060: We Vath do enjoy our nanka flesh. Have you been out hunting yet...?
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_061: Another gift for the Vath!? So unexpected! Mmm, yes, you will have more of the words you strange hunters hunger for. Listen, now.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_062: The senses of the Onemind are enmeshed by the Overmind─what one sees, all see; what one feels, all feel.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_063: Alert a single Gnath, and the whole hive is alerted. To reach our god undetected is all but impossible!
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_064: The senses of the Onemind are enmeshed by the Overmind─what one sees, all see; what one feels, all feel.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_NANKAEATER_000_065: Alert a single Gnath, and the whole hive is alerted. To reach our god undetected is all but impossible!
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ESTINIEN_000_066: I do not envy the antmen their bond. Were every man's mind made known to his neighbor, Ishgard would not last a bell.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ICEHEART_000_067: How strange must spoken language seem to those who once shared minds... 'Tis little wonder the Vath are by turns so obscure and transparent in their meaning.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_070: The Vath are wont to allude to certain concepts without explanation, but I believe I am beginning to grasp a few of the fundamentals.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_071: From what I understand, the king-like “Overmind” sits at the center of Gnath society, and its presence somehow allows its subjects to communicate without need of word or gesture.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_072: These Gnath─the ones who inhabit the larger hive─are known as the “Onemind,” and it was by their combined will that the primal was summoned.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Those who reside in this smaller hive, however, are the Vath─or the “Nonmind”─who, for reasons that yet escape me, seem to have been excluded from the telepathic bond which connects their Gnath counterparts. Thus are the Vath ignorant of the Onemind's thoughts and intentions.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ESTINIEN_000_074: ...And of the nature of their own god. In summary, we have wasted our time.
TEXT_HEAVNA313_01614_ICEHEART_000_075: Not so. Perilous though it may be, the Vath did furnish us with one certain method of approaching the primal: as sacrifices. Should we allow ourselves to be captured in the environs of the colony, the Gnath will bring us before their deity to make an offering of our souls...
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Forgive me, but let us be clear about what it is that you propose. You mean to say that you would deliberately provoke the Gnath, surrender yourself into what might generously be termed their “custody,” and then wait until their god arrives to claim your soul?
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_000_001: Aye, that fairly well describes my plan. You will join me in this endeavor, will you not, ?
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_000_002: Judging by the great risks you took to prevent the summoning of Saint Shiva, you are not a  to err on the side of caution.
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ESTINIEN_000_003: ...Would that I could fight at your side, Warrior of Light. But the power of the dragon is no protection against primal influence. Forgive me, but I must remain here with Master Alphinaud.
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_000_004: Then it is settled. , you and I shall challenge the guards at the entrance to the colony. Once the hive is roused, we shall feign a brief show of resistance, and then allow them to take us prisoner.
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Estinien's words stung me more than I care to admit─'twould seem I have begun to take your victories for granted. Do be cautious, my friend...
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ESTINIEN_000_006: I would be curious to test my lance against a beast tribe's god, but I cannot risk falling under its sway. Tell me of the battle upon your return, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ESTINIEN_000_007: I will admit, I had begun to wonder whether “Nonmind” meant “brainless.” Apparently not.
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_000_008: All rests upon the destruction of the Gnath's god. If we must surrender ourselves for sacrifice to approach the abomination, freely will I do it.
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_000_011: Be at the ready, ─kicking the ants' nest will summon no few of its defenders.
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_000_020: The Overmind must by now be aware of our intrusion. Let us press on into the hive, and ensure that we have our hosts' undivided attention.
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_102_021: Leave these drones to me. We can join forces again once we are deeper within the colony!
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_000_030: That should be sufficient. If we did not have our hosts' full attention before, we must surely have it now...
TEXT_HEAVNA314_01615_ICEHEART_000_031: Our audience with the primal may be granted soon after our capture. Pray advise me once you have steeled your mind for the battle to come.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_000: Hold here, . When next the Gnath come, we offer no resistance.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_GNATHSOLDIER01616_0: (-Gnath soldiers-)Surrender, intruders! There is no escape!
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_002: Enough! We surrender! We throw ourselves upon the mercy of your god!
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_010: They seem eager to proceed. Good. When they take us before their lord, pray leave matters to me. If what I know of summoning rituals holds true, I shall be well placed to act.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_011: ...Hmmm. Mark the sound of the river rushing through the ravine behind us. Passing loud, is it not? I imagine the noise would serve to mask our escape should we need to withdraw temporarily.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_012: But you are prepared, are you not? I do hope so. If I were to be dragged away for sacrifice while you were haggling over the price of potions, I should not be amused.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_003: Though I dismissed Master Alphinaud's concerns, I confess that I did wonder how the Gnath might treat their prisoners. Happily, it would seem they are not wont to harm sacrifices─nor even to disarm them. Plainly, they imagine their god invulnerable. The plan goes better than expected...
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_GNATHSOLDIER01616_0: Try to escape and we will break your fleshy legs.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_GNATHSENTRY01616_00: Try to escape and we will break your fleshy legs.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_006: The time is come. Let us bring an end to this unpleasant business.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_GNATHPRIEST_000_014: The Wrath of the Colony is undefeated! Victory to the Gnath!
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_GNATHSOLDIER01616_0: The Wrath of the Colony is undefeated! Victory to the Gnath!
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_GNATHSENTRY01616_00: The Wrath of the Colony is undefeated! Victory to the Gnath!
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_020: Never since we first fought have I seen you draw upon the full extent of your power...and never from afar till this day. You were a marvel to behold, .
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_021: Well...'tis time we rejoined our companions. They will be eager to hear the tale...and to continue our journey.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ESTINIEN_000_022: The antmen's god is fallen, then? Impressive, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ALPHINAUD_100_022: Are you unharmed, !? What of Lady Ysayle?
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ALPHINAUD_000_031: ...“Lord Ravana,” you say? How curious that the Vath never mentioned his name... And you are quite certain he will keep his word?
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_000_032: There was honor beneath his savagery.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_100_032: That we survived the encounter at all was a miracle─a miracle I must attribute to .
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ESTINIEN_000_033: Never did I doubt you, Warrior of Light...unlike some. You were gone so long that Master Alphinaud here nigh lost his wits with worry. Fretting like a maid for her sweetheart, he was!
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ESTINIEN_000_035: Hahaha... Not truly necessary─but certainly true.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Ahem! What matters is that the primal is banished, and our promise fulfilled. We should return to Vidofnir without delay.
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ALPHINAUD_000_037: Lest you forget, this was but a means to secure an audience with the wyrm Hraesvelgr. Nidhogg's minions will not be halted by idle chatter! Come, now─we must make every moment count!
TEXT_HEAVNA315_01616_ICEHEART_100_037: You are unkind, Estinien. For all his experience and intellect, Alphinaud is still but a boy.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Shall we be on our way to Anyx Trine, then? I would not have the dragons think that we have forgotten our bargain.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_001: Ahh, you should have seen the boy fretting... 'Twas a sight to behold!
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_002: Tease him no more. Master Alphinaud is to be applauded for his sense of responsibility. Given his years, 'tis little wonder the burden weighs heavy upon his shoulders...
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_100_002: 'Tis natural for him to feel concern for his companions.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_003: Vidofnir will be pleased to hear of Lord Ravana's defeat, and of his pledge to recall his soldiers.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_004: Will the dragon now honor her word? That remains to be seen...
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_005: You should be the one to break the news. The victory was yours, after all.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_010: Thou art returned, Little One. Hast thou abandoned thine ill-conceived contest with the Gnath?
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_011: Nay, my friend, we return in triumph. By 's hand was the beastmen's god, Lord Ravana, laid low.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_012: In his overconfidence, the primal swore to withdraw his followers from your lands in the event of his defeat─a promise we believe he will keep. The Gnath shall trouble you no longer.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_013: The deity is slain, then...? How didst thou contend with his biting blades!? ...But the particulars matter not. Thou hast fulfilled thy promise, and I shall fulfill mine.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_015: Attend me, mortals: hie you unto the deepest reaches of Mourn, and there shall you find Halo─the altar from which you may begin your ascent to the summit of Sohm Al.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_016: But be fairly warned: the minions of Nidhogg shall not lightly suffer your presence on that sacred mount. By your struggles within the cavern shall I judge your party possessed of sufficient fortitude to proceed.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_017: We shall not disappoint you, Vidofnir.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_100_017: If memory serves, the cavern of Mourn is entered from the second floor of the central tower. Let us begin the climb.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_018: Be fairly warned: the minions of Nidhogg shall not lightly suffer your presence on the sacred mount. By your struggles within the cavern of Mourn shall I judge your party possessed of sufficient fortitude to proceed.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_020: Well done, Little One. As promised, I shall open the way to Sohm Al's summit for thee and thy companions.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_021: Heed me now, children of man: the domain you seek to enter hath not seen visitors of your kind in nigh on a thousand years. Though I freely grant you passage, your presence will not be welcomed.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_022: To my kin, this mountain is revered as holy ground and resting place both─ware you the minions of Nidhogg during your ascent, for 'tis certain they shall take great offense at your intrusion.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_023: We are grateful for your warnings, gentle Vidofnir.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_VIDOFNIR_000_024: My final words are for thee, dragoon: have care to keep the stolen power thou wieldest in check, lest it breed further despair.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_026: The way is open. Let us not tarry here.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_027: A moment! Shall we blindly forge on, knowing the dangers that await us? Tioman herself is said to guard this peak.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_028: I do not fear Nidhogg's consort. Any dragon foolish enough to bar our path shall feel the sting of my lance.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_029: Spoken like a true butcher! Need I remind you that we are come to parley a peace!?
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_030: Let us be clear, heretic: 'twas to save Ishgard and her people that I first lent my support to this doubtful venture. And 'tis for their sake that I go now to speak with Hraesvelgr.
