TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_031: But I said nothing of Tioman. Should the opportunity present itself to rid my people of one of their deadliest enemies, I shall take it. That is my duty as Azure Dragoon.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ALPHINAUD_000_033: We will accomplish nothing by bickering. If we are to meet with Hraesvelgr, our path leads up the mountain.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ALPHINAUD_000_034: We shall defend ourselves if attacked, but avoid conflict wherever possible. What other choice do we have?
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ALPHINAUD_000_035: We shall defend ourselves if attacked, but avoid conflict wherever possible. What other choice do we have?
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_036: I feel the weight of Dravanian rancor pressing down upon me...
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_037: A dragon lost to anger is beyond all control. This I learned to my sorrow when I unleashed the Horde upon Ishgard...
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_100_040: Tioman, consort of Nidhogg, we beseech you─grant us safe passage to the mountain's summit. We mean you no harm.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_110_040: As I thought. Blind to reason like all the rest. If you would see our mission to its conclusion, you know what must be done.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_120_040: Such rage and rancor... Is there truly no other way?
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_041: 'Twould seem Tioman was the last. I sense no other dragons nearby.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_044: He knows we are here, then?
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_045: His fury... <gasp> It bleeds through the Eye.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_046: Fear not, I am yet my own master...
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_047: ...But that damned wyrm's wrath burns hotter than flame... Come, the heart of the dragons' homeland yet lies before us.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_048: Thus do we add another link to the chain of vengeance. Oh, Saint Shiva, when will it end...?
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ALPHINAUD_000_050: We have reached it at last... The peak of Sohm Al.
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ALPHINAUD_000_051: 'Tis said to be the highest mountain in all of Eorzea, you know. I thought it cold in Coerthas, but the air here carries the chill of a dozen winters...
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ICEHEART_000_052: We stand within the sacred homeland of dragons, beneath the sky that is Hraesvelgr's domain. Our quest nears its end, ...
TEXT_HEAVNA316_01617_ESTINIEN_000_053: Ahhh... I feel the wyrm's anger. His lair is not far...not far at all.
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Now that we have scaled the mountain, there remains the problem of finding Hraesvelgr himself...
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ICEHEART_000_001: What manner of creature is that...?
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ALPHINAUD_000_002: . Do my eyes deceive me, or was that a moogle?
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ALPHINAUD_000_003: It was my understanding that they only dwelled within the Twelveswood. I certainly never expected to see one in the Churning Mists...
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ALPHINAUD_000_004: If the moogle does live here, however, he may know where Hraesvelgr makes his lair. Quickly, now, before we lose the creature completely!
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ESTINIEN_000_005: This place is far from the barren mountaintop I pictured in my mind...
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ICEHEART_000_006: Well, dragoon? Do you believe these ruins were also built by heretics to deceive the faithful of Ishgard?
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ICEHEART_000_007: How can one not be moved by such a breathtaking sight...
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Bah, he's gone! , we must widen our search.
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ESTINIEN_000_011: A “moogle,” did you say? I am unfamiliar with the breed, but I shall search for one nonetheless...
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ALPHINAUD_000_013: We did see a moogle, did we not...?
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ESTINIEN_000_020: I see no evidence of this moogle of yours. Are you certain it wasn't a trick of the light? Mayhaps 'twas simply one of these strange plants, shifting in a breeze...
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ICEHEART_000_030: I have heard tales of these moogles, but 'tis the first time I've ever laid eyes on one. They are rather adorable, aren't they?
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ICEHEART_000_031: What─ Why do you stare at me so? Can I not find a creature adorable? My heart is not truly made of ice...
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_SYSTEM_000_040: There is no sign of a moogle in the area...
TEXT_HEAVNA317_01618_ALPHINAUD_000_050: I'm sure I glimpsed the moogle fleeing in this direction. Could he be concealing himself with magic...?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Confound it. Could we but enlist the aid of one of the local moogles, I am certain Hraesvelgr would not elude us for long...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ESTINIEN_000_001: Though the Eye enables me to sense the presence of dragons, I can only identify Nidhogg's with any certainty. We could wander the Mists for days, and not know if we were any closer to his brood-brother...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_002: And those are days we cannot well afford to squander. Shall we divide our forces, then?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Lady Ysayle─might I ask you to question any dragons whom you judge it safe to approach?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ICEHEART_000_004: I shall try. Yet I fear the influence of Nidhogg's rage will render most of the Dravanians in the area deaf to reason. And what of you, Master Alphinaud?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I have not yet given up on the moogles.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_100_005: ─come with me to Gridania. I mean to petition the aid of the moogles' kin in the Twelveswood. After that business with Moggle Mog, I daresay they will be glad to help us.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ESTINIEN_000_006: Assuming you have no need of me, I shall remain here.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ESTINIEN_000_007: Nidhogg senses both the loss of his consort and the coming of the Eye, and his attention is firmly fixed in this direction. I mean to do what I can to hold his gaze, in the hope that it might delay any action against Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_100_008: Come then, , let us make haste for Gridania, and rendezvous at Nophica's Altar. Ah, but I neglected to tell you...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_009: There is an aetheryte of ancient construction here which should make the return journey rather less arduous. Pray do not forget to use it!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ESTINIEN_000_010: I sincerely hope you have taken Master Alphinaud's advice concerning the aetheryte. You would not wish to miss the sport if Nidhogg deigned to visit us in your absence.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I sent word to the Elder Seedseer upon arriving in Gridania, and I am pleased to report that she has agreed to grant us an audience. If anyone can help us to contact the Twelveswood moogles, it is she.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_021: We are expected at the Lotus Stand. I trust you are familiar with the conjurer stationed at its entrance?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_022: The Elder Seedseer will receive us at the Lotus Stand. I trust you are familiar with the conjurer stationed at its entrance?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_DOORMANLOTUS_000_03: The Elder Seedseer awaits you. Pray follow me.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_031: I bid you welcome, friends. The Admiral spoke of having met with you, but 'tis no less of a relief to see you safe and hale with mine own eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_032: We humbly thank you for agreeing to receive us upon such short notice, my lady─and for all you have done for us in our absence. Would that it were solely to express our gratitude that we came to you this day...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Alas, the tides of battle yet dictate our comings and goings. Elder Seedseer─we would beg your wisdom in a matter that may finally bring an end to the Dragonsong War.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_035: ...I see. So you seek a means to contact these moogles of the Churning Mists...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_037: Greetings, Kuplo Kopp. To what do we owe the pleasure of your company?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_038: (-Kuplo Kopp-)I was struck by the sudden urge to bring you some fruit, Kan-E─and I'm jolly glad I did! Tell me more about these moogles in the sky, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_039: I will gladly tell you all I know─though it amounts to precious little. We encountered a moogle high in the clouds of Dravania, and had hoped that you and your kin in the Twelveswood might agree to facilitate a meeting.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_040: Pray correct me if I am mistaken, Kuplo, but there are legends, are there not, which speak of moogles who dwelled beyond the clouds?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_041: (-Kuplo Kopp-)Indeed there are, kupo! Long, long ago, back when the world was still young, they say my ancestors served the gods up in the heavens. Of course, that was before their masters took to bickering like spoiled children...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_042: Ah, yes, the tale of Good King Moggle Mog XII. He is revered for holding fast to a rope of miraculous length, that his subjects might climb down from the sky and escape to the world below.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Hmm... Ignoring the more fanciful aspects of the tale, it may well be that Kuplo's ancestors hailed from the Churning Mists. Given how long his kin have resided in the Twelveswood, it is perfectly possible that the details of their history have faded into myth...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_044: Indeed, Master Alphinaud. Such stories oft contain a measure of truth. 'Tis like that the moogles of the Churning Mists tell similar tales of the world below... I can well imagine why the one you encountered fled at your approach.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_045: (-Kuplo Kopp-)Oh, fleeing's second nature to us! We often hide when the larger races come tramping through the forest. Of course, where there's one moogle, there's bound to be more...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_046: (-Kuplo Kopp-)...Which is why I've decided to take a trip to the clouds, kupo! They surely won't be afraid to talk to me!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_047: I was hoping you might say that, Master Kuplo. You will accompany us, then?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_048: (-Kuplo Kopp-)Just you try and stop me, kupo! I'll admit, the thought of venturing outside the Twelveswood is a bit unsettling, but I can hardly refuse a chance to meet my distant, distant cousins!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_049: If you will have me, I too will accompany you on this venture, and lend my voice to your cause as an ambassador of Gridania.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_050: M-My lady, I─ Are you quite certain?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_051: How oft has our nation turned to the Scions of the Seventh Dawn in its hour of need? How oft have we asked the Warrior of Light to risk  life to save our own?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_052: Full many times, I say to you─and never have they refused us. Thus do I choose this day to offer mine aid to our allies for the good of the realm.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_054: A most unexpected─and most welcome─offer, Elder Seedseer. We would be honored by your presence.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_DOORMANLOTUS_000_05: Is it true that the Elder Seedseer means to journey with you to Dravania? I shudder to think of the dangers...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Pray return to the summit and inform our companions of these developments─I will serve as the Elder Seedseer's guide on the journey back to Sohm Al.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_061: It being a path I have already trodden, I do not anticipate any great difficulties. Besides, we shall have the Elder Seedseer's personal guard to escort us.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Pray return to the summit and inform our companions of these developments─I will serve as the Elder Seedseer's guide on the journey back to Sohm Al.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_063: It being a path I have already trodden, I do not anticipate any great difficulties. Besides, we shall have the Elder Seedseer's personal guard to escort us.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ICEHEART_000_064: Ah, , you are returned. How fared you in Gridania? Better than I, I hope... Hraesvelgr's whereabouts yet elude me.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ESTINIEN_000_070: Well met, Warrior of Light. Nidhogg has not stirred, but he watches us, unblinking...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ESTINIEN_000_071: ...Hm? The Elder Seedseer herself answers your call? Then there is naught to do but wait.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Greetings, my friends. I am happy to report that our journey was mercifully uneventful, devoid as the road was of Dravanians. 'Twould seem the dragons have abandoned Sohm Al for the Churning Mists.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ALPHINAUD_000_074: Elder Seedseer, may I present to you Ser Estinien, Ishgard's Azure Dragoon.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_075: 'Tis an honor to meet you, Ser Estinien. I have heard many tales of your order's extraordinary skill and courage.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_076: Friends─I feel it only right to inform you that we are not alone. The moogles are all around us even as we speak. And I should imagine they are more than a little concerned by the horde of strangers that have descended upon their home. Mayhap now would be an opportune moment to introduce ourselves.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_078: (-Kuplo Kopp-)They're hiding, of course─but there are so many of them, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_079: I am Kan-E-Senna. My companions and I have braved the long road from the Twelveswood to share words with you.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_080: On this, the occasion of our first meeting, we bring an offering of light and wind.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_081: (-???-)Oooh, such a gentle and pleasing glow, kupo...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_082: I am Moglin, the chieftain of this moogle clan.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_083: Chieftain Moglin─it is an honor to meet you.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_084: (-Kuplo Kopp-)Greetings! I am Kuplo Kopp, ambassador of the Twelveswood moogles!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_085: ...A moogle from the world below? Your hide is of a different hue, but that pom is unmistakable! I might need a moment here, kupo...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_086: My companions were no less surprised to learn of your existence here amongst the clouds. I hope they did not startle you overmuch in their eagerness to make your acquaintance. Full well can I imagine your wariness. I am told that men have not walked here in nigh on a thousand winters.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_087: Mayhap you will forgive them their forwardness when I unfold to you the grave matter which first brought them into your midst. My companions crave an audience with the great wyrm Hraesvelgr that they might negotiate an end to the war 'twixt man and dragon.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_088: An end to war, you say? Hmm... I trust you, Kan-E-Senna─the light of peace shines brightly within your soul.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_089: ...But I'm afraid the same cannot be said of your friends. To be plain, we did not hide ourselves because they were the first of your kind to be seen here in a thousand years─well, not only because of that. We hid because we smelled dragon blood.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_090: These skies are home to many, many dragons.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_091: While some crave peace, such as Hraesvelgr, many others crave the opposite...such as Nidhogg. Suffice it to say, we are worried that the presence of your blood-spattered warrior friends will attract the attention of the nastier kind, and invite destruction into our happy home.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_092: (-Kuplo Kopp-)Now just a moment, Chieftain!  here may have doled out the odd thrashing or two, but it's always been for a really good reason!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KUPLOKOPP_000_093: (-Kuplo Kopp-) is a champion of the Twelveswood moogles, and I'll not hear  good name slandered!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_094: Now, now, Ambassador─let's not ruffle each other's fur. I shall of course take your testimony into consideration...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_095: If I may, Chieftain: there is little room for trust 'twixt strangers. Might we not take this opportunity to learn more of each other?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_096: An excellent suggestion, kupo. In the interests of fostering friendship─and keeping an eye on you─I extend to you the hospitality of Moghome.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_KANESENNA_000_097: Prove yourselves worthy of our assistance, and it will be yours. I shall be watching, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ICEHEART_000_098: Forgive me, , but mine efforts have all been in vain. As I feared, Nidhogg's rage drives his minions to attack me on sight.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_ICEHEART_000_099: And the few who did deign to speak fell silent at the name of Hraesvelgr. Wherefore, I cannot say, yet I fear it bodes ill.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_100: Tell me─in the world down below, do all of your kind look so different from one another? It must be terribly disconcerting...
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_101: What was it Kuplo Kopp called you again?
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_102: "“? Hmph! Your names are as odd as your appearance. Have you ever considered a nice moogle name? ”Moglin“ is taken, by the way, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_103: As are “Moghan,” “Mogmug,” and “Mogwin”─these being the names of the three wise moogles who will administer the momentous challenges that I have devised to measure your worth. I call them...the Trials of Trustworthiness.
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGLIN_000_104: Undertake these trials, and we shall soon see whether or not you are worthy of our aid!
TEXT_HEAVNA318_01619_MOGC01622_101_105: Has Maestro Mogwin finished his latest piece? I can hardly wait to see it, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_000: Hello! Yes, I am Moghan─the foremost alchemist in Moghome, if you must know!
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_001: If your tummy's gloopy or your wings're droopy, I've a potion to fix that!
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_002: Or, I would if I didn't keep running out of ingredients. Luckily, you're here to do my chore─ Er, trial! Yes! Go forth, mighty adventurer, and mightily pluck three sprigs of cloudsbreath for me!
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_003: You'll find it blooming near the entrance to Eil Tohm. It's not the safest of places, so don't let yourself be too distracted by the pretty flowers, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_004: Pick three sprigs of cloudsbreath─that is your trial. Simple enough, kupo?
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_005: Just pay attention to the denizens near Eil Tohm. They're not exactly, um, friendly!
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_010: Did you have any trouble finding cloudsbreath? I do need it quite urgently, you know...
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_011: Oh, yes, these are perfect, kupo! Now I have the main ingredient for my pom tonic.
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_MOGHAN_000_012: ...Speaking of which, how are you feeling, ? Should you ever feel your pom losing its bounce, then I'm your moogle, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA319_01620_SYSTEM_000_900: You have completed the Trials of Trustworthiness. Return to Chieftain Moglin and await his judgment.
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_000: Hm? Yes, you have the pleasure of speaking with Mogmug. I know, I know, I am the fluffiest, most enchanting creature you have ever laid eyes upon, kupo.
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_001: It isn't easy being this adorable! I can barely take a stroll outside without those relentless Dravanians throwing themselves at me... Why, they look as if they might just gobble me right up!
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_002: In any case, fleeing their overbearing adulation is growing a bit tiresome. Your trial, , is this: find these ardent archaeosaurs, and slap some manners into them, kupo.
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_003: Perhaps a firm smack on the snout will teach them to appreciate my charm from afar!
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_004: Those archaeosaurs need a good trouncing, I say! It's the only way they'll learn to respect my boundaries.
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_005: I do appreciate my admirers, but enough is enough, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_010: You were able to humble my Dravanian devotees? Wonderful! You are as capable as I am captivating, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_011: Still, my precious perfection does not excuse those louts from pursuing me so mercilessly, their tongues lolling and bellies rumbling!
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_MOGMUG_000_012: The Dravanians and their ilk have much to learn about acceptable acts of admiration!
TEXT_HEAVNA320_01621_SYSTEM_000_900: You have completed the Trials of Trustworthiness. Return to Chieftain Moglin and await his judgment.
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_000: Mogwin's the name, and art is my game. When it comes to painting, there are none in Moghome who can match my talent with a brush, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_001: I know why you have come─Chieftain Moglin has demanded that I test your trustworthiness. But as I trust no one to create art that will satisfy me, I instead charge you with retrieving a masterpiece I seem to have misplaced...
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_002: It was an ambitious and innovative work─guaranteed to fetch at least four kupo nuts on the open market. You must find it! Question the masses!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_003: Surely a pebble painted with such vibrant color and unmistakable panache cannot have escaped the notice of every moogle in Moghome...
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_004: You must find my painted pebble, kupo! Art of this quality cannot be bought...for any less than four kupo nuts!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_005: Please, speak with my fellow moogles and track down my missing masterpiece!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGC01622_101_005: Has Maestro Mogwin finished his latest piece? I can hardly wait to see it, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGOMO_000_010: Mogwin is missing his masterpiece, kupo? Oh, you mean that paint-smeared mess of a pebble? I've not seen it recently─a fact for which my eyes are profoundly grateful.
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGOMO_000_011: Mogwin is missing his masterpiece, kupo? Oh, you mean that paint-smeared mess of a pebble? I've not seen it recently─a fact for which my eyes are profoundly grateful.
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGTOE_000_020: Hmmm. I don't know much about his stone, but I do know Mogwin's been creeping out the back way to Sohm Al's summit from time to time, kupo. Maybe he left it up there...
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGTOE_000_021: Hmmm. I don't know much about his stone, but I do know Mogwin's been creeping out the back way to Sohm Al's summit from time to time, kupo. Maybe he left it up there...
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGC01622_000_030: Maestro Mogwin has misplaced his masterpiece, kupo!? Oh, happy day!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGC01622_000_031: If I am the swifter in finding it, I will soon have a genuine Mogwin for the price of a little perspiration! Honestly, who has four kupo nuts just lying about to spend on such luxuries...
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_040: Well, what did you find out, kupo?
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_041: Ah. Ah, yes. Now that you mention it, I do seem to recall leaving my pebble out in the sun to dry...
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_042: Ahem! The second part of your trial commences! Go, adventurer, and retrieve my masterpiece before some art-starved admirer swipes the stone for himself!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_043: My pebble is somewhere out in the open on Sohm Al's summit. Retrieve it for me, and I shall put in a good word for you with the chieftain, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_050: Do you have it, kupo? Is my masterpiece safe?
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_051: Yes, this is my work! Is it not exquisite? I call it Contemplations of Zenith.
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_MOGWIN_000_052: Thank you, ! At last, I can exchange my art for those delectable kupo nuts! Chieftain Moglin will hear of this valorous deed!
TEXT_HEAVNA321_01622_SYSTEM_000_900: You have completed the Trials of Trustworthiness. Return to Chieftain Moglin and await his judgment.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_000: ─if that is what you insist on calling yourself─you have completed the Trials of Trustworthiness administered by the taskmasters Moghan, Mogmug, and Mogwin!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_001: During these grueling tests of character, I closely observed your conduct─as well as that of your companions...
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_002: And...I am decided, kupo! Gather your friends before me now, so that I need not repeat myself...needlessly.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_003: Not another word until you have summoned your companions, kupo! I was quite serious about the “not repeating myself” part...
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Are these “trials” over, then? My tasks have been little more than household chores...
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ALPHINAUD_000_011: If our hosts elect not to grant their aid after working us like pack chocobos, I shall demand compensation in kupo nuts out of principle. But I hope it will not come to that. Let us hear the chieftain's verdict, shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_BODYGUARD01623_100_: They had the Elder Seedseer scrubbing and sweeping... The Elder Seedseer!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_BODYGUARD01412_100_: I never imagined my duties would include tidying up fallen leaves in a moogle village beyond the clouds...
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ICEHEART_000_020: What sorcery is this...? That my heart should stir at mere...fluffiness...
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ICEHEART_000_021: ! I-I was... No matter. What is it? ...Chieftain Moglin has made his decision? Well, let us not keep him waiting, then!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_KANESENNA_000_030: Standing here in Moghome, my thoughts turn inevitably to the legend of Good King Moggle Mog XII, and his seat in the heavens...
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_KANESENNA_000_031: Like most, I thought it no more than a myth─a story for younglings that grew with the telling. But with every passing moment, I become more certain that we have discovered the origin of the tale. Full eager am I to hear what the chieftain has to say.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_KUPLOKOPP_000_040: We've become such friends, kupo! My moogle cousins love to sing and dance as much as I do!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_KUPLOKOPP_000_041: ...Chieftain Moglin has finally come to a decision, has he? Well, I suppose I'd better flutter over and see him, then!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ESTINIEN_000_050: How go your trials, Warrior of Light? I myself have been sent on a number of expeditions to “chastise” the local dragon population. Did not their chieftain wish to avoid inflaming the Dravanians...?
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ESTINIEN_000_051: Such contradictions aside, our hosts seemed entranced by the height of my leap. They compared me to “Mog,” a lance-wielding moogle warrior of eld who also favored such attacks.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ESTINIEN_000_052: 'Twas meant as a compliment, I expect, but I doubt these furry lumps could outleap a karakul lamb, much less a dragoon. Conclude your business here swiftly, ─I like not this place.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_063: Never have I seen such determined workers, kupo! It would have taken us moons to complete all those dreary chores and niggling errands!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_KANESENNA_000_064: And have our labors proven the purity of our intentions, Chieftain?
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_065: Without a doubt! In fact, there was never really all that much doubt to begin with... You were, after all, already friends with a fellow moogle.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_066: But, you see, before any meeting with Hraesvelgr could take place, certain preparations needed to be made... And what better way to help you pass the time than by having you perform all the tiresome tasks that no one ever wants to do, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_068: Ohhh dear... Th-The horn! Bring out the horn! Quickly now!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_069: We blow on this wondrous instrument whenever we wish to speak with the great wyrm, kupo.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_070: We, uh...we haven't perhaps been treating it with the care it deserves of late (and I think Moghan may have sat on it), so we needed some time for cleaning and polishing (and straightening).
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_071: No lasting harm done, though! Now, you need simply head to Zenith─the wyrm's dwelling to the west─and give the horn a good toot.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ICEHEART_000_072: We are in your debt, Chieftain. Thanks to your noble gift, we shall finally have a chance to plead our case to Hraesvelgr.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_073:
...Very possibly, yes.
...But I wouldn't get my hopes up too high, kupo. The old wyrm isn't terribly fond of...um...
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ICEHEART_000_074: Your concern is appreciated, but I am quite certain that Hraesvelgr will welcome our overtures.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ESTINIEN_000_075: ...Should we ever arrive at his lair. Come─we have squandered enough time already.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_KANESENNA_000_076: Chieftain Moglin, we thank you for your gracious hospitality. Though we must soon take our leave, I pray that we may continue to nurture the shoots of this new-sprung friendship 'twixt earth and sky.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_077: Of course, of course, kupo! Visit us whenever you wish! Consider Moghome your home amongst the clouds!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Well that took rather longer than expected. We can ill afford any further delays...
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ESTINIEN_000_081: Barefaced little bastards... They have played us for fools.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_ICEHEART_000_082: Hraesvelgr... At last, we shall meet again.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_KANESENNA_000_083: This journey has provided us an invaluable opportunity. We must cherish and strengthen the new bonds we have forged.
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_KUPLOKOPP_000_084: Oh, I have so many wonderful tales to tell my kinsmoogles back in the Twelveswood!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGLIN_000_085: Visit us whenever you wish, kupo! Consider Moghome your home amongst the clouds!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGHAN_000_060: Thanks for the help, kupo! I doubt I would ever have found time for all those rotten chores!
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGHAN_000_061: ...H-Hey, it wasn't my idea! If the chieftain had spent a little less time sitting about and a little more time chieftaining, things would never have gotten so messy in the first place! (And he was the one who sat on the horn, by the way.)
TEXT_HEAVNA322_01623_MOGHAN_000_062: But now all the errands are done and the horn is fixed, so...all's well that ends well, eh, kupo?
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_MOGHAN_000_000: Well, uh...I expect you're eager to be on your way! ...Did I mention your friend was looking for you, kupo? If not: Alphinaud is looking for you!
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_MOGHAN_000_001: I'll be waiting just outside, stretching my wings. Let me know when you're ready to depart!
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_014: I dare not think how long we have been away from Ishgard. Gods help us if we meet with further delays...
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ESTINIEN_000_015: What was I thinking, listening to those self-satisfied little... <mumble>
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ICEHEART_000_016: It will not be long now, Hraesvelgr...
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_KANESENNA_000_017: Through our labors, new friendships have blossomed. For this, we must give thanks.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_KUPLOKOPP_000_018: I cannot wait to tell my kinsmoogles in the Twelveswood all about this place! They will be beside themselves with envy, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_BODYGUARD01623_101_: They had the Elder Seedseer scrubbing and sweeping... The Elder Seedseer!
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_BODYGUARD01412_101_: I never imagined my duties would include tidying up fallen leaves in a moogle village beyond the clouds...
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_010: To the best of my knowledge, we have all that we need for our trip to Zenith. And I believe the Elder Seedseer and her retinue will soon be making the journey back to Gridania.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_011: It would be remiss of us, I think, not to convey our gratitude to them prior to going our separate ways. Shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_012: The Elder Seedseer and her retinue will soon be departing for Gridania.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Before they do, it seems only right that we thank them for their assistance. Shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_MOGHAN_000_019: ...Why do I get the feeling my life is in mortal danger? Could it be those berries I had for supper?
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ESTINIEN_100_019: Must we have this creature as our guide? I would sooner flay the thing than follow it.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_KANESENNA_000_020: Alphinaud, ─I do humbly thank you for what has been a most enlightening experience. Were it not for your pioneering spirit, the existence of these moogles might never have been revealed to us.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_021: 'Tis we who should be thankful, Elder Seedseer. Were it not for your timely diplomacy, they would never have chosen to reveal themselves at all.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_022: And 'twas your presence, Kuplo Kopp, that ultimately won us their trust. It must have taken great courage to leave the sanctuary of the Twelveswood, and we are exceedingly glad that you did.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_KUPLOKOPP_000_023: It was my pleasure, kupo! I've made so many new friends, and have so many fantastic tales to tell my kinsmoogles back home!
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_KANESENNA_000_024: And it is to our home that we must now return. May you ever walk in the light of the Crystal, my friends.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Safe journey, Elder Seedseer. We too must be on our way. Hraesvelgr awaits.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_KANESENNA_000_026: Warrior of Light... Pray attend closely to your companion, Ser Estinien─beneath that stoical facade, a storm of anguish seethes unseen.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_MOGHAN_000_027: Have you said your good-byes and dabbed away your tears, kupo? Then we are indeed ready to go!
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ALPHINAUD_000_028: We have tarried overlong. Let us forge ahead as swiftly as we may, lest Ishgard bear the brunt of the Horde's fury.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ESTINIEN_000_029: Enough talk. Let us leave this risible place behind us.
TEXT_HEAVNA323_01624_ICEHEART_000_030: The closer we come to Hraesvelgr, the higher my spirits rise. But is it I who am elated...or Saint Shiva?
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_MOGHAN_000_000: As Chieftain Moglin already explained, the shiny instrument we gave you is the best means of grabbing Hraesvelgr's attention. I'll come along, and show you the way to Zenith─that's the big palace where you need to blow the horn.
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_MOGHAN_000_001: First things first, though, we need to make for Asah. Oh...and watch out for rampaging dragons. Hm, maybe that should have been the first thing, kupo.
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_ALPHINAUD_000_002: We have tarried overlong. Let us forge ahead as swiftly as we may, lest Ishgard bear the brunt of the Horde's fury.
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_ESTINIEN_000_003: Enough talk. Let us leave this risible place behind us.
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_ICEHEART_000_004: The closer we come to Hraesvelgr, the higher my spirits rise. But is it I who am elated...or Saint Shiva?
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_MOGHAN_000_010: Things were a bit bitey for a while there, but I think we've arrived in one piece, kupo.
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_MOGHAN_000_011: I wonder what has the dragons so awfully snappy... I mean, the bad ones are always bad, but they seem worse than usual.
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_ALPHINAUD_000_020: The histories make no reference to the existence of these ruins... Curious... Most curious...
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_ESTINIEN_000_021: Never would I have believed that so much land lay hid above the clouds... Dravania is not as I imagined it.
TEXT_HEAVNA324_01625_ICEHEART_000_022: Do you see that sculpture to the south and west of here? I am all but certain it was carved in the likeness of Saint Shiva.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_MOGHAN_000_000: Hmmm...we may have a small problem, kupo. When the winds are high like this, Hraesvelgr invariably abandons his lofty perch and heads to the lands below to hunt.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_MOGHAN_000_001: If you tried blowing the horn now, I doubt he'd hear it. I suggest we stop at the clearing up ahead and rest until the wind dies down.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_100_003: The histories make no reference to the existence of these ruins... Curious... Most curious...
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_003: Never would I have believed that so much land lay hid above the clouds... Dravania is not as I imagined it.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ICEHEART_000_004: Do you see that sculpture to the west of here? I am all but certain it was carved in the likeness of Saint Shiva.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_005: The fates make mock of us. To be so close...
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_006: Who can say when the weather will turn... I have a mind to make camp.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ICEHEART_000_007: And now the very elements conspire to delay our meeting with Hraesvelgr... <sigh> I must be patient.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_MOGHAN_100_010: This should do nicely, kupo. The winds will likely have died down by tomorrow, but until then, we might as well make ourselves comfortable!
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_010: If we must interrupt our journey so close to its end, I suppose this place is as good as any.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_011: And mayhap a brief respite from the hardships of the road will help to clear our minds in readiness for the coming parley. Very well, then. I believe a campfire is in order.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Leave the gathering of fuel to me─I acquired a keen nose for firewood during my time in the frozen wastes of Coerthas.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_040: Hmph. “Clear our minds”? 'Tis Master Alphinaud whose mind needs clearing. The thought of meeting a great wyrm in the flesh has befuddled the boy.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_041: Did you see him stroll away as if these ruins were not crawling with deadly beasts? Follow him, , and see that the wildlife does not make a meal of our young friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_042: We will have the camp ready by the time you return.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_043: Master Alphinaud's artless quest for firewood is like to get him killed. I suggest you follow after the boy, and see that no harm comes to him.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ICEHEART_100_043: Do you see that sculpture to the west of here? I am all but certain it was carved in the likeness of Saint Shiva.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_MOGHAN_000_044: You know, Estinien may not be as bad as I thought, kupo. Under all those horrid spikes, he actually has a soft spot for his companions. Just a small one, mind. Oh, and don't tell him I told you, all right?
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ICEHEART_000_060: I've prepared some things for a meal. It will be plain fare, but better that than empty bellies.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_070: I see I was right to worry about the boy's safety.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_071: Once Alphinaud returns with the wood, we can see about supper. The ice queen has filled a pot with what looked like stew ingredients, ready for the fire.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Ahhh...few things compare to the simple pleasure of sitting beside a crackling campfire of one's own making.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_014: Hah! So speaks the “great explorer.” Until recently, you wouldn't have recognized firewood if it came with kindling and a flint.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_015: 'Tis well you instructed me so patiently, then! But yes, left to my own devices, I would have been compelled to signal to Ysayle with a pile of damp leaves.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_016: I was born the pampered son of a Sharlayan dignitary, and, alongside my twin, became the youngest student ever to be accepted into the Studium.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_017: How proud I was to match wits with scholars and philosophers... How ignorant of mine own shortcomings... That hubris invited manipulation and betrayal...and led to the downfall of the Scions.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ICEHEART_000_018: We all of us are guilty of similar ignorance. How many men lay down their lives, never knowing what it is that they fight for? Never questioning that which they have been taught to believe?
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ICEHEART_000_019: 'Twas only upon meeting Hraesvelgr that I learned the truth hidden within our history. Were it not for that chance encounter, I would never have vowed to tear down the Holy See, and expunge the falsehoods with which it fans the flames of conflict. I would have lived and died in ignorance. That the truth has driven me to do terrible things, I cannot deny, but I would rather sin in the pursuit of peace than imagine myself virtuous for perpetuating a needless war.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_020: If this journey has taught me anything, it is the importance─and difficulty─of holding to one's convictions in the face of failure...of striving always to replace one's ignorance with knowledge.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_021: You are well on your way, Master Alphinaud. At your age, I was but a fool swinging a spear, with scarcely a thought in my head.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_022: Even now, I struggle to acknowledge the misconceptions under which I have labored.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_023: Sitting here, amongst these grand ruins, how can I deny that man and dragon once lived in peace?
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_024: But for all that such an age existed, we are now in a time of war. Nidhogg killed my family, and no quirk of history will exonerate him.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_025: I may be ignorant of how the Dragonsong War began, but if we do not put an end to this conflict now, I can say for a certainty that it will only breed more vengeful souls such as mine.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_026: In my hands resides the power to vanquish a great wyrm. If Ishgard's survival rests on me wielding that power, I will slay Nidhogg myself...orders or no.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ESTINIEN_000_028: My word is contingent upon the success of our parley. Show me the strength of your convictions, Lady Iceheart. Convince Hraesvelgr of the righteousness of your cause.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ICEHEART_000_029: Doubt not but that I shall, dragoon.
TEXT_HEAVNA325_01626_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Well...winds willing, we shall have our answers on the morrow. Let us sleep now, and face our fate with the rising of the sun...
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_MOGHAN_000_000: The campfire was so cozy... I must have fallen asleep, kupo.
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_MOGHAN_000_001: But do you feel how the winds have shifted!? They will have borne Hraesvelgr back to the skies above Zenith─I'm sure of it!
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_MOGHAN_000_002: This is your chance to climb to the highest floor of the palace, and summon him with a toot on that shiny horn! So, uh...I-I'll be heading back now, if it's all the same to you. Good luck, kupo! It was nice knowing you!
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ALPHINAUD_000_003: I trust you are well rested, ? Good. If we are to parley with Hraesvelgr, we shall each have need of the full complement of our wits.
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ESTINIEN_000_004: Whenever you are ready, Warrior of Light. Full eager am I to gaze upon this great wyrm.
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ICEHEART_000_005: We must succeed in winning Hraesvelgr to our cause. Lend me your resolve, Saint Shiva...
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_MOGHAN_000_006: ! Y-You're alive! I was worried Hraesvelgr might─ Waaait a moment, kupo. I don't remember hearing any tooting. You haven't summoned him yet...have you? If you haven't, climb to the top of his palace and blow the horn. Oh, and forget what I said. I was rambling. Good luck, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ESTINIEN_100_004: It is time, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ICEHEART_100_005: Lend me your resolve, Saint Shiva...
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Hraesvelgr was every bit as awe-inspiring as I imagined. His voice fairly dripped with power─the will behind his words so undeniable that it transcended my ignorance of the dragons' tongue. 'Tis but a pity that I misliked what he said.
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ALPHINAUD_000_011: <sigh> So far did we travel─even unto the very heavens themselves─only to be dismissed like unruly children. And far from mitigating this...humiliation, the hidden truths we have learned serve only to prove that our grand mission of peace was destined to fail from the first.
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Nothing will deter Nidhogg from his course.
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ESTINIEN_000_013: As predicted, Iceheart's faith in the wyrm was misplaced. Which leaves us with but one recourse. You know I have the right of it, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNA326_01627_ICEHEART_000_014: What false god is this Shiva? What manner of phantom have I welcomed into my heart...?
TEXT_HEAVNA327_01628_ESTINIEN_000_000: Iceheart's faith in the wyrm was misplaced. Which leaves us with but one road to follow...
TEXT_HEAVNA327_01628_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Estinien... Pray tell me I am wrong...
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ESTINIEN_000_000: Hm. A force of sufficient power to break through a primal's defenses might conceivably grant us access to the Aery...
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ESTINIEN_000_001: ...And I can offer no better solution. Pray consult this engineer friend of yours.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Very well. On the condition that you swear not to lure Nidhogg from his lair in our absence.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ESTINIEN_000_004: And steal all the glory for myself, you mean? Nay, I am not so selfish as that. Contact me by linkpearl when your preparations are complete, and we shall set forth from Ishgard together.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I suggest we rendezvous back at Saint Reinette's Forum, . From what I gleaned of the Holy See's decidedly ambitious airship project, Cid will still be in Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ESTINIEN_100_006: Go, meet with your engineer friend. I shall remain here and keep vigil over the wyrm.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_006: If our only remaining recourse is to violence, then we should seek out the swiftest path to victory. With every moment we hesitate, Ishgard's prospects grow bleaker.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_010: When last you saw Master Garlond, he was advising the Ishgardians on their ailing airship, correct? In that case, he might still be at Camp Cloudtop. Failing that, we could try the airship landing, or mayhap even the Skysteel Manufactory... But let us not waste time searching aimlessly. Someone in the city is sure to know where to find him. The question is who? Ser Aymeric would seem the obvious choice, but there is no guaranteeing he will be able to grant us an audience at short notice...
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Ah, I have it! Count Edmont's youngest son prides himself on knowing all of the Holy See's juiciest rumors. Let us return to the manor and see if Lord Emmanellain is about.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_EMMANELLAIN_000_020: Ah, the hero returns! How goes the fight, old ? Well, I trust! ...Hm? In search of a “Cid Garlond,” you say? Then say no more!
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_EMMANELLAIN_000_021: The taverns are full of talk, and the name of said silver-haired genius has cropped up more often than most. I hear he has been tasked with getting that monstrous airship the Holy See commissioned to actually fly. 'Twould seem the project has been plagued with mishaps from the first.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_EMMANELLAIN_000_022: In any case, Garlond Ironworks employees are known to frequent the airship landing, and I'll wager their master does too.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_023: The airship landing? Yes, I thought as much. Come, ─we must find Cid and trouble him for his expert opinion.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_100_023: We were fortunate to find Lord Emmanellain at home. Hm! The tavern keeper's loss is our gain.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_BIGGS_000_024: If Ishgard comes under attack, we'll have to get out of the city pretty sharpish. Don't much like the idea of leaving a job half-finished, though...
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_WEDGE_000_025: ...What's that? There are dragons coming? Uh, s-s-sorry! Can't talk now! Have to finish this job and get out of here!
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_HONOROIT_000_026: When it comes to─ahem─exchanging information of uncertain origin, Lord Emmanellain is something of a prodigy.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_EMMANELLAIN_000_027: If you do find Master Garlond at the airship landing, I trust you won't forget who told you where to look! Credit where credit's due, and all that!
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_CID_000_030: ! Alphinaud! How fare you both? Not terribly well, judging by your faces.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Greetings, Master Garlond. I am sure it will come as little surprise when I tell you we have need of a favor...
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_CID_000_032: ...Another wind barrier? And you say it was conjured by Nidhogg?
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_CID_000_033: Hm. The Enterprise could certainly take you where you need to go...but she would not fare well against dragons. She's agile for a ship her size─but not that agile. The Dravanians would fly rings around her.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_CID_000_034: And if they took it into their heads to incinerate the rigging, there would be precious little we could do to avoid them.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_035: But there must be something we can do! Some manner of weapon we could employ...?
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Estinien stands vigil at the edge of the Churning Mists, but we do not know how much longer─
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_CID_000_037: All right, all right, I didn't say it was impossible. I said it was impossible for the Enterprise. We need a smaller boat.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_CID_000_038: Biggs! Wedge! It's time we gave that new toy of yours a proper field test.
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_CID_000_039: It's probably best if I let the lads show you. Come on, the manufactory's not far!
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_BIGGS_100_040: Our little project's just inside. Oh, you're going to like this one...
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Ah, yes─the Skysteel Manufactory. As I recall, this workshop is primarily devoted to the construction of dragon-slaying weapons...
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_CID_000_041: The Ishgardians have granted us the use of a small corner of their workshop─all part of the agreement. I think you'll see we've made the most of the space...
TEXT_HEAVNA328_01629_WEDGE_000_042: They all want to build bigger, but we know where the future is headed!
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_TATARU_000_000: General Raubahn says they may have uncovered the sultana's whereabouts!
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_TATARU_000_001: And he wants you─by which I mean both of you─to go to the Waking Sands right away and help with the investigation.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Come, ─pressing though Ishgard's plight may be, our presence here will not serve to hasten the manacutter's completion. Let us return to the troubled lands of Thanalan and lend what aid we may.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Tataru─have our friends at the Congregation send a message to Estinien. Tell him we have identified a solution to our problem, but that it will take some time to prepare.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_ALPHINAUD_000_005: To the Waking Sands, Warrior of Light. 'Tis past time Ul'dah was delivered from this darkness!
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_ALPHINAUD_000_006: I am as intrigued as you, . Shall we hear what news Tataru has brought us?
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_URIANGER_000_010: The Dunesfolk have long laced their teas with traces of venom, that they might better survive in a land rife with deadly snakes and scorpions. 'Tis all but certain that Her Grace hath nurtured a similar resistance to such substances... Might not this explain the need for so noticeable a quantity of alchemical supplies? In moderation, full many poisons serve as palliatives, after all...
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_ALPHINAUD_000_011: If one had chosen to entrap the sultana in a deathlike sleep rather than slay her, then one would surely also know of a means to rouse her from said state. There must be an antidote to this poison.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_HIGIRI_000_012: Raubahn's recovery has been nothing short of miraculous. But I should not be surprised. By his scars, I gather that he has survived many terrible wounds.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_YUGIRI_000_020: Our target is Meriel, the sultana's former lady-in-waiting─a woman of Midlander heritage. I am told the two of you have met.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_YUGIRI_000_021: Our sources indicate that she left the palace shortly after the incident, and quietly rejoined the dwindling population of the Silver Bazaar. I suggest we begin by questioning the market's residents, and confirm that Meriel is still in hiding there.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_YUGIRI_000_022: Our target is Meriel, the sultana's former lady-in-waiting─a woman of Midlander heritage. I am told the two of you have met.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_YUGIRI_000_023: Our sources indicate that she left the palace shortly after the incident, and quietly rejoined the dwindling population of the Silver Bazaar. I suggest we begin by questioning the market's residents, and confirm that Meriel is still in hiding here.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_ALPHINAUD_000_024: I have met the sultana's handmaiden on numerous occasions...but I cannot for the life of me bring her features to mind.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_RAUBAHN_000_025: Godsdammit, where is she!? I will tear this place apart if I must!
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_PIPPIN_000_026: I suppose it was too much to ask that we stumble upon her buying fruit in the market square...
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_PAPASHAN_000_027: Easy now, General. We don't want her bolting down some other hole.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_DEWLALA_000_028: Let us gather all the players together. This has gone on long enough...
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_PAPASHAN_101_028: So, Her Grace's poisoner seeks refuge in the Silver Bazaar...
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_DANYELL_000_030: Meriel? Aye, she's here─left the city for good, she says. Barely leaves her house, though. Hm? It's the one closest to the market entrance.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_DANYELL_000_031: Meriel? Aye, she's here─left the city for good, she says. Barely leaves her house, though. Hm? Oh, it's the one closest to the market entrance.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_KIKIPU_000_040: Greetings, ! What can I do for the Silver Bazaar's favorite adventurer?
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_KIKIPU_000_041: And what brings you to our lonely little hamlet? I believe the arrival of your entourage just about doubled our population...
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_KIKIPU_000_042: Looking for Meriel, you say? If you're hoping to lure her back to Ul'dah, you may as well give up now─the girl's done with city life.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_KIKIPU_000_043: Greetings, ! What can I do for the Silver Bazaar's favorite adventurer?
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_KIKIPU_000_044: And what brings you to our lonely little hamlet? I believe the arrival of your entourage just about doubled our population...
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_KIKIPU_000_045: Looking for Meriel, you say? If you're hoping to lure her back to Ul'dah, you may as well give up now─the girl's done with city life.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_SPOTTEDMEADOW_000_0: Do I know of any returning residents? Gods, don't tell me they're starting to come back! My masters will not be pleased to hear of this...
Do I know of any returning residents? Gods, don't tell me they're starting to come back! My masters will not be pleased to hear of this...
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_ALPHINAUD_000_060: By the Twelve... I feared Lord Lolorito's arrival would herald another bloodbath. Little did I suspect that he of all people would gift us the means to rouse the sultana.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_YUGIRI_000_062:
“You had killed the one you served...”
Ah, pray excuse my mutterings─I was reminded of a line from an old poem.
TEXT_HEAVNA329_01630_PAPASHAN_101_062: In all honesty, I care little for the truth behind these machinations. All that matters to me is that the sultana is alive and well...
TEXT_HEAVNA330_01631_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Shall we also make our way to Ul'dah? I should imagine Bartholomew has been instructed to admit us.
TEXT_HEAVNA330_01631_YUGIRI_000_001:
“You had killed the one you served...”
Ah, pray excuse my mutterings─I was reminded of a line from an old poem.
TEXT_HEAVNA330_01631_BARTHOLOMEW_000_010: Flame General Raubahn mentioned you might be coming. Please, this way if you will.
TEXT_HEAVNA330_01631_YUGIRI_000_011: I hope Lord Lolorito's potion is as effective as he claims...
TEXT_HEAVNA330_01631_ALPHINAUD_000_012: It would appear that the Syndicate has moved swiftly to clear our names. Bartholomew, for one, does not seem remotely surprised by our presence here.
TEXT_HEAVNA330_01631_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I blush to speak thus of mine inner turmoil...
TEXT_HEAVNA330_01631_ALPHINAUD_000_021: But the fact remains: there is no  alive in whom I would rather confide. Were it not for your shining example, I might never have emerged from beneath the pall of my despair.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_100_000: Hm, still no word from Master Garlond. I hope this manacutter of theirs is nearing completion...
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_YUGIRI_101_000: I am assured that Her Grace will make a full recovery.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_102_000: Aye, and Ul'dah, too, shall flourish once more. General Raubahn and his colleagues have matters well in hand, I believe.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_000: ...Lady Yugiri, a question, if I may. I believe your people have been keeping a close watch on the Crystal Braves. Might you know how things stand at the Rising Stones?
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_YUGIRI_000_001: Ah, yes, of course. You will be pleased to know that the 3rd Unit Braves abandoned Revenant's Toll when they learned of Captain Ilberd's defeat. The only blue uniforms to be seen there now are those worn by soldiers loyal to you, Master Alphinaud.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_002: ...To me? I see. I am grateful to hear that at least some of our members were true to their oaths.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_100_002: Ere we return to Ishgard, I must go to the Rising Stones and thank these stalwarts for their service. It shall be my final act as Crystal Brave commander.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_003:
Will you join me, ? You were there at the company's inception─'tis only fitting that you be present at its end.


And...I would appreciate the support.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_RIOL_000_011: An' , too! I knew ye'd scrape through!
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_012: My splendid Crystal Braves. I have wronged you. All of you. My promises of glory and salvation have brought you naught but blood and betrayal...
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_RIOL_000_013: Bah, ye'll not hear us complainin'. 'Twas a sight messier than expected, aye, but we was still fightin' for the freedom of all─just like we swore. Ain't that right, mates?
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_015: You humble me. I am truly blessed to have such steadfast comrades. It is with the most profound regret, then, that I must─
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_RIOL_000_016: That's enough o' that, Commander! We know what ye've a mind to say, an' we ain't havin' none of it.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_RIOL_000_017: We've talked it over, see, an' we're all agreed: ye can take our uniforms, an' strip us of our ranks─but we won't be no less of a company.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALIANNE_000_019: The Crystal Braves may be finished, but the ideals upon which the company was founded live on. They bind us to each other─and to you.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_RIOL_000_020:
Commander.
...Alphinaud. Our minds are made up, so ye may as well get used to it. Let us help the Scions. Let us help you find Minfilia an' the others.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_021: My friends... A-After all that has happened... I know not what to say...
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_030: <sniff> Pray excuse me... I had thought my tears spent.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_031: My grandfather used to say that one could measure a man by the constancy of his comrades... Mayhap I am the exception which proves the rule. Nay, do not protest. I know that I am not worthy of their loyalty, ...
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALPHINAUD_000_032: ...But as Thaliak is my witness, I shall do everything in my power to earn it.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_YUGIRI_000_033: I feel blessed to have witnessed such a display of camaraderie.
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_RIOL_000_040: I dunno if you know, but durin' that godsdamned feast, F'lhaminn got ambushed by some 3rd Unit curs over in Limsa. I'm told she danced free o' their noose, though. Ain't heard nothin' since, but my guess is she's lyin' low somewhere in the port...
TEXT_HEAVNA331_01632_ALIANNE_000_041: We'll find the missing Scions, I promise you. Between us and the Immortal Flames, no stone in Eorzea will be left unturned.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I must speak of future plans with the remaining Braves. Any information we uncover on the missing Scions will need to be shared with our allies across the realm─specifically, Urianger in the Waking Sands, and Tataru in Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ALPHINAUD_000_001: While we are organizing our various channels of communication, I would ask that you call upon Master Garlond at the manufactory. I will join you in Ishgard as soon as I am able.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ALPHINAUD_000_002: I am informed that F'lhaminn and her bodyguards, Hoary Boulder and Coultenet, went missing shortly after the feast. <sigh> Our list of absent friends grows longer...
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_YUGIRI_000_005: 'Twould seem the Ul'dahns no longer require my services. I shall return to the search for our missing companions...
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_CID_000_010: ! How in the seven hells do you do it? I was just about to send for you! We have but this moment completed the manacutter's first successful test flight!
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_CID_000_011: A few minor adjustments and she'll be ready to go. While we see to the finishing touches, you might want to pay a visit to Fortemps Manor─a dragoon by the name of Estinien was looking for you.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_CID_000_012: Loitering around here won't speed matters up. Leave the boys to apply the finishing touches, and go and see your friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_BIGGS_000_013: We've been working on a second vessel while we perfected the prototype. Don't worry─they'll both be able to handle the winds you're expecting.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_WEDGE_100_013: So sleepy... Hm? What!? I'm awake!
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ESTINIEN_000_020: You have fulfilled your obligations to the Ul'dahns, then? Mistress Tataru has been keeping me apprised of the situation.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ESTINIEN_000_021: Once I learned that these “manacutters” of Master Garlond's were nearing completion, I saw no reason to tarry in the Mists.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ESTINIEN_000_022: For the present, Nidhogg seems content to remain in the Aery, plotting his revenge.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ESTINIEN_000_023: Might not this be an apt moment to unfold our plans to Ser Aymeric? I think we have kept him in the dark long enough.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_TEMPLEKIGHTGATE_000: Ser Aymeric has been eager to speak with you. Pray proceed.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_Q1_000_000: Proceed to the Seat of the Lord Commander?
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_CID_101_030: Just a few more adjustments, . She'll be ready.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ESTINIEN_000_040: I have pricked Master Alphinaud's pride I fear. But had I been less forceful, the boy would have insisted on accompanying us to the Aery.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ESTINIEN_000_041: Do not think me blind to his talent. With a few more campaigns under his belt, I have no doubt that Alphinaud will make a fine field commander.
TEXT_HEAVNA332_01633_ESTINIEN_000_042: But one does not practice on an adversary such as Nidhogg. We shall be hard-pressed enough without the added worry of carrying a novice.
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_ESTINIEN_000_000: We have tarried long enough. Let us call upon Master Garlond and take possession of the manacutters.
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_BIGGS_000_001: These little beauties are our pride and joy... And now they're yours! So, uh...be careful with 'em, eh!?
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_WEDGE_000_002: <yawn> ...I guarantee you won't find any loose rivets─we triple-checked!
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_ESTINIEN_000_003: The moment is at hand, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_CID_000_010: , old friend! The 'cutters are ready when you are!
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_WEDGE_000_011: The finer adjustments cost us a few sleepless nights, but we got there in the end!
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_BIGGS_000_012: Which means you can get where you need to go. I tell you, these little beauties'll tear through that wind barrier like a cermet drill through cottage cheese.
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_CID_000_013: And that, my friends, is a Garlond Ironworks guarantee!
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_ESTINIEN_000_014: You have our thanks. Come, Warrior of Light─the dread wyrm awaits!
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_ESTINIEN_000_015: To the manacutters, Warrior of Light─the dread wyrm awaits!
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_CID_000_016: Give that overgrown lizard a kick in the tail from me, eh? We'll be waiting for you, !
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_ESTINIEN_000_020: Though Nidhogg is fallen, my heart is yet heavy.
TEXT_HEAVNA333_01634_ESTINIEN_000_021:
...And this stain of corruption pleases me not.
...When all has been put to rest, I must needs forge my armor anew.
TEXT_HEAVNA334_01635_ESTINIEN_000_000: With Nidhogg fallen, none save Hraesvelgr remains to answer our questions. Let us trouble the wyrm again.
TEXT_HEAVNA334_01635_ESTINIEN_000_001: And if Iceheart yet lingers at Zenith, all the better. I would have her hear the truth from the dragon's maw.
TEXT_HEAVNA334_01635_ESTINIEN_000_002: ...She has scarce moved since last we parted. Hmph. Hraesvelgr's confession will soon shake her from her stupor.
TEXT_HEAVNA334_01635_ICEHEART_000_010: 'Twas you, was it not? The furious screams of the dragons carried far...
TEXT_HEAVNA334_01635_ICEHEART_000_011: You have slain Nidhogg─what more could you desire from this place? Will you not allow Hraesvelgr to mourn the death of his kin in peace!?
TEXT_HEAVNA334_01635_ESTINIEN_000_012: Spare us your sanctimonious judgment, ice maiden. We have a gift for the great wyrm...and a mystery that can no longer lie buried.
TEXT_HEAVNA334_01635_ESTINIEN_000_013: Lady Iceheart─the Dragonsong War has all but consumed your life and claimed many of your followers. 'Tis time you learned the truth of its beginning─the whole truth─that we may at last bring this bitter conflict to an end.
TEXT_HEAVNA334_01635_ESTINIEN_000_014: Sound the horn, Warrior of Light!
TEXT_HEAVNA335_01636_ESTINIEN_101_010: Though he lifted not a single claw, 'twould seem that Hraesvelgr wreaked his own manner of vengeance against us...
TEXT_HEAVNA335_01636_ICEHEART_000_010: And thus did betrayal beget unending vengeance...
TEXT_HEAVNA335_01636_ESTINIEN_000_020: Let us see how long this peace lasts...
TEXT_HEAVNA335_01636_HAURCHEFANT_100_050: That was rather too close for comfort, but 'twould seem that calm is returning to the streets. My mind, however, yet clamors with a thousand questions! You return to Ishgard in the oddest of company, my friend!
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: I confess, I was more than a little dismayed to see you in the company of the Lady Iceheart. Whatever is going on, ?
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_HAURCHEFANT_000_001: Beg pardon...? You traveled to the Churning Mists together? ...Along with Estinien!?
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_HAURCHEFANT_000_002: Never was there a more unlikely alliance─nor one so magnificently effective! Nidhogg, dead; the heretics, pacified─Father and Ser Aymeric must know of this!
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_ESTINIEN_000_003: Let us break the news to them together. I will bring Ser Aymeric to Fortemps Manor.
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_HAURCHEFANT_100_004: Very well.  and I shall await you there!
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_ESTINIEN_000_005: Let us see how long this peace lasts...
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_LUCIA_000_010: Though your assistance is most welcome, I fear it will not be enough.
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_LUCIA_000_011: Few as we are, we will struggle to reach the lord commander. If we are to succeed, we must needs recruit others to our cause.
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Far be it from me to criticize a man for his blind idealism─but he might at least have pretended to consider another course.
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_ESTINIEN_000_021: Hmph. Of all the people... He should know better.
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_HAURCHEFANT_000_022: Have no fear, Father! My arm will not falter; my shield will not break. I promise you: we shall prevail!
TEXT_HEAVNA401_01637_EDMONT_000_023: If we must risk the fortunes of our house to bring this truth to light, then so be it. But are you truly prepared to do this? To face the Heavens' Ward in battle, if you must?
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_000: But how are we to carry out this bold endeavor? Even with an army of knights at our backs, a direct assault on the Vault seems unlikely to succeed.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_LUCIA_000_001: You are correct, Master Alphinaud. Not even the assembled might of House Fortemps and the Temple Knights would be sufficient. With the support of another party, however, we may yet stand a chance.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_002: You speak of one of the other High Houses?
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_LUCIA_000_003: Precisely the opposite. I speak of the revolutionaries rumored to reside in the Brume.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_LUCIA_000_004: 'Twas these disgruntled Ishgardians who opened the gates of our city to the heretics, I believe.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_005: But of course! If their hatred of the Holy See drove them to such deeds, they might well be persuaded to assist in Ser Aymeric's rescue, knowing the truth he would lay bare...
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_LUCIA_000_006: Such is my hope, Master Alphinaud. And I would have you and  reach out to them.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_LUCIA_000_007: As a Temple Knight and sworn servant of the Holy See, any overtures I make are doomed to fail.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_LUCIA_000_008: But as outsiders, the two of you may receive a warmer welcome.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_009: Very well. We shall seek out the leader of these revolutionaries, and make our case.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_LUCIA_000_010: My thanks. Estinien─will your brothers heed your command if you order them to stand aside?
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ESTINIEN_000_011: The dragoons have no love for politics, my lady. They will gladly watch and wait while the highborn fight amongst themselves.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_012: How very wise. ─we should hurry to the Forgotten Knight. Tataru may have knowledge of the revolutionaries.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_LUCIA_000_013: The lord commander has need of us...and we of him. We must act now.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ESTINIEN_000_014: I thought the lord commander wiser than this.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_HAURCHEFANT_000_015: Have no fear, Father! My arm will not falter; my shield will not break. I promise you: we shall prevail!
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_EDMONT_000_016: If we must risk the fortunes of our house to bring this truth to light, then so be it. But are you truly prepared to do this? To face the Heavens' Ward in battle, if you must?
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_017: It would seem that the Forgotten Knight was spared the worst of the earlier chaos...
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_TATARU_000_020: , Alphinaud! Gods, I've been worried sick! It's so good to see you!
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_021: And you, Tataru. How did you manage to escape the chaos in the streets?
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_TATARU_000_022: Gibrillont and the others barricaded the doors until the heretics left. No one was harmed, thankfully. But what about you two? What came of your journey?
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_TATARU_000_023: ...You're not serious. What was Ser Aymeric thinking!? I mean, the way you two talk about him, I wouldn't have believed... Anyway, I've heard rumors of the people you're looking for, but I doubt they'll be of much use.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_TATARU_000_024: The only thing I can say with any certainty is that they're led by someone called “the Mongrel.”
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_025: A queer moniker if ever I have heard one─but mayhap it will make the individual in question easier to find. Come, let us all make inquiries below.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_026: If truth be told, I doubt anyone will be willing to speak of this “Mongrel.” But we may still be able to confirm that Tataru's information is correct.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_TATARU_000_027: At first, the people here were a bit standoffish, but with a little effort─and a lot of parley─I've managed to make plenty of friends!
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_EDMONT_100_027: Tread warily,  . The men and women you seek may misinterpret your intentions.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_HAURCHEFANT_100_028: So she hopes to find a friend in the enemy of our enemy... Well, well, well...
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_THEPOORA01638_000_0: A mongrel? Not sure I catch your meaning. To a blue blood, we're all of us dogs down here.
Look around you, . Mongrels as far as the eye can see.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_THEPOORB01638_000_0: Eh? What's that? Speak up! I can't hear as well as I used to.
Are you whispering? I swear, I can't hear a word you're saying.
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_THEPOORC01638_000_0: I don't know a godsdamned thing about the Mongrel, but if I did, you can be sure I wouldn't tell you!
Piss off back where you came from, outlander. You'll get nothing from me!
TEXT_HEAVNA402_01638_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Not a single shred of information? Just as I expected. These revolutionaries would not have evaded capture for so long without the masses' complicity. Still, it is good to know that Tataru's ears are as sharp as ever.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_ALPHINAUD_000_000: There must be a way we can draw the Mongrel out into the open. Hmm... Mayhap we should discuss this with Tataru.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Speaking of which, where is Tataru? She... Oh, confound it. She went below to make inquiries on her own, didn't she? We must find her quickly, ─I have a premonition this is not going to end well.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Where could she have gone? Ah, ─try looking for her over there.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_SYSTEM_000_003: You cast your gaze over the streets below, but see no sign of Tataru...
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_ALPHINAUD_100_011: She must be around here somewhere... I take it you've had no luck either?
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_TATARU_000_010: Uwaaah! I'm sorry, forget I said anything!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_ALPHINAUD_000_012: <gasp> Those men are chasing her! Quickly, ─after them!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HILDA_000_017: Before you start─let's go somewhere a bit more private, eh? The Forgotten Knight, say.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_ALPHINAUD_000_013: For once, it would seem the fates are smiling upon us. Had those ruffians forced our hand, I dare not think what would have ensued.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_TATARU_000_014: Th-They didn't much care for my story about the weathered cane...
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_REVOLUTIONARY1_000_: Whatever it is you've got to say, say it!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_REVOLUTIONARY2_000_: I've got my eye on you...
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_ALPHINAUD_100_013: I think it best if you take the lead this time, .
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_TATARU_100_014: If you're nervous, I could try parleying with them on our behalf. Perhaps they'd be interested in techniques for working lauan logs...or maybe the tale of the cursed gladius? Oh, I know─the legendary skillet! Everyone loves that one!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HILDA_000_020: Let me guess: you're wondering why I chose “the Mongrel,” right?
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HILDA_000_021: Because it's what I am, and I'm not ashamed of it. Not anymore.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HILDA_000_023: Besides, even my pureblood pups have more in common with me than the lords and ladies up on high. They none of 'em are well bred. Hells, some of their mothers were cast out after a spot of fun, same as mine.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HILDA_000_024: Story old as time─and one we're sick of hearing, which is why we took up arms.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HILDA_000_025: Not that we mean to hold all the blue bloods to account. Some have done right by us, I'll allow, like them in House Haillenarte.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HILDA_000_026: Not that we mean to hold all the blue bloods to account. Some have done right by us, I'll allow, like them in House Haillenarte. 'Course, you'd know all about that, wouldn't you?
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HILDA_000_027: But enough talk. Your friend's still rotting in a cell. Let's not keep him waiting.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_ALPHINAUD_000_030: I had not reckoned with the Temple Knights' involvement... Not as enemies, at any rate.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_TATARU_000_031: First Ser Grinnaux and Ser Paulecrain, and now this Charibert character... I mean, it makes you wonder, doesn't it? Are all the knights of the Heavens' Ward this bad?
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_REVOLUTIONARY1_000_: Bugger me if you ain't everythin' they say! How in the hells did you do that thing with the other thing!?
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_REVOLUTIONARY2_000_: Hoo hoo hoo! You didn't half give that highborn scum what for! That was a sight for sore eyes, that was!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_HAURCHEFANT_000_034: Time is of the essence, . We must move quickly, before they discern our intent!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_LUCIA_000_035: I never liked him, not since his days as an inquisitor. He took far too much pleasure in his work.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_HILD: If it's a fight you want, then come and get it!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_CHAR: My, such fury! Patience, my queen. We've only just begun.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_TEMP: Defend Ser Charibert! Kill the rebels!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_HILD: Damn! There's no end to them!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_CHAR: It seems you are beyond reason. How marvelous...
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_HAUR: Stop this, all of you! It is madness! Why are you fighting!?
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_CHAR: Hmph. How fitting. The noble bastard and the mongrel bitch.
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_HILD: This mongrel bitch is going to put a bullet between your eyes!
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_ALPH: I suppose now is as good a time as any...
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_HILD: Of all the bloody places to...
TEXT_HEAVNA403_01639_QIB_BATTLETALK_HAUR: As long as you yet live...my...friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_000_000: We've been working in secret to undermine the Holy See and the High Houses. That much I'll acknowledge.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_000_001: But this nonsense about us throwing wide the gates for the heretics is just that: nonsense.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_000_003: You Temple Knights, of course. Reckoned it was your beloved Ser Aymeric's doing at first, but then I heard how he lost his head. My next best guess would be the Heavens' Ward.
