TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_000_004: That way they'd have the perfect excuse to go door-to-door through the Brume. Slaughter the heretics and their “sympathizers” in one fell swoop.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HAURCHEFANT_000_005: But the Heavens' Ward's scheme did not account for Lady Iceheart's intervention...and so they have been forced to improvise.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_000_006: A fine bloody mess, ain't it? But the die is cast. So what's the plan?
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_007: We must divert the attention of the High Houses away from the city, and to do that, we need the cooperation of your allies in their service.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_000_008: ...And what makes you think I have friends in high places?
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_009: You would be fools not to, given your goals. Lowborn knights are ideal recruits.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_010: Most swore fealty only out of desire for a better life. If offered an opportunity to shed the yoke and live for themselves, who among them would not at least be tempted to take it?
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_011: Rare is the man eager to die for a cause he does not hold dear. But it need not come to that this day. If they and their fellow knights are deployed afield to deal with a new threat─a massing of heretics, for example─then they will be unable to join in the defense of the Vault.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_000_012: Huh. Spread false reports of an attack to get 'em out of harm's way, you mean?
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_ALPHINAUD_000_013: The city will not soon forget the heretics' last assault. If the High Houses believe another attack is imminent, they will have no choice but to act.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_000_015: Can we trick them into leaving Ishgard? Aye. Can we keep them out for long? Not bloody likely. Make sure you're ready before I send word, because you won't get a second chance at this.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Then it is decided. To the Vault! The archbishop must be held to account!
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_017: And the lord commander granted his liberty!
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I do not relish the thought of facing the Temple Knights in battle, but what other choice do we have?
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_TATARU_000_061: First Ser Grinnaux and Ser Paulecrain, and now this Charibert character... I mean, it makes you wonder, doesn't it? Are all the knights of the Heavens' Ward this bad?
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_REVOLUTIONARY1_000_: Bugger me, if you ain't everythin' they say! How in the hells did you do that thing with the other thing!?
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_REVOLUTIONARY2A_000: Hoo hoo hoo! You didn't half give that highborn scum what for! That was a sight for sore eyes, that was!
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HAURCHEFANT_000_064: Time is of the essence, . We must move quickly, before they discern our intent!
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_065: I never liked him, not since his days as an inquisitor. He took far too much pleasure in his work.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_ALPHINAUD_100_060: Gods help me, I think we just might do this...
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_TATARU_100_061: Did you see the way she wielded that weapon of hers? Maybe I should get one for my own protection...
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_REVOLUTIONARY1_100_: So, er...what happens if we win?
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_REVOLUTIONARY2A_100: You seriously mean to attack the Vault, then, do you? As in, charge in there screaming and swinging steel? Bloody hells...
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HAURCHEFANT_100_064: With allies such as these, we cannot fail!
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_HILDA_100_065: One chance only, . Make it count.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_020: Hearken to me, everyone! We have two objectives: rescue Ser Aymeric and apprehend the archbishop. We will therefore divide our forces into two parties.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_021: Estinien and I will make ready to breach the underground gaol and search for the lord commander. We will not move, however, until the second party has entered the Vault.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_022: I speak of your party, Warrior of Light, together with Lord Haurchefant and Master Alphinaud. For this plan to succeed, you will need to fight your way into the highest levels of the Vault, even unto the archbishop's private chambers. When the Heavens' Ward realize what you intend, they will fly to their master's side, leaving only a token force to guard the gaol.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_023: Temple Knights loyal to our cause have already secured the entrance to the Vault. Once you are within, they will signal to us. If all goes to plan, we shall rejoin you with Ser Aymeric and confront the archbishop together.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_LUCIA_000_024: Is everyone clear as to their duties? Then let us do what must needs be done!
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_TEMPLEKNIGHT01640_0: I will send word once you and your party have entered...
Godsspeed, . For Ser Aymeric, and for Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_TATARU_101_033: I wish I still had some blood pearls...
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_TEMPLEKNIGHT01640_0: I...I know not what to say. The others, they...they are gathered at Fortemps Manor.
For what it is worth,  ...my condolences.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_ALPHINAUD_000_050: I...I could not stand there in silence, but...
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_ALPHINAUD_000_051: When all others had forsaken us, Lord Haurchefant took us in. Our beacon of hope in a world of darkness.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_ALPHINAUD_000_052: He did his utmost to raise our spirits, so that we might face our troubles with courage. With conviction.
TEXT_HEAVNA404_01640_ALPHINAUD_000_053: So that we might face them as...as knights...
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I... We must press on with our mission. Tataru, pray return to your duties at the Forgotten Knight.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Let us go and speak with Ser Aymeric, . I worry for his well-being.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ESTINIEN_100_063: Curse those bloody whoresons and piss on their swiving round table.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_010: , Master Alphinaud─I, Aymeric, lord commander of the Temple Knights of Ishgard, do hereby entreat the aid of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Our aid in preventing whatever it is that the archbishop intends?
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_012: Your aid in bringing him to justice. Too much blood has been spilled for the lies he perpetuated. No more.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_A1_000_001: I shall pursue him to the end of the world if I must.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_A1_000_002: Life for death. I will have Ser Zephirin's heart for what he did to Haurchefant.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_020: I thank you, . I have heard many men make such pledges, but you─you speak in earnest.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_030: Yes...yes, of course. You two were close, I know.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_040: I make no claim to know the turmoil in your soul, but I implore you, ─in this darkest of hours, pray lend us your strength.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Much has changed since our order's founding, but our duty to combat the primal threat has not. If the archbishop and the Heavens' Ward are guilty of the crime of summoning, then  and I will stop them.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_051: Would that I could join you in the pursuit, but alas, my father's absence has thrown our government into chaos.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_052: Ever since the founding of our nation, there has been an archbishop to serve as a guiding light for the masses─a force for stability to counterbalance the High Houses' ceaseless maneuvering.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_053: Convincing the people to recognize the truth of our origins would have been difficult even with my father's support. The road ahead is that much more fraught with peril without it.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_054: Yet walk it we must, for unity is more vital to our survival than ever. After all, Nidhogg's death did not mark the cessation of Dravanian hostilities. Far from it. We will have great need of each other in the days to come.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ESTINIEN_000_055: You may ever count on my lance, Ser Aymeric. To my dying breath, I shall defend Ishgard from the Horde.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_LUCIA_000_056: If I may, Lord Commander, I would like to assist the Scions in their search for the archbishop.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_LUCIA_100_056: , Master Alphinaud, pray attend me outside.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ALPHINAUD_000_057: Very well. With me, . I believe we have much to discuss.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_AYMERIC_000_060: If they knew what would come of it, would they still have done it? What power could be worth such bloodshed─such sorrow...
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_LUCIA_000_061: The Congregation is in disarray; the rift between our brothers and sisters still far from healed. But I will see us whole again─without further violence, so far as it is possible.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ALPHINAUD_000_062: I thought Shiva an unprecedented threat, but this? Ishgard's twelve finest knights, each imbued with primal powers. May the gods have mercy on us all.
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_ESTINIEN_000_063: Could Nidhogg sense their power? Is that why he did not lead his minions into battle?
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_TEMPLEKIGHTGATE_000: An audience with the lord commander? Yes, yes of course...
TEXT_HEAVNA405_01641_SCENE00020_EVENTARE: Proceed to the Seat of the Lord Commander?
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_LUCIA_000_000: The Soleil was eastward bound, so I sent word to Camp Cloudtop on the off chance the airship passed nearby.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_LUCIA_000_001: Sure enough, Lady Laniaitte informed me that it had been sighted by her scouts.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Then the archbishop is somewhere in the Sea of Clouds?
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_LUCIA_000_003: Or was, not long ago. The airship has not been seen since it disappeared into the northern reaches near the Blue Window.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_LUCIA_000_004: Alas, because the region is firmly held by the Vanu Vanu and not easily accessible from Camp Cloudtop, House Haillenarte has yet to establish a foothold. We will need not only an airship, but a captain bold enough to risk the beastmen's wrath.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I think we both know the perfect candidate, . Let us pay a visit to Master Garlond at the Skysteel Manufactory.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_LUCIA_000_006: I see... Then I will take my leave for now. There are other matters which require my attention.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_ALPHINAUD_000_007: Where could they be headed? And what does “Azys Lla” have to do with it?
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Who else but Master Garlond would be willing to deliver us into Vanu territory? I say we go and ask him first.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_AYMERIC_100_008: If they knew what would come of it, would they still have done it? What power could be worth such bloodshed─such sorrow...
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_CID_000_010: Ah, the dastardly duo. What mischief have you two been getting up to lately?
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_ALPHINAUD_000_011: ...You haven't heard, have you? I hardly know where to start.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Cid, have you ever heard of “Azys Lla”? The archbishop spoke of it before he fled.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_CID_000_014: No, but it's probably some source of phenomenal cosmic power that's key to his plans.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_CID_000_015: From what he told , the Ascians tried to tempt him as they tempted Gaius with the Ultima Weapon. Even if he spoke true about playing along, I can see him attempting to seize it.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_ALPHINAUD_000_016: As if we needed another reason to pursue him...
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_CID_000_017: Well, I'm convinced. The Enterprise is at your disposal. Come to the airship landing when you're ready to depart.
TEXT_HEAVNA501_01642_CID_000_018: Heh, it's just as well. After pulling you out of the fire these last few times, I reckoned I was due to deliver you into it.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Into the fire, is it... In that case, I should inform Tataru of our plans.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Pray go on ahead to the airship landing. I shall join you anon.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_CID_000_010: The boys have been hard at work preparing for our flight, and I'm pleased to say we are ready to depart.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_CID_000_011: That is, as soon as a certain... Ah.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Pray forgive me my lateness. Tataru and I had much to discuss.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_ALPHINAUD_000_013: We still have no news of the missing Scions, but she assures me that Urianger and Riol are pursuing promising leads.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_CID_000_014: Come, come─we can continue this discussion aboard the Enterprise!
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_WEDGE_000_015: Good to see you again, ! It'll be a pleasure to have you aboard the Enterprise again!
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_BIGGS_000_016: I, uh, heard about your man Haurchefant... Sorry for your loss, .
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_WEDGE_000_020: The others are waiting for you aboard the Enterprise, ! Shall we get going?
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_LKHONEBB_000_020: Hello there, ! So you know, I'll be available to ferry you back and forth once the chief charts a course. Deputy president's orders and all that.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_IRONWORKER01643_000: Greetings, . Do you require transport to the Blue Window?
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_ALPHINAUD_000_030: From here, Camp Cloudtop looks rather far...
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Ahem. Be on your guard, . The Vanu could be anywhere─even watching us as we speak...
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_CID_000_040: We'll keep the Enterprise here for now, but if you need to head back to Ishgard, you can use that standard to signal for an Ironworks airship.
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_CID_000_041: Don't worry─we charted a route safe enough for others to fly...unless that primal shows up. But what are the odds of that, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_WEDGE_000_042: We'll stay in touch with your Temple Knight friend, don't you worry!
TEXT_HEAVNA502_01643_BIGGS_000_043: The Enterprise is ready to fly at a moment's notice. Just come running if you run afoul of something you can't handle.
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Assuming the Soleil is here, I doubt she will come to us. We should begin searching the isles in earnest...
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Of course, we must remain vigilant for Vanu scouts as well. I would rather avoid needless bloodshed.
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_CID_000_002: We'll keep the Enterprise here for now, but if you need to head back to Ishgard, you can use that standard to signal for an Ironworks airship.

TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Gods, look at them. So many isles...so many places to hide. No, we must not lose hope. He is out there, ─and we will find him.
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Mayhap this effort was doomed to failure...
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_LONUVANU_000_021: (-???-)Begs mercy of netherlings! Does not fight! Does not wish to die!
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Was that a Vanu being attacked? But by whom?
