TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_LONUVANU_000_030: Netherlings save Lonu Vanu from certain death! Showers netherlings with thanks like summer squall!
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_LONUVANU_000_031: Lonu Vanu knows not what wind bears netherlings to cloud sea, but warmly welcomes them! Shows gratitude where gratitude is due!
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_ALPHINAUD_000_032: And so we live to fight another day...
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_CID_100_032: Imperial troops? Here? Well, hopefully that's the last of them. We'll keep an eye out for others.
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_CENTURIO_BATTLETALK: Remember: Lord van Hydrus wants them alive! That's an order!
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Lord van Hydrus? Regula van Hydrus!?
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_CENTURIO_BATTLETALK: What are you doing!? You're a disgrace to the VIth! Subdue these savages!
TEXT_HEAVNA503_01644_OBIETAVANUVANU_BATT: No weapons to fight netherlings! No desire to die!
Thunderous blows bring much pain! Blood flows, and does not stop! Blood flows!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_000: Lonu Vanu owes much and more to netherlings. As saviors, as heroes, Zundu welcome you!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_001: To village we go! To north! Come, come!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_002: And so we live to fight another day...
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_CID_000_003: Imperial troops? Here? Well, hopefully that's the last of them. We'll keep our eyes open, either way.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_WEDGE_000_004: Garleans!? Understood. We'll send word to the Temple Knights.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_BIGGS_000_005: All quiet here, . No Vanu, no Garleans, nothing.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_010: So the Garleans were searching for the archbishop and believed that the Vanu Vanu knew something of his whereabouts.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Methods notwithstanding, they may have had the right of it...
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_012: I conclude that we should accept Lonu Vanu's offer of hospitality, and visit his village.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_013: I want to believe Lonu Vanu is sincere in his intentions. Nevertheless, keep your eyes open, .
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_020: Like breeze guides leaves to rest, come and lay down your burdens, netherlings! Lonu Vanu throws wide arms in greeting! Behold─Ok' Zundu!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_021: A far warmer welcome than the one you received from the Vundu, I think.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_022: Hah! Vundu bluster and blow hither and yon. Sound and fury, like aimless gale.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_023: Eh!? What unseen lightning begets such thunderous report!?
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_CID_000_024: There you are! Did you see it!?
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_CID_000_025: It's that damned flying whale again! The imperials are after it!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_029: By the Twelve... Did the beast just eat that island!?
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_030: O insatiable White, O devourer of worlds! Why must You torment us!?
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_031: Bah! Lonu Vanu wastes no more words on His unfathomable deeds. Come, netherlings! Come and break words with chief of Zundu!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_040: With wisdom deep as nethers and eyes clear as cloudless blue, Sonu Vanu speaks for Zundu. Hearken to his words!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_041: Netherlings deliver Lonu Vanu from claws of steel-shod fiends and prove nobility. He knows not to ignore zephyr winds, and brings before you with all haste.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_SONUVANU_000_042: Soft rains to soothe the heart and sunshine to warm. Gratitude of Sonu, chief of Zundu, is boundless.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_043: We are honored to meet you, Chief Sonu. I am Alphinaud Leveilleur, and these are my companions  and Cid Garlond.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_044: We are come in search of an airship─a flying vessel of the nethers─which we believe is somewhere in the cloud sea.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_SONUVANU_000_045: Ah, like to black steel-shod contraption from which you save Lonu Vanu?
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Alas, no. That ship belongs to the Garlean Empire─an old enemy of ours...though not the enemy we are looking for at present.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_047: The men we seek wear armor of purest white, and are led by an older man in white robes.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_048: Wait! Lonu Vanu hear tell of these netherlings!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_SONUVANU_000_050: As sun rises and falls and returns, we are. Zundu scouts can testify to words of Lonu Vanu.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_051: Aye, aye! Winds carry purpose of netherlings to our ears as well. Netherlings seek key to Azys Lla!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_CID_000_052: Now we're getting somewhere! Tell us, Chief Sonu: what exactly is this “Azys Lla”?
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_SONUVANU_000_053: Beware, netherlings, for blackest clouds portend greatest danger. Look not into heart of tempest. There lies ancient birthplace of sin, home of forbidden secrets. To speak more is to call the wind!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_054: But the White devours isle where key is kept. Deep within bowels of mighty Bismarck, it lies, beyond reach of the foolhardy!
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_SONUVANU_000_056: Rejoice not in His gluttony, Lonu Vanu, for as stone gives way to water and wind, all yields to the White.
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_LONUVANU_000_057: This he knows, Chief Sonu. Madness of Vundu bodes ill for all Vanu...
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_ALPHINAUD_000_058: When you described it as a “flying feathered whale,” I naturally assumed you had taken some liberties...
TEXT_HEAVNA504_01645_CID_000_059: It'll take a lot more than imperial cannons to bring that beast down...
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_ALPHINAUD_000_000: So Azys Lla is home to forbidden secrets, accessible only to the bearer of a key which the archbishop covets... Much as I would like to believe it safe within the belly of Bismarck, the knights of the Heavens' Ward wield primal powers. If we do not slay the whale and claim the key first, they surely will.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Quite how we will go about it is another matter. As was the case in our battle with Leviathan, we are out of our element, and this time, we have far fewer allies to call upon... Be that as it may, our customary approach still holds true. We must begin by learning more about the White. Let us each question the residents of the village, then regroup and share our findings anon.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_ALPHINAUD_000_003: ...Then the quantity of crystals needed to sustain Bismarck would exceed that consumed by Leviathan...
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_LONUVANU_000_004: With every dawn, fewer and fewer remain, so great is the White's hunger...
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_005: Could we not just leave the key to the forbidden land in the island-eating whale's belly? I mean, I can think of worse places to keep it. ...No? I thought not.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_SONUVANU_100_010: Seek not the birthplace of sin, netherlings. They who do find only death and ruin.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_LONUVANU_000_010: If netherlings seek knowledge of the White, then speak with Kunu Vali, foremost keeper of tales.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_LONUVANU_000_011: But neglect not to present self with humility and respect. As sun yields to moon and moon to sun, netherlings must greet Kunu Vali with a bow.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_LONUVANU_000_012: Kunu Vali holds traditions in highest regard, and so must netherlings, if they wish to hear tales of the White.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_KUNUVALI_000_020: What ill-mannered beast comes before Kunu Vali and begs to hear tales? None who deserve aught, that much she knows!
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_KUNUVALI_000_021: Zephyr winds at your back and sunshine to warm your brow, traveler from below. Kunu Vali, keeper of tales, hears your words, and she remembers.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_KUNUVALI_000_022: In times long ago, in lands elsewhere, before even the cloud sea, the White is one among many. Newborn, He swims beside His many brothers, in seas of endless water.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_KUNUVALI_000_023: But hated, the White is, for His brothers are purest black. So great is their contempt, their loathing, that they turn upon Him and rend His flesh asunder. And so He falls, only to rise again, for merciful gods raise Him to the heavens, and there He is reborn.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_KUNUVALI_000_024: The White still longs for the sea to which He cannot return. But in rebirth, a splinter of the divine is shared, and so He opens His maw, from whence come the clouds, and a new sea is born, home to Him alone.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_KUNUVALI_000_025: Content, He gazes below, and sees others who are as He─hated and hunted. He weeps, and in His benevolence, He raises up isles of earth and guides these people to the cloud sea. Such is the tale of His rebirth, and the salvation of the Vanu. May it never be forgot.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_KUNUVALI_000_026: But this demon which menaces the cloud sea...His rage is that of the Vundu, His hunger that of a wild beast. The isles are His gift to us─yet now He must consume them? Kunu Vali knows no tales like this.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_KUNUVALI_000_027: The Lord of the Mists is merciful and kind─not so this demon...
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_ALPHINAUD_000_030: So according to the Vanu Vanu, the Sea of Clouds and the floating isles were gifts from Bismarck to his people...
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_031: Gifts which he has taken to eating, yes. Technically within his rights, I suppose, if perhaps a little ungenerous. Gods, eh!? But what of you, Alphinaud? Did you learn aught of value?
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Alas, no. That is, unless you have an interest in the intricacies of Vanu skyfishing...
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_033:
Skyfishing...?
My gods, that's it! Alphinaud, my boy, I could kiss you!
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_034: From what we have observed, Bismarck is a creature of pure instinct, driven primarily by hunger. When wounded by the imperials, it fled─but not before devouring another island to restore its strength.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_035: What I propose is this: we tow a suitably appetizing island through the Sea of Clouds, in essence “fishing” for our flying whale.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_036: Once we draw Bismarck out of hiding, we shall use dragonkillers to fire grapnels into the beast's hide, and then reel it in close, enabling our resident eikon-slayer to engage it directly.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_ALPHINAUD_000_037: A bold plan, Master Garlond─but an exceedingly dangerous one. Should  fail to subdue the creature,  would almost certainly be eaten, along with the rest of your “appetizing island.”
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_038: Oh,  won't fail. And if anything does go wrong, I'll be at the helm of the Enterprise, ready to tow  out of trouble. I wouldn't entrust a task like this to anyone else.
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_ALPHINAUD_000_039: Nor I. I trust you have no objections to my joining you as well?
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_040: Not at all, the more the merrier!
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_100_040: Right, then─it seems the boys and I have a lot of work to do if the Enterprise is to be ready for our fishing trip, while you two need to find me some bait! And not just any island, mind─I want a mouthful at most!
TEXT_HEAVNA505_01646_CID_000_041: Personally, I've seen enough of that flying feathered whale already...
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Well, you heard Cid. We need an island to bait the hook.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_001: By way of a first step, I propose we speak with Chief Sonu. If the Zundu are as concerned by Bismarck's behavior as they have given us to believe, they may well be supportive of our efforts to slay him.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_CID_000_003: The boys and I can handle most of the preparations, but we'll need you to secure us a suitable island. Let me know when it's done!
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_SONUVANU_000_010: The tramontane is upon us. The White feasts, and the Vundu rejoice in His carnage...
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Hear me, Chief Sonu. This creature which torments you now is not the deity who raised up the floating isles and made a gift of them to you.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_012: He is a perversion of your beliefs given form by the Vundu─a false savior who consumes that which he should rightly safeguard.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Yet it need not be this way, Chief Sonu. We have the power to strike down this impostor...but we must beg of you an island to see it done.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_SONUVANU_000_014: Motes against the tempest. In vain do they struggle...
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_SONUVANU_000_015: ...Yet who is Sonu to speak of what may be? Perhaps even the tramontane can turn to the ponente. Very well, netherlings. When you are ready, tell Zundu scouts what manner of island you require and they guide you to it.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_016: We shall not fail, Chief Sonu. On that you have my word.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_100_016: Come, ─let us see how Cid's preparations are progressing.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_SONUVANU_000_017: May soft rains come to cleanse us of these sins...
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_CID_000_020: Our Ishgardian friends have furnished us with dragonkillers and ammunition, and I've taken the liberty of procuring a magitek field generator as well.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_CID_000_021: Rest assured, we've chains to spare, every link forged by the manufactory's master craftsmen. If you've any lingering doubts as to their strength, know that they were originally intended to bind dragons─and were not found wanting.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_022: It pleases me to inform you that the Vanu Vanu have agreed to furnish us with an island of our choosing.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_CID_000_023: Then all that remains is to confirm the readiness of the poor buggers who'll actually be doing the fighting. , let Wedge know when your party is assembled.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_WEDGE_000_024: A-Are we really going to go skyfishing for a primal!?
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_025: My, that took hardly any time at all. The Ironworks engineers do not disappoint.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_CID_000_026: We'll depart for the island once you've assembled your party. Let Wedge know when you're ready.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_WEDGE_000_030: I probably shouldn't be telling you this, but I don't like this plan. I don't like it one little bit! ...But I can't help being excited all the same!
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_WEDGE_000_031: So tell me, : are you ready to hunt the white whale?
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_Q1_000_000: Are you ready to hunt the white whale?
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Would that I could fight alongside you, , but primal influence being what it is, I think it best that I assist Wedge with the machinery on this occasion.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_CID_000_042: Since we still don't know the extent of Bismarck's influence, I'd prefer to keep those not actively participating in the battle inside the ship. It would be a shame if one of us started chanting “The White! The White!” and stabbed you in the back, after all.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_WEDGE_000_043: Don't worry, ─the Enterprise is more than capable of staying ahead of Bismarck! Alphinaud and I will be keeping an eye on things in the engine room just to be sure!
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Forgive me, . Had I known what was happening, mayhap I could have done something to stop them...
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Alas, Wedge and I were still sealed within the engine room and heard naught of the struggle until it was over.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_052: And now, for all our efforts, the archbishop holds the very thing we sought to keep from him...
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_ALPHINAUD_000_053: But all is not lost, for we yet live, and we know their destination! Let us give chase and bring an end to their machinations!
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_CID_000_060: In retrospect, we should probably have seen that coming. Still, you fought well, ─better than that, in fact. Chin up, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_WEDGE_000_061: I didn't know Alphinaud had been studying magitek technology. He was a godssend during the fight, the way he helped me tend to the engines.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_BIGGS_000_062: I'm just glad we're all still here to tell the tale.
TEXT_HEAVNA506_01647_SONUVANU_100_063: May soft rains come to cleanse us of these sins...
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Though we failed to secure the key, we must not forget that we succeeded in ridding the realm of another primal─and prevented the Vanu Vanu's lands from being consumed in so doing. The Zundu, at least, shall be glad of our deeds this day.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Let us go and inform Chief Sonu of our victory. Cid and the others will need a moment to tend to the Enterprise, besides.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_CID_000_002:
I know you're eager to get after the Heavens' Ward, but considering what we just put the old girl through, I'd say she's due a little tender loving care.
...Now, where did I put my hammer?
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_BIGGS_000_003: As you'd expect, they flew off in the direction that beam was pointing. Bastards...
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_WEDGE_000_004: The force generated by the beam was enough to displace the ship, and after comparing the data recorded by our fore and aft gyroscopes, I... Ahem. To cut a long story short, I think I've almost determined its heading.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Never in my wildest dreams did I think I would stand less than twenty paces from the Emperor of Garlemald... Varis zos Galvus in the flesh...
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_011: I assume the commander that accompanied him must be the legatus of whom the centurion spoke...
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Ah, forgive me. This is neither the time nor place for such idle speculation. Pray return to the Enterprise at once. It occurs to me that our friends may have run afoul of imperial forces as well.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_013: I have yet to apprise Chief Sonu of all that has occurred, but once I have, we will rejoin you at the airship.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_014: If you fear for our safety, may I direct your attention to the suit of magitek armor nearby and its exceedingly capable pilot.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_LUCIA_000_015: Ah, the armor? I had it sent here as a precautionary measure...
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_BIGGS_000_016: Bugger me, did you see the size of that imperial battleship!?
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_WEDGE_000_017: We saw it fire on the village! Are you all right, !?
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_SONUVANU_100_017: So they too are seekers of the forbidden secrets, these netherlings of black steel...
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_CID_100_018: What the─!? Was that what I thought it was?
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_CID_000_020: Thank the Twelve you're alive, ! When that battleship appeared and fired on the village, we feared the game was up for you and Alphinaud. What in the seven hells happened out there?
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_CID_000_021: First the archbishop turns up with an Ascian in tow, and now the godsdamned Emperor pays us a visit!? What is this, a procession of notable bastards? Who's next? The Keeper of the Seventh bloody Gate!?
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_022:
No one so “notable,” Master Garlond.
I am happy to report that the Zundu were overjoyed to learn of Bismarck's demise.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Chief Sonu sends his warmest regards, . There was much talk of westerly winds.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_LUCIA_000_024: Miraculously, none suffered lasting harm during the raid. It would seem the Zundu were taken entirely unawares, and wisely chose to offer no resistance.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_ALPHINAUD_000_025: I sense they have no more to fear from the Empire, for the present, at least. Had the Emperor truly been intent on their extermination, Ok' Zundu would already have been leveled. Plainly, Varis is only interested in reaching Azys Lla.
TEXT_HEAVNA507_01648_CID_000_026: Speaking of which, if you're all ready to continue the chase, the Enterprise is as well. Shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_ALPHINAUD_100_000: Well? What are we waiting for?
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_WEDGE_100_002: I've done it, ! I've worked out which way they're headed! Whenever you're ready, we'll set course for Azys Lla!
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_LUCIA_100_003: And what will we find at the end of the road...?
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_CID_000_000: Lest you wonder, Wedge was able to calculate the heading indicated by the beam of light emitted by the key. If Azys Lla lies in that direction, we'll find it.
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_CID_000_001: The Soleil may have a lead on us, but she's no Enterprise. We'll catch them─you'll see!
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_CID_000_010: Ack! And we'd barely finished repairing the damage incurred during our skyfishing trip. On the other hand, any landing you can walk away from, as they say...
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_CID_000_011: I can only presume the Soleil passed through the barrier unscathed. That would certainly explain why the Vanu called it a key...
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Cid's piloting under pressure was a marvel to behold─and may I never have the opportunity to do so again.
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_LUCIA_000_013: What could be out there that would warrant the personal attention of the Emperor himself...?
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_WEDGE_000_014: I wonder─does she have a name?
TEXT_HEAVNA508_01649_BIGGS_000_015: Gods, just thinking about all the repairs we'll have to make is giving me a bleedin' headache...
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Assuming Cid is correct─and I have no reason to think that he is not─the Vanu's key is required to pass through the barrier protecting Azys Lla.
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_ALPHINAUD_000_001: But even without it, we must find a way to reach the isle. I shall have everyone convene at the Seat of the Lord Commander, that we might discuss how best to proceed.
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_ALPHINAUD_000_002: As before, make yourself known to the guardsman when you arrive, and he will show you in.
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_CID_000_003: For every day I spend in the sky, it feels as though I spend a week on the ground...
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_LUCIA_000_004: What could be out there that would warrant the personal attention of the Emperor himself...?
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_WEDGE_000_005: I wonder─does she have a name?
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_BIGGS_000_006: Gods, just thinking about all the repairs we'll have to make is giving me a bleedin' headache...
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_TEMPLEKIGHTGATE_000: Ah, you are returned! Ser Aymeric and the others await you within!
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_SCENE00008_EVENTARE: Proceed to the Seat of the Lord Commander?
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Though we know little and less of Azys Lla, one thing is plain: the archbishop and the Garleans cannot be allowed to avail themselves of its secrets.
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_CID_000_031: I swear, wherever there's an Allagan ruin, there's trouble just waiting to happen. I suppose that's why they erected such damnably convoluted defenses around everything...
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_LUCIA_000_032: If the Empire has an interest in Azys Lla, we have all the more reason to hurry. I would not see its secrets fall into the hands of either the archbishop or the Emperor.
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_EDMONT_000_033: Welcome back, my friend, and pray forgive me my earlier display. I grieve for my son still, and shall continue to do so, but I have resolved to be strong. It is what he would have wished.
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_AYMERIC_000_034: Think not of the cost. Whatever you require to modify the Enterprise, you shall have it.
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_TATARU_000_020: Welcome back, ! How goes the mission? Did you manage to catch up with the archbishop and his cronies?
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_TATARU_000_021: So, you finally arrived at Azys Lla...only to find your way barred by some sort of barrier... Typical.
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_TATARU_000_022: But it's not all bad news! I've made progress in the search for our friends! Don't worry, ─we'll get to Azys Lla yet!
TEXT_HEAVNA601_01650_ALPHINAUD_000_023: She may not spend her days slaying primals, but Tataru is no less a Scion than you or me. Full oft has her knack for acquiring information proven vital to our endeavors.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_TATARU_000_000: When you fled the victory feast, you used the ancient watercourse beneath the city, right?
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_TATARU_000_001: Well, shortly after things went back to normal in Ul'dah, I asked Marshal Tarupin to have the tunnels searched.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_002: A logical place to look... It was there that you lost contact with Minfilia, Thancred, and Y'shtola, was it not?
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Dare I ask what the marshal found?
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_TATARU_000_004: Um...I don't actually know. Pipin's message just said that there had been a discovery, and that we were to come to the Hall of Flames at our earliest convenience.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I dare not think what it might be... We shall depart at once. Tataru─let Urianger know to join us in Ul'dah. He will wish to be present as well.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_100_006: She may not spend her days slaying primals, but Tataru is no less a Scion than you or me. Full oft has her knack for acquiring information proven vital to our endeavors.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_007: As thou art returned to us, wherefore might our comrades not be the same? Never shall I concede them lost till I have seen proof of their passing.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_010: We are grateful for your assistance, Marshal Tarupin.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_PIPPIN_000_011: You saved Her Grace and Father both. 'Tis the least I can do to repay you.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_TATARU_000_012: Forgive me my impatience, Marshal, but your missive mentioned a discovery...?
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_PIPPIN_000_013: Yes, of course. As per your request, I had my men scour the waterways. Almost immediately, we encountered a difficulty: an entire section of the tunnel had collapsed.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_PIPPIN_000_014: With the Mineral Concern's cooperation, however, we were able to remove the rubble, which yielded the battered bodies of a dozen Crystal Braves.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_PIPPIN_000_016: Be at ease, Master Alphinaud─your friends were not among the deceased. That alone is cause for hope. And then there is this...
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_020: 'Tis as I did surmise. Judging by the aetheric imprint that lingereth yet upon this wand, it hath assuredly been employed in the casting of a most uncommon magick.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_022: The very first that man did conceive to traverse great distances, and the ancient precursor to all methods of travel that utilize the Lifestream: Flow.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_023: The spell entaileth the reduction of the corporeal form into its constituent aether, that the caster might enter the Lifestream, and ride its currents thereby. Unlike the teleportation magicks of modern times, it requireth not a lengthy incantation. That Y'shtola should choose to employ such a spell bespeaketh the need for haste.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_024: All of which would suggest she managed to escape!
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_025: Would that it were so simple. Know that the scholars of Sharlayan forbade the use of this spell─and with good reason.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_026: The caster hath but limited control over his course. For every mage who came safe unto his destination, another would be set adrift in the Lifestream, never to emerge.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_TATARU_000_027: What? No! No, you can't mean...
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_028: Be not downcast, my friends, for there is yet hope. 'Tis like that Y'shtola's passage hath left traces in the Lifestream. Could we but follow these from the point at which the magick was invoked, we may yet find her.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_029: To the Sil'dih excavation site, then. Our thanks for your aid, Marshal.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_PIPPIN_000_030: Do not mention it. I shall pray for Lady Y'shtola's safe return.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_PIPPIN_000_031: Would that I could be of more assistance, but our nation's resources are stretched thin. Be that as it may, do not hesitate to contact me if there is aught I can do.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Simply being here calls to mind the events of that fateful day...
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_TATARU_000_033: If our friends weren't in the tunnel, that must mean they're somewhere else!
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_040: Evidence of Y'shtola's passage will have been made faint by time. But mayhap some few scant traces yet remain to guide our steps.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_041: The trail leadeth to the north and east...
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_044: Aye, there is no mistake─thither hath Y'shtola journeyed.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_045: And yet the Gridanians have reported no sightings. We must take this to mean she is still adrift.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_URIANGER_000_046: If it be so, I do fear for our friend. Contrary to its name, the Lifestream is more akin to a raging torrent. Linger overlong in the midst of this maelstrom, and the aether that formeth one's soul shall surely be scattered, ne'er to be reformed.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_047: We have no time to waste. Urianger─pray explore all possible options for reversing the effects of this forbidden magick. , Tataru─we three shall press on to Gridania and petition the Elder Seedseer's aid.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_ALPHINAUD_000_050:
It is said that the elementals perceive the Lifestream. If, as we suspect, Y'shtola is still adrift in its midst, they may be able to find her. But if we are to appeal to them for assistance, we must needs do so through their chosen─the Padjal.
It is imperative therefore that we speak with Kan-E-Senna without delay.
TEXT_HEAVNA602_01651_TATARU_000_051: Hold on, Y'shtola! We're coming for you!
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I have already requested an audience with the Elder Seedseer. She will receive us in the Lotus Stand presently. We need but speak with the conjurer yonder to be admitted.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_ALPHINAUD_000_001: The Elder Seedseer is ready to receive us in the Lotus Stand. We need but speak with the conjurer yonder to be admitted.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_TATARU_000_001: Hold on, Y'shtola! We're coming for you!
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_DOORMANLOTUS_000_01: The Elder Seedseer awaits. Pray follow me.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_KANESENNA_000_011: Be welcome, my friends, and speak freely. I gather your suit will admit no delay.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_ALPHINAUD_000_012: It will not, my lady. Pray forgive the abrupt nature of our request, but it is a matter of life and death.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_KANESENNA_000_013: I see... As you say, we must needs act swiftly if we are to free Y'shtola from the ungentle pull of the Lifestream.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_KANESENNA_000_014: And as you have surmised, we cannot do this unaided. However...
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_TATARU_000_020:
If memory serves, Y'shtola's sister is named Y'mhitra.
...Oh, you know her, do you? Well then, that ought to make things easier!
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_TATARU_000_021: If memory serves, Y'shtola's sister is named Y'mhitra. She's supposed to be a member of the Sons of Saint Coinach.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_TATARU_000_022: Anyway, she spends most of her time around Apkallu Falls, from what I recall. Let's look for her there!
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_YMHITRA_000_023: You and your friends wish a word with me? Well, then...you had better bring your friends with you.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_ALPHINAUD_000_024: I was not aware that Y'shtola had a family member here in Gridania. How very convenient. Forgive me... I have grown so accustomed to being laughed at by the fates, I cannot help but mistrust them when they smile on us. We must, of course, seek the woman out at once.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_DOORMANLOTUS_100_02: The Elder Seedseer makes ready to reach out to the great ones. Pray see to your own preparations.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_YMHITRA_000_030: Greetings, . What brings you here today? I see that you have companions.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_YMHITRA_000_031: Yes? Is there something you require?
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Lady Y'mhitra, it is an honor to meet you. My name is Alphinaud Leveilleur, and this is Tataru Taru.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_YMHITRA_000_033: So you are my sister's comrades in the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_YMHITRA_000_034: When I heard that your people were being pursued, I desperately sought to reach Shtola, but all mine efforts were to no avail. Now I know why. A forbidden spell, of all things! That she should be so reckless...
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_YMHITRA_000_035: But what's done is done. I thank you for bringing word to me. Needless to say, I should be glad to help.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_YMHITRA_000_036: Though we were born of different mothers, our veins course with the same father's blood. I hope that this will be enough for the elementals. Come, let us make for Everschade at once.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_TATARU_000_041: Just seeing her face again... It's... <sniff> Oh, I've been so worried...
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Let us pray that Y'shtola awakens.
TEXT_HEAVNA603_01652_YMHITRA_000_043: I shall go to be with my sister at the Roost. My conjury skills should be of some use in caring for her.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_000: Y'shtola is resting within an inn room. Though she's still unconscious, the signs are positive.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_001: The conjurers say she is in sound health and should awaken before long! Isn't that wonderful?
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_002: Now, while we wait for Y'shtola to wake up, I thought I'd take the opportunity to finish my little surprise for her.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_003: It's something I've been working on for a while now, in the hope that she'd one day return to us. It wants for just a couple more items before it's ready.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_004: I've already placed orders for these items. Could I ask you to retrieve them for me? One is with the Leatherworkers' Guild and another is with the Conjurers' Guild. Speak with Mistress Geva and Brother E-Sumi-Yan, and they ought to take care of you!
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Without the Seedseers' aid, Y'shtola may have been forever lost to us. I shall go to the Lotus Stand to offer them my heartfelt thanks.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_006: Please fetch the items I ordered. One is with the Leatherworkers' Guild and another is with the Conjurers' Guild. Speak with Mistress Geva and Brother E-Sumi-Yan, and they ought to take care of you!
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_YMHITRA_000_007: I shall go to be with my sister at the Roost. My conjury skills should be of some use in caring for her.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_GEVA_000_010:
Well, if it isn't . Looking for some hides to tan, mayhap?
...Hm? Here to retrieve an order for Mistress Tataru, you say?
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_GEVA_000_011:
What is it? I am a busy woman, so be quick about it. If you wish to place an order, speak with Randall.
...Hm? Here to retrieve an order? For Mistress Tataru, you say?
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_GEVA_000_012: You come at a good time─I finished it but moments ago. It was no small coup working it to her specifications, but I did it nonetheless. Payment has already been settled.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_GEVA_000_013: However did that girl come by chimerical hide, anyway? You need either balls of steel or a bottomless coinpurse, and it seemed to me she had neither.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_GEVA_000_014: However did that girl come by chimerical hide? You need either balls of steel or a bottomless coinpurse, and it seemed to me she had neither.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_ESUMIYAN_000_020: Greetings, . I trust you have been well. Is there aught you require of me?
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_ESUMIYAN_000_021: You are come to Stillglade Fane, the home of the Conjurers' Guild. How may I assist you?
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_ESUMIYAN_000_022: Ah, yes, Mistress Tataru's order. As requested, it has been sanctified in the sight of the elementals.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_ESUMIYAN_000_023: I know not what she intends for the staff, but it is a most singular artifact. Even one possessed of my experience would struggle to wield it.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_ESUMIYAN_000_024: I know not what Mistress Tataru intends for the staff, but it is a most singular artifact. Even one possessed of my experience would struggle to wield it.
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_030: Ah, you're back! You have the items, I hope?
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_031: ...Oooh, it's precisely as I requested─a perfect match for the other pieces! Truly, Geva is a master among masters!
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_032: And the staff completes the surprise! Thank you so much, !
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_033: Tee hee, I can't wait to see what Y'shtola thinks of the surprise!
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_TATARU_000_034: Lest you wonder, she's doing very well, and the conjurers have left her in her sister's care. Let's go and pay them a visit, shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNA604_01653_ALPHINAUD_000_035: The Seedseers are gracious souls. It gives me heart to know that they are our allies.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_YSHTOLA_000_000: In my youth, I had the honor of studying under Matoya. In the field of aetheric research, she was without rival.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_YSHTOLA_000_001: I have no doubt that her knowledge will be of aid to our cause. The question is, will she share it with us? My master has ever been willful─the gods forbid anyone disagrees with her.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_YSHTOLA_000_002: When the Garlean Empire first marched upon Eorzea some fifteen years ago, the denizens of Sharlayan were summoned back to the motherland.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_YSHTOLA_000_003: However, Matoya refused to join the exodus. To this day, she lives a hermit's life on the fringes of the abandoned city.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_000_004: So it is to the Dravanian hinterlands that we must go. To the place of my birth...
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Though Alisaie and I were born in Sharlayan, our days there were short. We remained only until the exodus, and I have not returned since.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_YSHTOLA_000_006: Oh, so it's to be a homecoming, then? As fine a reason as any to go to Sharlayan, and it would afford us the opportunity to pay my master a visit.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_000_007: Ahem. I believe you have mistaken our primary objective, Y'shtola. At any rate, the journey will take us through largely unknown territory. Let us first return to Ishgard and make our preparations.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_TATARU_000_010: Tee hee! Y'shtola looks absolutely smashing in her new outfit, don't you think?
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_100_008: Matoya... The name rings strangely familiar.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Sharlayan is situated in the Dravanian hinterlands.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_000_012: To get there, we must strike west and traverse the breadth of the Dravanian forelands. Make no mistake, it will be a grueling journey.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_000_013: The party shall be comprised of , Y'shtola, and myself. Tataru, pray remain in Ishgard and continue the search for our missing friends.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_000_015: First, let us make for Tailfeather.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_TATARU_000_016: We managed to find Y'shtola. Given time, I'm sure we'll be reunited with the others as well!
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_YSHTOLA_000_017: So this is the Holy See. I should like to linger awhile and take in the sights, but it must wait till after our mission.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_YSHTOLA_000_020: A long soak in the Lifestream followed by a long journey... I would not recommend it to anyone.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_YSHTOLA_000_021: But rest assured my strength is returning to me. I shall be back to my former self ere long.
TEXT_HEAVNA605_01654_ALPHINAUD_000_022: When last we set foot here, Estinien and Ysayle were with us. Though it was not all that long ago, I find myself strangely taken by nostalgia.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_000: I believe I am sufficiently rested. Let us continue west to Sharlayan.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_001: Once we descend the mountain path, we will arrive at the Dravanian hinterlands. From there, it is but a short distance to the city.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_002: Be warned that we shall be passing through Gnath territory. We must needs be wary of them and the dragons both.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_ALPHINAUD_000_003: When last we set foot here, Estinien and Ysayle were with us. Though it was not all that long ago, I find myself strangely taken by nostalgia.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_010: Matoya dwells on the far side of the Thaliak River. Let us search for a crossing.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_011: The bridge ahead is collapsed; I am afraid we shan't be crossing there. But worry not, I know another way.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_012: See you the towering structure to the north? We should be able to cross there.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_ALPHINAUD_000_013: But fifteen years abandoned, and already Sharlayan has fallen into such disarray... Verily, a city is no more than its inhabitants.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_020: “Knowledge Seeks No Man”... So says the motto of Sharlayan engraved upon yonder stone. The meaning is simple: it falls to us to seek enlightenment.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_021: During the Sixth Astral Era, at the turn of the thirteenth century, men from the northern nation of Sharlayan journeyed across the seas to Eorzea in search of knowledge.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_022: Upon arriving at these shores, they established a camp for their scholarly endeavors. Over time, this camp grew into a settlement, and the settlement prospered, and so much so that it came to be counted amongst Eorzea's great city-states.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_023: Alas, those glory days are now but a fading memory. With her keepers lost to her, Sharlayan has become an empty husk of her former self.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_SLOWFIX_000_024: (-???-)Pshkohhh... Uplander is mistaken. Sharlayan has new keepers, is on cusp of new age of glory!
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Goblins? Here to plunder the city!?
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_SLOWFIX_000_026: (-Well-spoken Goblin-)<gasp> Uplander is mistaken muchly! We are not thieves! This place is our home!
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_027: Your home? When last I looked, it was mine and Alphinaud's. We were born here.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_SLOWFIX_000_028: (-Well-spoken Goblin-)Pssshmph! When uplanders abandoned city, uplanders gave up claim. Born here or no, uplanders are trespassers!
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_ALPHINAUD_000_029: My friends, please. We did not come to dispute your claim to this land. Our purpose here is peaceful: we desire but to cross the river.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Be calm, I beg you, and let us speak like the civilized folk that we are. Surely we can come to a mutual understanding.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_SLOWFIX_000_031: Pssshkoh... If that is truth, then uplanders are welcome here. Come with Slowfix─Slowfix will show uplanders settlement.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_SLOWFIX_000_040: Pshkohhh... Here is heart of settlement, name of Idyllshire!
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Greetings to you. I am Alphinaud Leveilleur, and may I introduce my companions,  and Y'shtola. We have journeyed far in search of a friend, and seek to cross the river.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_MIDNIGHTDEW_000_043: But findin' the main bridge collapsed, you went lookin' for a detour, and ended up stumblin' into Slowfix and his crew. Is that right?
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_044: That is the short of it, aye. This place, Idyllshire─I came expecting a ghost town; suffice it to say I am surprised to find it so alive.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_MIDNIGHTDEW_000_045: Well, with all them precious artifacts lyin' about, 'twas only a matter of time afore treasure hunters like me moved in. But we weren't the first to arrive, neither. By then, Slowfix and his gobbie friends were already settled.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_SLOWFIX_000_046: At first, gobbies and hunters disliked each other. But understanding came, then friendship. Now gobbies and hunters have joined hands to build great new nation!
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_047: So that is what happened after we Sharlayans departed...
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_MIDNIGHTDEW_000_048: Oh, so you're locals...? Um, no hard feelin's, I hope? All these nice buildings, but no one to live in 'em─felt like a waste, you know?
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_MIDNIGHTDEW_000_049: We've been tryin' to put the place to rights, and things've been goin' well for the most part, but it ain't all smooth sailin'. Not to sound ungrateful, but the traps your people left lyin' about are a bloody nuisance. And there's the Illuminati harryin' us day and night...
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_SLOWFIX_000_050: Pshkohhh, Slowfix has bright idea! Uplanders desire mutual understanding, yes? Best way to understanding is helping one another! Help citizens of Idyllshire, and uplanders can be citizens too! Citizens are free to cross river!
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Well, I am not aware of a quicker way to reach our destination. Let us assist Slowfix and his people.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_ALPHINAUD_000_052: From the goblins' perspective, such a well-appointed city is certainly an attractive proposition.
TEXT_HEAVNA606_01655_YSHTOLA_000_052: I suppose it's only to be expected that others would come and occupy Sharlayan. Nonetheless, it feels akin to having strangers take over your home in your absence.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_SLOWFIX_000_000: Pshkohhh... So uplanders agree to help? Good! Here is what Slowfix wants uplanders to do.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_SLOWFIX_000_001: Many golems prowl Idyllshire, get in the way of expansion plans. Slowfix wants uplanders to eliminate golems.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_SLOWFIX_000_002: Uplanders are Sharlayan, yes? Sharlayans should know best way to deal with creatures.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_SLOWFIX_000_003: Slowfix wants uplanders to eliminate golems. Uplanders are Sharlayan, yes? Sharlayans should know best way to deal with creatures.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_ALPHINAUD_000_004: From the goblins' perspective, such a well-appointed city is certainly an attractive proposition.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_YSHTOLA_000_005: I suppose it's only to be expected that others would come and occupy Sharlayan. Nonetheless, it feels akin to having strangers take over your home in your absence.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_ALPHINAUD_000_006: Sentinel golems? I daresay Y'shtola will know how to deal with them.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_YSHTOLA_000_010: So we are to eliminate the golems. That should be a simple enough affair.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_YSHTOLA_000_011: The automata were employed as sentinels, and by design can be unmade with a coded command. At the time of the exodus, it was “Noughts and Crosses,” and I see no reason why it should not still work.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_YSHTOLA_000_012: Let us divide the task between the three of us, the quicker to be finished with it.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_SYSTEM_000_013: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the coded command “Noughts and Crosses” to unmake a golem.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_YSHTOLA_000_014: Use the coded command “Noughts and Crosses” to unmake the golems. If all goes well, we can accomplish the task without recourse to violence.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_ALPHINAUD_000_015: I shall see to the golems beyond this point. The area yonder, I leave in your capable hands.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_SYSTEM_000_021: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter the password “Noughts and Crosses” to unmake a golem.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_SYSTEM_000_022: With a shudder, the golem crumbles to pieces.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_SLOWFIX_000_031: Now we can resume work to expand settlement!
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_YSHTOLA_000_032: I'm pleased to report that my golems obediently crumbled at my command.
TEXT_HEAVNA607_01656_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Of all the luck, one of my golems was not receptive to the password, and tried to pummel me bloody. Thankfully, I managed to dance clear of its fists and strike it down.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_SLOWFIX_000_000: Pssshkohhh... Uplanders helped gobbieflock, earned right to be citizens of Idyllshire. But Slowfix must ask another favor.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_SLOWFIX_000_002: Short time ago, dear friend of Slowfix ventured into Illuminati territory.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_SLOWFIX_000_003: Illuminati are nasty goblins, show no mercy even towards gobbiekin. Slowfix fears for friend's life. Please find friend before Illuminati do.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_YSHTOLA_000_004: I am suddenly taken by a sense of foreboding.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Be that as it may, we cannot turn a blind eye. Let us make haste and find Slowfix's friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_YSHTOLA_000_006: I'm pleased to report that my golems obediently crumbled at my command.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_ALPHINAUD_000_007: Of all the luck, one of my golems was not receptive to the password, and tried to pummel me bloody. Thankfully, I managed to dance clear of its fists and strike it down.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_SLOWFIX_000_008: Illuminati are nasty goblins, show no mercy even towards gobbiekin. Slowfix fears for friend's life. Please find friend before Illuminati do.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_BRAYFLOX_000_010:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
Goodly uplander! Long time no eyecatch! What is bringing uplander here?
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_BRAYFLOX_000_011: <gasp> Does uplander have lustyeyes for junk of Brayflox? Uplander must not be touching junk of Brayflox! Brayflox is finding junk first!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_YSHTOLA_000_012: I knew I recognized that voice... Greetings, Brayflox. It has been a while.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_YSHTOLA_000_013: Forgive us for interrupting your work, but Captain Wheiskaet gave me to understand that you are marked by the Illuminati. This happens to be Illuminati-held territory. Is it wise to be here?
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_BRAYFLOX_000_014: Pshhhawww! Brayflox eat Illuminati for sunupses!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Pshhhkohhh... Who eats who for sunupses?
Brayflox Alltalks! Unwise you are to come here after dirty-taking secret knowings of cheesemake from Illuminati!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_BRAYFLOX_000_018: Brayflox did no unright! Cheese recipe is gobbie birthright!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_QUICKTHINXALLTHOUGH: Save tongueflaps for trading in deathpit!
Pray to gobfathers, for punishment is neartimes!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_YSHTOLA_000_021: It appears we have no choice...
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_BRAYFLOX_000_022: Psssheehee! Illuminati no match for furious gobfists of Brayflox!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_BRAYFLOX_000_023: More junk is awaiting Brayflox muchly! Brayflox is taking leave of uplanders!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_YSHTOLA_000_030: Being embroiled in a cheese war was the last thing I expected coming to Sharlayan. At any rate, we have fulfilled Slowfix's request. Let us return with the good tidings and be on our way.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_ALPHINAUD_000_031: So that was the famous Brayflox... I have newfound respect for the Company of Heroes. That a motley crew such as theirs could achieve the feats they did bespeaks unwavering solidarity.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_SLOWFIX_000_040: Uplanders are back! Did uplanders find friend of Slowfix?
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_SLOWFIX_000_041: Pshkohhh... Time has not cured recklessness of Brayflox. Without help from uplanders, Brayflox would now be dead gobbie. Slowfix owes uplanders debt of gratitude!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_SLOWFIX_000_042: Slowfix and Brayflox are joined by unseverable gobbiebond. If Slowfix had known that uplanders are friends of Brayflox, Slowfix would have welcomed uplanders to gobbieflock at first meeting!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_ALPHINAUD_000_043: I had known that Y'shtola was capable, but to invoke such potent magicks so effortlessly... I must needs redouble my efforts if I am to approach her level of mastery.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_YSHTOLA_000_044: One does not simply “drift” in the Lifestream; it is a constant struggle to hold on to your very essence. The experience has hardened me in ways I can ill explain.
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_BRAYFLOX_BATTLETALK: Pssshkoh! Brayflox showy-do Illuminati gobbie trick or two!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Whatever this is about, Brayflox needs our help!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_BRAYFLOX_BATTLETALK: Spill bladder not over unstrong firebooms of Illuminati!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Yet more of them! At this rate...
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: Now seems as good a time as any...
Pray keep the enemy at bay!
TEXT_HEAVNA608_01657_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Amazing... How did you learn such a potent spell?
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_SLOWFIX_000_000: Pssshkoh... Uplanders have upheld bargain most highly. As promised, Slowfix makes uplanders honored citizens of Idyllshire, free to cross river at will.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_SLOWFIX_000_001: Though uplanders must leave for now, Slowfix hopes that uplanders will pay many visits and help build great new nation!
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_ALPHINAUD_000_002: You are most kind, my friend. You may be certain that we will return.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_YSHTOLA_000_003: I must confess, at first it upset me to learn that my home had been occupied by others. But I see now that it is in good hands.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_YSHTOLA_000_004: Under your care, I look forward to seeing Sharlayan thrive once more, to become a home to people of all races and creeds.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_SLOWFIX_000_005: Slowfix has already ordered the gobwatch to let uplanders through. Safe travels!
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_YSHTOLA_000_007: 'Twould be an understatement to say that I am quite ready to move on.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Let us hope there are no further surprises.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_YSHTOLA_000_009: I shall be very cross if we are asked to clear this mountain of rubble.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_ALPHINAUD_100_009: So we are free to go...where exactly?
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_GOBLINGUARD01658_00:
Pshhh... Shkohhh...
By order of Chief Slowfix, uplanders can come and go at will.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_GOBLINGUARD01658_10: One moment for clearing away barricade.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_YSHTOLA_000_020: Finally, we can continue our journey.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_YSHTOLA_000_021: Ahem. Barring any misadventure, we shall soon arrive at the cave where Matoya resides. Unless you have unfinished business in Idyllshire, let us strike out at once.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_YSHTOLA_000_023: Ahead lies the Answering Quarter, where the scholars of Sharlayan gathered to hone their knowledge.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_YSHTOLA_000_024: Even from this distance, 'tis plain that much of it has been given back to the wilderness.
TEXT_HEAVNA609_01658_ALPHINAUD_000_022: I am ready whenever you are. Let us go and meet the legendary Matoya.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_000: The cave in which Matoya resides is situated on the southern edge of the hinterlands.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_001: In choosing the spot, my master desired privacy above all else. As such, the cave is extremely well hidden; you'll not find it unless you know to look for it.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_002: We shall follow the road south until we reach a bridge. Rather than cross it, however, we shall ford the stream it spans, thence head straight until we arrive at the base of a bluff.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_ALPHINAUD_000_003: But the final leg of our journey remains. Let us go and meet the legendary Matoya.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_010:
This is the entrance.
...Hm? You seem unconvinced, . Well, that will only add to the surprise.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_011: A word of warning before we proceed: stubborn geniuses make poor hosts, and time will have done naught to improve my master's temperament.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_012: Doubt not but that there will be sentinels and traps both to deter unwanted guests. But we'll not be deterred, will we?
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_013: Go on and touch the wall yonder. You will want to have your weapon near at hand.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_ALPHINAUD_000_014: All kinds of herbs grow here, and they appear very well tended.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_015: What are you waiting for? Go on and touch the wall yonder.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_020: Those sentinels may suffice to discourage the average trespasser, but not the Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNA610_01659_YSHTOLA_000_021: The way should now be clear. Come, let us go and see my master.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_YSHTOLA_000_000: Being here calls to mind my days studying under Matoya. Though she was the strictest─and most irascible─of mentors, she led by example and inspired one to greater heights. Were it not for her sage guidance, I should not be the woman I am.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Do you see the tomes lying about like so many cheap romances? They are priceless. My professors at the Studium would have fits if they saw them in this state.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_000_010: Oh, the Great Library's guardians shouldn't pose any difficulty for a hero like you.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_000_011: But if it turns out you aren't up to the task... Well, then I'll know you can't be trusted with something as dangerous as an aetheric ram.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_100_011: I'll put a pair of familiars at your disposal. One's a poroggo who'll help you locate the tome.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_000_012:
The other's that broom yonder, who'll let you into the library.
...Well? What are you waiting for? Introduce yourself, !
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_000_013: Are you going to introduce yourself to that broom or not? No skin off my nose if you don't.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_YSHTOLA_000_014: The Great Library was more than just a repository for tomes; it also served as a center of research for countless fields of study.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_YSHTOLA_000_015: Fields such as the development of arcane entities, the fruits of which were employed as the library's sentinels. We must be ever on our guard.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Among other things, Master Matoya is an authority in familiars. After we have tended to our task, perhaps I shall beg her for some insights on the subject...
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MAGICALBROOM01660_0: Greetings, good . I am Broomsy, my lady's servant of some fifty years. May I say what an honor it is to serve you!
I am given to understand you wish to enter the Great Gubal Library. To find it, pray head east upon leaving this cave. The building will come into view shortly after you reach the collapsed bridge.
I shall go and fetch my fellow familiar on my way to the entrance. When your preparations are in order, pray come and meet me there. It will be my pleasure to unlock the door for you.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_000_023: What are you loitering around here for? Hurry up and fetch that book!
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MAGICALBROOM01660_0: You stand before the Great Gubal Library, one of Hydaelyn's foremost repositories of knowledge.
Alas, it has fallen into disuse since the exodus some summers since. In all those years, its halls have welcomed not the coming of a single soul─its floors felt not the loving brush of a broom...

M-Mine apologies, ! Pray pay no mind to the dreams of a humble broom. You are doubtless eager to venture within and retrieve my lady's tome. I shall unlock the door at once. When you have what you seek, pray return to the cave and report to my lady.
I wish you good fortune in your search. When you have what you seek, pray return to the cave and report to my lady.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_000_040: I take it you found the tome. Well, let's see it, then.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_000_041: Aye, this is it all right...
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_YSHTOLA_000_042: I must say, the experience brought back memories. Just like the old days, you still send people into the thick of danger as if it were nothing more than a mundane errand.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_ALPHINAUD_000_043: But we were able to accomplish our task thanks to Pero Roggo. He is an eminently capable familiar─a creation worthy of the great Master Matoya─and to simply witness him in action gave me a better understanding of arcane entities.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_ALPHINAUD_000_044: Should the opportunity present itself, I should very much like to employ this knowledge for the betterment of mankind─create a new variety of Carbuncle, perhaps...
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_MATOYA_000_045: Don't get ahead of yourself, boy. Louisoix's grandson or no, it'll take another decade under me before you can call yourself a scholar, and a deal more than that to make you a scholar worth a damn.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_YSHTOLA_000_046: As you may have gathered, Master Matoya is not easily impressed.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_ALPHINAUD_000_047: ...Indeed. Ahem. So, shall we examine the tome?
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_YSHTOLA_000_048: As expected, the library was rife with dangers, but full glad I am that I could accompany you.
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_YSHTOLA_100_048: Depending on her mood, Master Matoya may well have forced some of us to stay behind to help repair her sentinels. With her, there's simply no telling...
TEXT_HEAVNA611_01660_ALPHINAUD_000_049: Ahem... Despite how it may have sounded, I do not exaggerate when I say it was a tremendous learning experience to observe one of Master Matoya's familiars. The insights I acquired, I shall put to good use.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Thanks to your customarily heroic efforts, we now possess the knowledge to build an aetheric ram.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_ALPHINAUD_000_001: All that remains is to secure its energy source. Let us hasten back to Ishgard and consult Ser Aymeric regarding the Eye.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Ahem... Despite how it may have sounded, I do not exaggerate when I say it was a tremendous learning experience to observe one of Master Matoya's familiars. The insights I acquired, I shall put to good use.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_YSHTOLA_000_004: 'Tis well that you were able to retrieve the tome. Had you failed, Master Matoya planned to have us take dictation while she quoted its contents from memory.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_YSHTOLA_000_002: (As if you could conceal it...from her of all people...) Hm? Pay me no mind. I was but thinking aloud.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Ser Aymeric, I am pleased to see that your recovery proceeds apace. May I introduce Y'shtola, a fellow Scion of the Seventh Dawn and Archon of Sharlayan.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_YSHTOLA_000_012: My lord. Pray excuse me for forgoing due pleasantries, but we seek your counsel regarding the aetheric ram. Though we now possess the knowledge to build such a device, we yet lack an appropriate source of energy with which to power it. We believe, however, that Ishgard may possess the solution to our problem.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_AYMERIC_000_013: You need not apologize, my lady. Full eager am I to learn of your progress. Please, tell me of this energy source that you believe we possess.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_AYMERIC_000_014: ...And you are certain that the Eye can lend its power to Master Matoya's aetheric converger?
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_AYMERIC_000_016: Very well. I shall speak with him.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_AYMERIC_000_018: Nay, my friend, 'tis I who should thank you─as should every Ishgardian. You labor in our name, with nary a care for your own safety.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_ALPHINAUD_000_019: Let us next speak with Cid. He will doubtless be eager to begin work on the aetheric ram.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_AYMERIC_100_019: I shall personally relay your proposal to Estinien. If that which you ask is possible, you may be assured of his cooperation. My thanks again, .
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_LUCIA_101_019: I am glad that you and yours are safe.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_CID_000_020: Ah, you're back! The preliminary work on the Enterprise is more or less finished. Tell me you found a way to build the aetheric ram!
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_YSHTOLA_000_021: Greetings, Cid. It has been a while.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_YSHTOLA_000_022: This tome contains the fruits of my former master's research on a device known as an aetheric converger. Our ram should operate on the selfsame principle.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_CID_000_023:
Ack, where are my manners? Put a toy like this in my hand, and I go off into my own world... Gods, it's good to see you! And bearing a gift besides─a very distracting one, if I might add! If I didn't know better, I'd think it was my nameday.
...But there will be time for tearful reunions later. I'll make a start on the tome right away. So long as I have a grasp of the fundamentals, I should be able to knock something together. Which leaves the small matter of the energy source...
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_ALPHINAUD_000_024: We believe we have found a solution to that problem as well.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_ESTINIEN_000_026: The power of the Eye is not to be drawn upon lightly, but I believe we have sufficient cause to do so.
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_YSHTOLA_000_027: So this is the fabled Eye... By the Twelve...it seethes. 'Tis a wonder such power can be contained, much less controlled...
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_CID_000_028: Boys! Our friends have kindly provided all the ingredients. Let's see if we can't make something out of them!
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_BIGGS_000_029: You heard the chief! We're not resting till the aetheric ram is operational! Not one wink of sleep!
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_WEDGE_000_033: A bit of sleep deprivation won't kill me, I suppose. But if it does...well, then I'll have all the sleep I want, and the joke will be on Biggs!
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_BIGGS_000_034: What do you think? Looks like a different ship, doesn't she?
TEXT_HEAVNA612_01661_NOTRELCHAMPS_000_03: Most folk know Master Garlond as a genius inventor. It's only when you come to work for him that you realize he's a godsdamned tyrant taskmaster. Just, uh...don't tell him I said that, all right?
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Given the danger of the task that lies before us, I think it only right that we take a moment to bid our friends and allies farewell.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Alas, Cid requires my assistance with Master Matoya's rather singular writings. Might I entrust the task of visiting those who will remain behind to you?
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Before we depart for Azys Lla, it is only meet that we bid farewell to those who will remain behind. I should be obliged if you would attend to this, while I assist Cid.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_YSHTOLA_000_003: I know naught of the archbishop and his knights save that which you have told me─but if they truly possess the power of primals and the secrets of Azys Lla, they are dangerous foes indeed. We must spare no preparation.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_AYMERIC_000_005: It goes without saying that the Temple Knights will bear the costs for all work on the Enterprise. Would that we could contribute more to the cause.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_ESTINIEN_000_006: Azure wings to bear us to the final battle... I must admit there is poetry to it.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_NOTRELCHAMPS_000_00: Most folk know Master Garlond as a genius inventor. It's only when you come to work for him that you realize he's a godsdamned tyrant taskmaster. Just, uh...don't tell him I said that, all right?
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_AYMERIC_000_011: Would that I could join you in the coming battle, but with my wounds, I fear I would only be a burden to you.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_AYMERIC_000_012: In consorting with the Ascians and availing himself of primal powers, my father made himself an enemy of all that is good and right in the world.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_AYMERIC_000_013: Do whatever you must to end his madness. May the Fury watch over you.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_AYMERIC_000_014: Do whatever you must to end my father's madness. May the Fury watch over you.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_LUCIA_000_030: This is it, then? Go well, my friend. I shall pray to the Fury for your preservation.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_LUCIA_000_031: ...Hm? Mayhap you think it strange that a daughter of Garlemald should pray? I do not blame you─I used to think it passing strange myself.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_LUCIA_000_032: But that all changed when I discovered something dearer to me than mine own life. Thereafter, praying seemed the most natural thing in the world.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_LUCIA_000_033: Prayers are born of heartfelt faith. In manipulating the people's beliefs for his own twisted ends, the archbishop makes a mockery of their very existence. It cannot be borne.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_LUCIA_000_034: Go well, my friend. May the Fury bless you and keep you.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_TATARU_000_040: So you're off to face the archbishop, then... Please be careful. And...watch over the others, will you?
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_TATARU_000_041: We've lost too many friends as it is. Some may yet return to us, but I couldn't bear to lose anyone else. I just couldn't.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_TATARU_000_042: I realize it's asking a lot, but you're the strongest person I know, and I don't think there's anything you can't achieve if you put your mind to it.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_TATARU_000_043: So please, whatever else happens, keep everyone safe!
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_TATARU_000_044: You're the strongest person I know, . If anyone can do this, you can. Just make sure everyone comes back in one piece, all right!?
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_HILDA_000_050: Well, if it ain't my old friend . Off to face the archbishop and his cronies, is it?
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_HILDA_000_051: I'd love to go and give those bastards a good wallopin' myself─that snake Charibert, especially─but I've got to stay here and keep an eye on things.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_HILDA_000_052: With the archbishop gone, some of the poor folk might get it in their heads to do somethin' stupid like stormin' the Pillars. But blood won't get us what we want, and I need to be around to remind 'em of that in case they forget.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_HILDA_000_053: No need to worry about us, anyway. I'll work with Ser Aymeric to preserve the peace. You just concentrate on settlin' the score with the archbishop, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_HILDA_000_054: No need to worry about us. I'll work with Ser Aymeric to preserve the peace. You just concentrate on settlin' the score with the archbishop, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_SYMME_100_054: We'll keep the city in one piece, don't you worry!
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_EUDESTAND_101_054: We won't get up to no mischief while you're gone. Not too much, anyway!
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_EDMONT_000_020: , how good of you to pay me a visit.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_EDMONT_000_021: It feels as if it were only yesterday when first we met here in this chamber. You came to us a fugitive seeking asylum...and now you bear the hopes of our nation upon your shoulders.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_EDMONT_000_022: He would not have told you, but when Haurchefant begged me to accept you into our household, he described you as “hope incarnate.” At the time, I assumed that he was waxing lyrical, as was his wont. But I have come to see that he simply spoke the truth.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_EDMONT_000_023: You are hope─a shining beacon that shall guide the people of Ishgard through the raging snowstorm.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_EDMONT_101_023: ...A memento. Were my son here, he would have wished to fight at your side in the battle to come. Take care, my friend, and return to us!
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_EDMONT_000_024: When Haurchefant asked me to accept you into our household, he described you as “hope incarnate.” At the time, I assumed that he was waxing lyrical, as was his wont. But I have come to see that he simply spoke the truth.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_EDMONT_000_025: You are hope─a shining beacon that shall guide the people of Ishgard through the raging snowstorm. Take care, my friend, and come back to us!
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_ALPHINAUD_000_060: ...Count Edmont bequeathed to you Lord Haurchefant's shield? A noble gesture.
TEXT_HEAVNA613_01662_ALPHINAUD_000_061: We bear the hopes and dreams of full many souls. Let their faith in us be a source of strength and courage as we face our remaining trials.
