TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Work on the Enterprise is nearly complete. Let Y'shtola know to make ready.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Work on the Enterprise is nearly complete. Let Y'shtola know to make ready.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_AYMERIC_000_004: Do whatever you must to end my father's madness. May the Fury watch over you, my friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_NOTRELCHAMPS_000_00: Most folk know Master Garlond as a genius inventor. It's only when you come to work for him that you realize he's a godsdamned tyrant taskmaster. Just, uh...don't tell him I said that, all right?
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_YSHTOLA_000_006: I know naught of the archbishop and his knights save that which you have told me─but if they truly possess the power of primals and the secrets of Azys Lla, they are dangerous foes indeed. We must spare no preparation.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ESTINIEN_000_007: Azure wings to bear us to the final battle... I must admit there is poetry to it.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_URIANGER_000_010: That which man thinketh a trifle in the having, he mourneth as a treasure in the losing. A tired platitude, but one which shall haunt me unto my dying day.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_URIANGER_101_010: That which man thinketh a trifle in the having, he mourneth as a treasure in the losing. A tired platitude, but one which shall haunt me unto my dying day.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ESTINIEN_000_0011: The revelations of recent days may have overturned the foundations of my faith, but my purpose remains unchanged: ending this damnable war.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ALPHINAUD_100_020: Let us go, ! Azys Lla awaits!
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_CID_000_0020: Whew... I don't know about you, but I'm glad to be back on solid ground─even if said ground is floating in the sky.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_CID_000_0021: When that imperial battleship appeared, I honestly thought we were finished. And we would have been, had your friend not arrived when she did.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ALPHINAUD_000_0022:
Twelve grant her mercy...
Brief though our time together was, Ysayle was a true friend─a gentle soul who fought for her beliefs. She...she would have made a fine Scion.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_YSHTOLA_000_0023: What is a Scion but one who fights for our cause? Our hopes survive thanks to her sacrifice. Let that be enough.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_YSHTOLA_000_0024: Yet I cannot help but wonder: how came she to know of our presence here?
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ESTINIEN_000_0025: From Hraesvelgr, I would wager. He will have felt my channeling of the Eye's power.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ESTINIEN_000_0026: It would seem they were able to make peace with one another in the end.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_CID_000_0027: She gave her life because she believed in us. We owe it to her to see our mission through.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_CID_100_0027: See that dome-like structure further in? Let's make our way there.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ALPHINAUD_000_0028: Ysayle... I cannot believe she is gone...
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_YSHTOLA_000_0029: The Echo is a gift and a burden both...as you know only too well.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ESTINIEN_000_030: Though we walked opposing paths, Iceheart was a worthy woman. Her deeds will not soon be forgotten.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_BIGGS_000_031: Taking on an imperial battleship by herself... Primal or no, that took some courage.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_WEDGE_000_032: I-I wasn't afraid! N-Not in the least! ...Pardon? What smell? <sniff> ...Oh gods, someone's spilled something down my trousers!
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_CID_000_040: The isle's sentinels don't seem to frequent this area. We should be safe here.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_WEDGE_000_051: Crikey... This place is like something out of my dreams...
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_ALPHINAUD_000_0052: Cid is right. We owe it to Ysayle to see the mission through.
TEXT_HEAVNA701_01663_YSHTOLA_000_0054: Heavy though our hearts may be, we must forge on─in the name of those we have lost.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_000: First of all, in the interests of efficiency, I suggest we make this place our base camp. We can coordinate the search for the archbishop from here.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ALPHINAUD_000_001: I have no objections. Now that we stand upon Azys Lla, I am struck by the vastness of the isle. We must needs be methodical if we are to find our quarry.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_002: Good. Now, unless I'm mistaken, this used to be an airship landing, and a major one at that. From what I know of Allagan design, there should be a terminal nearby that's linked to the isle's operational heart.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_003: If we can find such a terminal, we should be able to learn something of the archbishop's whereabouts. Let's split up and look for it.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_004: This terminal has long since ceased to function. Search for another.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_WEDGE_000_006: Crikey... This place is like something out of my dreams...
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ALPHINAUD_000_007: Cid is right. We owe it to Ysayle to see the mission through.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_YSHTOLA_000_009: Heavy though our hearts may be, we must forge on─in the name of those we have lost.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I daresay this landing could accommodate even a Ragnarok-class vessel... Remarkable.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ALPHINAUD_000_011: What ungodly vessels must the Allagans have built to warrant so vast a landing?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ALPHINAUD_000_012: To think that such a massive structure has been floating above our heads for all these millennia... It beggars belief...
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_BIGGS_000_020: The Empire borrowed most of its technology from Allagan relics. If we can find the terminal, I reckon we can operate it.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_BIGGS_000_021: This place is an engineer's playground. If I had the time, I'd be going over it with a bleedin' magnifying glass.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ESTINIEN_000_030: Machines are beyond my ken─I shall leave it to the others to find this “terminal.” Of more concern to me are the dragons that I sense nearby.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ESTINIEN_000_031: This ominous presence... To whom does it belong?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_YSHTOLA_000_032: Alas, I have found naught of use.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_040: ...Nothing? Damn it. There's just this terminal, then, but it doesn't respond to anything I do. Any bright ideas, Wedge?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_041: ...Wedge? He was here just a moment ago. Oh, don't tell me he's wandered off...
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_042: I'm sorry, , but could you help me search for him? Absent-minded as he is, I worry that he's strayed beyond the landing area, and made friends with the local sentinels.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_043: I need you to help me search for Wedge. Absent-minded as he is, I worry that he's strayed beyond the landing area, and made friends with the local sentinels.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_WEDGE_000_052: I-I'm fine, Chief. I just tripped, that's all.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_053: Fool of a Lalafell! What were you thinking, coming here on your own!? Death by overwork is one thing─death by stupidity quite another!
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_WEDGE_000_054: I'm sorry, Chief... B-But I think I've found something!
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_055: What is this? The wreck of a sentinel?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_WEDGE_000_056: This is no wreck, Chief! She's still operational!
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_:
<blip> Initiating...
Performing diagnostics...

TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_WEDGE_000_060: I'm Wedge, and that there is !
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: <blip> User registration complete. Welcome to Azys Lla, Master Wedge and  . I am Guidance Node G-LI.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_070: Hm. This isn't quite what I had in mind, but it might just serve.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_071: Wedge, bring the node this way, would you? There's something I'd like to try.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_072: Node! I need a status report on the facility!
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_WEDGE_000_073: Gilly! You have to do what the chief says!
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_075: Ah, here we are... Hmmm, not much of note. It appears someone recently reactivated “Helix,” which is this area.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_077: By the archbishop, I'd wager. I daresay he woke the place up when he used the Vanu's key.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_078: Are there any other people in the facility? If so, where?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_079: Let's see here... On the “Flagship”─that's the central isle─I'm seeing positive readings within the Aetherochemical Research Facility and the Fractal Continuum...
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_080: And what have we here? Intruders detected in the Gamma Quadrant, defense system engaged.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_YSHTOLA_000_081: Our imperial friends, I suspect. I hope they enjoy the defense system. But what of the archbishop and his cronies?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_082: Hmmm, what might offer an indication? ...Ah! How about this: which area is currently consuming the most energy?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_083: ...Somewhere called “Triad Control,” inside the research facility.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ALPHINAUD_000_084: And what manner of place is that?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_085: It is, and I quote, “a regulation facility for the 'Warring Triad' test subjects.” And that's all it says. The rest of the information is only accessible to users with consular privileges.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_YSHTOLA_000_086: I mislike the sound of this...which leads me to believe that it is indeed the place.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ALPHINAUD_000_087: I am inclined to agree with Y'shtola. Whatever it is that the archbishop seeks, it is like to be there.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_CID_000_088: That settles it, then. Let's find a way to cross over to the Flagship.
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_BIGGS_000_089: That fool of a Lalafell, always making us worry... And he's already gone and named the node! Can you believe it?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_WEDGE_000_090: I'm sorry... I promise to be more careful from now on...
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: <blip> Greetings,  . Is there something you wish to know?
TEXT_HEAVNA702_01664_ALPHINAUD_100_092: This device serves as an aetheryte, yet it is not made of crystal. To think that the Allagans could emulate the properties of so fundamental a substance...
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: <blip> Greetings,  . Is there something you wish to know?
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_A1_000_001: Tell me how to reach the Flagship.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_A1_000_002: Tell me how to reach the Aetherochemical Research Facility.

TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ALPHINAUD_000_004: The Warring Triad... I somehow doubt they are amenable to negotiation.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ESTINIEN_000_005: What in the Fury's name is that thing?
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_YSHTOLA_000_006: The Warring Triad puts me in mind of a tale from my childhood. It told of three gods locked in perpetual conflict.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_CID_000_007: Well, this node turned out to be rather more useful than I expected!
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_BIGGS_000_008: A few years back, Wedge decided he wanted a dog. And when we said no, he sulked for a bleedin' month.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_WEDGE_000_009: Gilly's a good girl! Isn't she a good girl?
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Can the guidance node be trusted? I know not, but we have few other options. Let us see where it leads us.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ALPHINAUD_000_011: , Y'shtola, Estinien─we four shall proceed to the research facility.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Cid, the Excelsior is our sole means of escape. Pray remain here and have her ready to depart at a moment's notice.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_CID_000_013: Understood. We'll see that she's repaired and ready to fly. If anything happens, just let me know via linkpearl.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Be on your guard, my friends─the enemy could be anywhere.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_BIGGS_000_015: First Maggie, and now Gilly... Maybe we should have let him have that dog...
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_WEDGE_000_016: Promise me you'll take good care of Gilly! Don't let any harm come to her!
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_CID_000_017: Should you need to return to Ishgard for supplies, you can use that standard to signal for an Ironworks airship, just as before.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_CID_000_018: When your business below is done, let our man at the airship landing know, and he'll ferry you back here to resume the mission.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ESTINIEN_000_019: So we are to follow that...thing? ...I shall leave it to you to deal with it.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_YSHTOLA_100_019: Though we know little of the node, we know still less of the facility at large. Let us see where it leads us.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: <blip> You are currently within the Alpha Quadrant.
First, you must use the nearby matter conduit to travel to the Beta Quadrant. Please wait a moment while I activate it.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ALPHINAUD_000_023: If I am not mistaken, this is some manner of teleportation device.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ESTINIEN_000_024: We have scarce begun, and already it leads us to a dead end.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_YSHTOLA_000_025: Mayhap the node has further instructions for us.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: Conduit activated. You may travel to the Beta Quadrant at your leisure.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ALPHINAUD_100_023: If I am not mistaken, this is some manner of teleportation device.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ESTINIEN_100_024: We have scarce begun, and already it leads us to a dead end.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_YSHTOLA_100_025: Mayhap the node has further instructions for us.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: According to my records, this conduit was last serviced approximately five thousand and fourteen years, six months, eleven days, seven hours and thirteen minutes ago.
That it should function without mishap may be described as a miracle.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ESTINIEN_000_032: Are you certain it is wise to trust this orb with our lives?
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_YSHTOLA_000_033: That node is not what it seems. From amidst the metal, I sense the gaze of a living being. Have care around it.
TEXT_HEAVNA703_01665_ALPHINAUD_000_034: The matter conduit appears to operate on the same principle as the aetherytes. How remarkable that it should still function after all this time...
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: <blip> Resuming guidance to the Aetherochemical Research Facility. Please follow me.
This sector, the Beta Quadrant, is home to laboratories which produce chimerical life-forms for both military and household applications.
Our facility has been awarded three-star certification for compliance with ASO-3001. The good behavior of the creatures born here is guaranteed.
Please be warned, however, that millennia of neglect may have had an adverse effect on their disposition. For your own safety, please refrain from approaching the creatures.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ESTINIEN_000_004: Are you certain it is wise to trust our lives to this orb?
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_YSHTOLA_000_005: That node is not what it seems. From amidst the metal, I sense the gaze of a living being. Have care around it.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ALPHINAUD_000_006: The matter conduit appears to operate on the same principle as aetherytes. It certainly has stood the test of time.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_:
<blip> Unable to activate matter conduit. Energy shortage detected.
Identifying cause...

Cause identified: unauthorized siphoning of energy by chimerical creatures.
Locations: the Recombination Labs and the Biomass Incubation Complex.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Time is short─let us split up and eliminate the culprits. , pray dispatch the creatures at the Recombination Labs.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ALPHINAUD_100_012: The rest of us shall sweep the Incubation Complex. Take care, and return hither when you are done.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ESTINIEN_000_013: The orb is beginning to try my patience.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_YSHTOLA_000_014: The Allagans did not respect life. Brilliant as they were, I cannot bring myself to respect them.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ALPHINAUD_000_015: The area teems with chimerical creatures. Be on your guard.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ESTINIEN_000_016: I welcome the chance to limber up ahead of the battle to come.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_YSHTOLA_000_017: What has gotten into Alphinaud all of a sudden?
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_:

<blip> Energy restored to the conduit. Please wait a moment while I activate it.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ESTINIEN_000_041: Machines are not to be trusted, least of all those that can think.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_YSHTOLA_000_042: Alphinaud has come far. Master Louisoix would be proud.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ALPHINAUD_000_043: While facing the chimerical creatures, I had a moment of inspiration. I feel I have attained a better affinity with arcane entities.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_GUIDANCESYSTEM_100_: Conduit activated. You may travel to the Gamma Quadrant at your leisure.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ALPHINAUD_100_051: While facing the chimerical creatures, I had a moment of inspiration. I feel I have attained a better affinity with arcane entities.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ESTINIEN_100_052: Machines are not to be trusted, least of all those that can think.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_YSHTOLA_100_053: The next quadrant awaits. Let us make haste.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ALPHINAUD_000_051: So the Garleans managed to land... Repairs on their vessel appear to be well underway.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_YSHTOLA_000_052: I doubt that they will leave any time soon, however. Nay, they will remain here long after they have stripped the isle of all its secrets.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_ESTINIEN_000_053: Whether or not they mean to linger, their presence here and now is an unwelcome complication.
TEXT_HEAVNA704_01666_YSHTOLA_000_054: Indeed. Let us avoid confrontations unless absolutely needful.
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: Warning: intruders detected in force in this quadrant. It is recommended that you avoid confrontation where possible.
Be kindly reminded that, in accordance with the terms and conditions of use, you and your party assume all risks of damages or injury, including death, that you may sustain in the course of guidance.
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_GUIDANCESYSTEM_100_: Please follow me to the next matter conduit. It leads to the Delta Quadrant, where the facility's greatest achievement is located.
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_YSHTOLA_000_005: These soldiers bear the sigil of the VIth Legion, ordinarily deployed within Ilsabard. They are certainly a long way from home.
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_ALPHINAUD_000_006: The VIth Legion has long been the favored of Emperor Varis. It is the iron fist with which he crushes uprisings.
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: <blip> That you have survived to this point is in defiance of possibility. But it appears the danger is not yet past.
<blip> <bloop> WARNING! Intruders approaching. Please eliminate them if you wish to proceed.
<blip> Welcome to the Delta Quadrant, where methods are developed for mastering dragons.
To this day, the sector is home to live specimens brought over from the southern continent of Meracydia. Truly a testament to the greatness of the Allagan Empire.
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_QIB_BATTLETALK_BOSS: Surely you can do better than that.
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_QIB_BATTLETALK_ZAKO: Let us aid you, Lord van Hydrus!
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_QIB_BATTLETALK_ESTI: Hmph, naught but toy soldiers to knock down.
TEXT_HEAVNA705_01667_QIB_YBATTLETALK_SHT: Leave the rank and file to us! Focus on the legatus!
TEXT_HEAVNA706_01668_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: <blip> I regret to inform you that the matter conduit leading to the Flagship is no longer functioning.

According to my records, it was destroyed by a dragon, which broke free of its restraints when they failed approximately two thousand three hundred and sixty-nine years, one month, twenty-four days, seven hours and four minutes ago.
Please find an alternate route to the Aetherochemical Research Facility. The Allagan Research Council apologizes for any inconvenience caused.
TEXT_HEAVNA706_01668_MIDGARDSORMR_000_00: So, thy journey hath led thee to this accursed place. Canst thou hear it, mortal? The ceaseless keening of my kindred, steeped in five thousand years of suffering...
Long before the Ishgardians and their base betrayal, there lived still more wicked men whose ambitions knew no bounds.
Fearful of our might and covetous of our power, they devised a means to enslave dragonkind... Their vile misdeeds did set in motion a train of events whose repercussions are felt to this day.
Beyond, thou wilt find one of my first brood. Hark thou unto her words. Partake thou of her pain. Think thou upon the suffering that the conflict betwixt our kinds hath begot.
TEXT_HEAVNA706_01668_SYSTEM_100_010: A great wyrm is being held in some manner of restraint.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_GUIDANCESYSTEM_000_: <blip> Welcome to the Flagship,  . You are almost at your destination.
<blip> <bloop> WARNING! Intruders detected in the vicinity. Please eliminate them if you wish to proceed.
<blip> Area secured. Lifting access restriction to the Aetherochemical Research Facility...
Restriction lifted. You may enter the facility at your leisure. Ending guidance.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_GUIDANCESYSTEM_100_: <blip> Unknown energy source detected within the Aetherochemical Research Facility. Please exercise caution.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_GUIDANCESYSTEM_101_: I am pleased to have been of service to you,  . Please send my regards to Master Wedge.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_SYSTEM_000_012: The guidance node has ceased to function.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ALPHINAUD_000_020: After long years of estrangement, Ishgard rejoins her sister nations in the Alliance. Words cannot well express my joy.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ALPHINAUD_000_021: None of this would have been possible without you, my friend.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Change is coming to Eorzea. Though it will inevitably bring with it a measure of upheaval, with hard work, peace and prosperity are sure to follow.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ALPHINAUD_100_022: And yet, even as we look forward to the coming of a new age, we must needs be wary of old threats.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ALPHINAUD_101_022: The lords of Garlemald have not relinquished their claim upon Eorzea, and we shall be forced to contend with them again ere long. And then there is the matter of our comrade Estinien, claimed body and soul by Nidhogg... If there is a way to rescue him, we must find it.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ALPHINAUD_102_022: Suffice it to say, the path ahead holds no shortage of challenges, but together, we shall overcome them.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_TATARUL_000_032: If the Eorzean Alliance can be restored to its former glory, so can the Scions of the Seventh Dawn! Let's find our lost friends and begin anew!
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_BUTLER01580_200_000: When first I bade you welcome before the Arc of the Worthy, little did I imagine that you would go on to steer the very course of our nation. I am proud to have borne witness to history in the making.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_LUCIA_200_000: You are a true hero, my friend. The minstrels shall sing of your deeds for generations to come.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_LUCIA_200_001: The road to reform will be long and trying, but Ser Aymeric will not rest until he reaches its end. And I shall walk with him every step of the way.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_HILDA_200_000: You know, seein' you flyin' in on dragonback helped put things in perspective. I mean, if man and dragon can put aside their differences, how hard can it be for the rest of us?
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_HILDA_200_001: To be sure, our lives won't change overnight, and it'll take effort to bridge the gulf between highborn and lowborn, but I'm confident it'll all work out in the end.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ELAISSE_200_000: Ishgard's return to the Eorzean Alliance has breathed new life into the Jeweled Crozier. The announcement had scarce been made when the merchants began eyeing opportunities in foreign markets.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_GIBRILLONT_200_000: Shame Mistress Tataru had to move on. We've grown rather accustomed to having her around.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ARTOIREL_200_000: I confess, I found the ceremony unexpectedly stirring... Each of us must play our part in building a brighter future for Ishgard─we who profess to rule most of all.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_EMMANELLAIN_200_000: There you are, old ! We must go to the tavern together, and soon! My friends all demand to be introduced to the Warrior of Light, and they refuse to take no for an answer!
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_HONOROIT_200_000: Pray pay no heed to Lord Emmanellain,  . I am certain you have far more pressing demands on your time. And for his part, my lord has lessons to attend...
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_HONOROIT_200_001: He has resumed training in the blade, you see, and has shown admirable dedication...for the most part. I believe he has a mind to take up Lord Haurchefant's mantle─but if he is to succeed in this, he will need all the help he can get, and as few distractions as possible.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_VIDOFNIR_200_000: Thou art welcome here, friend of Ysayle. I have heard all that hath come to pass.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_VIDOFNIR_200_001: Ysayle was as a brood-sister to me, and her death no less tragic for man's fleeting life. I shall miss her...
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_MATOYA_200_000: I don't care much for politics. Too much talk and not enough action.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_MATOYA_200_001: If I were you, I'd forget about all that racket and have some time to myself. Even you must see you've earned it.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_EDMONT_000_023: During the ceremony, I felt Haurchefant's presence. He was watching us from on high, with pride in his eyes and that customary smile on his lips...
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_AYMERIC_000_024: Allow me to thank you, ─not as the lord commander of the Temple Knights, but as a humble citizen of Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_AYMERIC_000_025: Though you came to us an outsider, you risked all to bring us this chance for change. And we will not squander it, I swear to you. We will rise above the ashes of our dark past and rebuild our nation upon a foundation of truth and equality.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_LUCIA_000_026: You are a true hero, my friend. The minstrels shall sing of your deeds for generations to come.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_HILDA_000_027: Seein' you flyin' in on dragonback helped put things in perspective. If man and dragon can be friends, how hard can it be for us to get along with each other?
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_HILDA_000_028: To be sure, it'll take time and effort to bridge the gulf between highborn and lowborn, but I'm confident it'll all work out in the end.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_EMMANELLAIN_000_029: You are the talk of the Holy See, my friend! And by association, I like to think that I am too!
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ARTOIREL_000_030: Though Haurchefant is gone, his spirit lives on within us all.
TEXT_HEAVNA707_01669_ARTOIREL_000_031: For my part, I shall strive to be a knight worthy of the name. Pray watch over me, brother!
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Frustrating though it may be, we must press on. While I continue speaking with the people of the Brume, why not go and see if Gibrillont knows aught of value?
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_ALPHINAUD_000_001: As the proprietor of the Forgotten Knight, surely he must have heard whispers of the Mongrel before. We can only hope that he will be more forthcoming than the others.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_TATARU_000_003: If you haven't yet, you should learn the Manderville art of parley. It's surprisingly effective─so long as you stick to topics you know well. For example, the other day I was discussing the copper ore market with this one gentleman...
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_ALPHINAUD_000_002: I shall join you in the Forgotten Knight anon. There we can discuss our findings.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_010: You know, people long for a sympathetic ear, but they need to know that it comes with tight lips.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_011: Discretion, ─that's what my customers expect. If they don't get it, then I don't get them.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_012: That being said, I'm not without my sympathies. I've heard the tales, and I know you've done right by highborn and lowborn alike.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_013: Least I can do is point you in the right direction. But to do that, I'll need you to do something for me.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_014: So happens there's a hunter up in the Crozier who owes me a fair bit of coin. However, I've agreed to accept payment in fresh herbs. Go and get them for me. Agreed?
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_015: Tell the hunter I sent you, and he should hand over the herbs without a fuss.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_016: Come back here as soon as you have them. Simple as that.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_HUNTER01993_000_020: So you're Gibrillont's errand ? Good, good! How's he doing? Same as always? Right, right...
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_HUNTER01993_000_021: Anyroad, I hope he appreciates how much trouble I had to go through on account of his bloody herbs. Tell him to enjoy them while they last, because I doubt I'll be able to find any more next year.
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_030: <sniff> <sniff> Well? You going to hand them over or not?
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_031: Aye, this ought to do it. With a few other spices, I can make it just like she used to...
TEXT_HEAVNA406_01993_GIBRILLONT_000_032: There are few things which stir the hearts of men like a sip of mulled wine. Share a glass with the right people, and who knows what stories they'll share?
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_GIBRILLONT_000_000: Now that I think on it, there's a woman I know who's rather fond of this blend. Hierytha is her name, and she resides in the Pillars.
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_GIBRILLONT_000_001: She's a maidservant to some noble house or another, I forget. Anyway, be a shame if she didn't get to try this wine. Why not give her a bottle?
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_GIBRILLONT_000_002: Wonder what it's like being waited on by scores and scores of servants...
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_GIBRILLONT_000_003: After a time, the faces must start to blur together. But the servants, they remember. How can they not?
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_HIERYTHA_000_010: Y-Yes, I am Hierytha. Beg your pardon, but do I know you, ?
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_HIERYTHA_000_011: I...I know this smell! This is the wine that girl used to prepare! Her special recipe! It must be decades since I last tasted this.
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_HIERYTHA_000_012: Oh, the poor dear... Such a shame that she was taken in by that baron.
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_HIERYTHA_000_013: He cut a dashing figure, I'll grant you that. Tall, slender, long of ear... <sigh> But those dazzling ruby eyes of his were filled with lust. 'Twas naught more than infatuation, what she felt, but she convinced herself it was love...and he couldn't help but take advantage.
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_HIERYTHA_000_014: But when her belly started to grow, gods, the scandal! I mean, 'tis not an uncommon occurrence, but that it was with a Hyur made it so much, well...I needn't tell you. She was discharged from his service─cast out onto the streets, like so much refuse.
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_HIERYTHA_000_015: After she returned to the Brume, we drifted apart. I only learned of her death years later by chance...
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_HIERYTHA_000_017: Gods, it feels like a lifetime ago...
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_GIBRILLONT_000_020: So the amorous nobleman beds his maidservant, then casts her aside when the seed takes root.
TEXT_HEAVNA407_01994_GIBRILLONT_000_021: Not the most original tale, is it? Cold comfort for the women and children who live it, though.
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GIBRILLONT_000_000: Even the penitent can appreciate wine from time to time. Take Gerraldieux, for example. Surely you've heard of him. No?
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GIBRILLONT_000_001: He's a monk who offers succor to the poorest of the poor in the Brume. A man of many vows, but none which prohibit spirituous beverages. Aye, if ever there was a man who deserved a drink, it'd be him.
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GIBRILLONT_000_002: There's no shortage of suffering in this world, is there? Yet all too often, men of means are happy to turn a blind eye.
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GIBRILLONT_000_003: “Why should I care? It's not my story,” they say. But they're wrong. They're a part of it, same as we all are.
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GERRALDIEUX_000_010: Halone's blessings be upon you, . I─ A gift? For me?
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GERRALDIEUX_000_011: This scent...how reminiscent of a wine once made by a dear old friend, may her soul rest in peace...
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GERRALDIEUX_000_012: Forsaken by her family, she toiled tirelessly to feed and clothe her child. Yet somehow she found time to help me tend to those in even worse circumstances, so compassionate she was, so full of love for her fellow man.
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GERRALDIEUX_000_013: 'Twas that love which gave her child strength to endure the scorn of the other younglings... <sigh> That little girl, bless her heart, she couldn't help what she was. Eventually, she won them over, but those first few years were trying─even more so when she had to start fending for herself.
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GERRALDIEUX_000_014: I remember days she spent standing on the walls─raven black hair flowing in the wind, staring out, as if searching for her mother's face in the mists...
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GERRALDIEUX_000_015: I shall raise a glass to their memories tonight.
TEXT_HEAVNA408_01995_GIBRILLONT_000_021: After everything she was forced to endure, she still remained hopeful for the future. For her daughter's future...
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_GIBRILLONT_000_000: Some bonds are thicker than blood...but blood still defines us─and divides us in the end.
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_GIBRILLONT_000_001: It's the legacy of our parents, , and we can't escape it, no matter how hard we try.
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_GIBRILLONT_000_002: So the Mongrel and her pups chose to embrace theirs─to proclaim it to all and sundry.
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_GIBRILLONT_000_003: If you can understand that, then maybe you can find her on your own.
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_THEPOORA01996_000_0: Still looking for your mongrel? Like I said before, take your pick. Plenty around, if you know where to look. Or did you fancy someone specific?
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_A1_000_001: I'm looking for a mongrel with ruby red eyes and raven black hair.
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_A1_000_002: I'm looking for a mongrel with raven black eyes and ruby red hair.
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_THEPOORA01996_000_0: Ho, someone's got unusual tastes. Afraid I can't help you, though.
Won't, rather. It's bloody obvious you ain't of the Brume. Did you think I'd just tell you 'cause you asked nicely?
What, coeurl got your tongue? Off you trot, then.
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Hmm... So our mongrel was born of an Elezen nobleman and a Hyuran maidservant.
TEXT_HEAVNA409_01996_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Granted, it is no location, but it is far more information than we had before. Yes...now that her striking features are known to us, mayhap we need only remain vigilant.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Fortuitous timing as always, . Tataru was about to brief me on the search for our missing comrades.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_002: If you would be so kind, then?
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_003: Absolutely! You'll be pleased to hear that Riol and his men have been making excellent progress!
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_004: You remember how F'lhaminn helped me to escape the Crystal Braves in Limsa Lominsa, only to then disappear? Well, according to Riol, she crept aboard a ship bound for Radz-at-Han, where she's been hiding ever since. He assures me that it won't be long before we're reunited.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_005: As for Yda and Papalymo, the remains of their linkpearls have been found─and in Pearl Lane of all places. Riol thinks they must have disposed of them after escaping from the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_006: Yes, that would make sense... They could not risk being eavesdropped upon by our betrayers.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_007: We're all but certain they fled the city shortly after...though we still don't have a clue where they went.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_008: I see. And what of Thancred and Minfilia?
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_009: ...I'm afraid I have nothing new to share about those two. But it's not all doom and gloom! The good news is, we've enlisted the services of a Sharlayan scholar─one of the Students of Baldesion─to aid in the search, who should be arriving any day now!
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_010: One of the Students, you say? I should very much like to meet this scholar─if time permits.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_011: But first we must attend to a more pressing matter. Ser Aymeric has summoned the two of us for a private audience. The messenger did not specify what he wished to discuss─only that it was urgent.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Assuming you have no objections, , I suggest we proceed to the Congregation forthwith.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_013: And mayhap we can meet with the scholar afterwards. Agreed?
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_014: In that case, I think I'll return to the Forgotten Knight for now. Things are liable to fall apart if I'm gone too long, you know!
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_020: Don't worry about our visitor. Y'shtola and I will treat her to a warm welcome!
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Good invariably triumphs over evil in faerie tales, yet they are conspicuously reticent about what follows...
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TEMPLEKIGHTGATE_000: The lord commander is within. Pray proceed, .
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_SCENE00010_EVENTARE: Proceed to the Seat of the Lord Commander?
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_031: The journey, at least, should pose little difficulty this time.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_032: Be with you in a moment, !
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_LUCIA_000_040: I know little of the lands these dragons call home─this Anyx Trine. Had you not agreed to escort me, the coming journey would seem a far more daunting prospect.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_041:
I confess, I myself once shuddered at the thought of it. Yet even the longest journey begins with the first step, does it not?
Ah, but ere we set forth,  and I must needs inform our comrade of our plans.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_LUCIA_000_042: Very well. I shall see to my preparations.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Then let us go and bid farewell to Tataru, .
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_HANDELOUP_000_045: The first commander─and you─have been entrusted with a mission of grave import. For Ishgard's sake, it must not fail.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_HILDA_000_046: Heard about the watch from the lord commander, did you? Aye, it's true. Feels queer to be operatin' so openly, but I couldn't say no after he batted them eyelashes of his.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_SYMME_000_047: Hah, would you look at us! Honest-to-gods watchmen! Hey, how's this sound? “You there─move along!” Not bad, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_EUDESTAND_000_048: You can hardly call us a proper watch when we ain't got no uniforms or trainin'. That'll all come with time, though, I hope.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Hm? I thought you might want to tell her. Or would you rather I did all the talking...?
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_LUCIA_000_055: Traversing the western highlands calls for warmer clothing. Yet there are only so many layers one can fit under plate armor...
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_060: So? What was your secret meeting all about? I'm all ears!
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_061: A diplomatic mission to Anyx Trine, you say? Well, I suppose that does take precedence...
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_062: But should your meeting with Vidofnir happen to end early, you might consider rendezvousing with Y'shtola in Idyllshire. She'll be there to receive our guest.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_063: Don't get me wrong, your meeting with the dragons is terribly important and everything, but this scholar just happens to be─
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_064: Time permitting, as I said. We shall endeavor to join Y'shtola, but if we cannot, pray pass on our regards.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Let us be off, . We have kept the first commander waiting long enough.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_TATARU_000_070: <sigh> Well, let no one say I didn't try!
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_ALPHINAUD_000_075: One task at a time, . Besides, I have no doubt that Y'shtola can look after the scholar by herself.
TEXT_HEAVNB101_02156_LUCIA_000_080: You are ready, then? Good─so am I.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_001: If you and Master Alphinaud would be so kind as to lead the way...
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_010: The path is long but known to us. From Falcon's Nest, we shall cross the western highlands and make for Tailfeather in the Dravanian forelands.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_011: There we can stop to rest and replenish our supplies. Questions? If not, then the stables await.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Strange... This is only my third visit to Tailfeather, yet the first feels as though it were a lifetime ago.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_030: I always imagined that the first time I set foot upon Dravanian soil would be at the head of an army. And here I am, ready to treat with the brothers and sisters of mine enemies.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Full well do I know how difficult it can be to set aside the past. Though it was I who first proposed recruiting Ysayle to our cause, I questioned the wisdom of my words almost as soon as I had uttered them...and for a long time after that.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Here was a woman with the blood of innocents on her hands. Men, women, children─all slain in the name of the implacable Lady Iceheart.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Yet she acknowledged her misdeeds and agreed to join us in common cause. At our side, she fought in service to that greater good...even unto her dying breath─and while that does not absolve her of her sins, I...I hope that one day she will be remembered not merely as a heretic, but as a misguided soul who dreamt of peace.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_034: ...You ask much, Master Alphinaud. Yet who can say what might come to pass...should our negotiations bear fruit.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Yes─yes, of course. We must press on to Anyx Trine. If you will follow me...
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_VIDOFNIR_000_040: Thou art ever welcome here, friend of Ysayle.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_VIDOFNIR_000_041: But this one I do not know.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Pray forgive us this unannounced visit, Vidofnir. May I present to you Lucia, first commander of the Temple Knights of Ishgard─and our trusted friend.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_043: It is an honor to meet you, Vidofnir. I am come as an envoy of Ser Aymeric, lord commander of the Temple Knights and acting leader of the Holy See.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_045: For one thousand years, man and dragon have been locked in an endless cycle of bloodshed and sorrow.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_046: To our shame, we long believed your kin to be the architects of this war. But now we know the truth: that King Thordan and his knights twelve did willfully betray and murder the great wyrm Ratatoskr, shattering the peace between our peoples.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_047: For one thousand years, our leaders conspired to conceal this truth─a truth which was at last laid bare by the Warrior of Light, the Azure Dragoon...and Ysayle.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_048: Alas, a deception so intricately wrought cannot be undone in a moment, and our people labor to accept the truth. After an eternity of war, who would dare to dream that peace could at last be within our grasp?
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_049: Yet dream we must, as Ysayle once did. And we must make that dream a reality, as she could not.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_050: We humbly beseech you, Vidofnir: join hands with us in friendship once more, before the eyes of my people, in Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_VIDOFNIR_000_052: I have heard your request, knight. However, I cannot yet give you mine answer.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_VIDOFNIR_000_054: This matter concerneth my sire. He must needs be consulted.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_VIDOFNIR_000_055: Moreover, the Gnath grow bold, even as they did before, and I would not leave my people at the mercy of the swarm.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_056: Then we will wait. After a thousand years at war, we shall not give up on peace for want of patience.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_VIDOFNIR_000_057: Ha! Fear not, knight: thou shalt have mine answer within thy lifetime.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_058: So soon? My humble thanks. I shall bear your words to my lord forthwith. Until we meet again.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_060: To face such a creature in battle is one thing, to converse with it quite another...
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Given the circumstances, I would say that went rather well.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_071: To be frank, I am surprised our proposal was not rejected outright. Whether aught will come of it remains to be seen, however...
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_072:
Mayhap I should take this opportunity to speak with some of the other dragons...
Ah, but you need not wait for me. The return journey holds no fears for me now.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Well, if you have no further need of our services, we shall continue on to Sharlayan. We hope to welcome a scholar who has agreed to aid us in the search for our missing comrades.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_074: Then I pray your journey is as swift and uneventful as ours was, and thank you again for sparing the time to assist us, even when such grave matters remain unresolved.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_075: I can think of no graver matter than a thousand-year war─one which our friends gave their lives to see ended.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_ALPHINAUD_000_076: Suffice it to say, I would willingly make a thousand such journeys to ensure that their sacrifice was not in vain.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_LUCIA_000_077: Of that I have no doubt, Master Alphinaud. I only hope the fates will not hold you to your word.
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_VIDOFNIR_000_080: Never did I think to see a knight of Ishgard come unto Anyx Trine bearing words instead of steel...
TEXT_HEAVNB102_02157_VIDOFNIR_000_081: Would that the Gnath could show the same restraint. Too many children have fallen to their spears and muskets.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_LUCIA_000_001: ...Beg pardon? My favorite food? Well...I am fond of omelettes. Dodo egg omelettes.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_ALPHINAUD_000_010: So...it would seem we have time to greet this scholar after all. How delightful. I shall be interested to hear how she means to go about finding Minfilia and Thancred. I can only assume she is privy to some new investigative technique.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_ALPHINAUD_000_011: In any event, our first order of business is to rendezvous with Y'shtola in Idyllshire.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Another conspicuously uneventful journey... It would seem we are destined not to be late.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_YSHTOLA_000_030: Ah, ─'tis good to see you. I confess, I had assumed your business in Anyx Trine would detain you longer. Did your meeting with Vidofnir go well?
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_ALPHINAUD_000_031: As well as can be expected. She must discuss Ser Aymeric's proposal with Hraesvelgr, of course, but she seemed amenable to the suggestion.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_ALPHINAUD_000_032: What of our Sharlayan guest? Has she arrived yet?
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_YSHTOLA_000_033: She has, but when I explained that you would be joining us, she asked if she might use the intervening time to explore. I agreed to meet her outside on Frontbridge. We should be on our way.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Wait, back in Ishgard...what was she trying to tell me...?
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_YSHTOLA_000_045: It would seem we are early. Shall we wait?
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_HANDELOUP_000_047: We received word from the first commander not long ago. Though I would have preferred a swifter resolution, I am relieved to hear that our invitation is receiving due consideration.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_ALPHINAUD_000_050:
She was less than flattering about my technique when last we met, but this time I have come prepared. Let her belittle my Obsidian Carbuncle if she dares!
...Do not tell her I said that.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_YSHTOLA_000_055: The Crystal Eye is one of Master Matoya's most cherished relics. I doubt very much that she will grant us leave to lay hands upon it unless we can convince her that it is vital to our cause.
TEXT_HEAVNB103_02158_KRILE_000_060: You did say we were headed for a cave, did you not? Because I certainly don't see a cave nearby. Is Master Matoya meeting us on the way or something?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Oh, who am I kidding─it will be fortunate if she does not mistake me for my sister again.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_YSHTOLA_000_002: You know how she can be. If Krile does not meet with her approval, then that will be that.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_003: I have heard many stories of Master Matoya─some quite flattering, others less so.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_YSHTOLA_000_004: Rest assured, they all are true. This way─and have care where you tread.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_MATOYA_000_005: No one ever comes around for tea anymore. No, it's always saving this, preventing that, or mending the godsforsaken other. Anyone would think I wasn't good company.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_YSHTOLA_000_010: Thancred may be a capable warrior, but he was wounded when last I saw him. If any beasts were nearby when he emerged from the Lifestream, he would have been hard-pressed to repel them.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_011: We had forests like these on the Isle of Val. My grandfather and I used to go for walks together when I could prise him away from his work.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_012: It was the least I could do for him, considering everything he has done for me. Taking me in when I was an orphan, raising me as his own and giving me a name─you didn't think my parents named me Krile Baldesion, did you?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Were I to find myself in an unfamiliar wilderness, my first instinct would be to seek out signs of civilization.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_YSHTOLA_000_014: Ordinarily, perhaps, but in his wounded state, he may not have wished to risk contact with strangers of unknown allegiance. Yet even had Thancred chosen to remain in the forest, the hunters would surely have stumbled across his trail.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_015: Tailfeather doesn't strike me as an isolated outpost, though. Merchants and traders pass through reasonably regularly, do they not? In which case, we'll need to provide a more detailed description when we question the locals.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Fear not, Krile─I have already prepared several sketches of Thancred for that very purpose.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_YSHTOLA_000_017: This...this is impressive. You drew him from memory?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_018: A skill I acquired some years ago for reasons I no longer remember.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_019: I propose we split into two pairs. Y'shtola and I will inquire at the outlying encampments, while  and Krile question the residents of Tailfeather. Afterwards, we shall regroup near Loth ast Vath and share our findings.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Assuming there are no objections, let us be about it.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_021: My, he certainly has matured, hasn't he? Hard to imagine he was once a boy who practiced drawing for hours to impress young ladies...
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_022: Anyway, we had best get started. Find me when you've finished making your rounds.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_030: Pray excuse me, but have you seen this man before?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_MARCECHAMP_000_031: What's that you've got there? A sketch?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_MARCECHAMP_000_032: Hmm... Can't say I know the face. You say he's somethin' of a warrior?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_MARCECHAMP_000_033: Hmm...I heard a tale the other day about a Hyuran vagabond who brought down a bandersnatch by himself─an' with style. Way they tell it, he was dancin' with the beast like it was the belle of the bleedin' ball. Sound like your man?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_MARCECHAMP_000_034: If this friend of yours is as skilled as you say, then he's sure to have found a way to survive.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_MARCECHAMP_000_035: Still, if he's out there on his own, it's only a matter of time before he runs afoul of somethin' he can't handle.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_LOUPARD_000_036: Searchin' for a friend of yours? Let's have a look then.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_LOUPARD_000_037: Hmm...no, ain't seen him around. Sorry.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_LOUPARD_000_038: Nobody here but us and the chocobos, friend. Maybe someone else knows your man.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_GRIMOLD_000_039: A Hyuran man? We're not exactly rare, you know. Could you be more specific?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_GRIMOLD_000_040: ...I did spy this one bloke a while back. Didn't get a good look at his face, but it could have been him.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_GRIMOLD_000_041: This was beyond the forest, as I recall─along the river, to the west of Tailfeather. I remember thinking he wasn't much of a hunter. The lad was making no effort to cover his tracks, see. That, and he was carrying an axe instead of a bow.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_GRIMOLD_000_042: If he was hunting chocobos, he was doing a piss-poor job of it. The birds would've smelled him coming a malm away─I know I did.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_050: Finished? In that case, I think we've learned everything we can here.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_051: Let's see what the others have found out.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_055: I believe we are on the right track. Many of the hunters claim to have seen a strange man who could have been Thancred.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_YSHTOLA_000_056: 'Tis little wonder so many here have taken up hunting. The forest is teeming with wildlife.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_060: We were to meet here, were we not?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_061: My apologies for our late arrival. We thought it wise to question as many hunters as we could.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_YSHTOLA_000_062: Many have made camp in inaccessible locations─ideal for hunting game, not so receiving visitors.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_063: Nevertheless, our time proved well spent. There have been countless sightings of an exceptionally capable Hyuran hunter with whom no one is familiar.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_064: Though none chanced to see the man's face, his height and build match Thancred's description, as does his fighting prowess.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_065: ...So you have heard the same tales. Be that as it may, we yet want for conclusive proof...
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_066: Mayhap this is unrelated, but I heard a curious tale regarding a Vath trader.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_067: He came to Tailfeather in search of garments fit for a “man of refinement”─which seemed a rather curious description for one of his kind.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_YSHTOLA_000_068: ...You are implying that Thancred sent a Vath to market in his stead? Why would he not go himself?
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_069: Well, if you recall, you yourself emerged from the Lifestream as naked as your nameday. It is a scene I shall never forget─
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Well, I was pleased to see you! I-I mean─ It was a simple statement of fact!
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_ALPHINAUD_000_072: It stands to reason that Thancred found himself in the same...predicament.
TEXT_HEAVNB104_02159_KRILE_000_073: In any case, if he had dealings with the Vath, they should be able to tell us, no?
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_YSHTOLA_000_001: Given that Alphinaud seems to recall the details of my return so vividly, I would rather he did not draw me from memory, talented or not.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_KRILE_000_002: Honestly, that boy... Some things never change.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Well, what are we waiting for? For all we know, Thancred could be waiting for us in Loth ast Vath!
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_ALPHINAUD_000_004: We must go and see the Vath right away. Come along, everyone! Come along!
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_VATHSTORYTELLER_000: <click> <click> Great hunters, we welcome you once more to Loth ast Vath. What do you seek this day?
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_ALPHINAUD_000_006: We seek a man. A man with whom we are told you may have had certain dealings.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_VATHSTORYTELLER_000: ...How curious. The hunters tire of godly sport and pursue mortal prey?
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_ALPHINAUD_000_008: No, no, he is not prey, but a friend long missing.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_VATHSTORYTELLER_000: <click> <click> Good, good. He is a friend to the Vath as well, one with whom we have traded many times.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Truly? And you are quite certain it was this man?
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_VATHSTORYTELLER_000: There is no doubt. <click> <click> The fleshling clothed in skins came to us from Sohm Al, lost and weak. He offered meat and hides in trade, and in exchange we tended his wounds.
He brought us much flesh, so skilled a hunter he was. Much flesh. When he asked for garments, we were glad to provide them.
<click> <click> Gone to Loth ast Gnath. Not long ago. When he heard the Onemind had summoned our god once more.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Vidofnir did say that the Gnath had grown as before. But what could Thancred hope to accomplish by himself?
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Honored elder, we thank you for your help. Would that we could repay this kindness ere we depart, but we must hasten to our comrade's side.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_VATHSTORYTELLER_000: Go, great hunters, lest the Gnath claim him as a sacrifice. <click> <click>
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_VATHSTORYTELLER_100: <click> <click> One hunter, however skilled, cannot stand against the colony. Go to your friend.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_YSHTOLA_000_019: We should be safe here. Our pursuers are not like to stray so far from the colony.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_KRILE_000_020: The vision caught me unawares, and I was unprepared for their attack, but...I could hear the colony chattering all around us... They were so loud...so unbearably loud...
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Do you need to sit down? I have water, if it will help.
TEXT_HEAVNB105_02160_VATHSTORYTELLER_000: <click> <click> The colony laments for Lord Ravana. Was this your doing?
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_YSHTOLA_000_001: 'Twould seem the mystery of the axe-wielding Hyur has been laid to rest. I should have known better than to think Thancred would ever stoop to using such an inelegant weapon... But then how was I to know there was not one vagabond wandering the Chocobo Forest but two.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_KRILE_000_005: He knew us. He knew you. Did he walk in our memories as we walked in his?
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_THANCRED_000_010: I know what you're thinking, but really, you needn't worry. It will only lend credence to my tales of heroism. Besides, battle scars are to maidens what loose morals are to gentlemen. A definite bonus.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Blessed with the power of the Echo, and driven to put down primals... Despite his declaration that they walk a different path, I struggle to see how their goals conflict with ours.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Nor is that the only oddity. I find it passing strange that such exceptional individuals should have wholly escaped our notice until now. Surely we would have heard rumors and attempted to recruit them to our cause?
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_YSHTOLA_000_022: I recall no such adventurers─and I would not soon forget their like. Nor would any of us, I think.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_YSHTOLA_000_023: One of our primary duties was to scour the city-states for promising candidates─which is how  found .
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_THANCRED_000_024: Ah, the memories. It seems like only yesterday that you slew your first primal. Speaking of which, I had the distinct impression that it was not the first time that band of merry men and women had killed a god.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_YSHTOLA_000_025: I labor to believe that a band of preternaturally gifted adventurers has been traveling the land, slaying primals without our knowledge. 'Twould imply gross negligence on our part.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_026: Speculation will avail us naught. There is far too much we do not know.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_027: For the present, we must needs concentrate on what we do know, namely that Lord Ravana is no more. Vidofnir must be informed. The news may render her more receptive to Ser Aymeric's invitation.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_KRILE_000_028: Since you seem to have affairs here well in hand, I shall take my leave. Simply being in the vicinity of this colony is giving me a stinking headache.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_KRILE_000_029: If you have need of me, I shall be with Master Matoya. I would beg her assistance with the search for Minfilia.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_THANCRED_000_030: Wait─Minfilia is missing? I thought she escaped with !
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_031: I shall explain on the road. Much has happened in your absence...
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_040: I had not thought to see thee again so soon, mortal. If thou seekest the knight, know that she hath long since departed for Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_041: My thanks, Vidofnir, but it was not for her that we came. We bring good tidings for you and yours. Lord Ravana, who had been summoned by the Gnath, has again been laid low.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_042: Truly? Once more you mortals have succeeded where mine own kind did fail. You have our deepest thanks.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Would that we could take credit. The god fell by another's hand.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_044: Another? Revelation upon revelation. Regardless, it is cause for celebration. The Gnath will have no choice but to withdraw.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_045: But to another matter. I have tidings for thee as well.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_047: As promised, I brought the matter to my sire. Hearken to his answer now.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_048: “For a thousand years have I mourned my beloved, who gave her life to forge a peace thy king betrayed. Such was my lot, until a child of Ishgard came unto me.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_049: “For want of warmth, she wrapped herself in a dream. Yet the world will remember her deeds. For truth, she fought. For justice, she sinned. For redemption, she sacrificed, and became as light.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_050: “To follow one's heart, to have faith in one's convictions─be it for weal, or be it for woe. Such is the folly and the glory of man...and of dragon.”
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_051: He hath entrusted the choice to us, and we have made it. We will keep faith with you who walk in the Light.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Then you accept Ser Aymeric's invitation?
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_053: Let it be known that I, Vidofnir, shall journey unto Ishgard on behalf of my people.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_055: We are honored to receive your answer, and will convey your words to our allies without delay.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_056: It is happening, Ysayle. Would that you were here to see it...
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_TATARU_000_060: We can celebrate Thancred's return later. You and Alphinaud are needed at the Congregation!
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_YSHTOLA_000_065: Fortunately, the journey afforded us ample time to brief Thancred on recent events.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_THANCRED_000_070: So you slew a handful of primals, chatted with the Emperor of Garlemald, uncovered the truth behind a thousand-year war, thwarted a megalomaniacal archbishop's ambitions, and then rode home on the back of the Father of Dragons. Does that about sum it up?
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_HILDA_000_075: Oh good, you're back. Things got a bit heated while you were away.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_VIDOFNIR_000_086: When Ysayle first brought thee before me, I knew in my heart of hearts that this day would come.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_LUCIA_000_087:
One thing at a time, one thing at─
Forgive me, , I will attend you shortly.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_HANDELOUP_000_088: This is a dark day for the Temple Knights. But I have faith that we shall overcome this trial.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_GIBRILLONT_000_089: The city's gone mad, . Steer clear of the Brume if you don't want to get burned.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Right. Let us not keep Ser Aymeric waiting.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_THANCRED_000_092: Yes─yes, quite well. Forgive me. You have given me rather a lot to digest. This whole affair with the Ishgardians and the Dravanians...and our friends nowhere to be found.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_THANCRED_100_092: 'Twould seem there is no end to our troubles.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_YSHTOLA_000_093: We can but face them head-on, one at a time. For now, we must apply ourselves to our allotted tasks and leave the others to theirs.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_YSHTOLA_000_094: Remember, Thancred─we found you, as they found me. In time, we will find Yda and Papalymo and Minfilia as well.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_YSHTOLA_000_095: These troubles will soon be but a memory─one which we will look back on together.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_THANCRED_000_096: Pray do not misunderstand─I did not mean to imply that it would be otherwise. I merely wish that I had rejoined our grand adventure at one of its more triumphal moments. Despite your recent accomplishments, the mood here is less than celebratory.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_THANCRED_100_096: But I have no doubt that we will enjoy many more glorious victories soon enough─and you may rest assured that I will play my part in them to the very hilt.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_097: I know you will. So then─to the Congregation!
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_LUCIA_000_100: You have returned! In this at least the fates are kind.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Greetings, First Commander! It pleases me to inform you that Vidofnir has accepted Ser Aymeric's invitation.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_LUCIA_000_102: She has!? These are glad tidings indeed...
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_LUCIA_000_103: Would that the lord commander were here to hear them.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_HILDA_000_105: Aye─sleepin' off a knife to the gut.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_ALPHINAUD_000_106: What? What happened!? Will he live?
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_LUCIA_000_107: The chirurgeons tell me he will make a full recovery. But had Lord Edmont and Lord Artoirel not been on hand when the assassin struck, he would not have been so fortunate. For a mercy, they subdued the fiend before he could land the telling blow.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_HILDA_000_108: The attack was just the beginnin', though. Not long after, buildings all 'round the city─includin' several of ours─burst into flame.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_HILDA_000_109: Bastards caught us completely by surprise. We've been dowsin' the fires, but for every one we put out, it seems like two more start up. Casualties are mountin'─especially in the Brume.
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_LUCIA_000_110: 'Tis plain these fires were started by the assassin's conspirators. Until they have been rounded up, there will be no end to this. Will you help us find them?
TEXT_HEAVNB106_02161_LUCIA_000_111: Then let us be about it.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_YSHTOLA_000_001: The archbishop may have fallen, but the legacy of his predecessors endures.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Just as Ser Aymeric risked his life to bring about lasting change, so too will others wager all to preserve what they hold dear.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_010: Louisoix once told me that man is all too willing to let his future be bound by his past. And time after time have I witnessed how depressingly right he was.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_015: Even if we had the same resources to combat the fires as them up in the Pillars, we'd still be fightin' a losin' battle. You've seen the Brume─all them narrow streets with wooden houses crammed together. It's kindlin' is what it is.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_020: The flames are spreading. We must needs begin our investigation immediately.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_021: Witnesses must be found; suspects must be identified.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Have you been able to determine the precise locations where the fires were set? Mayhap there is a pattern.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_023: If there is, we have yet to discern it. Fires have been reported throughout the city, in both the Pillars and Foundation.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_024: Indeed, given the size of the area affected, I think it best to divide our forces. Master Alphinaud and Mistress Y'shtola─I would have you take charge of the investigation in Foundation.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_025: As you wish. Mayhap Tataru can be of assistance as well.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_026: Meanin'  and me get the Pillars. Oh, they'll like me up there. Only question is, will the grizzled old rogue strikin' a pose over there be joinin' us?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_027: Thancred, of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn. And may I say what a pleasure it is to meet you too, my lady.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_028: I'll bet. The name's Hilda. A Scion, eh? And there I was thinkin' I'd found a fellow ruffian amongst all these illustrious personages.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_029: I will remain here to coordinate the fire-quenching effort. If you learn aught of value, pray inform me immediately. That is all.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_030: While we could begin by sifting through charred rubble and questioning random passersby, in my experience, every town has at least one individual who can be counted on to know things he or she should not.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_031: Oh, aye...the infamous Lord Emmanellain de Fortemps, lover of women and wine─though neither care for him that much. They say he could gossip for Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_032: Just the sort of fellow I had in mind. Capital suggestion, .
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_033: He'll be at the Crozier most like, makin' an effort to be seen. So let's go and see him.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_035: Someone once said that a gentleman is rather than does. And in Lord Emmanellain I sense we have living proof.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_040: Well, go on then. Talk to the daft sod.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HONOROIT_000_045: (Ah,  . I fear Lord Emmanellain has once more strayed from the path.)
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HONOROIT_000_050: (As has so often been the case, his renewed enthusiasm for martial training gave way to frustration and disinterest at the first sign of difficulty...)
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_BEAUTY02162_000_051: I cannot well abandon my parents! But milord will not accept all three of us into his service. What am I to do?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_MAELIE_000_052: What did we do to deserve this?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ISHGARDIANPRIEST021: Have faith, my brothers and sisters, have faith! Halone has not forsaken you! We have not forsaken you!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_054: I have faith that Ser Aymeric will soon return to assume command. And when he does, I would welcome him with a gift─our arsonists, bound and begging for mercy.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Prior to the fire, do you perchance recall anyone unfamiliar loitering in the vicinity?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_YSHTOLA_000_056: Wooden dwellings built end-to-end and one atop another, each home to a family... How many were abed when the fires were set...?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_TATARU_000_057: You didn't expect me to stand idly by when there was work to be done, did you?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_EMMANELLAIN_000_060: Well, well, if it isn't , dearest of all my friends! You're looking rather glum. Something the matter, old ?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_EMMANELLAIN_000_061: Ah, yes, the arsons. Dreadful business, that─and awfully curious, wouldn't you say? There doesn't seem to be any rhyme or reason to it at all. Naturally, we've doubled the guard outside the manor, along with most of the other houses. Can't have the old pile going up in flames, after all!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_EMMANELLAIN_000_062: Oh, in case you were wondering why the Hoplon is awash with refugees, the lower levels of the Vault have been opened to those unfortunate souls who have lost their homes. Ser Aymeric's orders, from what I hear. Remarkable man─not even a knife in the ribs can keep him from his duties!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_EMMANELLAIN_000_063: Actually, old ...if you were thinking of questioning the refugees, I should be more than happy to accompany you to the Hoplon. While you conduct your inquiries, I could offer words of comfort to the distressed and despondent young maidens...?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_EMMANELLAIN_000_064: Wait a moment...I know what that is. You're giving me one of your looks, aren't you? You do me an injustice, old ! I will have you know, my heart yearns for but one rose─prickly though she may be!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_EMMANELLAIN_000_065: ...I sense you remain unconvinced. Very well, if it will help to prove the purity of my intentions, I shall gracefully rescind my offer. Now run along and catch those arsonists!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_066: That was...not entirely what I had hoped for. Whose idea was it to come here again?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_067: Never mind. For our next step, I suggest we divide our efforts. While you question the refugees in the Hoplon, , I shall investigate the locations where the fires were set. Would you be so good as to join me, Hilda?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_068: You know what, I reckon I would. Can't have you roamin' about in an unfamiliar city by your lonesome, can we? You'd only get robbed blind and left shiverin' in your smallclothes.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_EMMANELLAIN_100_060: I shall detain you no longer, old . Good luck with your investigation!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HONOROIT_100_061: My lord is a gentleman of unassailable principles. To assail them, after all, one would first need to locate them.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_BEAUTY02162_000_070: Ours was one of the first homes to be claimed, but I didn't see how the fire began.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_BEAUTY02162_000_071: It was only when I heard our neighbors shouting that I looked outside and saw the flames. We barely escaped with the clothes on our backs. Were it not for the church's generosity, I don't know what we'd do.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_BEAUTY02162_000_075: Say what you will about the archbishop, but I'll not hear a word spoken against the clergy.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_MAELIE_000_080: There was a man with a satchel. I saw him kneelin' outside the window, and then there was smoke everywhere, and it was so hot, and I couldn't breathe...
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_MAELIE_000_081: I don't remember how I made it out. I s'pose I must have climbed... Maybe my arm is gettin' better after all?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_MAELIE_000_085: Why did he do it? What did we ever do to him?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ISHGARDIANPRIEST021: Come, my brothers and sisters! There is food and shelter enough for all in the basilica!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_REFUGEE02162_000_09: Halone's blessings be upon you, Father.
I confess, we were not sure if we should come. There are so many unbelievable tales these days─about the archbishop, and Ser Aymeric, and the Dravanians...
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ISHGARDIANPRIEST021: Trust in your heart, brother, and pay no heed to the lies of lesser men. They seek only to lead you astray.
Do you require succor as well, ?
So the Temple Knights have begun their investigation at last! Good. This madness has gone on far too long.
Would that I could do something to aid you in your search, but I have a duty to these poor souls. Farewell, and may the Fury guide your steps.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_120: Ah, there you are. Anything to share?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_121: Hmph. We will require more than the muddled testimony of a traumatized girl if we are to identify the culprits...
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_122: While you were questioning the refugees, we inspected the scenes of several of the fires, including one near Saint Reymanaud's Cathedral and another near the Tribunal. For a mercy, neither structure suffered significant damage.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_123: Some might say they were spared by the grace of the Fury. Others might question how such ruthlessly efficient arsonists contrived to fail so miserably on the two occasions when their target was a bastion of Ishgardian orthodoxy.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_124: Nothing conclusive, of course, but it does give one cause to wonder. Alphinaud will doubtless have an opinion.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_YSHTOLA_000_125: Good. Now that you are here, we can proceed with the interrogation.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_TATARU_000_130: You should've seen the way Alphinaud tackled him!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_140: Silence will avail you naught, sir.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_141: Ah, ! I was just about to summon you. As you can see, we have detained a suspect.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_YSHTOLA_000_142: We found this man loitering near the remains of one of the stricken buildings. According to eyewitnesses, he was also present before the fires broke out.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_YSHTOLA_000_143: We wished to have words; he did not. So we insisted.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_PYROMANIAC02162_000: Let me go, damn it! You've got the wrong man!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_145: <sniff> <sniff> My, but you reek of oil. And are those burns on your hands? An occupational hazard, I suppose. But tell me─does arson pay well?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_PYROMANIAC02162_000: I-I'm a victim, you imbecile! Look at me!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_147: Aye, that you are─after a fashion. You should know that your pious patron has already spun us a delightful yarn about how his pet mongrel slipped the leash and set about burning half the city to the ground. Not very noble of him, I grant you─but then these highborn types rarely do show loyalty to their pets.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_100_147: ...In fact, he called you rabid and begged us to put you down.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_PYROMANIAC02162_000: Th-That's bollocks! He's the one what told me to keep goin'!

...Even a sinner such as me could find salvation in the Fury's work, he said. I'd left it behind─tried to, with all my heart! Said my prayers every day, like a good man. But he came to me! He came to me!
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_150: And there you have it. Hilda, would you be so kind as to escort our friend here to the Congregation?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_151: Aye. So long as you don't mind if he's limpin' when he gets there.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_TATARU_000_152: That was incredible, Thancred! But how did you know he would confess?
