TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_153: Well, I have seen his like before. A troubled soul, manipulated by men of power and wielded as a weapon...
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_154: I could not be certain, of course. But given the stakes, I thought it worth the risk.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_YSHTOLA_000_155: And if our captive had called your bluff?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_THANCRED_000_156: Must we entertain hypotheticals? The world as it is is vexing enough.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_157: Thank you, Thancred. Whether by luck or judgment, we have at last confirmed that these arsons were orchestrated by a person or persons of influence. I think it best that we now return to the Congregation and discuss how best to proceed.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_TATARU_000_160: Thank the Twelve you've returned to us! But what happened to your old outfit?
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_YSHTOLA_000_170: The Temple Knights are interrogating the arsonist as we speak. Gods willing, we shall have more information ere long.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_175: If we could but determine the motive behind these fires...
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HILDA_000_180: Bit of a gambler, ain't he? Fine by me, so long as his luck don't run out.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_HANDELOUP_000_185: Apologies, , but the interrogation is ongoing.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_190: On behalf of the Holy See of Ishgard, I thank you all.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_100_190: The man you apprehended is being interrogated as we speak. Though he fell silent upon realizing that we had not turned his master, he will soon tell us what he knows, one way or another.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_192: Ah, Lord Artoirel. Are you come to see your father? He is attending Ser Aymeric in his chambers at present.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ARTOIREL_000_193: I am. He bid me bring this salve.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_194: Then do not let me detain you. And thank you for your kindness, my lord.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ARTOIREL_000_195: In times of trouble, every man must do his part. Would that I could do more.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_ALPHINAUD_000_196: ...My lord Artoirel did not seem to be in the best of spirits.
TEXT_HEAVNB107_02162_LUCIA_000_197: 'Tis little wonder, Master Alphinaud. His father is widely slandered, and his half-brother not yet cold in the grave.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_001: How desperately we cling to that which we hold dear, knowing all the while that a day will come when we must let go.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ALPHINAUD_000_005: It was not so long ago, was it...
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_HILDA_000_010: The past belongs to the dead. The future's ours to do with what we will.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_THANCRED_000_015: No more farewells. Not for a good while yet, at least.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_020: Concentrate on freeing the hostages. I will tend to their wounds.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_HILDA_000_030: Bastards! If I had it my way, I'd be leadin' the charge myself!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_EUDESTAND_000_040: Don't you dare let us down! Bring our people home safe!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_LUCIA_000_045: We will hold here, . The Fury guide and keep you!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_000_055: Do not concern yourself with my safety. Lest you forget, I too am a knight.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_HANDELOUP_000_057: Pray keep in mind that the lord commander has not fully recovered from his wounds. Though the safety of the hostages is of paramount concern, I would ask that you do your utmost to dissuade him from engaging in any...heroics.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_000_060: Listen well. We will enter the basilica silently via this gate. According to our latest reports, there are at least six hostages being held within. The numbers and readiness of the True Brothers of the Faith are unknown.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_000_061: I am told one claimed to have served under Thordan VII. Might the same be true of the rest?
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_000_062: Given the swiftness with which they seized control of the Vault, I think it highly likely, yes─which means that they may well possess the knowledge required to turn the building's defenses against us.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_000_063: Be that as it may, we have no choice but to press on. Lord Artoirel─you are a brave man and true, and none would dare question your honor if you chose not to risk your life in this endeavor. Are you certain you wish to join us?
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_000_064: I am no stranger to the battlefield, Ser Aymeric! My arm will not falter; my shield will not break! Halone as my witness, we will bring these fanatics to justice!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_000_065: Well said, my lord! Friends─follow me!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_000_066: Ser Simeonard! Lay down your arms and release the hostages, and you will be shown mercy! I give you my word!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_TERRORIST_000_067: (-Simeonard of the Holiest Flame-)Hah! The word of a heretic and kinslayer! I would sooner trust a dragon. Activate the knights! We shall show the hostages the same mercy he showed the archbishop!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_TERRORIST_000_068: (-Simeonard of the Holiest Flame-)Unlike you, Ser Aymeric, I am a man of honor. By my hand, you shall receive of the Fury's judgment!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_000_069: So it is to be a trial, then. Lord Artoirel, ─leave us and save the hostages! I will deal with Ser Simeonard!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_THANCRED_000_070: Well that was timely. Vidofnir must have been circling for hours.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_075: In the moments before Vidofnir appeared, I contemplated teleporting the girl. Thank the Twelve that I did not.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_LUCIA_000_076: Since Haurchefant's death, Lord Edmont has grown ever more cautious. To speak plain, the man is afraid to hope. But I am not. Vidofnir's act of heroism will serve to shift public opinion in our favor, of that I have no doubt.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_HILDA_000_077: After this, I reckon there'll be a few less folk cursin' dragons 'round here, and a few more cursin' the clergy─which is fine by me.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_SYMME_000_078: Well, I'll be damned! Not only is Maelie safe, but she got to ride a dragon!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_EUDESTAND_000_079: We're the only family Maelie's got─her and a lot of other children. All the more reason to strengthen the watch, I say.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_HANDELOUP_100_079: Words cannot well express our gratitude, . Thank you for rescuing the hostages...and for keeping the lord commander safe.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ALPHINAUD_000_080: This has been a day of surprises, has it not? 'Tis but a pity Vidofnir could not stay longer.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_THANCRED_000_081: Yes, I think it's fair to say that she timed her departure rather less well than her arrival.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_082: Well-timed scarcely does it justice. But one moment later would have been a moment too late.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ALPHINAUD_000_083: Let us pray that the Ishgardians who yet harbored doubts will take these events to heart and accept the truth of Ser Aymeric's words.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ALPHINAUD_000_084: Well, 'tis only meet that I inform Tataru of what has occurred here. If you have need of me, I shall be at Fortemps Manor.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_THANCRED_000_085: Allow me to accompany you. Tataru would never forgive me if I left for the Rising Stones without saying good-bye.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_086: A moment, . I wish a word.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_100_086: Tell me, does Thancred seem quite well to you?
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_A1_000_000: He held his own in the Vault.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_A1_000_001: He got on well enough with Hilda.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_A1_000_002: I'm not sure how to put it into words, but...
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_087: That he did─which is especially remarkable given the injury to his eye. I can only assume that his time in the wilderness afforded him ample opportunity to compensate for his impairment.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_088: However, I speak not of his physical state, but rather his aetheric flow, which I fear has been irreparably disrupted.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_089: Of that I have no doubt. His time in the wilderness did not deprive him of his charm.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_090: But that is neither here nor there. What concerns me is his aetheric flow, which I fear has been irreparably disrupted.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_091: So you sense it too. A subtle change, imperceptible to most.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_092: I myself did not notice it at first, but upon closer examination, I saw that his aetheric flow had been irreparably disrupted.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_093: As a result, I strongly suspect that his ability to manipulate aether has been compromised. Simply put, Thancred may no longer be able to wield magicks.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_094: It would do much to explain why he chose to remain within the wilderness instead of seeking us out. He would have been compelled to rely solely on traditional methods of travel, significantly prolonging his journey. And when he learned that a nearby beast tribe was making preparations to summon a primal, it may well have seemed more sensible to wait.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_095: But this is still little more than speculation. Until I have proof, pray speak no word of it.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_000_096: Right, then. I should be on my way. Krile may have charmed Master Matoya for now, but who can say how long it will last.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_TATARU_000_105: Lord Edmont told me all about what Vidofnir did! Gods, how I wish I had been there to see it.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_BUTLER01580_000_106: When I heard the commotion, I went outside to look, but all I saw was the dragon's silhouette on the horizon...
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_STEWARD_000_107: It is a relief to see that you are unharmed,  . Pray remain here a moment─Lord Artoirel should be returning shortly.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_BATTLETALK_: 'Twould seem our presence yet goes unnoticed. Come─we must secure the entrance.
Remember: saving the hostages takes precedence over all else. Mind your attacks, and subdue the enemy quickly.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_HOSTAGE01_BATTLETAL: You must hurry! The others were taken elsewhere by Ser Simeonard.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: I will hold the entrance and look after this one. Now go!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_BATTLETALK: Ser Simeonard? So this is indeed the work of the archbishop's former servants...
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_BATTLETALK_: Secure the hostage, ! Leave the others to us!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_BATTLETALK: On your guard! They've sounded the alarum!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_HOSTAGE02_BATTLETAL: Th-They took the others somewhere. I... It all happened so quickly...
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_TERRORIST_ZAKO_ANY_: There they are! Let none escape!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Keep going! I will hold them here!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: Not alone you won't! ─stay with Ser Aymeric and Lord Artoirel!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_BATTLETALK_: Come, then! Let us see whom the Fury favors!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_BATTLETALK: Ser Aymeric is still wounded, ! If we do not move quickly, he will surely fall!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_TERRORIST_LEADER_BA: O Halone, render unto us Your judgment! Raise up the righteous, and cast down the wicked!
Traitor! Kinslayer! By what sorcery do you yet stand!? Enough! All of you─attack!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_BATTLETALK: I see no others nearby. Come, ! Ser Aymeric needs our help!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_BATTLETALK_: Well done! Now let us finish this, ser─before the eyes of gods and men!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_TERRORIST_LEADER_BA: Stand fast, my brothers! The Fury is with us!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_BATTLETALK: There must be others nearby, but where!?
Ser Aymeric's strength is almost spent, ! We must go to his aid at once!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_BATTLETALK_: Have no fear, child. We will save your friend!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_HOSTAGE03_BATTLETAL: You must hurry! The priest took Maelie upstairs when he saw you kill his men!
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_AYMERIC_BATTLETALK_: No, NO! The hostages, they... O Halone, pray forgive me...
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ARTOIREL_BATTLETALK: Fury take me, they murdered them! And we allowed it to happen...
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_URIANGER_000_110: ...This is thy proof? The Gerun Oracles? Apocrypha.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)It is a truth long forgotten─a tale of the beginning, and of the path we have been set upon.
(-Elidibus-)Our fates were ordained long ago, Archon. The Garleans are no exception. Nor the Triad. You know what must be done.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YDA_000_122: The Masks will attack as soon as all units are in position. The imperials won't know what hit them.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_PAPALYMO_000_123: I fear it will be bloody...
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YDA_000_124: By Rhalgr, it had better be.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_PAPALYMO_000_125: We cannot stay here forever, Yda. We have other responsibilities.
TEXT_HEAVNB108_02163_YDA_000_126: I know full well what my responsibilities are─and I mean to fulfill them, every one!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Much as I worry for the future of Ishgard, the fate of our missing friends concerns me even more...
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_010: Alphinaud, ! I've been looking all over for you!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_011: We've received news regarding F'lhaminn, Hoary Boulder, and Coultenet!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_013: No, no, it's nothing bad─quite the opposite, in fact! It seems that once they learned the Scions' good name had been restored, they boarded the next ship bound for Limsa Lominsa. They should be arriving any moment now!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_014: It's easy to forget how useful linkpearls are, isn't it? When they work, I mean. And you don't mind being spied on.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Quite. But what wonderful news! To think that our reunion is close at hand.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_THANCRED_000_016: A pleasure to see you too, Alphinaud.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Ah, Thancred...and Krile. What brings the two of you here?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_THANCRED_000_018: Krile and I have been looking into how we might track down Minfilia.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_KRILE_000_019: And we may just have found the answer.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_KRILE_000_020: ─when you were fleeing Ul'dah with Minfilia, you said that Hydaelyn spoke to her shortly before you parted ways, yes?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_KRILE_000_021: Well, assuming that is true─and I see no reason to suspect that it is not─it seems reasonable to conclude that Hydaelyn commanded her to remain behind.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_KRILE_000_022: That is to say, the Mothercrystal directly interceded to guide Minfilia.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_KRILE_000_023: Admittedly, this is all still quite hypothetical, but I propose that such intervention, however subtle, must surely leave some residual trace. A lingering disturbance in the aether─or ripple, if you will.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_KRILE_000_024: In order to establish the existence of such ripples, of course, we will require suitable data.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_THANCRED_000_025: Fortunately, I know where such data can be found: the battleground where  felled the Ultima Weapon...and the site of my personal ignominy.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_THANCRED_000_026: 'Twas there that Hydaelyn intervened to shield  from the magick I invoked. Krile and I will infiltrate the castrum and analyze the aether therein.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_THANCRED_000_028: I have a proven knack for subterfuge, and I am confident there will be sufficient nooks and crannies in which to hide Krile while the patrols pass.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_THANCRED_000_029: Besides, if you and  come along, who will see to F'lhaminn's grand homecoming?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_030: When you put it like that... Very well, I will trust in your plan.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_031: I know not whether this data will yield a means to find Minfilia, but it will at the very least eliminate another avenue of inquiry.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Tataru and I will return to the Rising Stones and make preparations for our comrades' return. Might I impose upon you to meet them at the Lominsan docks?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Then I shall see the four of you at the Rising Stones. Safe travels!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOARYBOULDER_000_04: Is that...? By the gods, it is you! Well met, , well met!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_COULTENET_000_045: If it isn't ! Really, you didn't have to come all this way just for us!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Oh? Lady F'lhaminn is not with you?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_047: I can't wait to hear what adventures they've had!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_050: Oh, ! How have you been? Come here─let me have a good look at you.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_051: Thank the Twelve. One hears the strangest tales in foreign lands. I worried about you all every day...
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_COULTENET_000_052: We would have sent word sooner, but the Braves afforded us no opportunity. When they fell upon us in the market, it was all we could do to escape.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_COULTENET_000_053: Tataru found her way to you, of course, but we were forced to seek shelter aboard a Hannish vessel.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOARYBOULDER_000_05: It pained us not being there when you needed us most. But we made the most of it, didn't we, Coultenet? Studied and trained from dusk till dawn, we did!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_055: We would have sent word sooner, but we knew not whom to trust, and with the vast distance...
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_056: But those dark days are behind us at last. I shall be glad indeed to return home and speak with my daughter.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_057: What do you mean she's missing!? How could you let this happen!?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_058: Forgive me, I...I am sure you are doing everything in your power to find her.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_059: ...As Thancred must be. He watched over her from the first─long before me. And he will watch over her to the last.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_060: I shall pray for her safe return, and busy myself in the meantime.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_COULTENET_000_061: For a certainty, there is much and more to be done. The Braves may have bloodied us, but the path remains, and we shall not be swayed from it.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOARYBOULDER_000_06: Aye, that's the spirit! To the Scions, and a long overdue reunion! Huzzah!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_063: Well, there you have it. To the Rising Stones!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: Ahhh, it's great to be back in the Toll! <sniff> It even smells like adventure!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_COULTENET_000_075: Home at last... I must make my rounds and see who remains.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_080: ...It feels good to be home again.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_081: To think that everyone is waiting for us, just beyond those doors. Friends and family with whom we have shared so much...
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_082: ...Gods help me, but the older I get, the more sentimental I become. Come, let us not keep them waiting.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_090: And there they are, at last. Thank the Twelve...
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_095: Nothing like a homecoming to lift everyone's spirits! Thanks for bringing them back, .
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALIANNE_000_100: When our comrades betrayed us, I feared all was lost. How wrong I was!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_EPHEMIE_000_105: We must tell the children at once! They've always been so fond of Hoary.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_BLUOMWYDA_000_110: I worry that Aergmhus is getting a bit carried away, but I suppose I can overlook it on this occasion.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ISILDAURE_000_115: Aye, aye, I heard it all from Alianne. So, where is she? If I'm to greet the Songstress of Ul'dah, I would do so on my feet!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_OCHERBOULDER_000_12: Huzzah! He is returned! Together, my brother and I shall serve the Scions till the breaking of an eighth dawn!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_CLEMENCE_000_130: First Ocher, and now Hoary! A passing fancy I could suffer, but this!? She's hopeless! Utterly hopeless!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_VMAHTIA_000_135: Is that the Lady F'lhaminn I've heard so much about? Well, well! I shall have to introduce myself.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_140: Alianne, Ephemie! It fills my heart with joy to see you both hale and healthy. And what of Higiri?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_EPHEMIE_000_141: She is well, though abroad on a mission at present.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALIANNE_000_142: It just wasn't the same without you. Welcome back, my lady!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_FLHAMINN_000_150: Twelve be praised, so many are still with us...
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_AERGMHUS_000_160: Ah, we could do with more of that around here! Heartfelt reunions with stalwart companions! Brings a─<belch>─brings a bloody tear to the eye!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOUMEI_000_180: To secret oneself in a ship's hold to secure safe passage to a faraway land... This is a tale we know all too well.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOUMEI_000_181: When they are well rested, I should like to seek a formal introduction.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ISILDAURE_000_182: Why wait, my friend? Come, there is no need to be shy!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOUMEI_000_183: Pray grant me a moment longer, at least! Though I am happy to oblige you, my legs are rather less accommodating...
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOUMEI_000_190: Isildaure has the spirit of a man half his age. I imagine his granddaughter often struggled to keep up.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOARYBOULDER_000_20: Ocher! What in the seven hells drove my little brother to come to Mor Dhona?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_OCHERBOULDER_000_20: Why, you, Brother─you and the Scions, of course! For a thousand days I trained, that I might grow as strong as you─that I might fight alongside you!
Yet now that you are here, I sense that you have surpassed me once more... No, do not tell me─you trained with the Hannish, did you not?
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOARYBOULDER_000_20: Your eyes do not deceive, Brother! Aye, I have studied the Trials of the Braves, and drunk deep of the souls of mine enemies!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_HOARYBOULDER_000_21: An unexpected but welcome reunion indeed! And a challenge, besides. It would not do to be bested by my little brother, oh no. Not after having come so far!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_COULTENET_000_220: Glad though I am to be home, I cannot help but think of those who have yet to return...
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_COULTENET_000_221: Once we have settled in, I would join the search.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_COULTENET_000_230: We all must do our duty─and I am no exception. Our brothers and sisters are counting on us.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_240: It's been so long since I've seen them all like this.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_242: 'Twas the chaos born of my foolish ambition which forced them to flee.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_ALPHINAUD_000_243: Though they are returned, there are others yet missing─others whom we cannot forsake.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_244: We'll find them, Alphinaud─I know we will! Minfilia, Yda, Papalymo...every last one!
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_245: And when they walk through those doors, we'll be here to welcome them home.
TEXT_HEAVNC101_02231_TATARU_000_246: With me at the head of the queue, of course!
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_TATARU_000_000: It'll all be like it was. Just you wait and see!
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Thancred and Krile contacted us a short while ago. It would seem that their foray into Castrum Meridianum bore fruit.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_011: They ask that we rendezvous with them and Y'shtola in Idyllshire, where they will share their findings.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Rude though it is to depart without speaking to the guest of honor, I expect she will forgive me if I return with her daughter.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_TATARU_000_020: What are you still doing here? They're waiting for you in Idyllshire!
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_THANCRED_000_025: How is F'lhaminn, by the way? Enchanting as ever, I trust. I shall have to pay my respects when time allows.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_030: 'Twas rather less than I had hoped...though mayhap I asked too much.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_040: My apologies, I see I am the last to arrive. So─what news have you for us?
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_KRILE_000_041: Well, as we postulated, there were indeed what appeared to be the remnants of an unexplained disturbance in the aether at the scene of the Ultima Weapon's destruction. A ripple at odds with the presiding pattern.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_KRILE_000_042: Though faint, the waveforms bore a strong resemblance to those observed following the destruction of the Isle of Val─when I believe Hydaelyn shielded me with the blessing of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_THANCRED_000_043: To confirm our findings, we paid a visit to the Sil'dih Aqueducts.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_THANCRED_000_044: There we detected the same waveform, but orders of magnitude larger...as one would expect of a more recent disturbance.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_045: Hydaelyn. There is no other explanation.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_KRILE_000_046: But there is more. When I studied the site where Y'shtola used Flow, it appeared that not two but three beings had been affected.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_KRILE_000_047: Yet unlike Y'shtola and Thancred, there was no trail to follow. Our unknown third party was simply there...and then not there.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_KRILE_000_048: Now, recall your visions of a vast crystal floating in a sea of aether. Though this too is but a theory, studies of gifted subjects suggest that, when communing with Hydaelyn, we briefly leave our bodies behind.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_KRILE_000_049: So, let us consider the facts. One─Hydaelyn interceded. Two─a third being was caught in Y'shtola's Flow and vanished without a trace. And three─Hydaelyn may have the capacity to summon the consciousness of gifted individuals to Her side.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_050: You are implying, I take it, that Hydaelyn guided Minfilia into the compass of my magick...that She might summon her, body and soul, unto the aetherial sea?
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_051: In which case, we must needs continue our search there. For a blessing, the means to do so already exists.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_052: I speak of the Antitower─a Sharlayan construction conceived to provide scholars a vantage point over the aetherial sea.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_053: Though I know not where its entrance lies, we need only ask its last custodian─a contrary old crone who, for another blessing, refused to join the exodus.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_054: Master Matoya was the keeper of the Antitower!? I had no idea...
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Then our course is clear. We must petition her aid once again.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_060: Oh, what a surprise. Well? What secrets have you come to extract from me this time?
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Ah. Though it pains me to admit it, your words strike close to the mark. We humbly ask that you grant us entry to the Antitower, that we might use it to seek a friend who we believe has been transported to the aetherial sea.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_062: And who told you I could do such a thing, I wonder.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_063: The tower was abandoned to its magical keepers fifteen years ago. They have the run of the place now. If that is no deterrent to you, then by all means.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_064: Is that all? I felt sure you would seek to dissuade us from our course, given your role as custodian.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_065: Role? Hardly. The Forum foisted the title on me.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_066: During the exodus, every entrance to the Antitower was sealed save one.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_067: My role consists of making sure no one with ill intent sneaks through it. Such was the Forum's final “order” to me.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_068: Well? I can remove the wards right now. Will you be going or not?
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_KRILE_000_069: We will, Master Matoya. We will do whatever it takes to find Minfilia!
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_100_070: You, Baldesion girl─you're staying here with me. I need your help to restore the wards to their original state.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_071: The rest of you can go─on the condition that you clean up the mess in the tower. If you encounter any unruly familiars, you're to tend to them. Those are my terms, and I'll hear no argument.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_THANCRED_000_072: Well, it appears the mistress has spoken. Lead the way, .
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_THANCRED_000_085: Whatever it takes, we will find Minfilia. Whatever it takes.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_090: Long did I wonder what awaited beyond that door. Several times in my youth, I even tried to open it, but the wards were beyond my ability to dispel.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_YSHTOLA_000_091: All I earned for my efforts was a mountain of menial chores, and I had given up on ever satisfying my curiosity. To think that I'm about to step through the threshold after all these years...
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_KRILE_000_95: To be honest, I'm not entirely sure what you'll need to do once you reach the bottom...but you've always been so resourceful, so...
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_100: Fair warning, but the arcane entities in the Antitower are a troublesome lot. Try not to die in there.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_110: 'Tis a blessed few who get to choose how and when and for what they die.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_111: Not that you need reminding, I suppose. But that boy... <sigh>
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_MATOYA_000_112: For all the suffering he has known, he still clings to the notion that there is a cosmic justice, a morality by which we are saved or condemned. And there isn't.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_120: She...she's not coming back, is she.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_A1_000_122: She did what she thought was best.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_130: I know that, I do. To give all for her beliefs was ever her way.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_131: So will we, as we must. What greater calling could there be than to stand against the Dark as defenders of the Light? And yet...where does it end? The sacrifice, the loss...
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_135: ...We carry on, as we must. She went to great lengths to inform us of the enemy's designs. We stand, as ever, against the Dark, as defenders of the Light.
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_136: Yet for how long, I wonder. How much more loss must we endure...?
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_140: It weighs on you too, I know. I understand why she made her decision, and yet...
TEXT_HEAVNC102_02232_ALPHINAUD_000_141: Every time we lose another friend, I have to ask myself if there was not another way...
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I must ask that you not breathe a word of this to any of the others at the Rising Stones─especially F'lhaminn.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_ALPHINAUD_000_001: I will brief Tataru on what we have learned, as well as Urianger. He may have insight into what the Word told us.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_ALPHINAUD_000_002: As for you, ...after all you have done, I would say you have earned a rest.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Ah, but speaking of well-earned rewards─I received a missive from Ser Aymeric while you were away. 'Twould seem he is planning a ceremony of some sort, and would like you to attend.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_ALPHINAUD_000_004: He did not divulge the details, preferring instead to explain in person. Mayhap you should pay him a visit?
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Pray take some time to rest. I think I may as well. Oh, and should you decide to visit Ser Aymeric at the Congregation, do be sure to give him my regards.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_HANDELOUP_000_015: The first commander is tending to the preparations at Falcon's Nest. If all goes to plan, this will mark a new day for Ishgard!
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_TEMPLEKIGHTGATE_000: Ah,  . The lord commander left instructions that you were to be shown inside.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_Q1_000_021: Proceed to the Seat of the Lord Commander?
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_ARTOIREL_000_025: Well met,  . Have you spoken with the first commander yet?
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_EMMANELLAIN_000_030: Oh! Fancy running into you here, old . Gave me a bit of a shock. We'll talk later, yes?
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_HONOROIT_000_035: (Thank the Fury you are here,  . I am not sure what my lord intends...and that troubles me far more than when I do.)
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_CITIZENA02233_000_0: By the Fury, would you look at the size of it! Got any idea what it'll look like when they've finished?
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_CITIZENB02233_000_0: Peace between dragon and man. I would have scoffed at it not long ago but now, after seeing that dragon pluck that girl from the sky, well... If this is to be the moment, then my wife and I would witness it firsthand.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_CITIZENC02233_000_0: I don't envy them poor sods what have to work atop that scaffolding, exposed to the wind and all. Aye, it's for a good cause, but better them than me!
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_LUCIA_000_060: The lord commander said you would come, .
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_LUCIA_000_061: As you can see, preparations for the conference are proceeding apace.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_LUCIA_000_062: It conceals a relief that will be unveiled during the conference. The masons labor day and night to see it finished on schedule.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_LUCIA_000_063: Ser Aymeric wanted a symbol which would endure long after this conference is concluded. I think he will be pleased with the result.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_LUCIA_000_064: 'Twas not my war, but I made it mine...and to see it draw closer to a resolution fills me with a strange hope.
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_LUCIA_000_065: His faith is infectious, is it not? His certainty that we can be better than we are...
TEXT_HEAVNC103_02233_LUCIA_000_066: Forgive me, I am rambling. You must be tired from your journey. Go, rest. I will not keep you.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_000: Will it truly be enough, I wonder...
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_EMMANELLAIN_000_005: Ah...still here, old ? This, uh...this really isn't the time.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_HONOROIT_000_010: (I will do my utmost to keep him out of trouble, but I may require your assistance later...)
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_CITIZENA02233_000_0: Have you peeked behind the curtain? Care to tell us what you saw?
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_CITIZENB02233_000_0: I suppose we came a bit early, didn't we? Nevertheless, better early than late!
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_CITIZENC02233_000_0: More and more folk are drifting into Falcon's Nest. Most ain't quite sure what to expect, I reckon. Quite frankly, neither am I...
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_LUCIA_000_030: If you would rather not take a rest, then why not take a walk around Falcon's Nest? Make your presence known to the people and so forth.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_LUCIA_000_031: In addition to those who have come from far and wide to attend this ceremony, you may meet lords Artoirel and Emmanellain, who have graciously volunteered their services.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_LUCIA_000_032: They should be glad to see you. Now, if you would excuse me, I must needs return to my duties.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_040: Taking a stroll around the hamlet? Very good, very good. We shall speak anon.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ROTHE_000_050: Bloody excitin', isn't it? Not just peace with the dragons, but with all them heretics besides!
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ROTHE_000_051: Don't misunderstand─we've all got a healthy fear of being bathed in dragon fire. That being said, the heretics did far more to hinder our efforts here in the past, so hearin' that we're close to a reconciliation comes as a great relief!
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ROTHE_000_060: If the dragons haven't got reason to fight, then neither will the heretics. Thank the Fury for that.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_REDWALD_000_070: I am glad to see that the rumors were true! Well met,  , and fear not─I've no intention of begging your aid with this or that. Everything appears to be in order.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_REDWALD_000_071: My only lingering concern is that one of the Convictors might not have been informed of our plans. As I recall, Vidofnir may pass directly over their encampment.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_REDWALD_000_072: The last thing we need is a glory-seeking nobleman attempting to slay a Dravanian ambassador to a peace conference...
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_REDWALD_000_080: Pay me no mind. Worrying over unlikely possibilities is my duty. Yours is to relax and enjoy the festivities.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_CITIZENA02233_000_0: Do you know when everything's set to begin? I wasn't sure how many might come, so I thought it best to come early and find a spot with a great view.

When I heard that Ser Aymeric was planning to make a speech, I knew I couldn't miss it. I mean, the man risked his own neck to rescue those hostages! How often do we get heroes like that in this day and age?
And he's more than a fighter, too─he's a thinker, he is. He's got plans to better our lives. To change things. And he'll do it, by the Fury. Me and my friends and family, we all believe he can do it.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_CITIZENA02233_000_1: Where is everyone else? Don't they know what they're missing?
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_110: How much has changed since we fought alongside each other in the Vault. If you had told me then that we would soon be hosting a peace conference, I would have thought you a naive fool.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_111: Yet here we are, preparing to make that fantasy a reality. Hah─and here I am, laboring to make it so.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_113: Certainly, First Commander. How may I be of service?
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_LUCIA_000_114: Some of the Convictors are refusing to stand down.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_LUCIA_000_115: The majority were willing to do so, but a small party have instead pledged to engage any Dravanians bound for Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_116: Fury take me, they would defy Ser Aymeric's commands!? If they dare attack Vidofnir─
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_LUCIA_000_117: It will not come to that. But to see that it does not, we must needs hasten to their encampment.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_LUCIA_000_118: They should be far more reluctant to oppose us were a lord of House Fortemps present.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_119: I understand completely. Let us depart at once.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_120: But ere we do, I must ask: would you look after Emmanellain while I am away?
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_121: As you know, he has ever been an impulsive, changeable child, but recently he seems to have been suffering from a bout of melancholy.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_122: I thought to lift his spirits by having him assist with guard duty─a simple but honorable charge, unlikely to expose him to danger given the presence of so many other knights. Alas, he has taken no interest, and I fear he may abandon his post in my absence.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_123: All I ask is that you keep an eye on him until I return...exhausting though that may be.
TEXT_HEAVNC104_02234_ARTOIREL_000_124: Thank you, my friend. I promise we will not be long.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_HONOROIT_000_000: Hm? Was that Lord Artoirel leaving with the first commander just now?
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_CITIZENA02233_000_0: Everything is going to be all right. I know it will.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_CITIZENB02233_000_0: What sort of trade opportunities might there be? I've never thought about it before, but do the Dravanians even have markets?
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_CITIZENC02233_000_0: Do you think we'll have to let them come and go as they please? In the capital, I mean. Our roads weren't exactly designed for Dravanians...
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_020: I'm rather busy at the moment, old . Guarding this tavern, as it were.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_021: Oh, I see now. Artoirel thought I might be derelict in my duties, eh? The nerve of my brother to question my dedication!
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_022: ...But since you are here, mayhap I can put you to proper use. The wasteland beyond the walls must be kept safe for travelers, yet I have been forbidden from leaving Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_023: It wouldn't do for our esteemed guests to be devoured by wolves, oh no. Yet that is precisely what will happen if we do not cull the roaming packs!
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_024: Your map, if I may. Right...there, those are the points our scouts marked for patrol. I'll leave you to it, old . Come, Honoroit─I must return to my rounds!
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_HONOROIT_000_030: Terrible imposition though it was, I am relieved that my lord did not think to tend to the wolves by himself.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_040: , Wolves' Bane! It pleases me to inform you that I have completed my rounds, and that all is well in Falcon's Nest.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_041: Oh, and there was a grizzled fellow looking for you. You know, the one who made that arsonist confess. Clever, that.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_042: Thancred, was it? He was asking after you.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_043: Anyway, once I noticed the garish weapons he was sporting, I deemed it a waste to leave him be. I dispatched him to an area I neglected to mark on your map...yes, this one. If you hurry, he might still be there.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_050: I suppose we could simply wait here for your friend to return. But, if you're feeling impatient, you are free to go and look for him.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_HERETIC02235_000_05: Stay your weapons! We come in peace!

Lady Iceheart told us tales of Vidofnir. If she would trust in Ser Aymeric, then we too would hear what he has to say. But the wolves caught us unawares, and were it not for this man, we would have surely died.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_THANCRED_000_061: 'Twas fortunate I came when I did. These two would not have fared well against the wolves on their own.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_THANCRED_000_062: The young lord wasted no time taking advantage of you, did he? And me, I suppose.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_THANCRED_000_063: Let us return to Falcon's Nest, then, and see what other thrilling tasks he may have for us.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_THANCRED_000_070: (It's always the younger one. Every time, without fail.)
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_HONOROIT_000_075: How wonderful, you found Master Thancred! As ever, I could not help but fear the worst.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_080: And there they are, a pair of gallant heroes if I ever saw them. Comrades-in-arms, reunited at last.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_081: By your selfless sacrifice have you guaranteed the safety of our many guests. On behalf of Ishgard, I thank you both.
TEXT_HEAVNC105_02235_EMMANELLAIN_000_082: And with that, there is naught left to do but to enjoy our well-earned respite.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_HONOROIT_000_000: (I am sorry, my . Truly, I am...)
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENA02233_000_0: Just imagine: an end to the violence! Doesn't the very thought fill you with joy? You'll never have to fight again!
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENB02233_000_0: Are we truly the first, I wonder? Surely our forefathers tried to sue for peace in the past...
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENC02233_000_0: Not much longer now, eh? Wonder if I could sneak off to the tavern for a pint or three.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_EMMANELLAIN_000_020: Oh, and this should of course go without saying, but let's keep those last few favors between us, yes? Artoirel wouldn't understand.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_EMMANELLAIN_000_021: Right, then─the first floor of those barracks has been converted into a tavern for the duration of the conference. Why don't you go and have something to eat?
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_022: For once, a suggestion with which I agree. Go on ahead, . I will join you anon.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENA02233_000_0: Gods, how could I have been so foolish!? She...she was right...
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENB02233_000_0: What was that fool of a lordling thinking!? What did he think would happen!?
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENC02233_000_0: I'm still not sure what they were about. I thought they might try to destroy the relief, but...
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_REDWALD_000_046: He was not wrong to want to subdue the leader as quickly as able, for she may have spurred others to further violence.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_REDWALD_000_047: But to fire on her as the crowd looked on was beyond reckless.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_TOURCENET_000_048: It wasn't just young ones struggling with the guards. Older folk attacked them as well, screaming bloody murder...
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_AURIAUNE_000_049: This was to be the end of it. Casualties at a peace conference, Fury take me...
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_EMERISSEL_100_049: She seemed like such a nice girl. Always greeted me with a smile when she passed. Never would've guessed she had it in her.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_NOIRTEREL_110_049: Pray forgive me, my . It's been chaos since preparations for the conference began, and I needed all the help I could get, and...and... How was I to know!?
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_NOIRTEREL_120_049: I only realized what had happened after we inspected the mug. Master Thancred tells me it was a sleeping agent of some sort...
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_ROTHE_130_049: Seven hells, the least he could've done is stop the bloody fool before he shot the second arrow!
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_INGARET_140_049: You should've seen the looks on their faces as they left. There's no fixing this.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_050: I daresay that could not have played out any worse, given that the first commander and Lord Artoirel are not here to take control of the situation.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_051: I spoke with a messenger who said that they would be returning shortly, but until they do, naught will be done. Lord Emmanellain has retreated to the barracks and is refusing to speak to anyone.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_052: Therefore it falls to us to ensure that order has been fully restored. Come, let us walk the streets and speak with the people.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_060: So far, it would seem that the worst has passed...
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENB02233_000_0: My wife and I fell while fleeing with the others at first. The chirurgeons tended to our bruises afterwards.
<sigh> Those mad fools have ruined everything, and for what?
I will never forgive them for this. Never!
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENC02233_000_0: I'd heard the rumors that the young lord was a drunken fool. What imbecile thought it would be a good idea to let him have the run of Falcon's Nest!?
Well, I say him and Ser Aymeric take their bloody “change” and shove it up their arses. I'll not be taken in by that rot again.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_CITIZENC02233_000_1: She's right, you know. We're naught but tools to them, to be used and discarded as they see fit. We all saw it.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_JOSSELOUX_000_110: They were wrong to resort to violence, but when I heard her speak, her words were as a dagger in my heart.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_JOSSELOUX_000_111: Who are we to decide that enough is enough? That their calls for justice can never be answered? Will this be the end of it, or will there be others like them and the True Brothers?
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_JOSSELOUX_000_112: I do not want to bear steel against my kinsman ever again. I do not know if I even can...
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_JOSSELOUX_000_120: I'm tired of it. I'm just so tired of it all.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_131: So, the violence has passed, but the people are far from recovered. That is to be expected.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_132: For the moment, it appears that no innocents were harmed by the guards. The blame for all casualties can be placed squarely upon the protesters.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_133: Nevertheless, the people will not soon forget the image of a young lordling ordering the public execution of an unarmed protester─one whose words resonated with the hearts of many.
TEXT_HEAVNC106_02236_THANCRED_000_134: After all, who among us has not lost loved ones...
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_CITIZENA02233_000_0: We cannot dishonor their memory. We must remember why they fought and died.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_CITIZENB02233_000_0: You were there, were you not? Then you must have seen it in the people's eyes. Not even Ser Aymeric could convince them to return.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_CITIZENC02233_000_0: The hells with them blue bloods. Can't believe I thought they might give half a damn about us. You can bet I won't be making that mistake again.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_020: Lord Artoirel and the first commander should have returned by now.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_021: To the tavern, then. Their first order of business will be to speak with Lord Emmanellain, and I somehow doubt that he has moved an ilm since last we saw him.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_ARTOIREL_000_025: Fury take me, what a disaster... I should never have left.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_030: My apologies, . I bear full responsibility for this...debacle.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_031: There will be time for that later. I, for one, am more concerned about picking up the pieces. What do we know?
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_032: According to initial reports, the protest was orchestrated by the young woman whom Lord Emmanellain ordered shot. She and her conspirators infiltrated Falcon's Nest posing as servants and guests.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_033: Several were taken alive. Others resisted and were struck down. Still others took their own lives.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_034: Our forces suffered casualties as well, but by the grace of the Fury, no civilians were seriously injured.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_035: Still more remarkably, the ringleader yet lives─for the time being, at least. The chirurgeons are doing what they can for her, but she may not live through the night.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_ARTOIREL_000_036: Given their impeccable timing, it is like that the Convictors who drew us away from the hamlet were in league with the protesters. Accordingly, we have detained them for questioning.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_ARTOIREL_000_037: <sigh> I'll be sworn that these villains spent as much effort plotting the failure of this peace conference as we did its success.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_038: Well, if the mood of the hamlet is any indication, theirs have been the more fruitful labors. In the wake of the protest, the people seem disillusioned.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_039: You spoke with them, then? I see...
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_040: ...Ser Aymeric placed his trust in me. It will be difficult to explain what has happened here.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_ARTOIREL_000_041: Remember how far we have come, First Commander. The people's faith may be shaken, but we convinced them before, and will do so again.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_ARTOIREL_000_042: If we can but find a means to remind them─to show them once more the promise that change holds for all─then this tragedy too shall pass into the past.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_043: We must pray that you are right. Nevertheless, for the time being, I have no choice but to suspend the peace conference, pending Ser Aymeric's final decision.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_044: Under the circumstances, I cannot leave Falcon's Nest. , will you deliver my report to the lord commander in my stead?
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_ARTOIREL_000_045: Get up, Emmanellain. You're going with .
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_ARTOIREL_000_048: You will answer for your actions. In person. Is that clear?
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_050: Your manservant is not here. In fact, I have not seen him for some time...
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_EMMANELLAIN_000_051: Honoroit...? Honoroit! I could have sworn he was...
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_LUCIA_000_060: Once I have determined that my presence is no longer required, I will return to the capital as well. Pray give my regards to the lord commander.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_ARTOIREL_000_065: I too had best remain here for a time. I should hope that the worst has passed, but it is too early to say for certain.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_EMMANELLAIN_000_070: Where are you, where are you...!?
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_075: Odd. The boy struck me as the rather devoted type. What reason would he have to leave his master unattended for so long?
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_EMMANELLAIN_000_085: I will take him to the chirurgeons! It is...it is the least I can do.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_090: ...I may have overreacted. But it needed to be done. He was becoming hysterical.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_091: I understand the desire to look for reasons. For excuses. To convince yourself you had no choice.
TEXT_HEAVNC107_02237_THANCRED_000_092: But the past is the past, and there is naught to be gained from reliving your mistakes. I know this. I know this. But he...
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_000: I will return to the capital as soon as I am able. Go, there is no need for you to remain.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_ARTOIREL_000_005: I heard what happened. You need not wait for Emmanellain and Honoroit.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_010: I have no desire to wait for the lordling to emerge from his puddle of self-pity. We have important matters to attend to in Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_020: We received troubling reports from Falcon's Nest. What befell you there?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_Q1_000_031: Proceed to the Seat of the Lord Commander?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_040: Word of the demonstration and its resolution outstripped you, . Every man, woman, and child of Ishgard has heard the tale.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_041: 'Tis rumored that my youngest's lack of judgment was to blame. Of course...such stories are prone to exaggeration. What exactly came to pass?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_042: ...I see. So that is the truth of it.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_043: Regardless of his intent, the result is undeniable. He has furthered the cause of these misguided few who cannot let go of the past.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_044: In an instant, the delicate peace we were poised to forge is once more beyond us.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_045: To dwell so deeply on the war and the vengeance it begets, only for that too to be taken away─is it any wonder that they were left bereft?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_046: For what was this sacrifice? Have we naught to show for our suffering? I thought peace a sufficient salve, but mayhap I was mistaken.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_047: We are warriors, Lord Edmont, and ours is a nation built on centuries of warfare. Right or wrong, this is who we are, and we deny it at our peril.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_048: To hold on to the past, without being beholden to it... Aye, we must needs find a way to honor the sacrifice of our forefathers without glorying in their excesses.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_049: A difficult path, to be sure. We dare not deny the scars which mar our nation's soul, lest we spur other disillusioned souls to retrace them...
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_100_049: ...But, as you say, we dare not revel in past glories either, for they are tainted all.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_050: A clear, unambiguous enemy, and an undeniably righteous cause... 'Tis a bitter reflection, but lies though they were, they did long serve to unite us.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_100_050: No truth will ever serve as well, I fear. Yet...we are not without options.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_051: At our last meeting, a proposal was tabled by the other members of the Eorzean Alliance for joint military exercises─to strengthen the ties between our nations, and test our readiness to meet with a common threat.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_052: I had thought to delay these exercises until after the peace conference, but mayhap a grand melee would be just the thing to lift our beleaguered spirits.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_053: Better still, an occasion for the Temple Knights and the watch to take the field as allies─a unified Ishgardian force filled with men and women from all walks of life, which would stand against a coalition of the allied nations' finest!
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_054: Hosted by Ishgard, in the shadow of the Gates of Judgement! A victory under such circumstances would serve as a reaffirmation─nay, a declaration to all and sundry that we are as strong and united as ever!
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_055: Such a victory would do much to fan the flames of patriotism, it is true. But if we should be defeated...? Though...even to hold our own against the cream of three nations might be presented as a triumph...
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_056: Very well. You may count on my support, for what little it is worth. However, I have a request: I would have my son Emmanellain take part in the grand melee.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_057: By his deeds has he brought shame upon Ishgard, and so by his deeds I would have him bring our nation honor.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_058: ...As you wish, my lord. If that is his desire, then it shall be so.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_059: Now then, we have no time to lose. , would you be so kind as to deliver my instructions to Lucia?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_060: I shall write to the Alliance leaders at once and begin making arrangements for the grand melee.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_061: Should you chance to see my son, pray inform him of his duty.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_062: If he has not already returned, he will soon enough─making every effort to avoid me.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_AYMERIC_000_070: Pray excuse me, . I have missives to write.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EDMONT_000_075: <sigh> I know my son. He will do his utmost to avoid me. See that he does not avoid you.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_080: Forgive me, . I arrived but a moment ago, and must needs unpack my things. We will speak anon.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_090: So that is their solution. A “grand melee” to unite the people...
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_091: And what part would they have you play in this affair, I wonder. You, whom they have taken into their confidence, upon whom they have come so heavily to rely.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_092: And will you oblige them, when the proposition is made? Will you stand for Ishgard once more?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_A2_000_094: We have come this far, have we not?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_A2_000_095: I will stand for my friends and comrades, not a nation.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_A3_000_096: It is getting to be a bit much, isn't it...
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_100: Well, when you put it like that, I suppose it would be a shame not to see it through to the bitter end.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_105: You say that, and yet here you are. Here we are. This is, after all, the life we chose.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_106: In any event, let us not forget that the Ascians sought to profit from this war. To put an end to it is to put an end to their plot, and that, my friend, is ever a worthy cause.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_110: A poor choice of words. For friends tried and true, then. The living and the lost.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_115: So, for this grand melee of his, Ser Aymeric wishes to field a force comprising both his Temple Knights and Hilda's watch, yes? I can only imagine what she will have to say about that.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_116: In fact, curiosity compels me to go and see for myself.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_120: Hm? I thought you had something to discuss with the first commander?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_SYMME_000_125: Huzzah! We've been spoiling for a fight! We won't let Ser Aymeric down, you'll see!
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EUDESTAND_000_130: (Bloody fool doesn't realize he'll have to sit this one out. If all the watch ran off with Ser Aymeric to play soldier, who'd be left to keep an eye on things here?)
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_HILDA_000_135: ...Because of course he had to deliver the news in person, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_140: Well met, . Have you spoken with Ser Aymeric?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_141: ...I was aware of the Alliance's request. So─Ser Aymeric would turn these exercises into a spectacle for the masses.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_142: It is not that I doubt the efficacy of such a plan. Indeed, I know its effectiveness only too well, having witnessed it firsthand...
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_143: Nevertheless, he has not once given me reason to doubt his intentions─and these are desperate times indeed.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_144: I will select knights for the event forthwith. As for the watch─
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_145: ...Did he now? How considerate of Master Thancred to seek out our young watch commander of his own volition.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_146: Alas, he acted prematurely. Pray deliver this list of watch candidates to Hilda. I would have her best men, not her most dispensable.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_150: Forgive me, but I have much to do. Send Hilda my regards.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_HILDA_000_160: Thancred's been tellin' me all about Ser Aymeric's grand soirée. Seems we're expected to join in.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_HILDA_000_161: It's nice of him to invite us and all, but I hope he knows what he's doin'─'cause we ain't dressed to dance with professional bleedin' soldiers.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_HILDA_000_162: ...Well, well─seems the first commander's gone and handpicked her guests. Can't say I disagree with her choices, though. She's got a good eye.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_HILDA_000_163: Will you be fightin' too? Reckon it'd inspire the lads if you were. Might take their minds off gettin' their hides tanned, and all. Think about it, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_164: I hate to ask, but you haven't seen our favorite lordling, have you?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_165: <sigh> I thought not. On the assumption that he is not to be found in his father's loving embrace, I suggest we split up and look for him. I will search Foundation, and you the Pillars.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_170: ...Do not look at me like that. I will begin my search in due time.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_HILDA_000_175: I still can't believe he actually hit the daft bastard. Gods, I wish I'd been there to see it!
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_180: Hilda did not object to my selections, then? Good.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_191: Our best chirurgeons are tending to him as we speak. He has yet to wake, but surely...surely he will.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_192: So Father has volunteered me for this “grand melee” of theirs?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_100_192: <sigh> My beloved family. Always making my decisions for me.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_193: No, it's not like that! It's just... Oh, you wouldn't understand. How could you? You are free to be the  you want to be, whereas I...I...
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_194: I am a son of House Fortemps, don't you see? My future was determined before I was born. What I could and could not do.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_195: Right or wrong, that was the way of it─until the old order began to crumble. Now we wander amidst the rubble, searching for a purpose, for a place...
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_196: All around me, brave men and women rise to the occasion. With faith and conviction they dedicate themselves to their causes. But not I.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_100_196: I was terrified of making the wrong choice, which is why I let better men make them for me. Do this, do that, take this duty, guard this conference─
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_197: I suppose I had convinced myself I was above it...until your friend showed me otherwise.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_198: When I saw Honoroit, I wanted to scream. I wanted someone to blame! But, in the end, there was only me. Only me.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_199: So you see, I cannot meekly bow my head and accept Father's command. Such cowardice is what brought me to this point.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_200: I will go to Ser Aymeric, and I will make my own decision.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_EMMANELLAIN_000_210: No more excuses. This will be my choice, and mine alone.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_TEMPLEKIGHTGATE_000: The lord commander is not to be disturbed. May I ask what matter demands his personal attention?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_Q3_000_223: Proceed to the Seat of the Lord Commander?
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_230: We would not have come this far were it not for you, .
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_LUCIA_000_235: It has been an honor and a privilege.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_240: Gods help me, I think it might be love.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_241: I daresay it might be cheating, too. Your mere presence is enough to turn the tide of most battles.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_242: And did you see the way his eyes lit up when you nodded? 'Twas a look of boundless relief and joy. One would think a politician more practiced at concealing his emotion.
TEXT_HEAVNC108_02238_THANCRED_000_243: Still, his honesty does him credit. For a moment, I was fair inspired to pledge myself to the cause. But that would be improper. This is their fight─and yours─but not mine.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_THANCRED_000_000: Mayhap I ought to fight for the other side─you know, even the odds.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_LUCIA_000_010: Ser Aymeric informs me that the Alliance leaders have agreed to his proposal. The grand melee will be held here, in the shadow of the Gates of Judgement, and in sight of the capital.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_LUCIA_000_011: An announcement has been made, and Allied forces are currently en route.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_LUCIA_000_012: The eyes of Ishgard are upon us, . We must not fail.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_THANCRED_000_013: A rare opportunity to see you pit yourself against Allied forces─outside of Carteneau, perhaps. I would not miss this for the world.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_AYMERIC_000_020: 'Tis a matter of pride for the Alliance as well. They will not scruple to send their best against us. Yet we must not be cowed. Too much rests on our success.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_LUCIA_000_025: The second commander and Hilda's lieutenants shall see to the security of the city in my absence. The melee demands my undivided attention.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_HILDA_000_030: It ain't often highborn dandies deign to fight alongside us hoi polloi. Like all our namedays rolled into one, it is.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_HILDA_000_031: Then again, it's our national pride that's at stake. National and personal. I ain't about to let a snotty-nosed lordling show me up.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_THANCRED_000_035: It looks to be a veritable who's who of the Eorzean Alliance. The only question is: who came to watch and who came to fight? Hmm...Nanamo. Definitely Nanamo.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_MESSENGER02239_000_: , you honor us with your presence. There is a scurrilous rumor going around that you will be taking the field with the Ishgardians. It, uh... It isn't true, is it?
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_LOANNE_000_037: The field has been made ready. All that remains is for the participants to assemble.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_CHAUNOLLET_000_038: Temple Knights fighting side by side with humble watchmen... A queer sight, but somehow...right.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_EMMANELLAIN_000_040: There  is! I say, when you didn't appear, I began to question... N-Nothing! Never mind!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_EMMANELLAIN_000_041: Ahem. To think that we are mere moments away from facing the cream of Eorzea's soldiery in battle. That I am...mere...mmm... But what if...?
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_EMMANELLAIN_000_042: Oh, what am I saying!? I have to stop imagining the worst! I must think of the victory, of the glory! Of the stories I will tell Honoroit when he awakes!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_EMMANELLAIN_000_050: I am ready, old ! Are you!?
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_EMMANELLAIN_000_051: By the Fury, how could I forget? Father bid me present this to you.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_EMMANELLAIN_000_052: I know it is sudden, but we believe the men would find it inspiring if you bore the colors of House Fortemps into battle. Pray do us this honor.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_SYSTEM_000_053: During the grand melee, some of your gear will be glamoured. Your attributes and abilities will be unaffected.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_TEMPLEKNIGHT02239_0: (-Flustered Temple Knight-)Cyclops! Cyclops! Everyone, on your guard!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_THANCRED_000_062: Continue the melee! I will deal with him!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_HILDA_000_063:
Hmph. Daft sod...
You heard the man! Back to it!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_AYMERIC_000_064: All forces, form a line on ! Now!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_RAUBAHN_000_065:
. I will not lie─I was hoping it would come to this.
So then...shall we dance?
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_PIPPIN_000_080: As long as I live, I shall never forget that duel. It was inspiring and humbling in equal measure. I feel honor-bound to point out, however, that my father was fighting one-handed.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_THANCRED_000_085: I believe the Flame General would like a word.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_AYMERIC_000_090: I confess, it stung my pride to be brushed aside so easily. But when the flames subsided, and I saw you standing there triumphant, there was only gladness in my heart.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_LUCIA_000_095: The messengers have already been dispatched. Let us pray that this victory has the desired effect.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_HILDA_000_100: That was just another battle for you, I bet, but for my lot... Hmph. It weren't so much the fightin' as the not trippin' over each other's feet. His lordship might think about layin' on some actual trainin' for us next time.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_EMMANELLAIN_000_105: What are we waiting for!? We must return to the capital at once and tell them all about our victory!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_LOANNE_000_106: What a sight! Blades flashing, magicks dazzling─I could scarce make out who had the advantage from one moment to the next. And that duel... By the Fury, I was wringing my hands until the very end! I cannot wait to tell the others!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_CHAUNOLLET_000_107: Never did I doubt! Nay, not for a moment! By the Fury, I could fair burst with pride! Ishgard! Ishgard!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_RAUBAHN_000_110: Thal's balls... I had forgotten what it was like to feel so alive!
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_RAUBAHN_000_111: Not since leaving the bloodsands have I had the privilege. Not since the Bull of Ala Mhigo hung up his swords.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_RAUBAHN_000_112: Back then, the outcome might have been different. But I do not begrudge you your victory. I know how far you have come, how much you have endured. Our fight only confirmed it.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_RAUBAHN_000_113: We shall have to do this again one day, when time allows. I shall look forward to it. Now go. Go to the Ishgardians and celebrate your victory. You have earned it.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_RAUBAHN_000_114: Come, Pipin. Her Grace is expecting us.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_THANCRED_000_121: In all the years I have known Raubahn, I cannot recall ever seeing him look so happy in defeat.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_THANCRED_000_122: Well! Everything seems to be falling into place, does it not? The Ishgardians have claimed their symbolic victory, and the Eorzean Alliance has been strengthened in the process. Be proud, . You made this happen.
TEXT_HEAVNC109_02239_SYSTEM_000_130: You have learned the emote Victory!
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_THANCRED_000_000: I cannot help but wonder what would have happened had you lost... Fantastical though such a state of affairs unquestionably is. I daresay the world would simply have ended.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_LUCIA_000_005: When you are ready to return, pray inform the lord commander.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_HILDA_000_010: I never imagined our humble gatherin' of like-minded souls would grow into somethin' proper, let alone a force fit to trade blows with the Alliance's finest. Can't say I didn't enjoy it, neither. Funny how things turn out, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_EMMANELLAIN_000_015: I do hope Honoroit recovers soon. I have so much to tell him!
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_AYMERIC_000_020: We have done it─nay, you have done it. You have brought us the victory we so desperately needed.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_AYMERIC_000_021: There is naught left but to return to the capital. Come─let us see what reception awaits us.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_030: They say you dueled General Raubahn within a ring of flames. I did not think the man so ostentatious. Would that I could have seen it...
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_031: After we parted ways in Matoya's Cave, I returned here to speak with Tataru. We agreed to tell the others only that our search for Minfilia had reached an impasse.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_032: I subsequently learned that you had left for Falcon's Nest, but I thought it best to keep to myself for a time. I am wont to rely on you overmuch when we are together, and I needed to think. To reflect.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_033: I still do, I suspect, but matters here seemed to be coming to a head. In short, there are some things I feel I must say─though nothing so urgent that it cannot wait until after the conference.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_034: So let us make for Falcon's Nest, and see if Lord Artoirel has need of our assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_040: As Ser Aymeric hoped, Ishgard's success at the grand melee has done much to restore the people's faith in this endeavor. Look on their faces, . Nervous, yet hopeful... Expectant, in a word.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_CITIZENA02240_000_0: I held on to the anger for so long. It was the only way I could cope with my husband's passing. But my daughter, stubborn as she is, insisted that we attend.
I never thought this day would come. Never wanted it. Never needed it. But when I saw all these young ones... For their sake, then...and perhaps for his memory too.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_CITIZENB02240_000_0: Did you hear how Ishgard trounced the Alliance forces in the grand melee? Hah, I knew they would be no match for us!
All credit to the lord commander, I say. I know some still had their doubts about his watch initiative, but who can argue with results like that?
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_CITIZENA02233_000_0: I haven't forgotten about what happened, but everyone else seems willing to give Ser Aymeric another chance...so I will, too.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_CITIZENB02233_000_0: While I am here, my family are at home celebrating the birth of our grandson. Though it pains me to be so far away, my wife insisted that one of us attend the ceremony, to tell the boy of this day when he is old enough to understand.
The world he will know as an adult shall be much changed if Ser Aymeric's conference succeeds─and if each and every one of us lends him our support.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_CITIZENC02233_000_0: It true that lordling fought in the grand melee? Bugger me, that must've been a thing to see. But they say he acquitted himself well enough. His way of making amends, I'll wager.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_REDWALD_000_056: Much has been said of your role in the grand melee. Needless to say, more than a few of my subordinates have implored me to invite you to a training session, that they might benefit from your guidance─though such conversations can wait.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_TOURCENET_000_057: After that disaster with the protesters, it seemed like the conference was doomed to failure. But now? Sometimes it feels like nothing even happened. I'm glad and all, but it's a bit surprising, even strange...
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_AURIAUNE_000_058: Wait...you aren't about to leave, are you? The Dravanian emissary could arrive at any moment!
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_EMERISSEL_000_059: All seems well for now. Nevertheless, we can ill afford to be caught off guard a second time.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_NOIRTEREL_100_059: No time to talk! I've got to prepare enough soup to feed a bloody conference, in case you haven't noticed!
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ROTHE_110_059: Praise Halone, I was beginnin' to think that scaffold would never get used! We worked like beasts to build the bloody thing in time, only for the protest to delay everything. Better late than never, anyway.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_INGARET_120_059: Rest assured that we will take no chances this time. All guests have been questioned, and we will have people watching the crowd for the duration of the ceremony.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ARTOIREL_000_060: Well met,  , and thank you for looking after my brother.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ARTOIREL_000_061: They say he fought bravely─that he did not dishonor his house. But you, my ─to you we owe everything.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ARTOIREL_000_062: As you can see, we have made every effort to strike while the iron is hot. We made our intentions known, and that all would be welcome to attend. And so they came. By the grace of the Fury, they came.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ARTOIREL_000_063: The ceremony will not be a lengthy affair, but there is still much to be done! I would speak with you more, but I must see to my duties. As for you and Master Alphinaud─you will do naught but enjoy yourselves, is that clear? If any dare beg your assistance again, I will have words.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Well, there you have it. We have been forbidden from meddling. Shall we wait, or have you other matters to attend to before the ceremony begins?
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_A1_000_072: Wait with Alphinaud for the ceremony to begin.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_074: By all means, then. I will remain here.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Excellent. I only hope Thancred and the others will not be late. Epochal events do not come around very often.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_079: There they go, the last of the guests. Having come hither with hope in their hearts, they depart with hatred and bloodlust...
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Until the moment I saw him strike, I still held some small hope that what you had seen in Azys Lla was...an illusion, perhaps. But he acted without hesitation...as did Ser Aymeric.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_081: For a mercy, Vidofnir's wound was not mortal, or so Lucia tells me. The dragon was spirited away to Anyx Trine to receive care from her brethren. We can but hope her recovery is swift.
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_082: ...But such was surely Nidhogg's intent. To deliver a proclamation not only to the children of Thordan, but to his kindred. “War is coming, and ye who do not stand with us stand apart.”
TEXT_HEAVNC110_02240_ALPHINAUD_000_083: She was an example─a message to her brood. Another instrument of his vengeance...like Estinien.
