TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_000: When I said I wished to speak with you after the conference, I confess I envisaged rather happier circumstances. If anything, however, this latest tragedy makes the need more pressing. There are things I must say.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Not to the Warrior of Light, or even my fellow Scion, but...to you, . My friend.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Ah, but of course. The intercessory in Camp Dragonhead is still open to us. Let us go there.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Thank you, . It is unfair of me to unburden myself in this manner, time after time, but I am glad that you permit me nonetheless. You are my true friend and ally.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Though not all of our fellow Scions will support our stance on Estinien, I have faith that we will win them over in due course. Such is the infectious power of hope.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Right. That is quite enough solemn introspection for one . I think we would both benefit from some time in the company of Tataru. She stays for us at Fortemps Manor. Let us not keep her waiting any longer.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_TATARU_000_020: (Well! Alphinaud certainly seems to be in better spirits. Do we have you to thank for this?)
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Yet again we walk an all-too-familiar path. I am reminded of when we first came to this manor.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Lost and uncertain, we were granted succor in our hour of need. We were saved─and now it is our turn to return the favor!
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_TATARU_000_032: Hear, hear! Let no one say that the Scions do not repay their debts!
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_TATARU_000_033: After all, what kind of people would we be if we forsook our friends? If we stopped looking for Yda and Papalymo, or if we gave up hope of bringing Minfilia back?
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Though she knew it would cost her dearly, Minfilia reached out to us to deliver a message. She believed it was imperative that we understand the true nature of this star─of the rift between Zodiark and Hydaelyn, and of the Ascians' aspirations.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_035: But for all that has been revealed, I cannot shake the suspicion that there is much we have yet to learn...
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_ALPHINAUD_000_036: In any event, I think it time we step back from the fray and carefully consider our next course of action. It will not be easy to turn this tragedy to triumph, but we will find a way. We will. We will.
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_SYSTEM_000_040: You have learned the emote Battle Stance!
TEXT_HEAVNC111_02241_PAPALYMO_000_050: Caution, Yda─that is all I ask! Do not be so eager to place your faith in them. Not until we know more.
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_HOUSEFORTEMPSKNIGHT: Ah,  ! It is well that you are here. You are wanted within.
I believe Master Alphinaud wishes a word with you...
Master Alphinaud awaits within the manor. He appeared quite anxious to speak with you.
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Ah, , there you are. Have you a moment? There is something I would fain discuss.
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_ALPHINAUD_000_004: I must ask you to recall the events which unfolded at the peace conference, though I daresay you would sooner forget them.
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_ALPHINAUD_000_005: My mind returns again and again to the moment when Nidhogg appeared before the crowd in the guise of Estinien. It was a sight to chill the soul─but one which gave me reason to hope that our friend might not be beyond salvation. When you described his fateful transformation at Azys Lla, I feared him lost forever, but the mere fact that some semblance of his former self endures must surely count for something. Alas, I have no evidence to support this impression...
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_ALPHINAUD_000_006: Thus did I turn to Y'shtola and Krile for a more empirical appraisal─and full glad am I that I did, for it would seem they have some observations of their own to share.
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_TATARU_000_007: The ladies have saved us a table at the Forgotten Knight. Shall we go?
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Excellent. Let us not keep our honored colleagues waiting.
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_YSHTOLA_000_010: The name does this establishment a disservice. Remarkably few of its patrons seem inclined to drink their way to oblivion. I do begin to see why Tataru chose to work here.
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_TATARU_000_020: I think I'll stay here at the Knight for the time being. After all, the rumors are fresh and the extra coin is always welcome!
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_HONOROIT_000_021: Have you visited the lord commander,  ? Then might I encourage you to report to the Congregation of Our Knights Most Heavenly at your earliest convenience? I would not have it said that I failed to pass on Ser Aymeric's summons.
TEXT_HEAVND101_02242_ALPHINAUD_000_030: What news has Ser Aymeric to share with us, I wonder...?
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Hmmm... Might Ser Aymeric perchance have received word of a Dravanian advance?
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_002: ...Or mayhap they have located Esti─ That is to say, mayhap Nidhogg has been found!
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Come! I would hear what the lord commander has to say!
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I somehow doubt that Hraesvelgr will be pleased to see us. But for Estinien's sake, and that of countless others, I suppose we must risk his displeasure.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_TATARU_000_035: I think I'll stay here at the Knight for the time being. After all, the rumors are fresh and the extra coin won't go amiss!
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_AYMERIC_000_040: It grieves me to impose upon you in this manner, but you of all people understand the threat we now face.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_041: It is no imposition, Ser Aymeric─to  and I, Ishgard is as a second home.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_042: After the many battles we have fought and the bonds we have forged, the plight of your nation has become our own. If there is aught that we can do to aid in its salvation, then pray impose all you must.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_044: Shall we be about our task, then? We have no way of knowing when Nidhogg's shade will strike, but we must assume that time is not our ally.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_AYMERIC_000_045: Indeed. With that in mind, I have taken the liberty of dispatching a messenger to inform Mistress Tataru that you will be escorting me to Sohm Al. I confess, I did not provide the exact details of our destination, as they are as yet unknown to me...
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_046: We will summon Hraesvelgr at Zenith in the Churning Mists. Ere we begin our ascent, however, I think it best that we pay a visit to Anyx Trine.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_AYMERIC_000_047: You seek an advantage in the coming negotiations?
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_048: I do. I would consult with Vidofnir.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_049: I propose this in part out of concern for her condition. Were she to succumb to her wounds, it could have grave consequences for our alliance. That apart, she may be able to provide insight into her sire's current state of mind.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_AYMERIC_000_050: Well reasoned. To the Dravanian forelands, then.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_TATARU_000_055: A nice young knight told me you were off to negotiate with Hraesvelgr again. Have you considered using the Manderville art of parley? It's surprisingly effective, you know!
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_VIDOFNIR_000_060: Ah, 'tis the warrior of warriors and  companions. What bringeth you to mine abode?
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Pray forgive us for disturbing your recuperation, Vidofnir. I hope your wound does not pain you overmuch...
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_VIDOFNIR_000_062: Didst thou imagine me close to death? The thrust was deep, but not mortal. I will heal in time.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_AYMERIC_000_063: Full glad am I to hear it. You were the guest of honor at our conference, and we failed in our duty of protection. On behalf of Ishgard, I apologize unreservedly.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_VIDOFNIR_000_064: ...I am a dragon full-grown, and thou thought to protect me, mortal? I was tempered by the fires of battle ere thy great-grandsire learned to crawl.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_VIDOFNIR_000_065: Thy words do remind me of a knight whom I called friend some thousand years past. He swore to defend me from harm and hardship...
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_AYMERIC_000_066: Would that we could return to that era of peace, when man and dragon knew such comradeship.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_067: Would that our every effort to do so were not undone by ancient rancor...
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_VIDOFNIR_000_068: For a truth, there can be no peace while Nidhogg's shade yet lingereth.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_069: That much is plain─yet we lack the strength to banish him. Thus do we make for Sohm Al, to beseech the aid of your sire once more.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_VIDOFNIR_000_070: Folly. Thou know'st as well as I how he will answer.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_AYMERIC_000_071:
...Hraesvelgr's heart remains unchanged, then. A pity.
But if it is folly to hope, I am content to die a fool.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_VIDOFNIR_000_072: As hath ever been the way with thy kind. Go then, but be warned: the shade's presence hath driven its minions to frenzy.
TEXT_HEAVND102_02243_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Thank you, Vidofnir. We shall disturb your rest no longer.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_AYMERIC_000_005: Lucia's report described Anyx Trine in detail, but her words failed to convey the overwhelming strangeness of standing here in the demesne of dragons.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_ALPHINAUD_000_010:
Though I expected no better answer from Vidofnir, I take little pleasure from having been proven right. 'Twould seem that our presence at Zenith will be every bit as unwelcome as I had anticipated. But what is the ire of one great wyrm to a trio of self-confessed fools such as ourselves?
Let us begin our ascent.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Scout ahead if you wish, . We shall join you outside Moghome!
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_ALPHINAUD_000_015: The lord commander seems lost for words. Nor can I blame him. I recall being similarly awestruck when I first beheld this vista.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_AYMERIC_000_020:
I had heard tales of the world above the clouds, but never did I dream...
One's mind paints a pale picture of its majesty.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Few live to see such wonders. I am reminded of my first visit to this peak, when Estinien and Ysayle yet walked at our side...
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Ah, if it isn't Mog... Mog...uh...
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_024: (-Churning Mists Moogle-)Don't tell me you've forgotten my name, kupo!? After all we've been through together!
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_025:
(-Churning Mists Moogle-)But at least you remember me!
You...you do remember me, don't you, ?
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_A1_000_001: How could I forget you, Moglin!
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_A1_000_003: Apologies, friend, but all moogles look the same to me...
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_027: (-Churning Mists Moogle-)H-How could you mistake me for that overstuffed throne-warmer!? I'm Moghan! The courageous moogle who guided you to Zenith, kupo!
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_028: (-Churning Mists Moogle-)Phew! You seemed a bit hesitant for a moment there! But I'm sure you were just fondly recalling the time we camped near Zenith, right, kupo?
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_029: (-Churning Mists Moogle-)...I see, kupo. Then I suppose our time around the campfire meant less to you than I thought it did. It's “Moghan,” by the way... <sniff>
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_030: But putting our shared history to one side, what brings you and your friends to Moghome, kupo?
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_031: Ah, another audience with old Hraesvelgr...
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_032: Well, I hope you've brought the horn, kupo! With the winds as gentle as they are, a good loud toot should reach the great wyrm's ears easily enough!
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_ALPHINAUD_000_033: That is good to hear, Moghan─thank you. We had best press on to Zenith, while the winds are in our favor.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_034: Now that was unexpected, kupo. Chieftain Moglin will want to hear about this!
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_035: Did you meet with Hraesvelgr already, kupo? You never know when the winds will pick up again!
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_AYMERIC_000_037: We must win Hraesvelgr to our cause. Fail in this and Ishgard's fate is all but sealed.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Another day, another trial. Such ordeals must seem almost mundane to you by now. Would that I could say the same.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_AYMERIC_000_045: For the sake of Ishgard, I shall overcome whatever trial is placed before me. And I have no doubt that you will do the same, .
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_AYMERIC_000_046: I believe I spied a wyvern landing just outside the palace. It is doubtless one of the “children” of whom Hraesvelgr spoke.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_AYMERIC_000_047: Come, my friends: let us not keep our escort waiting.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_WYVERN02244_000_050: My broodmates and I will bear you to the place of your trial. Make your preparations.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_WYVERN02244_000_055: Great Hraesvelgr honors you with this trial. Prepare to be sorely tested...
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_WYVERN02244_000_060: You have proven yourself in the eyes of great Hraesvelgr. I did not think such a thing possible...
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_AYMERIC_000_065: Countless times have I fought the minions of Nidhogg, but never did I imagine that I would one day face Hraesvelgr himself.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Oh...ohhh... Oh, my poor ribs... That was a painful reminder of a great wyrm's might...
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_AYMERIC_000_073: And had he truly meant us harm, we would not be standing here now. Plainly, his intent was to teach. His onslaught forced me to recall my training─about the speed of the dragon, his balance, his blind spots... It was, in short, a very thorough lesson.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGLIN_000_074: Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow...kupo. , let me begin by congratulating you on the completion of your trial.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGLIN_000_075: For one with a name more befitting a jester, you fight with the savagery of a rabid demon.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGLIN_000_076: Do you see how my wings are kinked? Even my pom aches! After this drubbing, I fear my loyal subjects will have to bear the load of my personal chores for quite some time, kupo. Possibly indefinitely.
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_077: What!? When I told you about 's trial, I didn't mean for the rest of us to suffer...
TEXT_HEAVND103_02244_MOGHAN_000_079:
<splutter> Triple!? But that's not fair!!!
There's no justice, kupo... None at all!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_AYMERIC_000_005: Ishgard will not last long against Nidhogg and his Horde. We must away!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_ALPHINAUD_000_001: I pray we are not too late...
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_TEMPLEKNIGHTB02245_: You would venture onto the Steps of Faith?
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_SCENE00017_EVENTARE: Proceed to the Steps of Faith?
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_BELTARDOIS_000_060: The Horde shall break itself upon the bulwark of the Temple Knights!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_MARCELAIN_000_061: The Dravanians shall find death at the points of our spears!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_LOANNE_000_062: Let the dragons come! We do not fear them!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_CHAUNOLLET_000_063: If the price be mine own life, I shall gladly spend it to purchase peace for Ishgard!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Through the haze of pain, I swear I sensed─ But no. The past is done, and we must look to the future. At long last, Nidhogg is gone, his foul spirit cast out once and for all. I only pray that Estinien survives the ordeal...
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_BELTARDOIS_000_070: I bid you welcome, slayer of Nidhogg! Ever do the gates of Ishgard stand open to our savior!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_MARCELAIN_000_071: Warrior of warriors! It is ever a pleasure to see you.
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_LOANNE_000_072: The light of the Holy See has faded, and the wyrm's shadow darkens our walls no more. That I would live to witness the passing of one age into the next...
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_CHAUNOLLET_000_073: Nay, I'll not deny it: without your skill and fortitude, the city would now be ash. Would that more of your adventuring brethren possessed such qualities.
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_QUOMONRENTIN_000_07: The Horde is routed, aye, but I will not count this war over until each blackened stone has been replaced.
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_GONDELIMBAUD_000_07: 'Tis you! The champion who slew Nidhogg! Your deeds shall pass into legend, yet I am honored to speak with you thus in the flesh!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_VAINCANNET_000_076: The Horde is fled, and there is much cause to celebrate...but I shall keep one eye on the horizon nonetheless.
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_TESCELINGEON_000_07:
After centuries of fighting, are we finally at peace...?
Bah! What a mawkish old fool I've become! I must needs return to my duties!
TEXT_HEAVND104_02245_HANDELOUP_000_078: Though our principal foe lies defeated, we shall continue to keep order inside the walls and protect the citizenry. In that much at least, the duties of the Temple Knights remain unchanged.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Your battle with Nidhogg's shade will beget many an epic ballad, , and rightly so. It was, without a doubt, one of your more epochal victories─though I must admit that I took greater joy in seeing you emerge from the experience unscathed.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_ALPHINAUD_000_002: ...And not only for your own sake. Had you not been there to aid me, those infernal eyes would still be fused to Estinien's mail...
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Yet even with Nidhogg gone, I cannot help but wonder how much of our friend remains... Let us pay a visit to Lucia, and beg news of his condition.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Let us speak with Lucia. She will know how Estinien fares.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_LUCIA_000_010: , Master Alphinaud...my honored friends... As if winning Hraesvelgr to our cause were not enough, you took it upon yourselves to rid us of his brood-brother... I know not how to thank you.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_ALPHINAUD_000_011: My own contribution was hardly noteworthy. The true saviors of the day were  and Estinien. One triumphed over Nidhogg's shade through strength of arms and the other through strength of will.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_ALPHINAUD_000_012: ...And speaking of Estinien, what news of his recovery?
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_LUCIA_000_013: The Azure Dragoon was conveyed to the infirmary, where he now resides under the care of our hospitalier captain. I am told he has yet to regain consciousness.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_LUCIA_000_014: But as you know, Estinien's mind and body were held hostage for many days. We must be patient, and allow the process of healing to begin. In the meantime, you would do well to rest and recover from your own ordeals.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_LUCIA_000_016: Ser Aymeric is never long from Estinien's bedside, and will send word the moment there are any developments. Now, if I have satisfied your concerns, I believe Lord Edmont and his sons are most eager to celebrate your return.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_ALPHINAUD_000_018: Come, ─'twould seem that we are awaited at Fortemps Manor.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_LUCIA_000_019: Pray call upon Lord Edmont. I gather Fortemps Manor holds its breath for your return.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_EDMONT_000_020: Go, Warrior of Light. We will not begrudge you time spent at a comrade's sickbed.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_ARTOIREL_000_025: At long last, Nidhogg is gone... No true son of Ishgard could wish for more. Yet scores of my brother knights fell in the battle, and I find my joy tempered by their loss...
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_EMMANELLAIN_000_030: Without the guiding hand of yours truly, House Haillenarte's famous dragonkillers wouldn't have killed half so many dragons just now─as I shall be sure to tell my lady when next we meet...
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_HONOROIT_000_035: If my lord's irrepressible optimism were ever to fix upon something about which he had cause to be optimistic, I dare not think what he might achieve.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_BUTLER02246_000_040: Once more you risk your life in service to Ishgard. We are forever in your debt.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_HOUSEFORTEMPSSTEWAR:
We prayed for your safe return,  . If I may be so bold...
Welcome home.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_AYMERIC_000_050:
, my friend. What can I do for the savior of Ishgard?
...You seek Master Alphinaud? Ah. He came to relieve me of my vigil a short while ago.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_AYMERIC_000_051: When he begged to sit at Estinien's side, I could not well refuse him.
TEXT_HEAVND105_02246_AYMERIC_000_052:
Though he would sooner faint than admit it, the boy must be exhausted by Hraesvelgr's trial and all that followed...
Estinien is blessed to have such devoted comrades.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_001: My own friendship with Estinien began some ten years past, shortly after we joined the Temple Knights...
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_002: I learned his name soon enough, but Estinien barely registered my existence. I was less a fellow recruit, and more a shadow which occasionally darkened his path.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_003: And so I might have remained, had fate not seen fit to intervene. While out on patrol, our company was set upon by a dragon, and we were the only two to survive. The experience forged a bond between us, as such life-threatening situations are wont to do.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_004: Despite our friendship, he remained an intense and solitary youth, wholly obsessed with claiming vengeance against Nidhogg. Revenge was ever at the forefront of his mind─revenge for the death of his parents, and revenge for his younger brother.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_005: I would venture that in Alphinaud he sees something of his lost sibling.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_006: And in the ungentle chidings of Estinien, Alphinaud has found the elder brother he never had.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_007: Truth be told, Estinien's tactless observations have saved me from disaster more than once, and I can well understand Alphinaud's affection for him. He is a friend for whom I would gladly─
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_TEMPLEKNIGHT02247_0: Lord Commander! Your presence is required in the infirmary!
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_009: Is he─ Tell them I am on my way!
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_TEMPLEKNIGHT02247_0: Captain Whitecape ordered me to fetch Ser Aymeric with all haste. I know no more than that.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_HANDELOUP_000_012: I did not take the Azure Dragoon for a man to pass in his bed...
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_020: Quickly, ! We must go to him!
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_SYSTEM_000_021: Upon proceeding to the infirmary, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_SYSTEM_000_022: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_030: I was gazing out at the Sea of Clouds, in an all too rare moment of idleness, when I chanced to behold a certain hero wending  way towards the city on dragonback. Welcome home, .
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_031: Nay, 'twas no grave matter that moved me to greet you in person. Between you and me, I merely sought respite from the pressures of office... No sooner do I surrender my role as temporary head of state than I am burdened with a position of more permanent responsibility!
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_032: I fancy that it echoes in some small measure the way you must feel when your improbable feats of heroism are rewarded with still more impossible challenges...
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_033: The myth which guided our society for generations lies in tatters─am I then to be scorned for building upon the system of nobility that I once sought to tear down? And what strange jest is this that places me at its pinnacle? An archbishop's bastard at the head of the House of Lords...
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_034: ...Ah, but these questions are for me to answer.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_035: It is not in man's nature to change overnight. This I learned through painful experience. And it was this hard lesson which convinced me to take the path which we now follow. Even as we rebuild the bridge between man and dragon, so must we reimagine Ishgard─one carefully placed stone at a time.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_036: We must remember that it is not for us that we lay this groundwork, but for the men and women that our children will become. May their towers rise proudly from the fundament of our legacy.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_037: ...I hear word from Captain Whitecape that Estinien has vanished from his sickroom. His willfulness survives undiminished.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_038: Should you ever happen upon our unmannerly friend on your travels, pray assure him that I shall keep Ishgard safe until he deigns to come home.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_AYMERIC_000_039: Thank you, . And please, convey my warmest regards to Master Alphinaud.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_TATARU_000_040:
You've saved the day again, !
...Not that I ever doubted you would!
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_ALPHINAUD_000_050: You spoke with Ser Aymeric? I do not envy him his new position.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Ishgard has chosen a new road, but one littered with the detritus of a thousand years of broken faith.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Yet though her people may stumble from time to time, I know of none better than Ser Aymeric to lead the march of progress.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_ALPHINAUD_000_053: As for us, there remains the small matter of ushering in a new dawn in the shadow of inscrutable Ascian machinations and a seemingly endless procession of primals... But we too must walk our chosen path─no matter how treacherous the footing!
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_SYSTEM_000_070: In the wake of Ishgard's governmental reform, new airship routes have been sanctioned. You may now travel to a selection of distant locales from the landing in Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_WARRIOROFDARKNESS_0: Thank you, Blanhaerz. Nay, you need not remain there. We shall rendezvous at the usual place.
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_ELIDIBUS_000_061: All is proceeding as expected, then?
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_WARRIOROFDARKNESS_0: Aye, there is naught to concern us. Aside from one overly curious mouse...
TEXT_HEAVND106_02247_ELIDIBUS_000_065: It is of no moment. They will play their part, and we will play ours...
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_HOUSEFORTEMPSKNIGHT: ,  ! You are come at a most excellent time.
An invitation from a truly preeminent personage was delivered to the manor but a short while ago. Would that you had been present to receive it, but in any event...
Ser Aymeric de Borel, lord speaker of the House of Lords, lord commander of the Temple Knights, and viscount of House Borel, cordially invites   to dine with him at his estate.
You seem surprised. The messenger assured me that his lord had broached the subject with you at an earlier date─when the arrangements for the peace conference were still being finalized...
Of course, the intervening moons afforded little opportunity for leisure. But with the happy advent of peace, 'tis plain the lord commander sees no further cause to delay. What say you?
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_A1_000_006: I should be glad to accept!
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_A1_000_007: I would, but I haven't the foggiest what to wear. Any thoughts?
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_A1_000_008: To be honest, I'd rather not...
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_HOUSEFORTEMPSKNIGHT: Indeed, who would not! You will forgive me if I seem envious. Ahem!
I shall send word of your acceptance to Borel Manor at once. When you are ready, pray report to the Astrologicum. They will have someone escort you the rest of the way.
Y-You would ask me!? Well, I...I am sure that as a personal friend of Ser Aymeric, you are at liberty to wear whatever you deem appropriate. That said...
"When in doubt, a man of note could do far worse than an alpine coat!“

...At least, that is what Lord Emmanellain has been heard to say. Ahem. When you are ready, pray report to the Astrologicum. A man of House Borel shall be waiting near there to escort you the rest of the way.
You─ You would rather not? Well...that is a great shame. The messenger went out of his way to express how very much his lord was looking forward to the occasion...

Forgive me, but might I trouble you to reconsider, if only as a courtesy to your friend, Ser Aymeric? At the very least, 'twill be an opportunity to sample the finest in Ishgardian cuisine. Should you choose to heed my counsel, a man of House Borel will be waiting for you near the Astrologicum.
Pray look for Ser Aymeric's man near the Astrologicum. He will escort you to Borel Manor.
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_BORELSTEWARD_000_04: I have the honor and the privilege to serve as head steward of House Borel─though, admittedly, our staff is somewhat smaller than those of other noble families...being countable on one hand.
Ahem! My lord will be overjoyed to hear that you have accepted his invitation. As you will soon see, we have spared no expense.

I daresay a  of action such as yourself enjoys nary a moment's respite. Aye, the battlefield beckons even now, I am sure, but for this day, we bid you lay down your burdens and raise a glass to peace and prosperity.
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_AYMERIC_000_050: Though the fates afforded us the time to share our long-delayed drink, 'twould seem the rest of my wine cellar will have to wait. As I am constantly reminded, there is no rest for the righteous.
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_EDMONT_000_055: However much we may change and grow apart...some bonds are unbreakable.
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Surely, surely they won't let her... <sigh> Yes, yes, I know. We must trust in Captain Whitecape and his chirurgeons. Did they not bring Estinien back from the very brink of death?
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_ALPHINAUD_000_061: ...I am uncomfortably reminded of how he mocked me for praying at his bedside for days on end.
TEXT_HEAVNE101_02341_ALPHINAUD_000_062: What say you, my friend? Shall we turn our attention to a matter whose conclusion we yet have the power to influence?
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_AYMERIC_000_000: Though I am not sure I grasp the full implications of her words, I know we dare not ignore them.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_EDMONT_000_005: Warriors of Darkness? Xelphatol? What is this all about?
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_010: So the Warriors of Darkness and the Ascians are conspiring to bring about Garuda's summoning, that they might put her to the sword...
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Then when we first encountered them in Loth ast Gnath...when they were confronting Ravana... Gods, has this been their aim all along?
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_EDMONT_000_012: What do you intend to do, Master Alphinaud?
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_013: There is much and more I do not understand, but I know this: a primal summoning cannot be ignored.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Alisaie risked her life to uncover this plot, and we squander her gift at our peril. , will you accompany me to Xelphatol and help me stop the Ixal's ritual?
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_AYMERIC_000_015: Given that Ishgard shares a border with the Ixali homeland, we have a vested interest in the outcome of this ritual.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_AYMERIC_000_016: We have been willing to suffer the beastmen's intrusions into Coerthan lands to a point, but the summoning of a primal is an escalation we cannot abide.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_AYMERIC_000_017: You shall have our fastest airship, Master Alphinaud. The mountains of Xelphatol are not easily traversed, and this endeavor demands all haste.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_018: The gesture is most appreciated, Ser Aymeric─but I fear an aerial approach is destined to fail. This is their homeland, after all, and Ixali dirigibles are not to be underestimated.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_019: No, experience tells me the only conceivable approach is by land. I believe it would be wiser to cross into Xelphatol by way of the mountain pass east of Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_EDMONT_000_020: In that case, I shall send instructions for a contingent of the camp's knights to be placed at your disposal. They will secure you safe passage through the mountains, and escort you thence to Xelphatol.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_EDMONT_000_021: Though my men are unqualified to confront a primal, they are more than capable of contending with the Ixal.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_022: We should be glad of their assistance, Lord Edmont.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_AYMERIC_000_023: In the event Mistress Alisaie regains consciousness, we will share with you any additional information she may provide. May the Fury watch over and keep you safe.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Then let us be off. We can procure any additional supplies we require in Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_EDMONT_000_030:
I shall send word to the acting commander at Camp Dragonhead of your imminent arrival.
Who knows...this may even spur me to nominate a permanent replacement. I have put off the task for far too long...
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Have you everything you require, then? Excellent.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_041: The entrance to the pass is north of Natalan and due east of Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Though it is normally guarded by a score of Ixali warriors, I have been informed that House Fortemps knights have already dispatched them.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_043: The enemy's gate lies open. We need but walk through.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Beyond this gate lies the trail which will lead us into Xelphatol. According to my map, it looks to be a relatively straightforward route, albeit one through exceedingly dangerous territory.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_CAVALRYB02342_000_0: We have everything in hand here, ! No need to worry! And may I say what an honor it is to work with you, !
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_CAVALRYA02342_000_0: , Master Alphinaud. As you can see, the gate is ours.
Be advised that our scouts are reporting increased activity around the First Mountain. Simply put, they are up to something, and don't want anyone interfering.
We stand ready to escort you to Xelphatol and aid you as you see fit.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_063: The enemy will be thick on the ground. Upon arriving, let us advance with care as we search for the site of the summoning ritual.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_065: If the gods are good, we should only have to contend with the Ixal─but if they are not, we may be forced to do battle with the Warriors of Darkness...
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Come, my friend, let us make for Xelphatol!
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_CAVALRYA02342_000_0: I won't lie to you: the trail will be hellish. But stick close and we'll see you safely through.
Well fought, well fought indeed! Lord Edmont will be pleased to learn that everything went according to plan.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_CAVALRYB02342_000_0: All quiet here, ! Nary a peep from the birdmen.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_090: All things considered, we should be grateful to have survived that encounter.
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_091: ...Do you think it could be true? That to save their world, they must bring ruin to ours?
TEXT_HEAVNE102_02342_ALPHINAUD_000_092: No. No, it matters not. Such wanton destruction is beyond justification. Whatever their reasons, they must be stopped. The sacrifice, the loss─it ends here.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_CAVALRYA02342_000_0: 'Twas a pleasure to work with you, . I pray the Fury grants me the opportunity to do so again.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_CAVALRYB02342_000_0: Seems our work here is done. No reason to linger any longer than we have to, eh?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Forgive me, this is neither the time nor the place for idle introspection.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_011: The knights can apprise Lord Edmont of our success, and we the lord commander. More importantly, I should like to see if my sister's condition has improved...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_012: You may take a moment for yourself if you wish. I will be at the Congregation.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Ah, there you are. Shall we make our report?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_AYMERIC_000_030: It brings me joy to see you safely returned to us, . What news from Xelphatol?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_AYMERIC_000_031: ...Then we were not too late. On behalf of Ishgard, I offer you my deepest thanks.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_AYMERIC_000_032: As for we who remained behind─Mistress Y'shtola has been tending to Mistress Alisaie in your absence...and I am pleased to report that she has regained consciousness.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_AYMERIC_000_033: I imagine you have many questions, especially given your recent encounter with the Warriors of Darkness. I know I do.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_AYMERIC_000_034: Come, let me show you to her room. Do not worry, her condition is much improved. She is a resilient one, much like her brother.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Would I be right in assuming that you have not spoken with my sister since...one of the memorial services, was it?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_041: By the Twelve, it seems a lifetime ago. I should like to think we have both grown since then...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_042: It has been many moons since last we worked together...though I believe the same cannot be said of the two of you.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Aye, I confess, I was aware of your subterranean expedition─of your search for the truth of the Calamity.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_044: I considered involving myself with her venture for a time, but as you know all too well, circumstances conspired to keep us apart. I can only assume she carried on in our absence...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_045: It was good of you to accompany my sister on her forays into the coils. The knowledge that you were with her did much to put my mind at rest.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Though I know not what she found at the end of her search, Deks and Sinis did inform me that she had taken to the road on her own, apparently on a journey of self-discovery...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_047: And what came of that I can only speculate. I am glad our paths crossed, regardless.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_048: ...To think that the three of us plumbed the depths of the coils and confronted Bahamut himself. Had I not been there, I would struggle to believe it.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_049: Shortly after we parted ways, I heard that she had taken to the road on her own, apparently on a journey of self-discovery. Precisely where to I never learned, though I suspect that was by design.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_050: ...So she enjoyed hearing tales of our exploits, did she? Hmm...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_051: My apologies for keeping you waiting.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_052: Right, then. Shall we be off?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Tataru never ceases to impress... Though, for a moment, I feared she might furnish you with an identical outfit.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_054: Praise the Twelve she did not! Mother and Father were rather too fond of making us wear matching clothes.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_055: Do you remember that time at the Studium when that girl of yours crept up behind me in the hall and whispered─
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_056: Sister, please! She was not my─ Ahem, can we not have this conversation in front of the Warrior of Light!?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_057: So be it. Another time, perhaps.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_058: It is an honor, . I realize we are barely acquainted, but having heard so much about you, it hardly feels that way.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_059: I should thank you again for your assistance with my expeditions, . Though we left matters somewhat unfinished, I am nevertheless prepared to focus on the task at hand and aid you to the fullest extent of my ability.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_060: As you helped me to brave the coils, so too will I help you to defeat the Warriors of Darkness.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_061: To be honest, , I wasn't planning on seeking you out just yet. When I set forth on my journey, I did so with grand ambitions. As you may recall, I promised I would not disappoint you...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_062: I pray you will forgive me if I do.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_A1_000_064: A pleasure to have you with us.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_A1_000_065: I've been meaning to ask about the carriage...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_067: Ah, yes, the carriage that so fortuitously arrived to spirit us away from Ul'dah after the banquet.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_068: The driver informed me that I had my sister to thank for his presence in Ul'dah. How did you know to send help?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_069: Oh, drunken Brass Blades are even less discreet than sober ones. Unfortunately, by the time I learned of the plot, it was too late to do anything more. Frankly, I'm still amazed  managed to find you.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_070: New garments aside, I must say that you seem different─more...resolute than when last we met. You have the look of a woman who is ready to fight for the future of Eorzea.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_071: To the extent of my abilities, perhaps, but I have no delusions of grandeur. Nor will I pretend to have “found myself” or any such thing.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_072: I am here today because I would regret it if I weren't. That is all.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Fair enough. Let us depart for the Waking Sands, then, and see if Urianger can be of assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Urianger─apologies for calling upon you unannounced.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_URIANGER_000_081: Why, Master Alphinaud. Would that the Scholar had seen fit to grant me knowledge of thy coming. What bringeth thee and thine here this day?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_082: The Warriors of Darkness have returned. Pray allow us to explain...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_URIANGER_000_083: ...I too have heard tales in recent days of primal beings rising up only to be cast down by forces unknown.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_URIANGER_000_084: Alas, as thou didst observe, this serveth but to spur the beast tribes to pursue their goals with redoubled fervor.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_085: We have two objectives at this time: to identify and remove the source of the beast tribes' crystals, and to take direct action to prevent any further summoning rituals from reaching completion.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_086: The second is easier said than done, of course. While we were fortunate enough to learn of the Ixal's plans before they came to fruition, I should be surprised if the Warriors of Darkness and the Ascians did not have similar designs elsewhere of which we have no knowledge.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_URIANGER_000_087: Thou wert wise to come hither, for this very day did I receive tidings most troubling from across the Strait of Merlthor.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_URIANGER_000_088: O'Ghomoro stirreth, and there are whispers that the Lord of Crags neareth his return. Mere rumors, mark thou─but in light of thine own discoveries...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_URIANGER_000_089: ...Thou canst ill afford to turn a deaf ear to their claims.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Aye─we must ascertain the truth of the matter for ourselves. Let us consult with the Maelstrom forces stationed at Camp Overlook, .
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Thank you for your counsel, Urianger. Pray inform us should you learn aught else.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_093: If I may, Brother─ Urianger, is there anything else you would like to say?
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_095: ...If not, then never mind. I only ask because you are normally rather more...verbose.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_096: Nothing to add? Very well. Ere we depart, I wish to make a request. The Warriors of Darkness spoke of how the Ardor had the power to “break down the barriers between planes,” that our worlds might be rejoined. I would ask that you research this for us.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_097: Being nowhere near as well-read as you, I'm sure I wouldn't know where to begin. That said, I have heard tell of a promising tome: The Gerun Oracles. Mayhap you could start there.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALISAIE_000_099: Camp Overlook, was it? Very well.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_URIANGER_000_105: We shall speak anon, . I prithee attend Master Alphinaud and Mistress Alisaie.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Come, let us speak with Commander Bloeidin and see if there is any truth to these rumors concerning Titan's return.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_BLOEIDIN_000_119: Seven hells, at this rate, I'll have to appeal to Maelstrom Command for reinforcements...
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_BLOEIDIN_000_120: Hm? Whatever it is, we don't want any.
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_BLOEIDIN_000_121: Well, fancy that! Just when my kobold problems look like coming to a head, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn turn up, itching to pitch in!
TEXT_HEAVNE103_02343_BLOEIDIN_000_122: Bloody brilliant timing is what it is! Right, then─let's get to it!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_000: (Is it just my imagination, or is Alisaie staring daggers at me?)
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_BLOEIDIN_000_010: So our friendly neighbors in U'Ghamaro have got much more aggressive of late, just as you said.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_BLOEIDIN_000_011: Matter of fact, our scouts spotted one sniffin' about the stores just now, likely lookin' to make off with an armful of crystals.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_BLOEIDIN_000_012: I'll be damned if I'm about to let that happen! Lend a hand and help us search the camp for the little bugger, would you?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_BLOEIDIN_000_020: Well? What are you waiting for!? We can't go lettin' thievin' bloody kobolds waltz into our camp and take whatever they fancy!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALISAIE_000_025: You've spoken with the commander, then?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Our Maelstrom friends seem notably more agitated than when first we arrived. Do you happen to know why that might be?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_031: A kobold in the camp, you say...?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_032: That would appear to corroborate Urianger's information, yes. But to be so reckless as to infiltrate a Maelstrom camp and draw attention to their efforts is passing strange.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Well, there will be time to think on this later. For the present, we must do everything in our power to prevent Titan's summoning─and that means finding and questioning this kobold.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Surely all this commotion cannot have escaped the kobold's notice. If he has any sense, he will attempt to quit this place, will he not?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALISAIE_000_045: One of the scouts said he looked quite small for a kobold. Could he be hiding somewhere like this?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_060: S-Stay back! Away, far, back! I'm n-not a...not a...
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_061: Gah, it's no use! Pointless, hopeless, no use!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_070: P-P-Please, d-don't hurt me! I only wish to talk. Yes, yes, just talk...
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_080: This was a stupid plan! Stupid, stupid, stupid! But...if I tell no one, then everyone will...
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_081: Gah,  found me again! What to do, what to do, what to do...?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_082: I...I come in peace, only to talk! Speak, say, talk! So please, please, do not hurt me!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALISAIE_000_083: So this is our wily kobold infiltrator, is it? No wonder the soldiers were on edge. He could very well give one a bruised knee.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_BLOEIDIN_000_084: Huzzah, we've got him! Fine work, Scions!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_BLOEIDIN_000_085: So, little one─thought you could sneak into my camp, did you? Plottin' to steal my crystals, were you!?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_086: No, no, no! I came to talk! To ask for help! But when your soldiers saw me, they drew their weapons and shouted, and I...I─
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_087: Now, now, let us all take a deep breath and discuss this like civilized...individuals. What is your name, child?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_088: (-Ga Bu-)Pickman Ga Bu of the 620th Order! At least...I will be a pickman...one day.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_089: Well met, Ga Bu. I am Alphinaud, and this is my sister Alisaie.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_100_089: , the  who found you, is our friend. And now that you know our names, we can be friends too.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Now, Commander Bloeidin here thinks you wanted to take his crystals, Ga Bu, but you said you came to ask for help. Why to us, and not to your own people? What happened, Ga Bu? Can you tell us?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALISAIE_000_092: No one is going to hurt you, all right? Not while we're here. I promise.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_093:
(-Ga Bu-)Th-The...
The patriarch, he...he's...
<gulp> ...The patriarch is going to summon the Great Father again, and you have to stop him! Beat him, fight him, stop him!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_094: (-Ga Bu-)Ga Bu's parents said they didn't want it, along with many others! But the patriarch wouldn't listen. He was so angry─raging, fuming, angry!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_095: (-Ga Bu-)He said that if they didn't have iron in their hearts, they would serve as coke for the furnace. And then the guards took my parents and the others away, and I haven't seen any of them since...
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALISAIE_000_097: I did not want to believe it...but I have heard tales of foci fashioned from the bones of beastmen, which worshipers use in their rituals, hoping to summon more powerful incarnations of their gods.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_098: By the Twelve... That is... That is sickening.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_100_098: (-Ga Bu-)No one listens to Ga Bu, no matter how much he cries─pleads, begs, cries! They do not listen, only talk about punishing the overdwellers and praising the Great Father.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_099: (-Ga Bu-)Ga Bu loves the Great Father, but he loves his parents too! So please, help Ga Bu stop the patriarch and save his parents!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Commander─advise Maelstrom Command that Titan's summoning is imminent. Should the worst come to the worst, we will require their support.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Time being of the essence, we three will attempt to infiltrate the kobold stronghold, secure their crystals, and free the prisoners.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_BLOEIDIN_000_102: Well, if you're sure... You'll forgive me if I don't seem optimistic. We'll make ready, just in case.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALISAIE_000_110: Do you know that there are collectors who will pay a fortune for beastmen ritual artifacts? It is perverse.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_GABU_000_115: I tried talking to the others, but they wouldn't listen! So even though I was afraid, I came here!
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_BLOEIDIN_000_120: I'll leave it to you lot for now, but at the first sign of trouble, I'm sendin' in the Swallows. Understood?
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_130: I have faith that we may yet stop the ritual. We would surely have detected the associated aetheric disturbance had Titan manifested already.
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_131: But I cannot speak for the prisoners. Twelve have mercy... That they would even contemplate sacrificing their own flesh and blood─brothers and sisters, mothers and fathers...
TEXT_HEAVNE104_02344_ALPHINAUD_000_132: Time is of the essence. We must see what else Ga Bu knows and formulate a plan without further delay.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Let us pray that we still have time to save Ga Bu's parents...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_005: What sort of twisted monster would consider a ritual focus a work of art, knowing full well how it was made? And we call them beastmen.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_010: I heard Great Father Titan loves crystals. Cherishes, covets, loves them, and if we gather enough, He will return. That's why the patriarch told everyone to go forth and gather them.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_011: So I was thinking, if we take all the crystals away, maybe the Great Father won't come?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Very good, Ga Bu. I was just thinking the same thing. Do you know where these crystals are stored?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_013: I know, I know, oh, oh, oh! Several spots, each defended by a different order!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_014: Ga Bu wanted to steal them, but he was too afraid to go alone. Yes, yes, too afraid to go alone.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_015: But together we can take them away and hide them! Come, come─Ga Bu will lead you to the first cache!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Pray see to the crystals. Alisaie and I will stand guard for any errant patrols.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_025: That hardly seemed fair. Then again, they only have themselves to blame.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Do you have them all? Good. Lead on, Ga Bu.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Hmm... If I did not know any better, I would say this crate was...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_055: What are you waiting for? We stand lookout─you take the crystals!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_060: If they find us, you'll protect me, won't you?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_070: Time is short. If you have the crystals, we should move on to the next cache.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_071: Did you hear me, Brother? Brother!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_073: I am quite certain that crate once bore Ishgardian seals. Someone took great pains to remove all traces, but enough remains to make out the pattern. See for yourself.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_074: I struggle to imagine kobolds traveling to Coerthas to obtain crystals, much less bothering to conceal their origins.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_075: I suspect these crystals were smuggled into Vylbrand by another party─most likely a pawn of the Ascians, as Thancred speculated.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_076: I don't understand. Who are the Ascians? Do they worship Great Father Titan too?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_077: Ah, never you mind about that. As Alisaie said, we do not have a lot of time. Can you lead us to the next cache, Ga Bu?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_078: Yes, yes, yes, of course! Ga Bu knows the way!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_079: This next one is the last and is very large! Very big, very huge, very large!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Ga Bu said the cache would be here, but unless it is remarkably well hidden...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_085: We should pack up the crystals and leave─now. The kobolds could stumble upon our handiwork at any moment.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_090: B-B-But they were here! Heaps and heaps and heaps of crystals!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_SYSTEM_000_100: Though you cast about for a time, you see no sign of the crystals...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Confound it. What about you, ? Any luck?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_102: Nothing, nothing, nothing! But this cannot be! Ga Bu saw them! Spied, spotted, saw!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_103: Think, Brother, think! They must have moved them, yes? The question is, where to, and why?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_104: ...Within O'Ghomoro, where they summoned Titan once before and mean to do so again. It is the only explanation.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_105: What about Mother and Father and the others!? We have to help them!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_106: And we will, Ga Bu, we will! Stay calm─we still have time.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_107: They have yet to call for the remaining crates, yes? If they had, then they would have found the other caches empty and sounded the alarum.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_108: Nevertheless, I believe the time for stealth has passed. We must breach the Navel and seize the remaining crystals. There is no other way to prevent Titan's summoning.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_109: But first, give me your crystals, that I might deliver them into Commander Bloeidin's custody. We dare not take them into the bowels of the mountain.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_110: Alphinaud is right. 'Twould be folly to deliver the kobolds the very thing we sought to deny them.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_120: The crystals, , if you would be so kind.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Thank you. I shall deliver them to Camp Overlook for safekeeping and brief Commander Bloeidin on the situation.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_122: Pray go on ahead. As I recall, there is an aetheryte within the U'Ghamaro Mines that should deliver you to the Navel. Ga Bu doubtless knows the way. Wait for me there─I shall rejoin you anon.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_123: Strange─I would've thought you eager to remain in the thick of the action. But if this is what you would prefer, then godsspeed, Brother.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_130: I hope the patriarch and my parents are there...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_140: Ah. I take it this is the aetheryte we seek? Right then.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_141: As soon as Alphinaud arrives, we go. I trust you're feeling suitably heroic, ─there's no telling what sort of resistance we'll face in there.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ZADA_000_300: Quickly, you clods! Briskly, swiftly, quickly! I will not suffer any further delays!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_301: Lay down your arms and surrender! We have your crystals. There will be no summoning this day!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ZADA_000_302: Overdwellers!? Here!? But how did you─
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_303: Where are my parents, Patriarch!? Where are they!?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_305: "Coke for the furnace“? You monster. How could you!?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ZADA_000_306: I... We are but servants of the Lord of Crags. We are His, that He may drink of our blood and partake of our flesh─that He might draw upon the strength of His children and defend them from the tyranny of the overdwellers!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_308: I understand, Patriarch. I do. Your fear, your anger, your hate...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_309: You would do anything to protect your people─anything to deliver them from despair. Whatever it takes to ensure that those who threaten you can never do so again.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_310: But in your single-minded pursuit of this objective, you have brought suffering on your own kith and kin. You have sacrificed the lives of the very people you sought to protect!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_311: But it need not be this way, Patriarch! Renounce this bloody course! Cease your attempts to summon your god, and work with us, together, to build a lasting peace!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ZADA_000_312: Another peace to be abandoned at the overdwellers' convenience! Oathbreakers, all of you! Liars, betrayers, oathbreakers!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ZADA_000_313: You take and you take and you take, and when you have had your fill, you sue for peace. You promise that this time, this time is the last─until you grow hungry again!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ZADA_000_314: And when we dare to defend ourselves, you declare that this “beast tribe” cannot be suffered to live! That our god drains the land of aether, and brings naught but suffering─death, destruction, suffering upon us all!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ZADA_000_315: I will hear no more lies from you and yours, overdweller! You've ruined your own lands─you'll not ruin ours!
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_316: I said I'd come for you, and I did! I'm here...I'm here...I'm here...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_GABU_000_319:
Wake up... Wake up...
Wake up wake up wake up wake up
wake up wake up─
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_330: He's breathing, and I don't see any injuries, but I can't seem to wake him...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_340: By the Twelve, how could I be so foolish? I should have known better than to let Ga Bu accompany us, given what we were like to find.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_341: His anguish and despair have served to birth a primal, just as surely as would the supplications of the faithful. Worse, being born of such tumultuous emotion, this incarnation of Titan seems incapable of naught but violence.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_342: If we have one cause for optimism, it is that while many crystals were present, they represented but a fraction of the quantity intended for the summoning ritual.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_343: ...Meaning that Titan must be far weaker than planned.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_344: Be that as it may, he is yet a primal, and the longer we leave him to bleed the land of aether, the stronger he will grow.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_345: And should Titan be permitted to leave O'Ghomoro, more lives will be lost. The Maelstrom will rally their troops, and the cycle will continue.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_100_345: , you know what must be done. Will you face the Lord of Crags once more?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_347: Alisaie and I will tend to Ga Bu. When you have finished with the primal, look for us in Camp Overlook. We will be expecting you.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_350: I have faith that you will return to us, just as you always have.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_360: You're back! Gods, what a relief...
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_370: Ah, there  is! Did I not tell you  would return safe and sound?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_371: The deed is done, then? Titan is no more?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_372: Good. There has been enough tragedy this day.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_373: He has been like that since he regained consciousness. We believe he can hear us, but he has made no attempt to respond.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_374:
He is almost certainly still in shock, but...
But we cannot discount the possibility that he succumbed to the primal's influence. Should that prove to be the case─
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_375: He must be put to death, like any other thrall. Such is the Alliance's policy, yes?
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALPHINAUD_000_377: But we must not rush to conclusions. After all, we once feared that Ysayle's followers were beyond reason, and many have since laid down their arms and accepted Ishgard's peace.
TEXT_HEAVNE105_02345_ALISAIE_000_378: ...We can but watch, wait, and pray.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_000: I know what happened. Gods help me, I was there. But the thought that we might have to... Seven hells, he's just a child!
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_010: There is naught to be gained from dwelling on an eventuality over which we have no control, much less one which may never even come to pass. Let us tend to more immediate matters─informing Commander Bloeidin of Titan's demise, for example.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_011: You may be certain that he will be glad of the news. Would you be so kind as to break it to him?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I expect the commander would enjoy hearing the tale of Titan's defeat from the  responsible, don't you?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_BLOEIDIN_000_030: Ah, you're a sight for sore eyes! When the others came back without you, I feared the worst, but they said you had matters well in hand.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_BLOEIDIN_000_031: All settled then, is it? I'm glad to hear it. But not half as glad as my men'll be, believe you me!
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_BLOEIDIN_000_032: Regardless of whether or not he was summoned properly, a primal's a primal. And there ain't a soul in the Maelstrom that hasn't lost a friend to one.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_BLOEIDIN_000_033: Don't get me wrong, like─we were all prepared to do our part. But we weren't so naive as to think we'd live to tell the tale.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_BLOEIDIN_000_034: Thankfully, of course, it didn't come to that─which, my friend, sounds to me like cause for celebration! Now, I know you lot have places to be, but why not stay the night? We'd be honored to raise a glass to the triumphant return of Titan's Bane!
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_BLOEIDIN_000_040: Ahh, I haven't slept that well in weeks!
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_050: What ho, . I trust you had a good night's rest?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_051: I was but this moment speaking with Thancred and Y'shtola via linkpearl. They had some interesting news to share.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Apparently, during the course of their respective investigations, both came across crates which had once borne Ishgardian seals. 'Twould seem that someone in the capital has been very busy indeed.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Accordingly, the Temple Knights have launched a full-scale investigation. Ser Aymeric believes that it is only a matter of time before the culprits are found, but we shall have to wait and see.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_054: In the meantime, it seems only prudent to look into the recent activities of the other tribes, in case they too are flush with Ishgardian crystals. And with that in mind, I suggest we pay Urianger another─
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Wait. Where is Alisaie? She was here a moment ago...with Ga Bu.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Would you be so kind as to look for my sister? She is doubtless somewhere in the camp, but... Well, I am sure you will find her.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_070: Ah, let me guess: it's time to leave, isn't it?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_071: My apologies for disappearing again. If it is any consolation, I have already packed my things.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_073: Brother. Commander Bloeidin. Something tells me you are not solely here out of concern for his welfare.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_074: But to answer your question, there has been no change. He will not speak or eat─I'm not even sure if he slept. If he did, he seems none the better for it. He just...shuffles about with that same expression on his face...
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_075: You will look after him, won't you, Commander─and treat him with every kindness?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_076: He's still in there. I know it. Beneath the anguish and the despair, he's still fighting with all his heart.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_077: He deserves to be given that chance. Until he comes back to us─until we know for certain what has become of him.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_BLOEIDIN_000_078: Aye, aye, you needn't worry. If he hadn't risked his neck to warn us and help you secure the better part of the crystals, this could've turned out a damn sight worse than it did. We'll not soon forget that, and nor will Maelstrom Command.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_079: I'm so sorry, Ga Bu. I truly am. You should never have been made to... And I know I cannot possibly understand...
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_080: Mayhap there is nothing I can do or say. The pain, the anger...the helplessness...
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_081: ...Hold fast to the memories of better times. Remember them as they were.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_082: And when it hurts so much your heart feels fit to burst, let it burst. Let it burst, and fill up again with your love for them. And never, ever forget.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_GABU_000_084: I...I will remember them. And you, Alisaie. Thank you...
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_086: Have faith, Sister. Your words have reached him. In time, he will recover...
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_087: And those who orchestrated these events will be made to answer for their crimes.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_088: A thousand times over, aye. There will be a reckoning.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_BLOEIDIN_000_090: Judgin' by what the little feller said, I doubt he's been corrupted. Sayin' that, we'll keep him close till we've heard a bit more─just to be on the safe side.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_100: We have heard the glad tidings from O'Ghomoro, my friends. By the grace of the Twelve and your most valiant efforts, the people of Limsa Lominsa may rest easy.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_101: I should like to think so, yes. Though we failed to prevent the Lord of Crags from manifesting, we did succeed in weakening him, enabling our friend to dispatch him before the Warriors of Darkness could make matters worse. 'Twas by no means an unmitigated success, but it will have to suffice.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_102: Then let us speak of another matter─one which weigheth heavy on my lady's mind.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_103: As thou didst request, I sought out The Gerun Oracles, that we might better understand the aims of the Warriors of Darkness.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_104: Though their copious use of allegory defieth any single interpretation, the oracles paint a most disturbing picture─one of worlds parallel to our own, apart yet linked, reduced to ruin with every Umbral Calamity...
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_105: "Seven times have they succeeded.“ Then of ten and three, only six worlds remain.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_106: Aye. All is as my lady Minfilia spake unto thee.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_107: As for what becometh of these reflections when they and the Source are rejoined...
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_108:
"Frail flesh undone in Umbral fires,
Each soul surrend'reth to Her call,
To flow unto the endless sea,
There to endure as one and none.“
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_109: Then...then if the Warriors of Darkness succeed, everyone in their world will die?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_110: In essence, aye. The verse speaketh of the renunciation of the flesh, and subsequent return to the Lifestream.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_111: However, this fate may yet be preferable to the alternative, for if the First were to fall to transcendent Light in the manner the Warriors of Darkness described, it would give way unto a void wherein none may know either life or death.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_112: Far better to die, they reason─for in death there is life. The essence of a soul which returneth unto the Source may be born anew. Saved. Such, at least, is their belief, I surmise.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_113: If that is true, then... Gods. No one should ever have to make such a choice.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_114: ...Ere we speak further on this subject, I would share with thee another recent discovery.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_115: 'Twould seem that several sizable shipments of crystals have been delivered into the hands of certain Ala Mhigan parties.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_116: Ala Mhigans? Strange... And you believe this to be the work of the same Ishgardian smugglers who supplied the beast tribes?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_117: I know beyond a shadow of a doubt. And lest thou wonder at their motive, I would remind you that the Ascians did once attempt to bring about the summoning of Rhalgr.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_118: The individuals who took receipt of these shipments are refugees belonging to a group devoted to the cause of Ala Mhigan liberation.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_119: It may also interest thee to know that their Ishgardian suppliers appear to be none other than the remnants of Eline Roaille's network of spies.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Surely you jest... And yet...it is not so surprising. Bereft of leadership and hunted by the Alliance, I can well imagine such villains being desperate enough to conspire with the Ascians. Assuming they even know─or care─who their new employers are.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_121: All of which is irrelevant. Forgive me. We must seek out the Resistance group which received the crystals without delay. , Alisaie─will you come with me to Little Ala Mhigo?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_122: Yes, of course. I should like to hear what they have to say for themselves. Firsthand.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_123: May you ever walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_124: Alphinaud, Alisaie, ─are you three listening? Good. I have tidings.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_125: The Temple Knights raided the smugglers' warehouse less than an hour ago. A cursory interrogation of the prisoners yielded confirmation that they were in the employ of─and I hope you are sitting down─a man in black robes.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_126: Then you have them? And the crystals too?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_127: What few remained, aye. Regrettably, it would seem they dispatched one final shipment in the hours before we struck.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_128: 'Twas bound for Little Ala Mhigo, we are told, where it will be received by members of a local Resistance group.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_129: Since Ser Aymeric's men no longer have need of my services, I have a mind to head that way.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_130: As do we, by happy coincidence. We learned of the shipments but a few moments ago.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_131: Hah! And there I was thinking I might finally be one step ahead of the Warrior of Light and  little helpers.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_132: ...Ah! Wait a moment! There is more! And I defy you not to be surprised by this revelation.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_133: The leader of the Ishgardian smugglers was formerly in the employ of one Eline Roaille─the infamous Ivy herself!
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_100_133: Once again, Thancred, I fear I must inform you that─
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_134: Thancred─with whom else have you shared this information?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_THANCRED_000_135: About the smugglers? No one. As I think I mentioned, the raid was less than an hour ago. I was planning to contact Y'shtola next, but is there someone else you would have me notify first?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_URIANGER_000_140: Pray proceed with all due caution. To what end these refugees covet crystals remaineth to be seen.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_150: What in the world has gotten into her? It is twice now that we have sought Urianger's aid, and twice she has treated him as if he were a stranger.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_151: The Archon was one of Grandfather's most dedicated pupils, and spent as much time at the Leveilleur estate as we did. He's practically a member of the family!
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_152: Truth be told, I struggle to recall a day from my childhood when I did not see the three of them laughing together.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALPHINAUD_000_153: If this continues, I may have to raise the matter. Later, though─Little Ala Mhigo awaits.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_170: I will get to the bottom of this...
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_171: Oh, forgive me. I was... It has been a long day. Did you have something to say?
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_172: Urianger? Oh, I... I've always struggled to understand what's going on in his head. Now more than ever.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_173: Listen, ─if anything should happen, it should be me who... Just know that I am prepared to do what must be done.
TEXT_HEAVNE106_02346_ALISAIE_000_174: Right, then. To more pressing matters. Since we have no idea when Thancred might arrive, I suggest we see what information we can gather in his absence.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALISAIE_000_000: Let us pray that someone will be willing to speak with us about the Resistance...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_010: So, to review: we are reliably informed that members of the Ala Mhigan Resistance operating here have taken receipt of several large shipments of crystals, our task being to ascertain who and why.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Given the size of the settlement, I find it hard to believe that anyone here could be wholly unaware of the Resistance's movements. The challenge, of course, will be finding individuals who are both able and willing to share such information with outsiders.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_012: It would seem sensible to divide our forces. , why don't you question the residents in the eastern half of town? Alisaie and I will do the same in the west, and afterwards we can rendezvous here to share our findings.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Have you finished already, ? If not, then we shall speak anon.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALISAIE_000_018: As outsiders, we must be careful how we broach the subject, lest they grow suspicious of our intent.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_SIFRID_000_020: Ah, let me guess: come to join the fight, have you? No need to deny it, friend. You're not the first to answer the Griffin's call!
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_SIFRID_000_021: While he's lit a fire in every Ala Mhigan's heart, he's also inspired more than a few Ul'dahns to pledge themselves to the cause. And little wonder─the Garleans won't stop until we're all under the yoke!
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_TALEBOT_000_025: ...I see you there, goin' around askin' questions. Lookin' for the Griffin an' his lot, I'll bet.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_TALEBOT_000_026: Seems they're the talk of Little Ala Mhigo these days. Folk wonderin' what he's about, what he's got in store for the Garleans─an' what's under that mask of his, of course.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_TALEBOT_000_027: Some say he's hardly got a face, what with all the scars. Others reckon he's been marked for death by the Empire, an' that they'd send a bloody legion if they knew he was here. <snort> Your guess is as good as mine.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_OTELIN_000_030: Eh? The Resistance? Damned if I know. It's not as if I'd be any use to 'em. <cough> <wheeze>
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_OTELIN_000_031: If you set store by all these tales of secret weapons, good luck to you─but I'm too old for the Masks' bedtime stories. This is our lot, and it's time we got used to it.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_SIFRID_000_040: The Griffin's the leader we've been waiting for, mark my words! With his help, we'll finally take back our homeland!
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_TALEBOT_000_045: Ever wear a mask like that? They're bloody hot! He must have a pretty damn good reason for wearing one all the time. I'd sooner stay indoors.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_OTELIN_000_050: Maybe...maybe if things were different...but they're not. I want to believe, I do, but...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALISAIE_000_055: Well, that was easier than expected. There's not a soul here who isn't eager to talk about our masked friends.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I suppose I should ask what you learned, but I think I already know.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_061: ...This Griffin seems to be the leader of a newly formed faction within the Resistance. The Masks.
