Yet despite their growing popularity, no one seems to know much about them─only that they are the most aggressively militant group to join the movement in recent memory.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Indeed, many claim their commitment to the cause of Ala Mhigan liberation is unrivaled. We can but hope their revolutionary fervor is never channeled in the direction of a primal.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_063: Though I feel confident that this is the group which received the crystal shipments, we yet lack proof. Before taking any action, I would speak with the settlement's leader to confirm my suspicions─and mayhap enlist his help while I am about it.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_064: Given that you and Gundobald are already acquainted, mayhap it would be best if you took the lead. Shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Naught would please me more than to be wrong about all of this...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALISAIE_000_075: To hear people speak of him, the Griffin sounds like a man in his middle years. But if that's the case, just what has he been playing at for the past two decades? If he's so devoted to the cause, why has he waited until now to do something about it? Unless, of course...he hasn't...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_GUNDOBALD_000_080: Much as it pleases me to see you again, , I cannot help but wonder if I should be worried. I hear you and yours have been asking questions...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_GUNDOBALD_000_081: The Griffin? Aye, I know of him, as do we all. He and his Masks have become a leading faction within the Resistance.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_GUNDOBALD_000_082: Though there was suspicion at first given his secretive ways, he quickly proved himself a charismatic and capable commander. Men are drawn to his passion and his vision─they truly believe that he has what it takes to lead them to victory.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_GUNDOBALD_000_083:
Even I cannot help but admire the man for what he's accomplished.
...But I have not forgotten Wilred. I was blind to the danger of his ambitions...and you were not.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_GUNDOBALD_000_084: The Griffin will soon deliver a speech to our people at the Sunken Temple of Qarn. Go and see him with your own eyes, weigh his words with your own heart.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_085: How convenient. 'Tis but a pity Thancred is not here to join us.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALISAIE_000_086: You two go on ahead. I shall stay behind and wait for him.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALISAIE_000_090: Whatever could be keeping him? If he's taken the scenic route, leaving us to do all the hard work, I shall treat him to a piece of my mind.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_GUNDOBALD_000_091: Men who can inspire such fervor in their followers are destined to shape the world. In what manner, however, is not always clear...until it is too late.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_GUNDOBALD_000_092: The young ones were led astray once. Help us ensure that it never happens again. For their sake...and for Wilred's.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Has it begun already? I hear voices coming from within...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_110: Of all the places to meet! It has to be fate!
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_115: Mayhap it is my imagination, but you seem rather more rugged and world-weary than when last we spoke...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Words cannot express how glad I am to see you both alive and well.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_121: And you! Though it was pretty obvious you and  would be fine.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_122: The Crystal Braves never had a realistic chance of capturing any of the Scions, divided as they were and distrusted by the better part of Eorzea.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_123: But if you truly believed that─ Forgive me. What exactly have you two been doing all this time?
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_124: ...Repaying a favor. After the banquet, we had no choice but to flee Ul'dah, and we would not have been able to do so without the aid of some old friends from the Resistance.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_125: That's right. They smuggled us out of the city and sheltered us in Little Ala Mhigo, all at great risk to themselves. Obviously, we couldn't let that go unacknowledged, so we offered to help them out with their operations for a while.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_126: When we learned of the Scions' exoneration─that Lolorito had severed all ties with the Crystal Braves, and that General Raubahn had been reinstated─we resolved to make contact. But having long since discarded our linkpearls as a precautionary measure, our options were rather limited.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_127: To make matters more complicated, we were embroiled in a delicate operation at the time, leaving me with little choice but to entrust a letter to a courier. I gather from your puzzled expressions, however, that you never received it.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_128: To be honest, we thought this might happen. While the Masks are happy to let the refugees spread the word within the community, they're pretty strict about communicating with outsiders. Oh, and we also heard a rumor that the Griffin doesn't want us meddling in his affairs.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_129: The Griffin mistrusts the Scions of the Seventh Dawn?
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_ALPHINAUD_000_130: Curious. It is well known that we are no friends to Garlemald. One would think the man we saw beseeching all and sundry to join his cause would welcome our support.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_131: Ah, I should say that the man you saw was not in fact the Griffin, but an impersonator. And a talented rabble-rouser, to boot. 'Twould not surprise me if he were responsible for the majority of these public appearances.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_132: As you may have gathered, the Griffin is an extremely cautious and distrusting man who has made every effort to conceal his identity. Even when we participated in a raid under his direct command, we were not permitted to approach him.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_133: It's hard to know what to make of it all. The secrecy, the impersonators, the masks...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_134: What!? It's not as if I'm making all of you wear one! And mine only covers half my face. It's completely different!
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_135: Anyway, when we heard the Griffin was due to give a speech, we thought it might be a good opportunity to get a better sense of the man behind the─uh, to get a better sense of the man.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_137: And now you have heard the whole of it. But tell me─what prompted you to take an interest in the Griffin?
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_138: Summoning!? You're not serious! I can't believe it...
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_139: The Resistance would never even entertain such a ridiculous plan, but the Griffin... Well, the man is an enigma. I cannot say with any confidence what he would or would not do.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_140: What I can say, however, is that the speech we heard today was not the first to make reference to a “power” capable of defeating the Empire. The Masks have made many such claims of late. I confess, I had assumed it to be mere bluster, but in the context of the shipments of which you spoke, it is not impossible that they are alluding to a primal.
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_YDA_000_141: Whatever it is, we'll find out together─and if anyone tries to stop us, they'll answer to me!
TEXT_HEAVNE107_02347_PAPALYMO_000_142: Indeed. That is...assuming you'll have us?
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_YDA_000_000: Do you honestly think he's planning to liberate Ala Mhigo with the help of a primal? I mean, could he really be that stupid!?
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_005: In retrospect, their tale is not so surprising. We had reason to believe that they had escaped with the aid of Ala Mhigan refugees, after all. Still, Tataru will be delighted to hear we have been reunited─once we have attended to matters here, of course.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALISAIE_000_010: ...He hired a chocobo porter, didn't he? By the Twelve, was the aetheryte not to his liking? <sigh>
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_PAPALYMO_000_020: If, as you suspect, the Griffin is indeed plotting to summon a primal, we must needs obtain confirmation while there is yet time to act. To that end, I propose we question his double.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_PAPALYMO_000_021: Given his role as the group's de facto mouthpiece, I should not be surprised if he were one of the Griffin's closest associates. And while he may not be aware of the most sensitive details, he can probably tell us the Masks' plans in broad strokes.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_PAPALYMO_000_022: Like the man whom he impersonates, however, he is wary of outsiders. He will not expose himself without a suitable incentive.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_PAPALYMO_000_023: My plan is as follows: you and Alphinaud will pose as adventurers fallen on hard times, inspired by his words to take up arms for a noble cause.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_PAPALYMO_000_024: Yda and I, as members of the Resistance, will recount tales of your past achievements, and testify as to your usefulness in the struggles ahead. With our enthusiastic assurances still ringing in his ears, he will decide to welcome you in person, and we will arrange a meeting.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_PAPALYMO_000_025: You will need to look the part that we might maintain the charade─until we have him cornered, at least. Here─this should be enough to purchase suitable garments from Talebot, and to have him rub a respectable amount of dirt on them for good measure. Any questions?
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_026: It all seems simple enough, thank you. And with that, , let us be off!
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_PAPALYMO_000_030: Talebot has an assortment of affordable clothing which he sells to the refugees. The sum in that sack should more than suffice, but if it and my name are not enough to secure his cooperation, pay him double. I shall see that you are recompensed.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_YDA_000_035: Our identities will be revealed, but it can't be helped. We don't have time for a cleverer approach.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_040:
Well, don't look at me. You are the one with the sack of gil.
...You do have the sack of gil, don't you?
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALISAIE_000_045: Oh, don't mind me. Just waiting for our fashionably late bard... You seem rather busy, so I won't keep you.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_TALEBOT_000_050: Eh? You want to buy what? I don't know what you're up to, but I want no part of it.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_TALEBOT_000_051: Well, you're the ones with the gil, and seein' as you're friends of Papalymo...
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_TALEBOT_000_052: There. Tunic and slops for the both of you, tailored and, er...treated to your tastes. Now, off with you, before someone sees us together.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_TALEBOT_000_060: ...Don't tell me you lost 'em? Thal's balls, ! <sigh> I'll give you another set if you did─but let's not make a habit of this.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_070: "Clothes maketh the man,“ as they say.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Right, then. I will go and change, and see you at the spot Papalymo marked on our maps.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Why are you not wearing the clothes Talebot gave you? They could be here at any moment!
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_076: If by some curious and inexplicable twist of fate you have mislaid them, go back to him and request another set. But for the love of the Twelve, do it quickly!
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Well, look at us─a pair of down-at-heel adventurers seeking a chance to recapture past glories. Yes, this should suffice.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_081: And now we play the waiting game...
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Quarrymill, he said? Do you remember...?
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Forgive me. You cannot be expected to recall every name and face, and besides, it's not as if it matters.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_092: I have long admired how you live in the present. How you focus on the problems at hand and always keep moving forward.
TEXT_HEAVNE108_02348_ALPHINAUD_000_093: So let us keep moving forward together, . We must find and secure those crystals─this is no time for looking back.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALPHINAUD_000_000: If we take the Griffin's double at his word, then the crystals are now somewhere within Zahar'ak...ready to be put to use by the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALPHINAUD_000_001: We must apprise Alisaie of all we have learned. I will join you both in Little Ala Mhigo after I have changed.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Ahh, that's much better. Subterfuge was never my strong suit. You are prepared for battle, then?
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_THANCRED_000_015: Kept you waiting, eh? My apologies.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALISAIE_000_020: Now that Thancred has finally arrived, mayhap you could share your latest findings?
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_THANCRED_000_021: You mean to tell me that while we were worrying ourselves sick, Yda and Papalymo were here all along? Well, Y'shtola will be relieved. And also angry. Mainly angry, I should think.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_THANCRED_000_022: As for the crystals, what choice do we have? We cannot very well leave them in the hands of the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_THANCRED_000_023: For all we know, they could be preparing to summon Ifrit even as we speak. We must make for Zahar'ak without delay.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Agreed. If there is naught else to discuss, let us depart at once.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_URIANGER_000_025: ...And so they go forth, in accordance with the Griffin's plan.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_URIANGER_000_026: The players gather to assume their marks on a stage wreathed in flame... Ere long, the curtain shall rise, and the drama of which I am author, gods forgive me, shall at last be performed.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_URIANGER_000_027: Naught else remaineth, save to stand at the ready and pray that the chance is seized. For never shall we know its like again.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_THANCRED_000_030: You'd think there would be more obvious signs that something was afoot─but, if anything, the place seems quieter than I remember it. I have a bad feeling about this...
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALISAIE_000_035: All seems calm here. Is it possible that we've been deceived?
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALPHINAUD_000_040: I confess, I expected a warmer greeting. But we must not jump to conclusions─not until we have braved the Bowl of Embers.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALPHINAUD_000_041: We must be ready to engage the enemy at any moment. If you would make any final preparations, pray do so now. I shall await your signal.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_SYSTEM_000_042: Upon proceeding to the Bowl of Embers, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_SYSTEM_000_043: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALISAIE_000_050: Though things did not unfold as perhaps─ I mean to say, I truly believe that she─ Forgive me. I should not have spoken. It is not my place.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_URIANGER_000_060: ...Speak thy mind. I do not expect thy forgiveness.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALPHINAUD_000_070: ...It would seem we are in southern Thanalan again. Minfilia's doing, no doubt. May the Twelve speed her on her way...and the Warriors of Darkness too.
TEXT_HEAVNE109_02349_ALPHINAUD_000_071: I cannot help but wonder what awaits those wayward souls. If they gave their lives in order to travel to the Source, then in returning to the First, would they not...?
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_000: ...We should talk about what to do next.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_URIANGER_000_010: ...Speak thy mind. I do not expect thy forgiveness.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_020: ...Hm? Forgive me. My thoughts were elsewhere. And this when I know full well there is yet work to be done. The crystals─
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_THANCRED_000_021: Leave them to me. I will go back into Zahar'ak and secure them.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_THANCRED_000_022: The Amalj'aa will still be in disarray after the thrashing the Warriors of Darkness gave them. They are not like to notice a lone bard skulking about.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_THANCRED_000_024: Don't have to do this, I know. But I want to. I will see you at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_025: ...I should go and find Yda and Papalymo. They must have finished searching the Masks' camp by now. Not that it matters anymore...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_030: You must be tired, . I know I am...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_URIANGER_000_031: If thou wilt permit me, my lady, I would ask a question. When didst thou become aware of mine independent pursuits?
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_032: When I saw you meeting with that Warrior of Darkness and the Ascian in white at the Great Library.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_033: I tried not to think the worst. You've never been one to confide in others, so I knew that even were your intentions pure, you would not share your plans with us until you felt the time was right.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_034: But I cannot deny that a part of me feared you had simply betrayed us.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_URIANGER_000_035: Would that there had been another way. Know that I took no pleasure in deceiving thee, and that these sins will forever weigh heavy on my heart.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_036: ...I understand why you did what you did. That you but sought to achieve the greatest good while inflicting the least harm. Not many would have the courage to make that choice.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_037: But even knowing what came of your actions...I find that I cannot condone them. I'm sorry.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_038: , forgive me, but I believe the events of the day have taken their toll on me. I should like to rest for a while.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_URIANGER_000_039:
If thou wilt grant me leave, I would gladly escort thee unto a refuge of thine own choosing.
Once my lady hath regained her strength, we shall join thee at the Rising Stones. Until then, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_040: (I have yet to tell them what happened in Zahar'ak. I thought it best to do so together.)
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_YDA_000_045: Ah, there you are! We've finished our search, in case you were wondering.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_PAPALYMO_000_050: Well met, . Alphinaud said you would be joining us.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_PAPALYMO_000_051: 'Twould seem the Griffin's double was telling the truth, insofar as we found nothing resembling a sizable cache of crystals in the Masks' camp. Did you perchance find one in Zahar'ak?
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_YDA_000_053: ...I don't believe it. The crystals, Minfilia, all of it. It's just─ I don't know what it is.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_054: I sympathize, Yda. Even now, I struggle to comprehend that which I saw... The only thing I can say with any certainty is that I feel blessed to have been granted a final chance to speak with her. 'Twas bittersweet, aye, but also...affirming.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_PAPALYMO_000_055: ...Alphinaud, I believe it is past time Yda and I rejoined the Scions. We have been away for far too long.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_PAPALYMO_000_056: Though I am loath to leave the Griffin to his own devices, I feel our investigation would benefit from your more dispassionate perspectives. And I hope that we might, in turn, offer our own opinions on the many challenges that you have faced in our absence.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_YDA_000_057: Gods, it's been absolutely ages, hasn't it? I can't wait to hear about everyone's adventures.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_058: We should be glad to recount them. And Tataru's tales may well surprise you.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_GUNDOBALD_000_059: Yda...? Yda! Rhalgr be praised, it is you!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_GUNDOBALD_000_060: Yda, alive and standing here before me, in the flesh! I can hardly believe my eyes!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_GUNDOBALD_000_062: Oh, come now, has it really been so long you don't remember me? It's Gundobald! I fought beside your father in the revolution!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_GUNDOBALD_000_063: Do not think less of her, friends! It's been twenty years since the occupation sent us our separate ways. But the Resistance were always welcome in Little Ala Mhigo. They gave us hope─and young Yda most of all!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_GUNDOBALD_000_064: Aye, Yda here was always full of fire, ever the first to volunteer for a mission. Until the day she up and vanished, that is! There were rumors, and we feared the worst, but here you are, alive and well, looking nary a day older!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_YDA_000_065: W-Well, what can I say? I...I'm sorry for running off like that and making you all worry.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_YDA_000_066: It's a long story, but, you see, I...I got involved with my friends here, the Scions─ Oh, sorry, we were still the Circle of Knowing back then, right! A-Anyway, I wanted to come back and tell you, but it was all very secretive stuff at the time and, uh...as you can see, I'm completely fine!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_YDA_000_067: I know we've got a lot to talk about─and we will─but right now I've got to hurry back to our headquarters. My friends are expecting me!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_PAPALYMO_000_068: Pray forgive her. It has been a very long day for us all. I promise we will visit again at the first opportunity.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_PAPALYMO_000_069: Let us return to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_PAPALYMO_000_070: Hells take me for giving you that mask...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_GUNDOBALD_000_080: Yda's father was one of the finest men I've ever known. A true leader of the revolution. He inspired countless others to rise up and cast down the tyrant Theodoric, and fought tirelessly for the land he loved.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_GUNDOBALD_000_081: ...But not even he could inspire us to victory over the Garleans. He died...and I grew old. But Yda carried on his legacy─our legacy...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_HOARYBOULDER_000_08: Huzzah! Have you heard, !? Yda and Papalymo are returned!
We have not had a chance to speak, but the mere sight of them was enough to raise our spirits! Huzzah!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_COULTENET_000_090: Many of our number are still out in the field, but I believe Ocher's party should be returning shortly.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_FLHAMINN_000_095: ...You needn't say a word, . I know. I know...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_FLHAMINN_000_096: Wherever she wanders, no matter how far, she will always be with us.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Welcome home, . I trust your journey was uneventful. You will be pleased to hear that Thancred has secured the crystals. He sent word a short while ago.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Once he has delivered them safely into the Temple Knights' care, he will rejoin us here, and we can declare this matter officially resolved.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_102: While awaiting your arrival, I took the opportunity to contact Y'shtola and Krile, and briefed them on all that has occurred. I also requested that they return to the Rising Stones at their earliest convenience. Now that our lost friends have been found, it would seem meet to discuss the future.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_TATARU_000_110: Leave it to me, ! I'll make sure she's properly introduced to everyone!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALISAIE_000_115: <sigh> It's official, then. Gods, I hope I don't regret this.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_YSHTOLA_000_125: As agreed, we shall spend the coming moons conducting our own independent research. Should you have need of our services, however, you are of course welcome to seek us out.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_KRILE_000_130: It would seem that I'm a Scion, then. Hmm... Some derive comfort from such titles, but I cannot say that I feel any different from before. Well, mayhap a twinge of pride...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_URIANGER_000_135: It may be argued that the great sundering of the Source was an aberration, and the existence of the ten and three reflections an offense to the natural order.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_URIANGER_000_136: That, most assuredly, is the Ascians' belief. 'Twas in the hope of opening mine eyes to said revelation that they first came unto me, imagining it sufficient to secure mine allegiance.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_URIANGER_000_137: Nor would they have been mistaken─were my heart a temple to truth alone. But as a devoted follower of Master Louisoix's teachings, and for the love I bear him and his, I hearkened not to their words.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_PAPALYMO_000_140: I suppose I should not be surprised. With everyone standing in a circle delivering grand proclamations about their future endeavors, she naturally felt obliged to make up one of her own.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_THANCRED_000_145: I have Ser Aymeric's assurances that the Temple Knights will henceforth keep a close eye on the Ishgardian crystal trade.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_THANCRED_000_146: Oh, and he extends his deepest apologies for your dinner having been cut short. Courteous fellow, isn't he? You would never guess he was a politician.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_HOARYBOULDER_000_15: Ohoho! Do not think I will be bested so easily again! When my competition with Lady Yda has ended, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn shall crown a new champion of the squat!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_COULTENET_000_155: 'Tis passing strange to think that we may never see Lady Minfilia again. After witnessing so many of our missing comrades return to us, I dared to hope that she might one day do the same...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_OCHERBOULDER_000_16: All these little mistakes are beginning to add up, Aenor! You must try harder to remain focused!
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_AENOR_000_165: I-I'm doing my best, Ocher, I am! I just can't seem to clear my mind. I keep thinking about you...and your brother...and me...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_CLEMENCE_000_170: (Trouble in paradise, eh? Heh heh heh...)
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_180: Look at them, . The Scions of the Seventh Dawn. Look how far we've come...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_181: The people we've met. The moments we've shared. The losses we've suffered. The tragedies we've overcome. All of it has made us who we are today.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_182: Where we go from here and what the future holds, only the Twelve know...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ALPHINAUD_000_183: ...But I know that we will find out together.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_IRONMASK02350_000_8: Well done, brother. You may resume your normal duties and rejoin the others. The coming battle shall be our greatest yet, and I intend to stand with you all on that glorious day.
I have given them everything they desired. All for which they have prayed. I doubt you can say the same for your pawns.
Get what you wanted, then? Was it all worth it in the end?
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: There were some...unexpected developments, but they were ultimately to our advantage.

Be it host to a surfeit of Light or Dark, a world bereft of equilibrium is but a void in waiting. And a void is of no use to my master.
I shall follow Her emissary with great interest.
As for the “pawns” whom you so pity...they have delivered unto me a gift, which I do now present to you.
The eyes of Nidhogg. Many were the candidates considered, but by your deeds, you have proven yourself the most deserving.
A man of boundless rage and bottomless despair, in whose breast beats a heart which thirsts for vengeance. Only you are fit to wield these eyes─for weal or for woe.
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_NERO_000_810: (-???-)Hmph. So it was here all along...
TEXT_HEAVNE110_02350_NERO_000_811: Oh, just you wait, my pretty! You and I are going to have so much fun!
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_000_001: Ah, , just the hero I wanted to see! Would you mind doing me a small favor?
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_000_002: I need you to meet me at the Diamond Forge. This won't take long, I promise!
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_000_005: You're familiar with Rowena's House of Splendors, aren't you? Wait for me at the Diamond Forge and I'll be along shortly!
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_000_010: I'm sorry to drag you away from your duties, but as I said, this won't take long! I just need you to stand perfectly still for a few moments...
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_100_010: Right, everyone! Ready to go to work?
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_000_011: No squirming now! Oh, and you might want to close your eyes...
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_000_013: There! All finished! The Warrior of Light's every measurement, from heroic head to intrepid toe!
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_000_014: ...Well, wouldn't you like to know! All in good time, ! All in good time!
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_YDA_000_016: Alphinaud wants everyone in the solar for a meeting. I don't know what it's about, but he seemed to think it was very important.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_TATARU_000_017: Go on, we have everything we need. No sense in keeping everyone waiting!
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_YDA_000_010: I hate leaving Naago like this, but I know Krile and Tataru will take good care of her...
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_PAPALYMO_000_015: After conferring with Y'shtola, we have decided to focus our attentions on the East Shroud. Someone needs to keep an eye on the border, not to mention the sylphs.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_FYRBRYDA_100_010: Your measurements were rather larger than I expected.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_FYRBRYDA_100_011: And no, I shan't tell you which ones.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_EGINOLF_100_015: If Rowena has the gaze of a dead-eyed serpent, then Tataru's stare is alike to a raptor what's sighted prey. Each is bloody terrifyin' in her own way.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_LUCIA_000_020: Greetings, Warrior of Light. What business brings you to Ishgard?
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_LUCIA_000_021: ...I see. Wait here. I will summon Ser Aymeric.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_AYMERIC_000_022: It is good to see you, my friend. 'Tis but a pity it must be under such circumstances. Had Lucia not informed me of the urgency of your suit, I would certainly have sent for some wine.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_AYMERIC_000_023: But to business. I thank you for bringing these developments in Ala Mhigo to our attention. Ishgard will of course send an envoy to attend the council in Gridania.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_AYMERIC_000_024: I cannot say who will represent us, however, as the choice is not mine to make─not mine alone, at any rate.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_AYMERIC_000_025: Given the imminence of the threat, we may forgo the formalities of a full assembly, but I will still need to consult my counterpart in the House of Commons prior to proceeding. Will you permit me some time to make the necessary arrangements?
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_AYMERIC_000_027: Our representative, whomever we select, will require a suitable escort. Make your preparations, and inform Ser Handeloup that he is to lead in your absence.
TEXT_HEAVNF101_02351_AYMERIC_000_029: ─pray accompany Lucia to the Gates of Judgement and make ready to depart for Gridania. I will have our envoy join you as soon as I can. Fury speed you on your way.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_HANDELOUP_000_001: Retaking our place in the Eorzean Alliance is a vital step in reforging our bonds with the wider realm. The Temple Knights stand ready to honor the promise our nation has made.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_LUCIA_000_010: If you have no other business in the city, join me at the Gates of Judgement. We must be ready to depart the instant the envoy arrives.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_LUCIA_000_015: You are perhaps wondering who will represent Ishgard at the council? As this is a military matter, I should not be surprised if Ser Aymeric nominated himself. He is yet lord commander of the Temple Knights, after all.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_020: We meet again. As it happens, my counterpart in the House of Commons agreed that I should act as Ishgard's envoy.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_021: ...Not, I concede, that there was ever any real doubt. As lord commander of the Temple Knights, it is my duty to sanction any military cooperation.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_022: Be that as it may, I could not in good conscience make the decision alone─not with the ink scarce dry in the republic's book of statutes.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_023: I trust you understand, my friend. Alas, I must test your patience still further by making a brief stop at Camp Dragonhead. Given the trouble brewing in the Black Shroud, I would see that the garrison is ready to defend the border.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_LUCIA_000_025: I am glad that Ser Aymeric's counterpart saw the wisdom in his coming. Few if any in Ishgard can claim to possess his expertise in both politics and warfare.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_030: The garrison commander waits within. Why not accompany me, ? You may see a familiar face...
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_EMMANELLAIN_000_031: , old !? How wonderful to see you! And Ser Aymeric, too! To what do I owe these unexpected pleasures?
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_HONOROIT_000_032: I will have some mulled wine brought up from the kitchens at once! If you will excuse─
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_033: Nay, do not trouble yourself, Honoroit─we shall soon be on our way. Lucia, a brief summary, if you will.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_EMMANELLAIN_000_035: Hmph. Those villains hardly need an excuse to wage war. Bloodletting comes as naturally as breathing to a Garl─I-I mean, to an imperial.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_HONOROIT_000_036: ...And thus we shall strengthen our patrols as you suggest. We shall also be sure to communicate these developments to Lord Francel and the Observatorium.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_037: I see you have everything in hand. Carry on, Commander.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_EMMANELLAIN_000_038: Surprised to see yours truly at the helm?
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_EMMANELLAIN_000_039: You and me both, old . I doubt I'll ever feel worthy to sit where he sat...
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_EMMANELLAIN_000_040: Yet we can but play the hand we're dealt. And with a little help from the veterans─and Honoroit's ceaseless chiding─I'm sure I'll muddle through. So worry not, old ! Off to Gridania with you!
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_EMMANELLAIN_000_045: I shan't waste my time attempting to replace him. I can but be my best self and hope that that's enough!
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_HONOROIT_000_050: I shall do my utmost to see that my lord is not overwhelmed by his duties. He can be surprisingly diligent when he puts his mind to it. If he puts his mind to it...
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_LUCIA_000_055:
It seems so peaceful...
One would scarce believe that Baelsar's Wall─and wretched Ala Mhigo─lie but a few short malms away.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_SERPENTHONORGUARD_0: I bid welcome to our visitors from Ishgard!
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_060: Diplomatic duties have brought me here on several occasions, but I find that I am as enraptured by the Black Shroud's beauty now as when first I laid eyes upon it.
TEXT_HEAVNF102_02352_AYMERIC_000_061: I fear that this time, however, events shall not afford us the luxury of enjoying the splendor of the forest...
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_LUCIA_000_001:
It seems so peaceful...
One would scarce believe that Baelsar's Wall─and wretched Ala Mhigo─lie but a few short malms away.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_SERPENTHONORGUARD_0: I bid welcome to our visitors from Ishgard!
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_010: It seems we are to have an escort to the Lotus Stand. A pleasant place to discuss unpleasant matters, is it not?
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_011: Yes, of course. 'Tis like that we are the last to arrive. Let us announce ourselves, shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_SILENTCONJURER_000_: The envoy from Ishgard is arrived? Very good. This way, if you pl─ Ah, and the Lominsan party, as well.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_MERLWYB_000_021: I had hoped to slip in unnoticed, but I see I was not the only one delayed in my arrival. Greetings, Ser Aymeric.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_MERLWYB_000_023: And , I trust you are well? 'Tis a day for reunions, it seems. I believe you are well acquainted with my escort?
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_YUGIRI_000_024: . I was glad to hear from Riol that the missing Scions have now been found.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_MERLWYB_000_025: There is much and more I would discuss with you, but let us first attend to the issue at hand. Shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_ALPHINAUD_000_030: ...That the council was able to reach an accord so swiftly is a heartening development in itself. I only hope my misgivings prove unfounded...
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_031: Ah, good, you have yet to depart. I feared I had missed you.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_033: Master Alphinaud, a pleasure as always. And Mistress Alisaie, how wonderful to see you thus recovered. Pardon the interruption. I had hoped to thank  for serving as our escort before other duties called  away.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_034: I also wished to thank our Doman ally...
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_YUGIRI_000_035: Forgive me, my lord. I was but awaiting an opportune moment to join the conversation, and force of habit made me keep to the shadows.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_036: No apologies are necessary, Mistress Yugiri. I was most grateful for your interjection when I offered Ishgard's support.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_037: My nation's historic failure to heed the Alliance's pleas for aid is a matter of record.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_038: Even so, the Alliance leaders were plainly unprepared for my impromptu apology.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_039: The resulting air of awkwardness might have lingered longer were it not for your timely offer of cooperation, which allowed the Elder Seedseer to accept us both. I very much appreciated the gesture.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_YUGIRI_000_040: I only did my duty, Ser Aymeric. The Empire is an enemy to us all, and we are grateful for the opportunity to fight at your side.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_AYMERIC_000_041: And full glad are we to have you. Pray convey my regards to the Scions, my friends. We must return to Ishgard.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_ALISAIE_000_042: Whatever is wrong with a simple “sorry” or “thank you”? Must these politicians always make a speech out of everything?
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_ALPHINAUD_000_043: That is how we adults speak, dear sister.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_ALISAIE_000_044: Hmph. Mayhap the ones who like the sound of their own voice. In any case, our business here is concluded. We should be on our way as well.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_ALISAIE_000_045: Will you accompany us to Revenant's Toll, Yugiri?
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Actually, I think I shall first pay a brief visit to the East Shroud. I am curious to know how Papalymo and Yda fared in their talks with the sylphs, not to mention what has been going on at Baelsar's Wall. I will join you at the Rising Stones anon.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_YUGIRI_000_050: Even now, I am astonished by how closely Mistress Alisaie resembles Master Alphinaud. Their very mannerisms are alike. From a distance, I should be hard-pressed to tell one from the other─until they opened their mouths, of course...
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_ALISAIE_000_060: Welcome back, . I don't know about you, but I am heartily glad that all of the talking is over. I understand that these council meetings are important, but do you not find it tiresome to have to weigh every word before you speak it? I doubt I will ever feel at home in the realm of politics.
TEXT_HEAVNF103_02353_ALISAIE_000_061: That said, people have been known to change. And if my brother is willing to run his own errands, anything is possible.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YUGIRI_000_001: Even now, I am astonished by how closely Mistress Alisaie resembles Master Alphinaud. Their very mannerisms are alike. From a distance, I should be hard-pressed to tell one from the other─until they opened their mouths, of course...
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALISAIE_000_010: Well, as much as I enjoy the bustle of the Toll, I think it's time we headed inside. My brother and the others will not be long.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YSHTOLA_000_020: Ah, you are returned from the council. But what of Alphinaud? Did some other matter require his attention?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Mine apologies, friends. I trust we have not kept you waiting overlong.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_022:
Greetings, everyone!
Oh, Krile─how's Naago doing? She will be all right, won't she?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_KRILE_000_023: I don't see why not. She's sleeping at the moment. Tataru is keeping an eye on her, so we'll know soon enough if there's any change in her condition.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YSHTOLA_000_024: Her wounds are healing well. With sufficient rest, I am certain she will make a full recovery.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YSHTOLA_000_026: Now, mayhap you would share with us the council's decision?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALISAIE_000_027: Each of the nations, Ishgard included, has committed to providing military support to Gridania. The Eorzean Alliance will soon have a significant force in the Black Shroud, ready to respond to any imperial act of aggression.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_028: You know, I almost wish the council would stop messing around and give the Griffin what he wants. I wouldn't like to be the imperial caught between the Resistance and the Alliance!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PAPALYMO_000_029: Yda, you cannot seriously─ One does not lightly go to war with the Garlean Empire.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Quite. To open hostilities without due consideration would be to invite disaster. <sigh> If only there were some way to reach the Griffin─some means to convince him to abandon this reckless course...
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PAPALYMO_000_031: It may not be entirely unfeasible.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PAPALYMO_000_032: There is a network of tunnels beneath Baelsar's Wall─secret passages dug by the Resistance to provide a way out of Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YSHTOLA_000_033: ...Which may equally serve as a way in?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PAPALYMO_000_034: Precisely. If all are in agreement, I would be the one to undertake the necessary negotiations. I am familiar with the route, and the Resistance is familiar with me.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_035: About as familiar as they are with me, you mean? Say what you want─I'm coming too!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YUGIRI_000_036: I have some experience in the practice of infiltration. If you would have me, my services are at your disposal.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_037: As are mine. It has been far too long since I shared a shadow with a shinobi, and I do not intend to waste the opportunity.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YSHTOLA_000_038: Four is quite sufficient for an infiltration mission. Greater numbers will only serve to increase the risk of detection. Krile and I will direct our energies elsewhere. What of you Leveilleurs?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_039: I will return to the East Shroud, and stand watch over the border. Should matters take a turn for the worse, 'twould seem wise to be on hand.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Might I prevail upon you to accompany me, ? Gridania will be safer for your presence. And...while it may not seem the most thrilling duty, dear sister, might I ask that you remain at the Rising Stones to pass on messages and so on?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALISAIE_000_041:
To hold the fort, you mean.
...Very well. I suppose the task must fall to someone.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALISAIE_000_045: I suspect Tataru would have little trouble facilitating communication between our forces under normal circumstances. But I concede she has her hands full nursing that Resistance fighter back to health. No matter: my turn in the field will come.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_050: All I'm saying is that it wouldn't be the worst thing if we ended up joining the Griffin's fight against the Empire. I mean, it's going to happen sooner or later, isn't it?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PAPALYMO_000_055: ...I may perhaps have exaggerated my standing with the Resistance a little. But I am confident that I have a reasonable chance of putting a stop to this madness before events spiral out of control. Yes, fair-to-middling at the very least...
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YUGIRI_000_060: My fellow shinobi required little encouragement to take their place amongst the Alliance forces massing in Gridania. They are most eager to cross blades with the armies of Garlemald once more.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_065: I am no ninja, but I did spend some few moons in the Sharlayan homeland learning how to move unseen. Between Yugiri and my humble self, Yda and Papalymo will be well protected.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_070: If you have any unfinished business in the Toll, pray attend to it now. I would depart for the Hawthorne Hut without delay.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_071: The nearby watchtower offers an unobstructed view of Baelsar's Wall, and I should be interested to speak to the Alliance commanders who have installed themselves at its top.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Ah, , there you are. Come, Amarissaix's Spire awaits.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_081: The Alliance officers on the platform should be able to apprise us of any developments at the Wall.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_082: Fancy meeting the two of you here. We were about to set forth.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_083: Indeed. I was about to say, “Twelve watch over you,” but I doubt you have need of divine protection, even if you are venturing into enemy territory...
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_084: Don't worry, Alphinaud─we'll have the Griffin by the scruff of the neck before you know it!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PAPALYMO_000_085: Do make up your mind, Yda. Nary a moment ago, you seemed ready to shake the Griffin by the hand rather than the neck. So, which is it to be? 'Twould be best to decide before we enter into negotiations.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_086: Trust me, Papalymo: I'll shake whatever needs shaking. The talking part I leave to you!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PAPALYMO_000_087: ...I think I feel a headache coming on. Let's be on our way, shall we?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_088:
Ah, some things never change...
Well then, shall we make for the spire? Our Alliance friends will doubtless have news for us.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_SERPENTSCOUT_000_08: Welcome, Warrior of Light. I assume you are here to speak with our commanding officers?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_SERPENTSCOUT_100_08: You will find them on the observation platform. Pray proceed.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PIPIN_100_090: Greetings, my friends. 'Tis good to see you both well.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_HILDA_100_091: I was hopin' you might turn up. I've dragged half the watch here, see, and the sight of you might help remind 'em why we bothered.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_RASHAHT_100_092: If memory serves, I have not seen many of you since the day of the grand melee. Having borne the brunt of your blows, may I say what an honor it is to stand at your side!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_100_093: 'Tis heartening indeed to see the realm's most stalwart defenders thus gathered in common cause. Speaking of which─what news from the Wall?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_VORSAILE_100_095: Report! What? Seven hells... Fighting has broken out on top of the Wall! A full-scale assault!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PIPIN_100_096: So the Griffin has made his move.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_HILDA_100_098: And what's that s'posed to mean?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_VORSAILE_100_100: The attackers, they─ They're wearing Grand Company colors.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_RASHAHT_100_101: Impossible. We gave no such order.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_100_102: Of course... The Wall was never the Griffin's target─it was bait. We have been goaded into deploying our armies nearby, thus lending weight to this deception!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_VORSAILE_100_103: If those uniforms were convincing enough to deceive my scouts, the Empire will surely think we've launched an offensive. This could mean war!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_100_104: Even so...this may yet be no more than a diversion. With the armies of the Alliance occupying the Empire's attention, it would be comparatively easy for the Griffin's supporters to slip into Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_100_105: He could then incite a rebellion amongst the populace which the imperial reserves would be hard-pressed to contain. Eorzea, meanwhile, would be plunged into chaos.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_100_106: , we must make for the Wall at once.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PIPIN_100_107: What, just the two of you!?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_100_108: Our companions embarked on a mission to sway the Griffin from his course, and are likely halfway to his command post by now. They will emerge in the midst of a raging battle and I do not mean to abandon them to their fate.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_100_109: It will be dangerous, aye, but the confusion may work to our advantage. If we are careful to avoid the skirmishing, it may yet be possible to reach the Griffin...and if we can do that...
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PIPIN_100_110: Lady Hilda─might I ask that you have an airship ready to bear the Scions to safety?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_HILDA_100_111: Ha! I don't know who this Lady Hilda is, Marshal, but you can count on me.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_RASHAHT_100_112: We must prepare for imperial reprisals. May the Navigator guide us through the storm!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_IRONMASK_100_113: Forward, comrades! The time has come to drive the Empire from Ala Mhigo, and force action upon those who have turned their backs to our suffering for so long!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_IRONMASK_100_114: Let this victory be the first step in the liberation of our homeland!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_IRONMASK_100_115: Ala Mhigo will be free─no matter the cost.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_100: From what Papalymo told me, the trail ahead should lead us into the shadow of the Wall.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_101: As we have two objectives, I suggest we divide our forces. I shall make straightways for the tunnels, and attempt to intercept our comrades ere they stumble into a bloodbath.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_102: While I do so...I must ask that you scale the Wall. Know that I would not propose such a course if there were any other way. But the time for subtlety is past. Take a band of your most trusted companions and cut a path through to the Griffin. Make him see reason─by any means necessary.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_103: Once we are free of the tunnels, we will make for your position with all due haste. And if everything proceeds according to plan, Hilda will then swoop in and spirit us all away to safety. I only pray that we have enough time.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_SERPENTSCOUT_000_11: ! As per Marshal Tarupin's orders, we will provide a feint to cover your advance. May the Crystal light your way forward!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YUGIRI_000_115: I understand only too well the desire to reclaim one's homeland...but I cannot condone such slaughter.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_120: Papalymo knew what he was doing. I could not refuse him.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_PIPIN_000_125: It has been explained to me what that light represents, and I have ordered our forces to stand ready. It seems we can do little else but wait...
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_ALPHINAUD_000_130: How many more must we lose...?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_HILDA_000_135: Every Ishgardian gets taught that the Sea of Clouds churns in the grip of the warrin' elements of water and wind. Enough to tear you apart, they say. No one's ever gone to the bottom of the abyss and lived to tell the tale. So how did that bastard manage to get his hands on Nidhogg's eyes?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_141: Why didn't they let me stay!?
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_142: Papalymo is my friend! I should have been there with him!
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_143: You could see it in his eyes, Yda. He knew what he was doing─what had to be done.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_144: Master Louisoix wore that same look, right before the end...
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_YDA_000_145: Do you think I don't know that!? I know, all right! I know.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_146: There is nothing more you could have done. Ilberd caught us all off guard. Even  was powerless to stop him.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_147: If you must blame someone, then blame me. Just promise that you will never forget what Papalymo strove to protect, or the lessons he tried to teach you.
TEXT_HEAVNF104_02354_THANCRED_000_149: Leave Yda with me. Go on. Go back to the Rising Stones. The others need to know what happened here.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_YUGIRI_000_001: I understand only too well the desire to reclaim one's homeland...but I cannot condone such slaughter.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_THANCRED_000_010: Leave her be. Nothing you can say will console her now...
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_PIPIN_000_015: It has been explained to me what that light signifies, and I have ordered our forces to stand ready. It seems we can do little else but wait...
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_HILDA_000_020: Every Ishgardian gets taught that the Sea of Clouds churns in the grip of the warrin' elements of water and wind. Enough to tear you apart, they say. No one's ever gone to the bottom of the abyss and lived to tell the tale. So how did that bastard manage to get his hands on Nidhogg's eyes?
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_030: ...Once again, I find myself at a loss for words.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_031: But Thancred is right. We must return to the Rising Stones and apprise our companions of...all of this.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Pray make your way there at once. I will send word to Y'shtola and the others of our imminent return.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Let us return to the Rising Stones. We must gather our companions...
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_TATARU_000_040: Why does everyone look so grim? Has something happened? Say something, for heavens' sake!
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALISAIE_000_050: ...'Twould seem you bring ill tidings, Brother.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_051: ...Aye. Behind the Griffin's mask, we found the grinning face of an old adversary... Ilberd. I know not how, but he had in his possession the eyes of Nidhogg, whose dread power he used to initiate a summoning ritual, even as we looked on...
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALISAIE_000_053: I don't understand. To attempt such a magick requires every onze of one's aether. No one─not even Grandfather─could cast it and hope to survive...
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_054: Indeed. It was ever a last resort─as I am certain Papalymo was aware.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_URIANGER_000_055: Thus did the pupil follow in the footsteps of his master...even unto the grave.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_056: I have as yet been unable to explain how Ilberd came to possess Nidhogg's eyes.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_057: In the depths of the Sea of Clouds, a perpetual storm of water- and wind-aspected aether rages. No mortal could endure such conditions.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_YSHTOLA_000_058: Then mayhap it was the work of an Ascian. But now is not the time for idle speculation. Krile, I have need of your assistance.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_YSHTOLA_000_060: We must inspect the cocoon of light, and ascertain the state of the primal trapped within. Between our respective talents, I daresay we shall glean some measure of insight.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_KRILE_000_061: Understood. I can't promise I'll be able to sense much through the barrier, but I shall certainly do my best.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_YSHTOLA_000_062: As shall I. Let us be about it, then.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALISAIE_000_063: ...What, without so much as a “by your leave”!?
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_URIANGER_000_064: Pray forgive Archon Y'shtola her brevity. She seeketh employment, lest her grief deprive her of the will to act. A desire to comfort Yda doubtless compoundeth her unseemly haste.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_URIANGER_000_065: I, too, must contend with this grievous loss in mine own way. By thy leave, Lady Alisaie, I shall honor our fallen colleague through gainful study. There exist writings which may yet further our understanding of this cocoon of light...
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALISAIE_000_066: ...Mayhap I was too quick to judge. Surrendering to sadness and regret would be a poor tribute to Papalymo's sacrifice.
TEXT_HEAVNF105_02355_ALPHINAUD_000_067: Quite. We must begin preparations to face Ilberd's accursed creation without delay. What time we have was purchased at too dear a price for us to squander it.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALISAIE_200_001: Ah, . I wish I had more to tell you, but the situation in the East Shroud remains largely unchanged.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALISAIE_200_002: ...Meaning we still have no idea how long it will be before─
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALISAIE_200_003: A communication from the Alliance! One moment.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALISAIE_100_001: ...Yes, of course. Our representatives will be present. My thanks.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALISAIE_000_001: Word from Gridania: the council will shortly be reconvened. The Alliance leaders have already begun to assemble.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALPHINAUD_000_002: They wish to discuss the primal, of course. As of Y'shtola's last report, the cocoon yet hung above the Wall, unchanged...
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALISAIE_000_003: Yes. But the Elder Seedseer doubtless shares our concerns about how long it will remain so. I am told that Cid Garlond has been called in to add his expertise to proceedings.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALPHINAUD_000_004: A wise decision. The more minds we have working on this, the better.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALISAIE_000_005: Well then, I suggest we leave the Rising Stones in Tataru's capable hands and make haste for the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_TATARU_100_010:
Let's see here...
Riol's report needs to be filed, Alianne has requested additional supplies, and then there's─ Oh! Don't mind me! Everything's under control!
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_SILENTCONJURER_000_: Welcome, Warrior of Light. This way, if you please.
TEXT_HEAVNG101_02356_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Well, that was a rather unexpected development, and one which raises a number of questions...not least among them how Nero chanced to learn of the council meeting in the first place.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Cid and the others are assembling at the airship landing.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Alisaie is already on her way, and it would not do to lag too far behind. Let us be off.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_100_010:
Let's see here...
Riol's report needs to be filed, Alianne has requested additional supplies, and then there's─ Oh! Don't mind me! Everything's under control!
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_CID_100_012: , Alphinaud! Ready to go? The others have stepped out onto the landing for a moment, lest you wonder. Nero insisted that he be allowed to inspect the Excelsior before boarding.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALPHINAUD_100_013: And you let him? Despite his very timely offer of assistance, the thought of that man poking about in the workings of the ship without proper supervision does not fill me with confidence.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_CID_100_014: Calm yourself, Alphinaud─your sister was adamant that he would never leave her sight. She and Yugiri are─ Ah, well here they are now.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_CID_000_020: Right, I think that's everyone. Shall I set course for Carteneau?
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Ah, might I ask that we delay our departure slightly? I require no more than a few hours at most. Our colleagues are studying the cocoon even as we speak, and I would hear their latest observations ere we proceed.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALPHINAUD_000_022: It would seem wise to gain as clear an understanding of the situation as possible before formulating our plan.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_NERO_000_023: Oh? I thought time was against us! How foolish of me.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALISAIE_000_024: Hold your tongue. When we want your opinion, we'll ask for it.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_NERO_000_025: Forgive me, my lady! I shall keep my counsel until such time as you have finished procrastinating.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_CID_000_026: All right. While Alphinaud speaks with his colleagues, I shall fly the Excelsior over to Mor Dhona, and we can reconvene at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALPHINAUD_000_027: Mine apologies for the trouble. I shall visit Y'shtola and the others forthwith, and join you as soon as I am able.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALPHINAUD_000_028: , pray accompany Alisaie back to the Rising Stones. I should feel safer knowing you are present to entertain our “guest.”
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_CID_000_029: Right. Everyone heading to Mor Dhona is welcome to travel aboard the Excelsior. I'll clear things with the girl at the counter here. Let her know when you're ready to leave.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_HIDA_100_030: You are traveling with Master Garlond, ? The Enterprise Excelsior is right this way.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_CID_100_040: Not quite a door-to-door service, but I couldn't exactly land her in the Toll's main square...
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_CID_100_041: Shall we adjourn to the Rising Stones, then?
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALISAIE_100_045: Strange though it may seem, Nero's former loyalties do not trouble me. But I can see why people are loath to lower their guard around him.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_YUGIRI_100_050: I do not care for that man...
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_NERO_100_055: What manner of airship has no private cabins!? Then again, I suppose Garlond had to find somewhere to stow his half-baked inventions...
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_000_050: , wait! Could I speak to you for a moment?
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_200_050: Do you remember when I had you meet me at the Diamond Forge, and we, uh...ambushed you?
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_200_051: Well, once we had your measurements, I set to work making you a traveling outfit in my spare time. I've only just this moment finished the stitching, but I wanted you to have it before you left. Here!
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_200_052: You can try it on right now, if you like!
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_000_051:
Assuming we measured correctly, the fit should be just right. Snug but not too snug, if you know what I mean...?
Sooo...how does it feel?
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_000_052: You're not just saying that, are you!? Oh, I can't tell you how much this means to me! To have crafted something worthy of the Warrior of Light is... It's─ Well, let's just say it makes all the practice worthwhile.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_000_053: I also sewed in a blood pearl charm to...you know...bring you home. May it always protect you.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_ALISAIE_000_030: One was created to capture Bahamut and the other to surpass him... Which will prove the stronger, I wonder.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_CID_000_035:
We must be careful, old friend. The walking weapons of Allag were expressly designed to subdue primals, but men like Gaius will always seek to use them against mankind. It falls to us to ensure that Omega is never employed as a weapon of war. In the wrong hands, it would be...
It would be bad.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_YUGIRI_000_040: Fear not. I shall keep a close eye on our new ally.
TEXT_HEAVNG102_02357_TATARU_000_045: I know Nero's a guest here, but we don't exactly have the happiest history with the Empire, do we? So my question to you is: do I offer him tea?
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_ALISAIE_000_001: Truly, I had no idea Domans could be so loud. He and Yugiri could hardly be more different...
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_005: Oh, I think he's going to fit right in.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_YUGIRI_000_010: Never did I think to hear Gosetsu's voice echo through these halls...
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_GOSETSU_000_015: My blade shall carve a path through the Empire's ranks as a scythe fells stalks of wheat!
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_NERO_000_020: The “Mark XIV Thermocoil Boilmaster”? Dear me... How risible must the previous thirteen iterations have been? I could design a more efficient water heater in the time it took that ill-conceived lump to become lukewarm.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_TATARU_000_025: How dare he mock the Scions like that!? If I ever had to sew a set of traveling clothes for him, I just might forget to take out the pins.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_ALPHINAUD_100_005: Just the two unexpected guests, then. Still, I suspect that each will prove useful in his own way.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_YDA_000_030: So we have to wake Omega up, right? When do we start?
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Yda, you... Are you sure that's...?
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_YDA_000_032: I'm sure, yes. I won't lie and say I'm completely fine, but I'll feel a lot better if I'm doing something useful.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_ALISAIE_000_033: Very well. I will remain here and continue coordinating our efforts with the Alliance. Alphinaud, mayhap you could return to Gridania and assist Y'shtola and Krile?
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_035: The rest of us will form the Carteneau expedition party. Nero and I will focus on rousing Omega, while , Yda, and our Doman friends take care of security.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_036: The Excelsior is by the lake just outside town. We'll leave as soon as everyone is ready.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_YUGIRI_000_040: Gosetsu is an accomplished swordsman. Should it come to battle, he will prove a staunch ally. Would that I could say the same for Nero.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_GOSETSU_000_045: ...Will this contraption truly bear us through the skies!?
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_NERO_000_050:
Soon, Omega, soon...
I will see you rise again!
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_YDA_000_055: I was a bit...lost for a while back there─but I'll be fine. Trust me.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_ALISAIE_100_020: Go and save the realm, . I have everything in hand here.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_TATARU_100_025: I do hope you like your new outfit. It may just be my finest creation!
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_060: We haven't far to go─with any luck, we'll be in Carteneau before Gosetsu graces the deck with his dinner.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_061: Once there, however, we had best be on our guard. Given that Eline Roaille was still active when Omega was discovered, we can be sure that the Empire has long been aware of its existence. And if Nero deemed it the obvious solution to the threat posed by this new primal, it is not impossible that Garlemald might do the same.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_062: Have your weapons ready and your wits about you. Something tells me we're flying into a fight.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_NERO_100_062: Are you still playing with those soldiers? <sigh> I suppose I can lend you one of my toys─but only if you promise to give it back.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_NERO_100_063: Behold! The Red Baron! Now end this nonsense!
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_GRYNEWAHT_100_064: What the─? No one told me they'd have magitek armor! Er...forward! For the Empire!
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_GOSETSU_100_065: The honorless cur thinks to abandon his men? I shall see that he shares their fate! Pray attend to the rest of his minions!
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_065: I take it you're ready to make for the control room?
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_080: I'm not sure why we lost contact with Omega, but I mean to find out. Let's be on our way.
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_ALPHINAUD_000_105: I came as soon as I heard the Excelsior had been spotted on its approach...
TEXT_HEAVNG103_02358_CID_000_110: One moment everything was functioning perfectly and the next it wasn't. It makes no sense. We need to see what happened for ourselves, and soon.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALISAIE_100_001: I am always glad to see you, , but wasn't your presence required in Gridania?
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_TATARU_100_005: ! You're back! I knew those blood pearl charms were worth the effort! Maybe I should make some more!?
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_CID_000_020: Alphinaud looks like he has news for us. I almost dread to ask...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Words can ill express how glad I am to see you all unharmed. When Omega came hurtling towards the cocoon, everything dissolved into chaos...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_YDA_000_031: I have to see it... I have to see it with my own eyes!
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_032:
Yda, wait! We must first─
<sigh> The Elder Seedseer is expecting us...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_YUGIRI_000_033: Worry not, Alphinaud─Gosetsu and I will watch over her. You may safely attend your meeting.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_035: The council reconvened a short while ago. Let us make haste for the Lotus Stand. All there are eager to hear your testimony.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_SILENTCONJURER_000_: The Elder Seedseer awaits you within.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_RAUBAHN_000_055: 'Twould seem Garlond's little friend was as good as his word.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_AYMERIC_000_060: Had I not instructed you to throw Nidhogg's accursed eyes into the abyss, all of this might have been avoided. I thought them beyond reach...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_MERLWYB_000_065: Another Calamity averted, eh? How many times now have you and yours hauled us back from the brink?
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_KANESENNA_000_070: My friends, full eagerly have we awaited your return. Few indeed could have discharged the duty entrusted to you, and most humbly do we thank you for seeing it done.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_CID_000_071: You are too kind, Elder Seedseer. As I recall, we as good as demanded the right to try. But tell me: how did the battle unfold?
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_CID_000_072: We succeeded in waking Omega, aye, but we lost contact with the weapon shortly after it launched. From our position in the control room, we were blind to all that followed...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_MERLWYB_000_073: ...What words could do justice to such a scene? None of my choosing, that much is certain. But I can give you the facts: the cocoon hatched even as Omega arrived, and from its midst rose a great dragon. The pair duly set about each other in the skies over Gyr Abania.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_AYMERIC_000_074: The primal's might defied belief─it seemed the very heavens would be rent asunder by the force of its blows. And it wielded such magicks as I have never seen...and hope never to see again.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_AYMERIC_000_075: The battle raged on with no end in sight, until both combatants were engulfed in a blinding flash of light. When the radiance faded, I saw the pair fall motionless from the sky, coming to rest somewhere on Ala Mhigan soil. I will not speak for the rest, but to my eye it seemed that each had landed a fatal blow upon the other...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_KANESENNA_000_076: While most among us could think only of Bahamut when looking upon the primal's form, the Domans were heard to whisper the name “Shinryu.” It would appear that the being resembles a creature of Far Eastern legend, and we have found it convenient to refer to it as such.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_KANESENNA_000_077: This Shinryu's fate─and indeed, that of Omega─is yet unknown. We have, alas, no eyes on the Gyr Abanian side of the border.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_RAUBAHN_000_078: Aye. Which is why we have sent our main force, under the command of Marshal Tarupin, to capture the Wall.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_RAUBAHN_000_079: With the imperials in disarray, we have the perfect opportunity to secure Gridania's border, and assess the aftermath of the impact. I myself will join the marshal and his men when the council is adjourned.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_CID_000_080: Well, that explains a few things. I'll wager that “flash of light” coincided with our loss of contact...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_CID_000_081: Lest you wonder, we quickly reengaged Omega's stasis systems, so even if it has fallen into the Empire's lap, it will be of no use to them─save perhaps as a statue.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_NERO_000_082: Correct. Without me to guide their efforts, it would take them decades to decipher Omega's core functions, if they managed it at all.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_KANESENNA_000_083: Such reassurances do much to calm our fears─yet the relic's fate is but one of several concerns.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_AYMERIC_000_084: Indeed. I humbly submit that the time has come for us to make contact with the Resistance representatives in Gyr Abania. Though Ilberd has forced our hand, it would seem only logical to seek an alliance, given the inevitability of imperial retaliation. And by working in concert, it is not impossible that Ala Mhigo might finally be wrested from Garlemald's grasp.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_RAUBAHN_000_085: I go to oversee operations at Baelsar's Wall. You have done your part─leave us to handle the initial imperial reprisal and rest while you may.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_AYMERIC_000_090: This operation to take the Wall will be Ishgard's first military action under Alliance banners. Though I have no appetite for bloodshed, a part of me is glad of the chance to begin reparations for our past inaction.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_MERLWYB_000_095: When the primal emerged, I was for an instant transported back to Carteneau...to the moment the black wyrm made an eighth hell of the battlefield. Gladly would I live out the rest of my days without seeing such a sight again.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_CID_000_100: If, as seems likely, we put Omega into stasis after─what did they call it? Ah, yes─after “Shinryu” was defeated, we should have little to fear from either one of them.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_NERO_000_105: I should very much like to see this “Shinryu” creature for myself.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_KANESENNA_100_085: Pray accept my humblest and most earnest thanks once again, Warrior of Light. Had Shinryu been suffered to roam free, the Twelveswood would surely have been laid waste.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_120: You must be exhausted. I would ordinarily suggest that we retire directly to the Rising Stones...but I wonder if we might first make a small detour?
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Y'shtola and the others have gathered at Amarissaix's Spire, and I imagine that you, too, would be interested to see what has become of the Wall now the cocoon is gone.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_122: It is decided then. Lead on.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_GOSETSU_000_125: Only the curs of Garlemald would sully such beauty with that black iron monstrosity. Those animals respect nothing and no one!
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_YUGIRI_000_130: Yda is there, atop the spire. She has done naught but gaze silently at the Wall for some time now...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_KRILE_100_125: Oh, thank the Twelve. After witnessing Omega's single-minded onslaught, I had visions of you being trapped between it and its target. Hardly the most rational concern, I concede, but if you had seen what I saw...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_100_130: No trace of the cocoon remains. 'Tis as if it never existed.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_140: It was brave of Lyse to remove her mask after so long...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_141: Though she has scarce begun to come to terms with Papalymo's loss, that one act made plain her determination to move forward.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_142: And should she ever falter, we shall be there to support her on this road she has resolved to walk.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_143: Let us return to the Rising Stones. We have quite a story to tell Tataru and my sister...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_LYSE_000_145: I'm going to stay here until the Alliance calls on us. That way, I'll be close by if anything happens.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_YSHTOLA_000_150: I will stay with her a while longer...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALPHINAUD_000_155: You should have seen the look on Tataru's face when I recounted Lyse's─ Ah. I realize in retrospect that I should perhaps have waited for you to return... I, uh...also told Alisaie. Apologies.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_TATARU_000_160: Did you know about Yd─I mean, “Lyse”? I had no idea! We only met after the Calamity, and her sister must already have been... Well, you know.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALISAIE_000_170: He may have mentioned, but Alphinaud has apprised me of all that came to pass in Gridania. Your only task now is to rest. This is the calm before the storm.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALISAIE_000_171: Lyse has chosen her path, and as her friends, we must do what we can to support that choice. We are fated to join the conflict in any case. Once the Alliance has taken the Wall and opened the way to Gyr Abania, we will have little choice but to fight.
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ALISAIE_000_172: Which is not to say the cause is unworthy. After all, ignoring the plight of those whom one might conceivably save is not wisdom but indolence, correct? I for one look forward to joining hands with the Ala Mhigans, and striking a blow against the tyranny of the Empire─as, I rather suspect, do you!
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_PIPIN_100_180: Quick march! The imperials will soon come to their senses, and we must be ready to face their retribution!
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_PIPIN_100_183: I learned to brace myself against the charge of the Bull of Ala Mhigo. No foe will dislodge me!
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_RAUBAHN_100_184:
Very well, Ilberd...
I will take our homeland back...
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_IMPERIALOFFICER_000: My lord Viceroy─our scouts have confirmed the preliminary reports. Baelsar's Wall has fallen to the Eorzean Alliance.

The hunt for Omega and the unknown eikon continues, though both yet elude us. My lord...their battle caused considerable damage across the region... Should we perchance divert some of our forces from the search to undertake necessary reconstruction work?
I─ Forgive me, my lord! I did not intend─ Your will be done!
TEXT_HEAVNG104_02359_ZENOS_000_183:
(-Viceroy-)"Unknown“? My spies tell me the Domans call it ”Shinryu,“ and that it proved a match for Omega.
Yes...the coming days promise to be most interesting.
Most interesting.
